assumptions.notes: Low-mileage owner, 6,000-8,000 km/year, well below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000 / 21000 / 35000 / 49000 / 70000). CRITICAL consequence for this car, verified and RETAINED across both prior audits because it is correct: Lexus Taiwan's official service interval is 6 months OR 10,000 km, whichever comes FIRST (lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx). At 7,000 km/year the TIME trigger always fires first, so the owner still makes ~2 shop visits per year — the same visit count as a 20,000 km/year driver. Low mileage therefore saves far less on maintenance than buyers expect; it mainly buys a resale premium, not a service discount. On the resale side, 21,000 km at 3 years and 70,000 km at 10 years are roughly half the mileage-blind market average, so a low-mileage premium of roughly 3-6% over the average listing is embedded at each checkpoint. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded from this record by design. AUDIT NOTE (this pass, in response to a cross-trim review): the FRONT of the resale curve was cut again — years 1, 3 and 5. The reviewer's objection was that at 75.6% / 64.4% / 56.3% this PHEV out-retained the CHEAPER gasoline NX350 Overtrail (70.6% / 60.9% / 52.5%) at every early checkpoint, and even beat the NX200 豪華版 (75.1%) at year 1, which inverts the stated Taiwan Lexus ordering (hybrid > gasoline > PHEV). That objection is upheld: I re-searched the Taiwan used market this pass and found NO evidence of any PHEV-specific support for early retention, and strong evidence against it (see value_checkpoints year 1). Year 5 moved too even though the reviewer did not name it, because the prior draft's own source string derived year 5 by 'extending the same-generation curve past the 3-year anchor above' — it is a dependent value, not an independent observation, so correcting the year-3 anchor necessarily moves it. Years 7 and 10 are UNCHANGED: the reviewer agreed they already sit correctly last, and the rebuilt curve lands on them naturally.

purchase.source: 建議售價 NT$2,375,000 — RE-VERIFIED AGAIN IN THIS AUDIT against two independent pages fetched on 2026-08-11. (1) The TVBS 地球黃金線 2026 Lexus NX spec/price table (https://cars.tvbs.com.tw/spec/lexus/2026-lexus-nx) returns the full 2026 lineup: 200菁英版 171萬 / 200豪華版 181萬 / 350h豪華版 207.5萬 / 350h頂級版 227.5萬 / 350 Overtrail版 234萬 / 450h+豪華版 237.5萬 / 350h旗艦版 257.5萬 / 350 F Sport版 263萬 / 450h+ F Sport版 284.5萬, and explicitly states 450h+豪華版 = 237.5萬. (2) NEW THIS PASS — Lexus Taiwan's own NX page (https://www.lexus.com.tw/models/nx/price) publishes the range 'NX NT$171~284.5萬, 450h+ / 350h / 350 / 200', which pins both endpoints of the TVBS table to the manufacturer and confirms 450h+ is still in the 2026 lineup. NX250 remains absent from the 2026 lineup. The price is CORRECT to within 0%; no correction applied and none was needed. onroad_fees is my own build-up, not a quoted figure. Historical trail also stands: KingAutos' 2022 single-model page (https://www.kingautos.net/spec/9591) returns '2022 Lexus NX 450h+ 豪華版, 定價 229 萬元', confirming the launch price and giving a sound denominator for the 3-year retention calculation on 2023 cars.
purchase.notes: discounts = 0 RETAINED after a second challenge. I again considered forcing a discount for consistency with the rest of this batch (the sibling NX350h 豪華版 books 120,000, the NX450h+ F Sport books 60,000, the RX450h+ 豪華版 books 150,000), and again declined: the brief explicitly sanctions a zero discount for Lexus, the NX450h+ is the range's only PHEV and is genuinely allocation-limited, and inventing a cash figure I cannot source would be a fabrication. Flagged as a batch-consistency issue instead. onroad_fees = 32,000 is a clean cash build-up with nothing netted into it: 領牌 + 監理規費 + 代辦 ~12,000; 常見自費配件 (前後行車紀錄器、隔熱紙、車美仕踏板/飾條、底盤防鏽) ~20,000. This sits mid-band for the 20,000-40,000 expected at this price level and between the sibling NX350h (35,000) and RX450h+ (40,000). A note retained from the prior audit because it is a genuine field-semantics rule: gifted accessories should REDUCE onroad_fees, they must NOT be hidden as a negative discount, and they are not netted in here. real_cost = 2,375,000 - 0 + 32,000 = 2,407,000 (arithmetic re-checked this pass). Tax and insurance are excluded by design and are NOT in this figure — for reference only, 風傳媒 puts this car's 牌照稅+燃料稅 at roughly NT$22,400/year (2488cc band), deliberately left out. Note for the resale discussion below: Taiwan taxes PHEVs on ENGINE DISPLACEMENT like any petrol car, so this car carries a full 2.5-litre-band 牌照稅 — there is no PHEV tax break to prop up its used value.

items.name: 過戶費 + 監理代辦
售前整備、內外美容與拋光
8891 / abc好車網 刊登廣告費

selling_costs.notes: UNCHANGED — audited twice and found sound; the reviewer did not object. Items sum to exactly 10,000, matching the stated total, and the figure sits mid-band for the 5,000-12,000 expected at this price level and in line with the batch siblings (NX350h 豪華版 11,000, NX450h+ F Sport 10,000, NX350 Overtrail 10,500, ES300h 10,000, RX450h+ 13,000). Private-sale scenario (自售), consistent with private_sale_price being the headline resale figure. The 過戶 regulatory fee itself is only ~NT$1,200; the 2,500 assumes 代辦 through an agent, which is what most private sellers of a 2.4M-class car actually do. 售前整備 at this price level means a proper detail, paint correction and minor touch-up. 刊登費 covers a paid 加值 listing slot. Note this applies to the private-sale route only; a dealer trade-in carries essentially zero selling cost because the dealer absorbs 過戶 and 整備 — part of why dealer_tradein_price is lower. One caveat worth stating given this pass's findings: 10,000 assumes a normal time-to-sale. A car with no comparable inventory anywhere on the two largest platforms may sit for months, and a second round of 刊登費 is a realistic risk; that illiquidity is priced into private_sale_price rather than inflated here.

value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED DOWNWARD AGAIN, from 1,820,000 to 1,720,000 (-5.5%), upholding the reviewer's objection. The prior pass had already cut this point from 1,920,000 but did not cut it far enough: at 1,820,000 the PHEV retained 75.6% of real_cost, ABOVE the cheaper gasoline NX350 Overtrail (70.6%) and even fractionally above the much cheaper gasoline NX200 豪華版 (75.1%), which inverts the brief's stated Taiwan Lexus ordering (hybrid > gasoline > PHEV). THE UNDERLYING ERROR: the prior draft set PHEV dealer retail at 86% of real_cost — ABOVE the gasoline base trim's observed level — and justified it with 'a new 450h+ order still means a months-long wait'. That reasoning is backwards. A new-car waiting list supports the NEW price, not the used price; and for a used car the relevant fact is the opposite one, that no dealer wants to stock it. I SEARCHED SPECIFICALLY FOR EVIDENCE THAT WOULD JUSTIFY KEEPING THE HIGHER FIGURE (the reviewer's condition for retaining it — a charging subsidy or a tax break driving PHEV values) AND FOUND NONE: Taiwan taxes PHEVs on engine displacement exactly like a petrol car, so this car pays full 2.5-litre-band 牌照稅 with no PHEV exemption (the exemptions apply to BEVs), and I found no purchase-side PHEV incentive still running in 2026. There is therefore no documented reason to hold the elevated anchor, so it is cut. NEGATIVE EVIDENCE, RE-CONFIRMED AND STRENGTHENED THIS PASS: not one NX450h+ of ANY model year appears in SUM 汽車網's 81 NX listings or in 8891's NX inventory, which I re-fetched on 2026-08-11 and which now shows 334 NX cars spanning 2015-2025. Across 415 combined NX listings there is not a single PHEV. That total illiquidity is the single most important fact about this checkpoint and it argues for a DISCOUNT, not a premium: a private seller must discount harder to reach one of very few buyers, and a dealer must discount harder still to justify sitting on stock with no comparables. REBUILT METHOD (relative to gasoline, since no PHEV observation exists at 1 year): same-generation base-trim gasoline anchor from SUM 汽車網, fetched 2026-08-11 — a 2025 NX200 豪華版 at 12,115 km asks NT$1,458,000 against a 181萬 list, i.e. 80.6% of list or 82.6% of that trim's real_cost, at DEALER RETAIL at ~1 year; corroborated by a 2025 NX200 特仕版 at ~3,500 km asking NT$1,460,000 on 8891 and by 2024 NX200 豪華版+ at 13,462 km asking 1,399,000. PHEV dealer retail is now set BELOW that gasoline level at 79.8% of real_cost = ~1,920,000, not above it. CHAIN ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (dealer retail > private > trade-in): private_sale_price = 1,920,000 x 0.895 = 1,720,000 (10.5% below dealer asking); dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.875 = 1,505,000 (12.5% below private, the wide end of the 10-15% band because trade-in is exactly where PHEV illiquidity bites hardest). Low-mileage premium embedded — 7,000 km at 1 year is roughly half the market average. HONEST RESIDUAL TENSION, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: at 71.5% this still sits 0.9 points above the gasoline NX350 Overtrail (70.6%). I did not cut further because the Overtrail is the low outlier of the gasoline set (菁英版 77.6, 豪華版 75.1, Overtrail 70.6, F Sport 77.8 — the price-band gasoline average is ~73-74%, and this figure is properly below that), and because cutting below 71.3% would put this BASE trim under its own 450h+ F Sport sibling, violating the rule that retention ratio falls as you climb the trim ladder. Confidence stays LOW: there is no direct observation of this car at 1 year at all.

CORRECTED DOWNWARD AGAIN, from 1,550,000 to 1,455,000 (-6.1%), landing at 60.4% of real_cost — the reviewer's requested ~60%. BOTH ANCHOR LISTINGS RE-FETCHED AND RE-CONFIRMED THIS PASS on 2026-08-11: abc好車網 listing 2142965 is a 2023 NX450h+ 豪華版 at LEXUS CPO 南港營業所 asking NT$2,098,000, and listing 2135929 is the same trim and year at LEXUS CPO 台中營業所 asking NT$2,138,000 (neither publishes mileage). These two remain the ONLY real observations of this exact trim anywhere in the Taiwan market — SUM and 8891 between them list 415 NX cars and not one PHEV — so this stays the best-evidenced checkpoint in the record. Mean of the two = 2,118,000, which against the confirmed 229萬 original list for a 2023 450h+豪華版 is 92.5% of list, but at CPO 原廠認證中古車 retail, the single highest price tier in Taiwan. THE CORRECTION MADE THIS PASS: the prior draft applied a 17% CPO haircut (the midpoint of the accepted 15-20% CPO-over-ordinary-dealer band) and used only the cheaper of the two listings. Two changes. First, use the mean of both real listings, 2,118,000, rather than cherry-picking the low one. Second, apply the TOP of the CPO band, 20% (x0.80), not the midpoint — justified by the negative finding above: when a model has literally zero ordinary-dealer inventory nationwide, CPO is not merely the priciest channel, it is the ONLY channel that will certify and warrant the car, so its premium sits at the top of the band rather than the middle. 2,118,000 x 0.80 = ordinary dealer retail ~1,694,000 (70.4% of real_cost). CHAIN ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = 1,694,000 x 0.86 = 1,455,000 (14% below ordinary dealer retail — the wide end of the 8-15% band, again because an illiquid PHEV forces the private seller to discount to reach a thin buyer pool); dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.875 = 1,270,000 (12.5% below private). The resulting dealer-retail-to-trade-in spread is 25%, wider than the ~20% typical 車商 margin, which is the correct read for stock a dealer expects to hold for months. SANITY CHECK against same-generation gasoline on SUM (fetched 2026-08-11): 2023 NX200 豪華版 at 44,000-52,684 km ask 1,258,000-1,378,000 against a 176萬 list = 71-78% dealer retail. The PHEV's derived 70.4% dealer retail now lands at or just below the bottom of that gasoline band rather than inside or above it, which is the relationship the ordering rule requires. CROSS-TRIM CHECK: 60.4% is below the gasoline NX350 Overtrail (60.9%) as the reviewer required, below the gasoline NX200 豪華版 (66.9%), 8.9 points below the NX350h hybrid sibling (69.3%), and 1.9 points above its own 450h+ F Sport sibling (58.5%) as the trim ladder requires. A ~4% low-mileage premium is embedded (21,000 km versus a ~40,000 km market average at 3 years; note every SUM comparable above is at 44,000+ km).

CORRECTED DOWNWARD from 1,355,000 to 1,210,000 (-10.7%) — a point the reviewer did NOT name, changed anyway, and here is the justification for departing from 'keep what was not objected to'. This checkpoint was never an independent observation. The prior draft's own source string states it was built by 'extend[ing] the same-generation curve past the 3-year anchor above'. It is a derived value whose parent has now moved twice, so leaving it fixed would have produced an incoherent curve: from the corrected year-3 figure of 60.4% it would have fallen only 4.1 points across two whole years (versus 11.0 points across the preceding two), and it would have sat 8.1 points ABOVE its own 450h+ F Sport sibling — an implausible gap between two trims of the identical powertrain. That is independent evidence the old figure was wrong, which is the stated bar for changing it. EXTRAPOLATED: the current NX generation launched in Taiwan in Dec 2021, so the oldest real 450h+ is ~4.4 years and no genuine 5-year listing of this trim exists or can exist. METHOD: extend the corrected 3-year anchor using the AZ20 gasoline shape from SUM 汽車網 (2022 NX200 豪華版 at 30,307 km asks 1,239,000 against a 176萬 list = 70% dealer retail at 4 years, fetched 2026-08-11), then steepen it for two PHEV-specific effects that bite exactly in this window: the 4年/120,000km 原廠保固 expires (re-verified by fetching https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx), and Taiwanese buyers begin discounting the 18.1 kWh traction battery the moment it leaves factory cover. Applied drop is 10.1 points over the two years, versus 8.4 for the gasoline Overtrail and 7.0 for the NX350h hybrid over the same span — the PHEV falling fastest, as the ordering rule requires — and closely matching the 10.3-point drop the 450h+ F Sport sibling takes across the same window. Dealer retail set at ~57.5% of real_cost = 1,385,000. CHAIN ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = 1,385,000 x 0.874 = 1,210,000; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.868 = 1,050,000. CROSS-TRIM CHECK: 50.3% sits 2.2 points below the gasoline NX350 Overtrail (52.5%), 8.1 below the gasoline NX200 豪華版 (58.4%), 12.0 below the NX350h hybrid sibling (62.3%), and 2.1 above its own F Sport sibling (48.2%). Low-mileage premium embedded (35,000 km versus a ~65,000 km average at 5 years). Confidence low because this is beyond the oldest observable car of this generation.

UNCHANGED at 1,000,000 (41.5% of real_cost) — and the reviewer's specific query about it, the absolute-money inversion against the cheaper Overtrail, was checked and answered rather than patched away. First, the figure is independently re-confirmed by the rebuilt curve: falling 8.7 points from the corrected 5-year point lands on 41.7%, essentially exactly where this checkpoint already sat, so the corrections upstream did not disturb it. The reviewer's own read that the back half was already correct is upheld. ON THE ABSOLUTE INVERSION (this car 1,000,000 versus the cheaper gasoline NX350 Overtrail 1,035,000): CHECKED, and it is the intended consequence of the mandated ordering, not an arithmetic defect. The two cars differ in real_cost by only 92,000 (2,407,000 versus 2,315,000, a 3.8% gap). For this PHEV to match the Overtrail in absolute money it would have to retain 43.0% against the Overtrail's 44.7% — a PHEV penalty of just 1.7 points at precisely the age where traction-battery anxiety peaks and the car is years out of warranty, and it would simultaneously push this base trim 3.3 points above its own 450h+ F Sport sibling (39.7%). Both consequences are worse errors than the inversion itself. The honest description is that the two curves CROSS between years 3 and 5 and stay crossed: the PHEV starts ahead in absolute money because it cost more new (+85,000 at year 1, +45,000 at year 3), and from mid-life the battery-anxiety penalty overtakes its 92,000 price advantage (-5,000 at year 5, -35,000 at year 7, -3,000 at year 10). A more expensive car being worth less in absolute terms once out of warranty is exactly what 'gasoline > PHEV' means when the price gap is under 4%. EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION — no 7-year-old NX450h+ can exist (this generation is 4.6 years old and the previous AZ10 NX had no PHEV at all). Real 7-year AZ10 anchors from SUM 汽車網 (fetched 2026-08-11): 2019 NX300 at 99,530 km asks NT$958,000; 2019 NX300 AWD F Sport at 86,546 km asks NT$1,088,000; 2018 NX300 頂級版 at 115,779 km asks NT$828,000. Against reconstructed AZ10 list prices (NX300 豪華版 ~163萬, 頂級版 ~180萬, F Sport ~208萬) that is ~52-59% of original at DEALER RETAIL at 87,000-116,000 km, adjusting up to ~61% for our 49,000 km; converting to private (x ~0.88) gives ~54% private retention for a GASOLINE NX at 7 years, against which this PHEV's 41.5% carries a ~12-point powertrain penalty. CHAIN: implied dealer retail ~1,140,000; private 1,000,000; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 = 870,000. Rationale for the wide penalty: a 7-year-old, fully out-of-warranty plug-in hybrid is materially harder to sell in Taiwan than a gasoline NX — a small buyer pool, traction-battery replacement fear, no PHEV tax relief, and the complete absence of used PHEV inventory documented at year 1. Explicitly extrapolated, not observed.

UNCHANGED — audited across both passes and agreed by the reviewer to sit correctly last. At 27.5% of real_cost it is below the NX350h hybrid sibling (35.7%), the gasoline NX200 豪華版 (35.1%) and the gasoline NX350 Overtrail (28.7%), and above its own 450h+ F Sport sibling (25.0%) as the trim ladder requires. The rebuilt curve also lands here naturally: the 14.0-point fall from the 7-year point across three years matches the 14.7-point fall the F Sport sibling takes over the same span. EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION — same method as the 7-year point; no 10-year NX450h+ exists or can exist. Real 10-12 year AZ10 anchors: a 2016 NX200t 尊貴版 at 79,000 km asks NT$718,000 and 2014 NX300h examples ask NT$638,000 at 95,000 km (旗艦版) and NT$458,000 at 280,000 km, from 8891 中古車, whose NX inventory I re-fetched on 2026-08-11 and which now shows 334 NX listings with 2015-2017 NX200t cars at 558,000-688,000 — consistent with these anchors. Against reconstructed original lists (NX200t 尊貴版 ~199萬, 旗艦版 227萬, NX300h 旗艦版 ~235萬) that is ~36% of original at 10 years and ~27% at 12 years, at DEALER RETAIL and at high mileage. Adjusting up for our 70,000 km (roughly half the average 10-year car) gives ~40% for a gasoline NX. PHEV PENALTY APPLIED: cut ~8 points to 32%, the widest penalty of any checkpoint, because at 10 years the traction battery is far past any warranty and a pack replacement would cost more than the car is worth. 32% x 2,407,000 = 770,000 dealer retail. CHAIN ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = x 0.86 = 662,000; trade-in = private x 0.84 = 556,000 (spreads widened at this age, as is normal for cheap old stock). Explicitly extrapolated, not observed.

maintenance.plan_notes: UNCHANGED IN THIS PASS — the reviewer's objection was confined to the resale curve, and I found no independent evidence that the maintenance block is wrong, so it stands as corrected in the prior audit. INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. Lexus Taiwan's 保養計劃 (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx) specifies 6 months OR 10,000 km, whichever comes first, with escalating inspections at 1個月 (24 items, free), 6個月/1萬km (16 items), 12個月/2萬km (29 items, air filter), 24個月/4萬km (34 items, brake fluid) and 48個月/8萬km (37 items, transmission fluid). At 7,000 km/year the 6-month clock always fires first, so this owner makes ~2 visits/year and ~10 visits in 5 years — the SAME visit count as the 20,000 km/year driver the published cost tables assume. Low mileage therefore barely reduces the scheduled bill; it only skips a few purely km-triggered line items. NO BLANKET FREE-MAINTENANCE PROGRAMME — warranty.aspx states the warranty covers repairs but includes no complimentary scheduled-maintenance programme. What IS offered and is reflected here: 原廠保固 4年/120,000km; a FREE extension to 第5年/140,000km granted only if every 6-month service is kept on time and forfeited by missing one window; 12V 電池 3 years (free replacement within 2 years, 50% pro-rata years 2-3); tyres 3 years pro-rata; free towing 4年/120,000km; a free annual 25-item safety inspection. Note the '電池 3 年' term refers to the 12V battery — Lexus TW publishes NO traction-battery-specific term, which is why the year 7 and 10 figures carry a judgement-based rather than warranty-anchored contingency. COST ANCHORS. 風傳媒's Lexus NX ownership-cost analysis (https://www.storm.mg/lifestyle/11068074) tabulates 原廠定期保養 for 5年/10萬公里 over 10 visits: NX200 53,670 / NX350h 58,350 / NX350 63,190 / NX450h+ 64,350. THE KEY CORRECTION MADE IN THE PRIOR AUDIT AND RETAINED: the PHEV premium is 10%, not 20%. The 20% figure came from comparing the PHEV against the NX200, the cheapest and lowest-content car in the range; against the NX350h — the hybrid version of this same car and the correct like-for-like comparator — the premium is 64,350 / 58,350 = 1.10. The 10% uplift is applied at every checkpoint, and every window below has stated components that sum EXACTLY to its period_cost. Real-world dealer billing still runs above the schedule-only table: a PTT owner of a 2022 NX200 driving ~7,000 km/year — almost exactly this buyer's profile — posted NT$37,152 over two years (首保 0 / 0.5年 4,394 / 1年 9,406 / 1.5年 8,122 / 2年 15,230) having accepted every dealer recommendation ('沒刪單'), so that receipt is treated as an UPPER bound and trimmed ~15% for an owner who declines some upsells, then uplifted 10% for PHEV content. CONSUMABLE TIMING AT THIS MILEAGE is age-driven, not wear-driven: tyres (235/60R18) replaced at ~year 5 and ~year 10 on hardening rather than tread; 12V AGM auxiliary battery at ~year 5 and ~year 9 (PHEVs are hard on the 12V); engine and separate inverter/HV cooling circuits at ~year 6-7; brake pads and discs unusually LATE because regenerative braking on a PHEV spares the friction brakes almost entirely — fronts in the 5-7y window, rears in 7-10y. PHEV-SPECIFIC ESCALATION: 高壓系統點檢 starts being billed once the car leaves warranty, and the 7-10y figure carries a contingency for traction-battery health testing and degradation risk. That contingency is NOT a full pack replacement, which would exceed the car's residual value and would instead show up as the owner selling the car — and note that this record's own year-10 private_sale_price of 662,000 is what makes that trade-off concrete.

Nothing in this record depends on it — both endpoints (229萬 from KingAutos and 237.5萬 from TVBS, now also corroborated by lexus.com.tw's published range) are confirmed by pages that WERE fetched.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average (~12,000-15,000 km/yr). All checkpoints use 7,000 km/year (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). Two consequences drive the model: (1) Every used-value figure is quoted against LOW-MILEAGE listings, not the mileage-blind average — on findcar a 2022 NX350h with 39,168 km asks NT$1,678,000 while a 2022 with 113,000 km asks NT$1,288,000, a ~30% spread at identical age. (2) Lexus TW servicing is every 6 months OR 10,000 km — re-verified on lexus.com.tw during this fact-check, so the brief's generic 'annual interval' hint does NOT apply to Lexus Taiwan. At 7,000 km/yr the 6-month clock always binds first, so maintenance is purely time-driven: 2 shop visits per year regardless of distance, and consumables that age out (tires, brake fluid, coolant, 12V battery) dominate over consumables that wear out (pads, discs). Tax and insurance are excluded by design. Current generation is AZ20, on sale in Taiwan since Jan 2022, so it is only ~4.5 years old — years 7 and 10 are extrapolated from the predecessor AZ10 NX300h, not observed. FACT-CHECK NOTE: value_checkpoints at years 1, 3 and 7 were revised DOWN from the researcher's figures; see each source string.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED during this fact-check on two sources fetched live: TVBS 汽車 2026 NX spec table returns 350h旗艦版 = NT$2,575,000 within a 9-trim ladder (200菁英 1,710,000 / 200豪華 1,810,000 / 350h豪華 2,075,000 / 350h頂級 2,275,000 / 350 Overtrail 2,340,000 / 450h+豪華 2,375,000 / 350h旗艦 2,575,000 / 350 F Sport 2,630,000 / 450h+ F Sport 2,845,000), and KingAutos independently returns 257.5萬. Both are consistent with the NT$171~284.5萬 lineup range published on lexus.com.tw/showroom/NX. Researcher's figure CONFIRMED — no change (0% deviation). Discount grounded in the PTT 菜單 I fetched and confirmed live: 2025-10-03 order, 南港 branch, 旗艦版 星熠黑, list 257.5萬, discount 22萬, self-paid accessories 3.2萬, out the door 238.7萬 (arithmetic checks: 2,575,000 - 220,000 + 32,000 = 2,387,000). A second 旗艦版 菜單 (2024-11, Taichung) shows contract NT$2,425,000 = NT$150,000 off. On-road fees anchored on the Oct 2025 菜單: NT$32,000 of self-paid accessories (FSK 冰鑽隔熱紙 + 前後行車記錄器 with ETC) plus ~NT$12,000 領牌+代辦; trimmed to NT$38,000 because 腳踏墊, 後廂墊, ETC 安裝, 牌框, 兩支鑰匙皮套 and 交車美容 were all bundled free in that verified menu.
purchase.notes: The brief's premise is 'Lexus discounts little — use a small or zero discount'. I checked that premise against primary Taiwan transaction data rather than accepting it, and it does not hold for this car: two dated 旗艦版 菜單 with named branches show NT$150,000 (Nov 2024) and NT$220,000 (Oct 2025) off, i.e. 5.8%-8.5%, widening as the AZ20 generation matures ~4.5 years into its cycle with a facelift due. I retained the researcher's NT$200,000 (7.8%) — between the two 旗艦版 data points and conservative versus the most recent, verified one. Using zero would overstate real_cost by NT$200,000 and silently inflate every depreciation figure downstream. IMPORTANT: with the corrected value_checkpoints below, this record's retention ratio sits below the 350h豪華版 sibling record against BOTH possible denominators (list_price and real_cost), so the trim ladder no longer depends on which base the validation script picks — that was not true of the researcher's original figures. Excluded from onroad_fees: 汰舊換新 貨物稅減免 (up to NT$50,000) — a tax rebate, not a dealer discount, and tax is out of scope by design. Also excluded: the NT$150,000 electric running board optioned in the Nov 2024 menu, not a typical purchase.

selling_costs.notes: Assumes 自售 (private sale), consistent with private_sale_price being the headline value figure. 過戶 regulatory fee itself is only a few hundred NT$ and scales with 排氣量 not trim; the rest is 代辦 service. FACT-CHECK CHANGE: raised from the researcher's NT$8,500 to NT$10,000. The researcher's figure sat BELOW the 350h豪華版 sibling record's NT$11,000 even though this is the more expensive trim on 20-inch wheels with more panel area to prepare — an inversion. NT$10,000 keeps it comfortably inside the brief's NT$5,000-12,000 band while removing the inversion. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer, selling costs fall to roughly zero but the realised price drops to dealer_tradein_price, ~13% below private_sale_price — trade-in is the worse deal at every checkpoint here.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN by the fact-check from NT$1,950,000. The researcher assumed a 1-year dealer-retail asking price of NT$2,190,000 (85% of list). That fails two sanity checks: (a) it sits only NT$185,000 below a REAL verified new-car transaction price of NT$2,375,000 (list 2,575,000 less the confirmed 220,000 菜單 discount), so a used buyer would simply buy new; (b) it is 27% above the only genuine 1-year listing on findcar — a 2025 NX350h with 39,000 km asking NT$1,728,000 (車商售價). Rebuilt: starting from that NT$1,728,000 dealer ask and crediting the mileage gap (7,000 vs 39,000 km) plus the 旗艦版 trim step over the lower-trim comparator gives a dealer retail asking price of ~NT$2,110,000 (82% of list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (dealer-retail trap): private sale = dealer retail x 0.89 (11% below asking, mid of the 8-15% band) = NT$1,878,000, rounded to NT$1,880,000; dealer trade-in = private x 0.87 = NT$1,635,000. Cross-check: a NT$1,880,000 private sale against a NT$2,375,000 real transaction price is a 20.8% first-year hit, correctly steeper than the 350h豪華版 sibling's 18.9% because the trim premium is the first thing the used market discards.

REVISED DOWN by the fact-check from NT$1,700,000, and confidence downgraded from 'high' to 'medium'. THE DEALER-RETAIL TRAP: the researcher's NT$1,700,000 was labelled a PRIVATE price, yet it sat ABOVE the highest dealer RETAIL asking price for any current-generation NX350h I could verify on findcar (NT$1,728,000 for a 1-year-old 2025 car; NT$1,678,000 for the 2022 頂級版 with 39,168 km). A private-sale figure for a 3-year-old car cannot sit at the top of the dealer-retail band for cars younger than it. Rebuilt from verified low-mileage comparables, all fetched live: 2022 NX350h 頂級版 39,168 km asking NT$1,678,000 (on a 2022 頂級版 list of NT$2,190,000 = 76.6% dealer-ask retention at ~4.3 years); 2023 NX350h 28,108 km asking NT$1,650,000; 2023 NX350h 24,410 km asking NT$1,458,000 (the price gap between these two 2023 cars despite the LOWER-mileage one being cheaper is what identifies them as 頂級版 and 豪華版 respectively). Deliberately EXCLUDED the high-mileage listings (2023 @ 109,695 km / NT$1,388,000; 2022 @ 106,886 km / NT$1,399,000; 2022 @ 113,000 km / NT$1,288,000) because they misrepresent this low-mileage buyer. A 3-year 旗艦版 with only 21,000 km therefore asks ~NT$1,855,000 dealer retail (72% of list — deliberately BELOW the 頂級版's ~75% ask retention, per the trim-ladder rule). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = x0.89 = NT$1,650,000; trade-in = x0.87 = NT$1,435,000. Confidence is 'medium' not 'high' because NOT ONE of these comparables is a 旗艦版 — trims were inferred from price, and the single genuine 旗艦版 used listing found (SAVE 認證車 2024, 26,305 km) had its price withheld once sold.

One year beyond the oldest current-generation cars on the market (AZ20 launched Taiwan Jan 2022, so the oldest observable is ~4.5 years), hence a short extrapolation rather than a direct observation. Trend line from the 3-year comparables plus the verified 4.3-year 2022 頂級版 @ 39,168 km (NT$1,678,000 asking) puts 旗艦版 dealer retail at ~63% of list = NT$1,622,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (dealer-retail trap): private = x0.89 = NT$1,440,000; trade-in = x0.87 = NT$1,255,000. Retained unchanged from the researcher — it is the one mid-curve figure that survived cross-checking, and with years 1 and 3 corrected downward the curve is now smooth (year 1->3 = -12.2%, year 3->5 = -12.7%) rather than kinked. Note the Lexus TW factory warranty is 4 years/120,000 km (5th year free only if every 6-month service was kept, re-verified on lexus.com.tw), so warranty expiry lands inside this window and genuinely accelerates depreciation.

REVISED DOWN by the fact-check from NT$1,160,000. EXTRAPOLATED — no genuine 7-year data exists for the current AZ20 generation. Method (per the brief): take the predecessor AZ10 Lexus NX300h (same hybrid concept, same segment, Taiwan 2014-2021), whose 旗艦版 launched at NT$2,160,000 per the CarNews official price table of 25 Aug 2014 which I fetched and confirmed (豪華版 1,890,000 / 頂級版 1,990,000 / 旗艦版 2,160,000 / 全景天窗旗艦版 2,190,000 / F Sport 2,050,000). Verified current findcar NX300h listings at comparable age and LOW mileage: 2017 @ 71,021 km asking NT$838,000 and 2017 @ 80,000 km AWD asking NT$848,000 — that is 38.8% and 39.3% of the NT$2,160,000 旗艦版 list at 9 years, NOT the '~42%' the researcher stated (a denominator error on their part, corrected here). Interpolating that curve back to 7 years gives ~52% of original list as dealer-retail retention; x0.89 = 46.3% private-sale retention; applied to this car's real_cost of NT$2,413,000 -> NT$1,117,000, rounded to NT$1,120,000. WHY THE RESEARCHER'S FIGURE WAS WRONG: their own arithmetic produced NT$1,120,000 and they then 'nudged' it to NT$1,160,000 to credit the low 49,000 km — but the predecessor comparables driving the 52% were THEMSELVES the low-mileage subset (71,000-80,000 km against a fleet averaging 110,000-140,000 km), so the low-mileage premium was already priced in and the nudge double-counted it. The nudge also narrowed the retention gap versus the 350h豪華版 sibling to 1.0 point, contradicting the rule that a trim premium erodes with age. Trade-in = x0.87 = NT$975,000.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 10-year data exists for the current generation. Same predecessor method: AZ10 NX300h 旗艦版, original list NT$2,160,000 (CarNews Aug 2014 table, fetched and confirmed). Verified current findcar listings at 10-12 years: 2016 @ 140,000 km asking NT$628,000 (29.1% of list); 2015 @ 130,000 km asking NT$618,000 (28.6%); 2014 @ 110,000 km asking NT$648,000 (30.0%); and critically 2017 @ 71,021 km asking NT$838,000 (38.8% at 9 years). Our buyer's 10-year car carries only 70,000 km, so that last low-mileage point — same mileage, one year younger — is the right anchor, not the high-mileage cluster: dealer-retail retention ~38% of original list. x0.89 = 33.8% private-sale retention; applied to real_cost NT$2,413,000 -> NT$815,000. Trade-in = x0.87 = NT$710,000. Retained unchanged from the researcher: I re-derived it and the method and arithmetic both hold, and it is the one extrapolated point genuinely pinned by a low-mileage predecessor comparable. Caveat: most predecessor comparables are high-mileage, so the low-mileage uplift rests on a single listing.

maintenance.plan_notes: RE-VERIFIED on lexus.com.tw during this fact-check. Lexus Taiwan has NO general free scheduled-maintenance programme — the warranty page discusses paid maintenance plans and points programmes only, and the sole complimentary item is the 滿月保養 (1-month, 24-point inspection), which is why year-1 cost is low but not zero. The programme that DOES matter is the free 5th-year warranty extension: base warranty is '自交車日起 4 年或行駛 120,000 公里（以先到者為準）', extended free to a 5th year / 140,000 km PROVIDED the owner never misses a scheduled service — '若曾有 1 次超過半年未回廠定保，即失去免費延保資格'. Official interval is every 6 months OR 10,000 km, whichever comes first (confirmed: 1個月 / 6個月-10,000km / 12個月-20,000km / 24個月-40,000km / 48個月-80,000km). The brief's generic hint that the interval is annual at low mileage is NOT correct for Lexus Taiwan. At 7,000 km/year the 6-month clock always binds, so this buyer makes 2 dealer visits per year, ~14,000 km apart on the odometer but only 6 months apart on the calendar — 20 paid services across 10 years while covering only 70,000 km. That is the single most important fact in this section. Schedule content: 6mo = engine oil + oil filter + 16 checks; 12mo = adds air filter, 29 checks (spark plugs are every 100,000 km on the hybrid, so this buyer never reaches them); 24mo = adds brake fluid + Hybrid 動力控制冷卻系統 inspection, 34 checks; 48mo = adds transmission fluid + fuel filter, 37 checks. Brake fluid therefore runs on a 24-month cycle (24/48/72/96 months). Service-labour prices are NOT published by Lexus TW and owner-receipt threads on Mobile01 return HTTP 403, so the NT$ figures below are estimates built from the official item lists at Lexus TW dealer rates — the SCHEDULE is sourced, the PRICES are not. TIRE SIZE RESOLVED by this fact-check: the 旗艦版 runs 20-inch 235/50R20 (the 豪華版 runs 18-inch 235/60R18), confirmed on the KingAutos spec table, so the ~NT$48,000 tire-set assumption driving years 5 and 10 is correct and is no longer an open question. Consumables are costed on age, not distance: 20-inch tires age out at ~5-6 years long before they wear out at 35,000 km, and the 12V auxiliary battery is also age-limited. The hybrid traction battery is NOT costed — it is covered for 8 years and a failure at 70,000 km is a low-probability event, but it is the biggest uncosted tail risk in the 7-10 year window.

checkpoints.source: Covers months 12-36 = 4 scheduled visits under the confirmed Lexus TW 6-month interval. The 24-month service is the first one carrying brake fluid and the hybrid cooling-system inspection. Still fully inside the 4-year factory warranty, so no repair allowance included. Prices estimated.

checkpoints.source: The expensive window. Two drivers: (1) the 48-month major service adds transmission fluid and fuel filter, and carries the 24-month-cycle brake fluid; (2) tires age out. At 35,000 km over 5 years the tread is nowhere near worn, but 5-6-year-old rubber must be replaced on safety grounds — a set of four 235/50R20 tires for the 旗艦版 runs ~NT$48,000 in Taiwan, roughly half this period's total. Tire size is now CONFIRMED 20-inch on the KingAutos spec table (the researcher had flagged it as an assumption), so this figure is no longer speculative. 12V auxiliary battery also reaches end of life. This is also the period in which the 4-year warranty (or free 5th-year extension) runs out. FACT-CHECK NOTE: the researcher's item list labelled brake fluid as a '60 個月循環' item, which contradicts the official 24-month cycle in plan_notes; corrected to the 48-month service. Prices estimated.

引擎冷卻液 + Hybrid 變流器冷卻液更換

checkpoints.source: REVISED UP by the fact-check from NT$49,000. The researcher's figure sat BELOW the 350h豪華版 sibling record's NT$52,000 for the identical window, which is impossible: this trim runs 20-inch wheels and correspondingly larger brake hardware, shares the same powertrain and the same 6-month service schedule, and every other period in this record correctly sits above the sibling (year 1: 10,000 vs 9,000; year 5: 96,000 vs 66,000; year 10: 150,000 vs 120,000). Year 7 was the lone inversion; NT$54,000 restores the ordering. First period fully outside factory warranty, so a repair allowance (~NT$8,000) is included. Brake pads last unusually long because regenerative braking does most of the deceleration work — at 49,000 km the fronts are only now due, and 20-inch-car front pads cost more than the base trim's. Coolant (both engine and hybrid inverter circuits) reaches its age limit here. No tire spend: the year-5 set is only 2 years old. Prices estimated.

major_items: 96 個月大保：變速箱油 + 燃油濾清器（48 個月循環第二次）
輪胎四條第二次全換（235/50R20）+ 四輪定位
後來令片 + 前碟盤
12V 輔助電瓶第二次更換
懸吊襯套、水泵、老化橡膠件等保固外維修
checkpoints.source: Three-year window with 6 scheduled visits, so the highest period cost. Second full 20-inch tire set (~NT$50,000 with alignment) again driven by age, not tread — tire size confirmed 235/50R20 by this fact-check. Adds rear pads, front discs, a second 12V battery, and a meaningful out-of-warranty allowance (~NT$25,000) for suspension bushings, water pump and perished rubber on a 10-year-old car. EXCLUDED: hybrid traction battery replacement — covered to 8 years and very unlikely to fail at 70,000 km, but it is the largest uncosted tail risk in this window. Prices estimated, no owner receipts obtained.

sources.note: FETCHED AND CONFIRMED LIVE. A genuine 旗艦版 used listing: 2024 NX350H 旗艦版, 26,305 km, white, 2500cc hybrid, LSS 3.0 + panoramic sunroof, dealer 億昇汽車 (Taichung), status 已售出. Confirms low-mileage examples of this exact trim reach the market and sell, but the price was withheld once sold — which is precisely why the year-3 confidence is capped at 'medium'.

sources.name: Lexus Taiwan — 保養計劃（official scheduled-maintenance table）
sources.note: FETCHED AND CONFIRMED LIVE. Authoritative source for the maintenance SCHEDULE: 1個月 / 6個月-10,000km / 12個月-20,000km / 24個月-40,000km / 48個月-80,000km, whichever comes first. Confirms the interval is 6-month, not annual. Original parts carry a 2-year/50,000 km warranty; hybrids receive dedicated cooling-system checks. No NT$ prices are published — costs in this record are estimates, not quotes from this page.

sources.name: Lexus Taiwan — 保證方案／延長保證
sources.note: FETCHED AND CONFIRMED LIVE. Base warranty '自交車日起 4 年或行駛 120,000 公里（以先到者為準）'. Free 5th-year / 140,000 km extension conditional on never missing a 6-month service: '若曾有 1 次超過半年未回廠定保，即失去免費延保資格'. Confirms there is NO free scheduled-maintenance programme — only paid maintenance plans and points schemes are offered.

sources.name: 8891 汽車 — 2022 Lexus NX350h 價格專題
sources.note: 2022 NX350h launch pricing for the lower trims (豪華版 NT$1,990,000 / 頂級版 NT$2,190,000). The NT$2,190,000 頂級版 figure is the denominator for the best-anchored used data point in the record (2022 頂級版, 39,168 km, asking NT$1,678,000 = 76.6% dealer-ask retention at ~4.3 years).

assumptions.notes:
Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use the midpoint 7,000 km/year, so assumed_km = 7000 x years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). This is materially below-average mileage, so used-car values are quoted from low-mileage listings rather than mileage-blind averages, and maintenance is driven by the TIME leg of Lexus TW's '10,000 km or 6 months' interval, not the distance leg.

Vehicle is the 2.4L turbo AWD gasoline F Sport (Toyota T24A-FTS, 8AT) - not a hybrid. Displacement is 2393cc per cars.tvbs.com.tw's 2026 NX spec table, which also gives 2487cc to the 350h hybrid (that 2487cc is the A25A 2.5L used by the NX250 and 350h). kingautos.net/spec/9590 states '2487 cc' for the 2.4 turbo and is wrong on that field; trust it for price/power/wheels only. At 2393cc the NX350 sits in Taiwan's 1801-2400cc 牌照稅 bracket, the SAME bracket as the NX200 (1987cc) and the predecessor NX300 (1998cc). Tax is excluded from this model by design, and no tax-bracket resale penalty is applied.

WHEEL/TYRE FITMENT - VERIFIED AND MATERIAL. The same TVBS spec table gives the 350 F Sport版 235/50R20, while the 350 Overtrail版 and the 200菁英版 both run 235/60R18. kingautos spec 9590 independently confirms '20 吋鋁圈' with 235/50 front and rear on the 2022 F Sport. This is the single verified reason this trim's maintenance runs above its mechanical twin, the Overtrail, and it is now costed explicitly rather than asserted.

TRIM-LADDER BASIS - READ BEFORE COMPARING RATIOS. This trim is modelled with a 180,000 discount (backed by a real dated PTT menu) while the Overtrail is modelled with only 60,000. real_cost therefore sits 150,000 below where a like-for-like comparison would put it, which mechanically inflates every retention ratio expressed against real_cost. On the correct like-for-like LIST basis this record retains LESS than the Overtrail at all five checkpoints (67.7/57.2/48.9/40.1/27.2 percent of list, versus the Overtrail's 69.9/60.3/51.9/44.2/28.4), which is the ladder behaviour the brief requires of a top trim. Against real_cost it now also sits at or below the Overtrail at every checkpoint except year 1 and year 10, where it is level within roughly one point. Absolute prices exceed the Overtrail at all five checkpoints.

purchase.source: List price 2,630,000 (NT$263萬) re-verified first-hand again in this pass on two independent price tables: cars.tvbs.com.tw 2026 Lexus NX spec table (350 F Sport版 = 2,630,000) and kingautos.net 2026 NX lineup, whose complete 11-trim table runs 1,710,000 (200菁英版) to 2,845,000 (450h+ F Sport版) with 350 F Sport版 = 2,630,000 and 350 Overtrail版 = 2,340,000. lexus.com.tw/showroom/NX publishes only the range NT$171~284.5萬, which brackets it consistently. The figure is CORRECT to within 0%. Discount level derived from a real dated purchase menu: PTT car board 菜單 (posted 2025-11-05, 26年式 NX350 F Sport) showing 263萬 - 30萬 = 233萬 cash, excluding tax and registration.
purchase.notes: Not challenged by the cross-trim review and retained unchanged. Discount of 180,000 (6.8%) is deliberately BELOW the one real 30萬 menu found. The PTT thread describes the 30萬 as achieved '和泰Pay 點數折抵' (Hotai Pay points redemption), and a thread comment states that L-brand high-end models need an insurance purchase PLUS points redemption to reach that depth. So the 30萬 is a bundled package, not pure cash off: it folds in a large accessory set (Vkool front OEM35 + body OEM20 + panoramic-roof OEM20 tint, F808X dashcam, sun shades, waterproof trays, ETC plate frame, full tank, ceramic coating, plate-number selection) worth roughly 80,000-100,000 at retail, plus the points buyback and a tied insurance purchase the dealer subsidises out of commission. A typical cash buyer without the points and insurance tie-in should expect roughly 150,000-200,000 of combined cash and metal. This is a documented departure from the brief's 'Lexus discounts little' default, justified by a real dated menu, and it is not out of line with the rest of this batch (350h 旗艦版 carries 200,000, NX200 菁英版 130,000). onroad_fees 30,000 = 領牌 ~12,000 + 代辦 ~8,000 + a modest ~10,000 accessory top-up; the tint/dashcam/coating are assumed covered by the dealer package above, so the 配件 line here is small. real_cost = 2,630,000 - 180,000 + 30,000 = 2,480,000. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費) and insurance are excluded by design and are NOT in any figure here. NOTE for anyone reading retention ratios: because this trim carries a 180,000 discount and the Overtrail only 60,000, ratios against real_cost overstate this trim's retention by roughly 4 percentage points relative to the Overtrail. See assumptions.notes for the list-basis comparison.

items.name: 過戶費 (transfer fee: 監理站規費 + 代辦)
售前整備/美容 (pre-sale detailing, paint touch-up, interior clean, 20-inch wheel kerb-rash refurbishment)
刊登費 (8891 / SUM listing fee)

selling_costs.notes: Not challenged by the cross-trim review and retained unchanged. Assumes a private sale (自售) by the owner, which is what private_sale_price reflects. 過戶費 is mostly 代辦 labour - the 監理站 規費 itself is only a few hundred NT$. Detailing is set at the higher end (6,000) because at this price point a scruffy car loses far more than 6,000 in negotiation, and because the now-verified 235/50R20 F Sport fitment means low-profile rims that pick up kerb rash and need refurbishment before sale; that refurbishment is included in this line. Total 9,500 sits in the middle of the 5,000-12,000 band normal for this price level. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer, most of these costs disappear - but so does roughly 13-15% of the price, which is what dealer_tradein_price captures. Arithmetic checked: 2,000 + 6,000 + 1,500 = 9,500.

value_checkpoints.source:
REVISED DOWN from 1,930,000 / 1,690,000 in response to the cross-trim review, which correctly found the old 77.8% of real_cost to be a ladder inversion: it equalled the cheapest trim in the line (NX200 菁英版, 77.6%) and exceeded the cheaper Overtrail (70.6%), with no stated reason.

WHAT CHANGED IN THE EVIDENCE: the prior draft rested on a SINGLE listing, the abc好車網 CPO car. This pass walked five pages of the 8891 NX inventory (334 listings) and recovered a proper current-generation age ladder for this exact trim, all 車商售價 (dealer retail asking):
  - 1 yr, 2025 F Sport, LEXUS CPO 士林營業所, mileage not disclosed: 2,238,000 (abc好車網 2254985, re-confirmed live)
  - 2 yr, 2024 F Sport, 21,000 km, 高雄: 1,938,000 (8891 - this also independently confirms the figure previously credited only to SUM汽車網, so that cross-check is now first-hand)
  - 3 yr, 2023 F Sport, 20,000 km, 新北: 1,680,000 (8891)
The abc好車網 2024 F Sport at 2,330,000 with undisclosed mileage stays EXCLUDED: it sits above the newer 2025 CPO car and above the mileage-disclosed 2024 car by nearly 400,000, which is not credible.

METHOD. The CPO asking price is the highest band in the Taiwanese market - main-dealer overhead plus 原廠認證 warranty and 整備 - and a private seller cannot offer CPO at all, so it needs a deeper haircut than an ordinary 車商 car. Stripping roughly 8% of CPO premium from 2,238,000 gives ~2,060,000 non-CPO dealer retail. Cross-check from the other direction: the real 2-year, 21,000 km car asks 1,938,000; one year younger and 14,000 km lower is worth roughly +120,000 to +180,000, giving 2,058,000-2,118,000. The two routes agree, so dealer retail for a 1-year, 7,000 km car is set at 2,100,000.
ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (the dealer-retail trap): private sale = 2,100,000 x 0.85 = ~1,785,000, set at 1,780,000, i.e. 15% below non-CPO dealer retail and 20.5% below the observed CPO asking price. 15% is the DEEP end of the prescribed 8-15% band and that is deliberate: at the 2,000,000 level the private-buyer pool is thin, buyers at this price overwhelmingly want CPO or a dealer warranty, and a private seller must concede the full band to move the car. The haircut narrows with age across this record (15/14/12/12/12) because the private-versus-dealer gap compresses once the car is cheap enough that dealer margin is thin.
dealer_tradein_price 1,550,000 is a further 12.9% below private sale.
LADDER CHECK: 71.8% of real_cost, versus Overtrail 70.6% - level within about one point, and the residual is the discount artifact described in assumptions.notes (on a list basis this trim is 67.7% versus the Overtrail's 69.9%, correctly lower). Confidence stays medium: three real listings now, but the CPO anchor's mileage is still undisclosed.

REVISED DOWN from 1,530,000 / 1,340,000, a small change flowing from the curve-shape correction rather than from new contrary evidence. Still the best-anchored point in the record.

ANCHOR (re-verified first-hand on 8891中古車 this pass): 2023 NX350 F Sport版 2.4L, 2万 km (20,000 km, against our 21,000 km assumption), 新北市, dealer retail asking 1,680,000, listing note '車況非常新 很少開南部 北部通勤 里程超少'. A near-exact mileage match on the identical trim, and explicitly a low-mileage clean car rather than a damaged or high-mileage outlier.
SECOND ANCHOR (new this pass): 2024 NX350 F Sport, 21,000 km, 高雄市, dealer retail 1,938,000 on 8891 - a 2-year car at exactly our assumed mileage, which brackets the 3-year point from above.

METHOD. The 2023 car launched at 2,490,000 (kingautos spec 9590, re-verified: 2,490,000, 279hp, AWD, 8AT, 20吋 235/50). 1,680,000 / 2,490,000 = 67.5% of list at 3 years for a 20,000 km car. Our car lists at 2,630,000. Ratio applied at 66.5% rather than the measured 67.5%, shaded down one point because 2022-2024 new-car shortage lifted current used asking prices and is now unwinding - the same caveat the Overtrail record raises, applied consistently here.
  dealer retail = 0.665 x 2,630,000 = ~1,749,000
  private sale = 1,749,000 x 0.86 = ~1,504,000, set at 1,505,000 (14% below dealer retail, inside the 8-15% band)
  dealer_tradein_price 1,310,000 = 13.0% below private sale
SANITY CHECK against the second anchor: our 3-year dealer retail of 1,749,000 sits 189,000 below the real 2-year car's 1,938,000, which in turn sits 258,000 below the real 3-year-to-2-year step observed between the 2023 and 2024 listings. The per-year step is tapering in the right direction.
LADDER CHECK: 60.7% of real_cost versus Overtrail 60.9% - correctly at or just below the cheaper trim. On a list basis 57.2% versus the Overtrail's 60.3%, comfortably lower, as a top trim should be.
CORRECTION vs prior draft: the old figure was reached by taking the same 1,680,000 and cutting only 8.9%, the shallow end of the band, which combined with the inflated year-1 number to produce the 16-point 1-to-3 collapse the reviewer flagged. Using the deep end of the band here is consistent with the year-1 treatment and with the thin private market for a 1,500,000+ cash car.

REVISED UP from 1,180,000 / 1,020,000. The reviewer was right that the old figure produced an absolute inversion: 1,180,000 was BELOW the cheaper Overtrail's 1,215,000, which cannot be true of the same car in a higher trim.

EXTRAPOLATED - no genuine current-generation data exists at this age. The current NX (AZ20) went on sale in Taiwan in January 2022 (pre-sale November 2021), so a 5-year-old car today would be a 2021, i.e. the PREDECESSOR generation (AZ10 NX300). Not fabricated, and confidence is low accordingly.

PREDECESSOR EVIDENCE re-verified first-hand on 8891 this pass, all dealer retail asking:
  - 2020 NX300 F Sport (6 yr), 75,000 km, 台南: 1,158,000  <- like-for-like trim
  - 2020 NX300 豪華版 (6 yr), 36,000 km, 台北: 1,152,000   <- near-exact mileage match to our 35,000 km
  - 2020 NX300 頂級版 (6 yr), 27,000 km, 台北: 1,030,000
  - 2019 NX300 豪華版 (7 yr), 11,100 km, 高雄: 1,098,000
  - 2020 NX300 豪華版 (6 yr), 120,000 km, 台南: 898,000
Against the NX300 F Sport's original Taiwan list of roughly 2,280,000, the like-for-like car sits at 50.8% of list at 6 years and 75,000 km. Our checkpoint is one year YOUNGER and at less than half that mileage, which on the observed mileage sensitivity of this model is worth roughly +10 points of ratio combined.

METHOD. Rather than lean on that single cross-generation denominator (which could not be verified first-hand - see the confidence note), the ratio is set by interpolating this record's own list-basis dealer-retail curve between the two points that ARE anchored on real current-generation and near-generation listings: 66.5% at year 3 and 45.6% at year 7. The linear midpoint is 56.1%; taken at 55.5%, shaded down for the unwinding 2022-2024 shortage premium. The predecessor evidence above independently supports 56-60%, so 55.5% is the conservative end of what the data allows.
  dealer retail = 0.555 x 2,630,000 = ~1,460,000
  private sale = 1,460,000 x 0.88 = ~1,285,000 (12% below dealer retail, inside the 8-15% band)
  dealer_tradein_price 1,110,000 = 13.6% below private sale
CROSS-CHECK: 1,460,000 dealer retail for a 5-year, 35,000 km NX350 F Sport against the real 6-year, 75,000 km NX300 F Sport at 1,158,000 is +26%. The components: one year younger (~+8%), 40,000 km less on a market that pays for low mileage (~+8%), and a newer generation listing 350,000 higher (~+8-10% carry-through at this age). That adds up, so the figure is not stretched.
LADDER CHECK: 51.8% of real_cost versus Overtrail 52.5% - correctly below. Absolute 1,285,000 versus Overtrail 1,215,000 - correctly above. On a list basis 48.9% versus 51.9%. All three orderings now hold.
Confidence low: cross-generation extrapolation, and the NX300 F Sport's original list price could not be confirmed first-hand this pass (kingautos' NX300 page returns HTTP 404, u-car returns HTTP 403, and the web-search budget was exhausted).

REVISED UP from 990,000 / 850,000. The reviewer was right that 990,000 was below the cheaper Overtrail's 1,035,000, an absolute inversion.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation - no current-generation NX350 exists at 7 years old in Taiwan. Benchmark is the like-for-like predecessor NX300 F Sport (2.0T AWD, original Taiwan list ~2,280,000).

NEW AND MUCH BETTER ANCHOR, found on 8891 this pass. The prior draft's best 7-year comparator was an 80,000 km car, nearly double our assumed mileage. This pass recovered a clean NX300 F Sport mileage ladder at the same model year, all dealer retail asking:
  - 2018 NX300 F Sport (8 yr), 48,000 km, 高雄: 938,000   <- essentially our exact mileage (49,000 km)
  - 2018 NX300 F Sport (8 yr), 100,000 km, 台中: 858,000
  - 2018 NX300 F Sport (8 yr), 200,000 km, 高雄: 798,000
  - 2020 NX300 F Sport (6 yr), 75,000 km, 台南: 1,158,000
Those three 2018 cars form a monotone, internally consistent mileage curve, which is what makes the 48,000 km / 938,000 point trustworthy as the low-mileage end rather than a lucky outlier.

METHOD. Expressed as retention of the NX300 F Sport's ~2,280,000 list: 41.1% at 8 years and 48,000 km, and 50.8% at 6 years and 75,000 km. Our checkpoint sits between them in age (7 years) and at the LOW end on mileage (49,000 km), so linear interpolation to 7 years gives roughly 46%, with our lower mileage arguing for the top of that. Taken at 45.6%.
  dealer retail = 0.456 x 2,630,000 = ~1,200,000
  private sale = 1,200,000 x 0.88 = ~1,056,000, set at 1,055,000 (12% below dealer retail)
  dealer_tradein_price 905,000 = 14.2% below private sale; the private/trade-in gap widens with age because dealers discount harder for stock that moves slowly.
HONEST NOTE ON SPREAD. A second, more conservative route - taking the 938,000 anchor in absolute terms, adding ~10% for one year less age, then ~8% for the newer generation's higher list - lands at ~1,115,000 dealer retail and ~980,000 private. The ratio route used above lands at 1,200,000 / 1,055,000. The gap between the two routes is about 8%, and it exists because the ratio route assumes used prices scale fully with list price across generations while the absolute route assumes they barely do; reality is between. The ratio route is used because every other checkpoint in this record and across this trim line is built the same way, and switching methods at one checkpoint is what produced the inconsistent curve in the first place. This spread is the main reason confidence stays low.
LADDER CHECK: 42.5% of real_cost versus Overtrail 44.7% - correctly below. Absolute 1,055,000 versus Overtrail 1,035,000 - correctly above. On a list basis 40.1% versus 44.2%.
No tax-bracket penalty is applied. The prior draft at one stage pushed this checkpoint down on the false premise that the NX350 is 2487cc and sits one 牌照稅 bracket above the NX300; it is 2393cc and sits in the SAME bracket. That correction stands.
Confidence low: cross-generation extrapolation with an unverified denominator and an 8% method spread.

REVISED DOWN from 750,000 / 640,000. Not objected to directly, but the old 30.2% of real_cost sat ABOVE the cheaper Overtrail's 28.7%, the same ladder inversion the reviewer flagged at year 1, and the old value was left stranded by the year-7 revision.

EXTRAPOLATED - genuinely no current-generation data can exist at this age. Benchmark is the NX200t (2015-2017, 2.0T), whose original Taiwan list prices were 2,110,000 (FWD F Sport), 2,220,000 (AWD F Sport) and 2,250,000 (全景 AWD F Sport) at the December 2014 launch.

EVIDENCE re-verified first-hand on 8891 this pass, all dealer retail asking:
  - 2016 NX200t 旗艦版 (10 yr), 79,000 km: 718,000   <- closest mileage match to our 70,000 km
  - 2016 NX200t F Sport (10 yr), 138,000 km, 高雄: 699,000
  - 2016 NX200t 豪華版 (10 yr), 63,000 km, 台南: 729,000
  - 2017 NX200t AWD F Sport (9 yr), 130,000 km, 高雄: 838,000
  - 2017 NX200t F Sport (9 yr), 129,800 km, 台北: 679,000
  - 2015 NX200t AWD F Sport (11 yr), 190,000 km, 台中: 638,000
By this age the market has largely stopped paying for either trim or mileage - the 63,000 km, 79,000 km and 138,000 km cars all sit within 30,000 of each other, and the two 2017 F Sports at nearly identical mileage differ by 159,000. Prices are dominated by condition and by how long the dealer has been sitting on the car.

METHOD. The 79,000 km / 718,000 車 on a 2,250,000 list gives 31.9% of list, and it is the only comparator within 10,000 km of our checkpoint. Applied at 31.0% rather than 31.9%, one point lower per the trim-ladder rule (the comparator is that generation's 旗艦版; equipment grade is not paid for at 10 years, and a top trim's ratio should sit at or below a cheaper one's).
  dealer retail = 0.310 x 2,630,000 = ~815,000
  private sale = 815,000 x 0.88 = ~717,000, set at 715,000 (12% below dealer retail)
  dealer_tradein_price 610,000 = 14.7% below private sale; at this age many dealers will simply decline the car, so this remains the weakest number in the record.
LADDER CHECK: 28.8% of real_cost versus Overtrail 28.7% - level, with the residual being the discount artifact rather than a real difference. Absolute 715,000 versus Overtrail 665,000 - correctly above. On a list basis 27.2% versus the Overtrail's 28.4%, correctly lower.
DENOMINATOR WARNING: the 2,250,000 and 2,220,000 NX200t launch prices come from a U-CAR launch article that returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch, and the web-search budget for this session is exhausted, so they could not be re-read first-hand. That unverified denominator, plus the cross-generation extrapolation, is why confidence is low.

maintenance.plan_notes:
REBUILT IN RESPONSE TO THE CROSS-TRIM REVIEW. The prior total of 390,000 was the highest in the entire NX line - above the Overtrail (330,000), which is the SAME car mechanically, and above the 450h+ F Sport (310,500), which carries the SAME 20-inch fitment plus a high-voltage system. The reviewer was right that no stated reason supported that, and that the round numbers (15,000 / 35,000 / 105,000 / 55,000 / 180,000) looked assembled rather than derived. Every window has been rebuilt from the official interval table and benchmarked line-by-line against the Overtrail, whose drivetrain is identical (T24A-FTS 2.4 turbo, 8AT, AWD, same service scopes). New total 357,500.

WHAT THE F SPORT PREMIUM ACTUALLY IS - NOW VERIFIED, NOT ASSERTED. cars.tvbs.com.tw's 2026 NX spec table gives the 350 F Sport版 235/50R20 while the 350 Overtrail版 and 200菁英版 both run 235/60R18; kingautos spec 9590 independently confirms '20 吋鋁圈' with 235/50 front and rear on the 2022 F Sport. Real Taiwan retail for that size, checked first-hand on PChome 24h: Michelin Primacy 5 Energy 235/50R20 at 45,600 for four (11,400 each), with budget brands from 5,700 each. A premium OE-grade set fitted, balanced and aligned costs roughly 41,000-45,000, against roughly 30,000-32,000 for the Overtrail's 18-inch fitment. Across the two tyre sets this car needs in ten years that is a genuine premium of roughly 22,000-25,000, and it is essentially the whole of the 27,500 gap to the Overtrail. A small further allowance sits in the brake lines for the heavier wheel and tyre.
I could NOT verify that the NX350 F Sport carries a larger brake package than other NX trims, so no separate 'F Sport brakes' premium is claimed - only the modest effect of the larger wheel. The prior draft's implied brake premium is removed.

FREE-MAINTENANCE PROGRAMME - CONFIRMED NEGATIVE, WITH ONE EXCEPTION. lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx was re-fetched first-hand. It publishes the interval table and confirms exactly one complimentary item: the first-month new-car service (24 inspection items, free from registration). It describes NO ongoing complimentary scheduled-maintenance programme and publishes no prices. lexus.com.tw/ownerservice exposes only navigation links (保證方案/延長保證, 保養計劃, 服務特色, 和泰點數, 零件與服務) with no figures. All scheduled maintenance from the 6-month service onward is therefore modelled as SELF-PAID, the conservative assumption. This is a confirmed negative, not an unchecked gap.

WARRANTY - CORRECTED AGAIN, AND IT MOVES MONEY THIS TIME. lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx was re-fetched. The Lexus Taiwan new-car warranty is 4 years or 120,000 km, whichever comes first, with 3-year paint/surface-rust cover, 6-year rust-perforation cover, 3-year battery cover and 3-year tyre manufacturing-defect cover. The page ALSO states a FREE extension to a 5th year / 140,000 km for owners who keep every scheduled visit on time (within 6 months) at Lexus authorised dealers - which is exactly what this model assumes the owner does. The prior draft missed this and charged a 2,000 out-of-warranty repair allowance inside the 3-to-5 window; that allowance is removed, and the 5-to-7 window is now the FIRST one genuinely outside cover. At 7,000 km/year the distance legs (120,000 / 140,000 km) never bind. Self-paid replacement parts carry a separate 2-year / 50,000 km warranty.

SERVICE INTERVAL (confirmed first-hand from the official 保養計劃 table): 每 10,000 公里或 6 個月, whichever comes first, with escalating scopes - 1 month new-car check (24 items, free), 10,000 km / 6 months oil change (16 items), 20,000 km / 12 months oil + filters (29 items), 40,000 km / 24 months brake fluid + transmission check (34 items), 80,000 km / 48 months coolant + transmission oil + fuel filter (37 items). At 7,000 km/year the TIME leg always fires first, so this car sees two visits per year regardless of distance - a light ~3,500 km oil service at 6 months and a fuller service at 12 months. This is exactly the low-mileage trap: the owner pays the full annual cadence while accumulating almost no distance, so cost per km is high even though total spend looks moderate.

CONSUMABLE TIMING is age-driven, not distance-driven, at this mileage. Tyres dominate: at 7,000 km/year the tread on 235/50R20 rubber outlasts the rubber itself, so replacement is triggered by hardening and cracking at roughly years 5 and 10-11, not by wear. This is why period_cost is NOT monotonic - the 3-to-5 window (99,600) carries the first tyre set and the 5-to-7 window (60,500) falls back because tyres and 12V battery were just done. 12V battery lands around years 4-5 and again around 8-9. Brake pads stretch a long way at this mileage (front around year 5, rear around year 6-7), with discs due around 70,000 km. Coolant and brake fluid follow the 24/48-month cycle.

ENGINE. Toyota T24A-FTS 2.4L turbocharged inline-4, 2393cc (not 2487cc - that is the A25A 2.5L in the NX250 and 350h). Four iridium spark plugs are a real later-life line item and cost more on this engine than on the NX200's 2.0 NA. assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use the midpoint of 7,000 km/year, so assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Two consequences drive this record. (1) Resale: the car is a genuine low-mileage example at every age, so it should sell above the mileage-blind average, and every used-price data point below was mileage-adjusted upward toward the low-km end of its listing band. (2) Maintenance: Lexus Taiwan's published service interval is 6 months OR 10,000 km, whichever comes first — VERIFIED directly against lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx, which lists 1 month (24-item), 6 months/10,000 km (16-item), 12 months/20,000 km (29-item), 24 months/40,000 km (34-item) and 48 months/80,000 km (37-item). At 7,000 km/year this owner is therefore entirely TIME-driven: ~20 workshop visits over 10 years for only 70,000 km, versus the 7 visits the mileage table alone would imply. Time-driven servicing costs materially MORE than the official per-100,000-km figure suggests, and this is reflected in the maintenance numbers. A PHEV amplifies this: short low-mileage trips run mostly in EV mode, so the engine accumulates very few hours but oil, brake fluid, coolant and the 12V AGM battery still degrade on the calendar. IMPORTANT FOR THIS TRIM: low mileage also means tyres and brake discs are replaced on AGE, not on wear — which is exactly why the F Sport's 20-inch fitment, not its engine, is what separates its maintenance bill from the 450h+ 豪華版's. Tax and insurance are excluded from this record by design. Home-charger (wallbox) installation, typically NT$30,000-60,000 for a PHEV owner, is also excluded — it is not one of the 領牌/代辦/配件 categories.

purchase.notes: Discount: Lexus Taiwan (Hotai) holds price firmly and the observed spread on the volume 450h+ 豪華版 was NT$45,000-140,000 cash. The midpoint was deliberately NOT used for the F Sport. The NT$140,000 sheet was a November year-end clearance on the high-volume base PHEV trim, which carried inventory pressure; the F Sport is the low-volume flagship, ordered rather than stocked, and consistently sees a smaller cash concession. NT$60,000 is 2.1% of list — small, consistent with Lexus practice, and defensible against the only two real transaction sheets available. It satisfies the brief's 'Lexus discounts little' instruction while remaining tied to real transaction evidence rather than to an assumption. On-road fees NT$35,000, at the upper end of the 20,000-40,000 band because this is a NT$2.8M car: 領牌 (plates + 監理站 regulatory fees) ~NT$5,000, 代辦費 (dealer processing) ~NT$8,000, and 配件 ~NT$22,000 for the accessory pack an actual buyer at this level takes (dashcam, window film, all-weather mats, cargo tray, paint coating). The verified PTT sheet explicitly records 是否含領牌稅金：否, confirming these fees are genuinely additive to the quoted cash price. real_cost = 2,845,000 - 60,000 + 35,000 = 2,820,000 (arithmetic re-checked and correct). Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded by design. A home wallbox is also excluded, though a PHEV buyer without home charging loses most of this car's running-cost advantage — worth flagging separately in the comparison.
