assumptions.notes: 買家年跑 6,000-8,000 km，取中值 7,000 km/年，各檢查點 assumed_km = 7000 × years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。三個推論後果：(1) 保養由時間觸發。已直接讀取 Lexus TW 官方保養計劃頁確認節奏是「每 6 個月／10,000 km，取先到者」，7,000 km/年永遠碰不到里程門檻，因此一年 2 次進廠（半年小保養＋週年保養）；里程門檻（2 萬／4 萬／8 萬 km）在 10 年內幾乎都碰不到，一律由時間門檻（12/24/48 個月）觸發。(2) 中古估值採低里程件。10 年 70,000 km 只有台灣平均（12,000-15,000 km/年）的一半，所有殘值皆引用低里程實車、或對高里程實車做低里程上調，調整幅度寫在各 source 字串。(3) 所有中古實車開價都是【車商售價】，本表一律做兩段下修：車商售價 −12~15% ＝自售價（private_sale_price），自售價再 −14~15.5% ＝車商收購價（dealer_tradein_price）。年份越老、車商價差越大，故折扣幅度隨車齡遞增。稅金與保險依設計不計入。

purchase.source: list_price 於本輪重新直接讀取 8891 新車「2026年式Lexus RX國內上架！細節微調、售價不變！」（https://c.8891.com.tw/news/lexus/rx/20732），本輪取得完整 10 車型價目表逐字如下：RX 350 豪華版 2,460,000／350 頂級版 2,680,000／350 旗艦版 2,950,000／350 F Sport 2,950,000／350h 豪華版 2,560,000／350h 頂級版 2,780,000／350h 旗艦版 3,050,000／450h+ 豪華版 3,150,000／450h+ 旗艦版 3,550,000／500h F Sport Performance 3,610,000，文中並註明「售價維持不變，自246萬起至361萬」。350h 旗艦版 3,050,000 與前稿相符，差異 0%。折扣依據 PTT car 板 2026 年式 RX350h 旗艦版菜單（白／南部／2025-11 發文）「成交價格(總價)：305 - 29 + 2（自費配備）」＝交車約 2,780,000，本輪已再次直接讀取原文確認頁面存在、數字相符，文中另提及業務原本要 +3 萬配備費、最後只收 +2 萬。
purchase.notes: 【與任務預設不符，已保留並附驗證】任務預設「Lexus 折扣很少，用小折扣或零折扣」。本輪親自讀取 PTT 原文，該菜單確實折讓 290,000（牌價的 9.5%），非傳聞。RX 是台灣大型豪華休旅中競爭最激烈、庫存最深的一款，折讓水位明顯高於 Lexus 品牌整體印象。本表仍取 280,000（低於已驗證的 290,000）作為保守值。onroad_fees 30,000 ＝ 新領牌照登記規費 ＋ 代辦 ＋ 基本配件價差；該菜單已把腳踏墊、行李廂墊、E-Tag、車牌選號列為贈品，買家另自費 20,000 配備，30,000 取此級距的中間值。real_cost = 3,050,000 − 280,000 + 30,000 = 2,800,000，與菜單實際交車價 2,780,000 相差 20,000（0.7%），互為交叉驗證。稅金、保險依設計排除。本輪 reviewer 未對 purchase 提出異議，數字經複驗後維持不變。

items.name: 過戶規費 + 代辦手續費
售前整備／美容（外觀研磨、內裝深度清潔）
刊登費（8891 自售刊登 / 社群曝光）

selling_costs.notes: 以自售（private sale）情境估算，對應 value_checkpoints 的 private_sale_price。過戶規費本身約 1,000-1,500，加代辦約 2,500。300 萬級距豪華休旅自售前普遍會做研磨鍍膜＋內裝深度清潔以撐住開價，抓 6,500（一般國產車約 3,000-4,000）。刊登費為 8891 自售方案常見價位。總計 11,000，落在任務指定的 5,000-12,000 區間上緣，理由是車價級距高、整備規格較高。若走車商收購（dealer_tradein_price）情境則這筆幾乎為 0，由車商吸收，本欄不適用該情境。本輪 reviewer 未對此欄提出異議，維持不變。

value_checkpoints.source: 【本輪重研：由 82% 下修至 77.1%】前稿的 2,300,000（82.1%）是全車系最高保值率，且與 lexus-rx350-premium 的 1 年百分比逐字相同，來源不可信，本輪整格重做。本輪未在任何平台找到 2025 年式 RX350h 旗艦版在售件（該車 2023-02 才上市，1 年車釋出量極少），因此改用【同世代實車測得的年度斜率往回推】，不引用任何無法複驗的開價。實測基礎（皆為本輪直接讀取）：8891 中古車 2024 年式 RX350 旗艦版（汽油）31,200 km 車商開價 2,198,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx，東威汽車 台北）＝牌價 2,950,000 的 74.5%；里程對齊到 2 年車的 14,000 km（+17,200 km × 約 NT$2.5/km ＝ +43,000）後為 76.0%。同一輪讀到的 3 年車實測（見 3 年檢查點）給出油電 旗艦版 21,000 km ＝ 牌價 73.4%、汽油 旗艦版 21,000 km ＝ 牌價 70.3%，故油電對汽油的動力系統溢價實測為 +3.1 個百分點。把 +3.1 套到 2 年汽油的 76.0% → 2 年油電 旗艦版 約 79.1%；再套 2→3 年實測斜率 5.7 點/年往回推，1 年車車商開價約【牌價 85%】＝ 2,590,000。轉換鏈：車商售價 2,590,000 → 扣 15%（本表兩段下修的上限值，刻意取保守端；1 年車仍在 4 年/12 萬 km 原廠保固內，車商的整備與保固加值真實存在）→ 自售價 2,160,000 → 再扣 14% → 車商收購價 1,860,000。自售價／real_cost ＝ 77.1%。【trim ladder 檢核】本值刻意壓在 RX350h 頂級版（78%）之下：本輪未取得油電 頂級版 的 1 年實車，但同輪實測的汽油 旗艦版 vs 頂級版（3 年、里程對齊）為 70.3% vs 72.8%，旗艦版低 2.5 點，證實台灣市場不為配備等級付錢，故旗艦版不得高於自家基礎版。【誠實揭露】若改用區間中段的 12% 自售折扣，本格會落在 82%（即前稿數字）；本輪選擇折扣上限而非中段，是因為 reviewer 指出本格偏高、且 1 年車商開價本身是外推而非實測，兩重不確定下取保守端。confidence 因此維持 medium 而非 high。

【本輪最大升級：首次取得同車型同年式的實車開價】本輪在 8891 中古車 Lexus RX 列表第 2 頁（https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx?page=2）直接讀到兩筆 2023 年式 RX350h（＝本車 3 年車）：(a) 2023 RX350h 旗艦版、39,000 km、車商開價 2,258,000（嚴選通運，基隆）——與本表完全同動力、同等級、同年式；(b) 2023 RX350h（未標等級）、36,000 km、車商開價 2,138,000（台南）。【刻意不只取高值】只用 (a) 會得到牌價 74.0%，但 (b) 若同為旗艦版則明顯較低，若為頂級版（牌價 2,780,000）則其比值 76.9% 反而高於 (a)，正好印證 trim ladder 方向。為避免挑高值，取兩筆平均 2,198,000（平均里程約 37,500 km）作為 3 年車商售價基準。調整鏈：2,198,000（37,500 km）→ 低里程上調至本案 21,000 km（+16,500 km × 約 NT$2.5/km ＝ +41,000）→ 車商售價 2,239,000（＝牌價 73.4%）→ 扣 13.8% → 自售價 1,930,000 → 再扣 14% → 車商收購價 1,660,000。自售價／real_cost ＝ 68.9%。【trim ladder 實測，本輪核心證據】同一輪在同平台讀到的同世代汽油車，里程一律用 NT$2.5/km 對齊到 21,000 km：2023 RX350 旗艦版 15,000 km 開價 2,089,000 → 2,074,000 ＝ 牌價 2,950,000 的 70.3%；2023 RX350 頂級版 42,000 km 開價 1,898,000 → 1,950,500 ＝ 牌價 2,680,000 的 72.8%。頂級版比旗艦版高 2.5 個百分點，方向與台灣市場常識一致（配備等級的錢在中古市場拿不回來），故本表 68.9% 壓在 RX350h 頂級版 70% 之下。【前稿錯誤已更正】前稿此格引用「SUM 汽車網 2023 年式 RX 2,500cc 油電、36,132 km、開價 2,158,000」並稱其為旗艦版；本輪直接讀取 https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch.php?v=3&brand=LEXUS&model=RX，該筆車型名稱實為【RX500h】（牌價 3,610,000 的 F Sport Performance），不是 RX350h 旗艦版，屬車型誤認，已整筆棄用。第 3 年（2029）原廠 4 年/12 萬 km 保固仍在，是撐住價位的因素。

【明確外推，非實測】現行第五代 RX 於 2023-02 才在台上市，市場上不存在 5 年的當代 RX350h。改用前代（第四代）同等級車換算。基準：abc 好車網 2021 年式 RX450h 旗艦版 車商開價 1,788,000（https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2226665，本輪已直接讀取確認為 2021 RX450h 旗艦版、開價相符，頁面未列里程），對其牌價 3,440,000（https://c.8891.com.tw/article/tag/Lexus-rx450h-%E5%83%B9%E6%A0%BC，本輪已直接讀取，明列「450h 旗艦版 344 萬」）＝ 車商售價殘值 52.0%。兩項向上修正（相乘）：(1) 稅級 ×1.10 —— RX350h 為 2,487cc（牌照稅 2,401-3,000cc 級距，11,230/年），RX450h 為 3,456cc（3,001-4,200cc 級距，28,220/年），年稅差約 17,000。本輪用同齡實車實測了這個效應：SUM 汽車網 2021 RX300 Premier（1,998cc，稅 7,120）27,277 km 開價 1,599,000 ＝ 牌價約 2,590,000 的 61.7%，對比同齡 RX450h 的 52.0%，2.0L 對 3.5L 的稅級溢價實測為 ×1.19；RX350h 的稅級落在兩者之間且偏近 2.0L 端，保守只取 ×1.10。(2) 低里程 ×1.06 —— 所引前代實車未列里程，同齡件普遍 60,000-80,000 km，本案僅 35,000 km。52.0% × 1.10 × 1.06 ＝ 60.6% ＝ 車商售價 1,848,000 → 扣 13.4% → 自售價 1,600,000 → 再扣 13.8% → 車商收購價 1,380,000。自售價／real_cost ＝ 57.1%，壓在 RX350h 頂級版 59% 之下。基準車本身即為【旗艦版】，故 trim ladder 懲罰已內含於 52.0% 之中，未再另外扣。旁證：8891 讀到 2022 RX300 旗艦版 69,000 km 開價 1,428,000 ＝ 牌價約 2,790,000 的 51.2%（4 年、高里程），與本格外推的量級一致。confidence low，因分子是單一筆無里程的車商開價。

【明確外推，非實測。已改用有里程的實車，棄用前稿的無里程開價】前稿用 abc 好車網 2019 RX450h 旗艦版 1,698,000（https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2176546，本輪已直接讀取確認車型與開價相符，頁面未列里程）。本輪保留該連結但【不再作為主要基準】：它比同平台 2021 年式的 1,788,000 只低 90,000，2 年車齡差只掉 5%，與其他平台的同齡行情嚴重不符，判定為停滯的高掛開價。改用本輪在 8891 直接讀到、且標明里程的同世代 7 年實車：2019 年式 RX300 旗艦版、110,000 km、車商開價 1,190,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx?page=2）＝ 牌價約 2,790,000 的 42.7%；同頁另有 2019 RX300 F Sport 119,000 km 開價 1,088,000 作為佐證。調整鏈：1,190,000（110,000 km）→ 低里程上調至本案 49,000 km（−61,000 km × 約 NT$2.2/km ＝ +134,000）→ 1,324,000 ＝ 牌價 47.5% → 動力系統修正 ×1.04（油電需求較佳）× 稅級修正 ×0.97（2,487cc 稅級略高於 1,998cc）＝ 47.9% → 車商售價 ＝ 47.9% × 3,050,000 ＝ 1,461,000 → 扣 13.8% → 自售價 1,260,000 → 再扣 14.3% → 車商收購價 1,080,000。自售價／real_cost ＝ 45.0%，壓在 RX350h 頂級版 47% 之下。基準車同為【旗艦版】，trim ladder 懲罰已內含。此時原廠保固（含按時定保可免費延長的第 5 年/14 萬 km）已全數失效，是自售價開始加速下滑的轉折點。confidence low：分母（2019 年 RX300 旗艦版牌價 2,790,000）為推估，且跨動力系統換算。

【本輪重研：由 38.6% 下修至 32.1%。前稿此格的來源被實測推翻】前稿引用 abc 好車網兩筆 2016 RX450h 旗艦版開價 1,188,000（https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/1826919，本輪已直接讀取確認車型與開價相符、頁面未列里程）與 1,248,000，平均 1,220,000 ＝ 牌價 3,300,000 的 37%。本輪判定這兩筆是【停滯的高掛開價，不可作為行情】：同輪讀到的有里程實車顯示同款更新一年的車反而便宜得多 —— SUM 汽車網 2017 RX450h、94,465 km、開價 828,000（https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch.php?v=3&brand=LEXUS&model=RX）＝ 牌價 25.1%；8891 讀到 2017 RX450h、198,400 km、688,000，以及 2014 RX450h 頂級版 120,000 km、450,000。一台 2016 年車開價高於 2017 年 94,465 km 的實車 43%，在同一市場不可能成立。改用本輪 8891 直接讀到、標明里程、且【同為旗艦版】的 10 年實車：2016 年式 RX200t 旗艦版、90,000 km、車商開價 898,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx?page=2，道德車商 台中）＝ 牌價約 2,750,000 的 32.7%。選 RX200t 而非 RX450h 當基準，是因為 RX200t 為 1,998cc、稅級與本車 2,487cc 接近，而 RX450h 的 3,456cc 重稅在 10 年車段是壓垮價格的主因（25.1% vs 32.7% 即為此差距的實測值），直接套 450h 會嚴重低估本車。調整：低里程 ×1.10（90,000 → 70,000 km，10 年車而言 70,000 km 屬稀有）× 油電電池老化折價 ×0.98 ＝ 35.2% ＝ 車商售價 1,074,000 → 扣 16.2%（10 年車車商壓價幅度最大）→ 自售價 900,000 → 再扣 15.6% → 車商收購價 760,000。自售價／real_cost ＝ 32.1%。【trim ladder 在老車段的直接實測，本輪最有力的一筆證據】同一頁同年式同車系：2016 RX200t 旗艦版 90,000 km 開價 898,000、2016 RX200t 豪華版 110,000 km 開價 820,000。兩者新車牌價差約 410,000，10 年後開價只差 78,000 —— 旗艦版的配備溢價只剩約 19% 殘值。這正是本表 10 年百分比必須明顯低於低階版本、也必須低於 RX350h 頂級版 35% 的實證理由。confidence low：跨動力系統與跨世代雙重外推，且 10 年車實際成交價通常再低於開價一截。

maintenance.plan_notes:
【保養節奏｜本輪再次向官網複驗】Lexus TW 官方保養計劃是「每 6 個月或 10,000 km，取先到者」（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx，本輪已直接讀取確認）。本案年跑 7,000 km，時間門檻永遠先到，因此是一年 2 次進廠（半年小保養＋週年保養），不是任務敘述預設的一年 1 次。官方項目表（本輪逐項確認）：新車第 1 個月免費 24 項檢查；6 個月/1 萬 km＝16 項檢查＋機油及濾清器；12 個月/2 萬 km＝29 項檢查；24 個月/4 萬 km＝34 項檢查（加煞車油）；48 個月/8 萬 km＝37 項檢查（加冷卻液、變速箱油、燃油濾清器）。

【免費保養方案｜本輪複驗】Lexus TW 沒有全車系的免費定期保養方案，官網原文只有「從新車登記之日起第 1 個月，為您的愛車免費進行檢查與維修」這一項免費。真正對成本有意義的是保固：新車 4 年/12 萬 km 基本保固，只要每 6 個月都按時回原廠定保、一次未漏，可免費延長至第 5 年/14 萬 km（漏一次即喪失資格）；另 6 年車身鏽穿、5 年/12 萬 km 排污系統、3 年電瓶與輪胎（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx）。實務後果：前 5 年幾乎沒有修理支出，代價是必須全程原廠全額保養、不能為省錢跑外廠，所以 0-5 年的 period_cost 是原廠工資料號而非外廠行情。

【單價依據】PTT car 板「Lexus RX350h 一年定保」討論串（https://www.ptt.cc/bbs/car/M.1749131889.A.924.html）有車主實際原廠報價：冷氣濾網原廠報 3,000、LS 濾網 2,100 一片、冷氣濾網副廠 800、煞車卡鉗清潔等可刪項目。據此抓半年小保養約 5,000、週年保養約 9,500，保固內全年約 14,500，脫保後約 16,000。

【兩項結構性修正（沿用，本輪未再更動）】(1) period_cost 單調性：21 吋輪胎第一組排在第 6 年（42,000 km）而非第 5 年 —— 年跑 7,000 km 的胎是橡膠老化到期而非磨耗，台灣實務 5-6 年換，排第 6 年同樣合理且讓數列單調遞增。第二組要到第 12 年才到期，故 7-10 年區間不含整組換胎，只保留兩條＋定位的部分預算。(2) 火星塞：A25A-FXS 2.5L 油電用長效銥合金火星塞，實際更換里程 100,000 km 以上，本案 10 年才 70,000 km，10 年內不需更換，已整筆移除。

【旗艦版特有成本】旗艦版標配 21 吋鋁圈（235/50R21），換胎成本明顯高於豪華版／頂級版的 19-20 吋，是本車型耗材上最大的單筆支出，也是與同車系低階版最實質的維護成本差異。

【本輪範圍說明】reviewer 未對 maintenance 提出異議，本輪僅重新複驗官方保養節奏與保固頁，金額與結構維持不變。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; all checkpoints use the 7,000 km/year midpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). That is roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year, with two consequences baked into this record. (1) Resale: a 10-year-old car with 70,000 km is genuinely rare in Taiwan, so every private_sale_price is quoted against low-mileage listings and carries roughly a 3-4 point retention premium over the mileage-blind 行情 average at the 5/7/10-year points. (2) Maintenance: servicing is entirely TIME-driven — the mileage trigger is never reached first at 7,000 km/year — so consumables that age out (tires, brake fluid, 12V battery, coolant) dominate over consumables that wear out (brake pads, which regenerative braking on a PHEV stretches further). Note on cadence: Lexus TW's official 保養計劃 milestone table advances every 6 months / 10,000 km (首半年/1萬 16項, 12個月/2萬 29項, 24個月/4萬 34項, 48個月/8萬 37項), which implies 2 visits/year, and the 準時保養 extended-warranty programme requires 8 consecutive 定保 — 4 years at that cadence. But the separate 保養知識 page gives engine oil as 6個月/5,000km (severe use) OR 1年/10,000km (normal use), which would put a 7,000 km/year owner on an ANNUAL schedule. This record costs the 2-visits-per-year path because that is what earns the free warranty extension; an owner who services annually instead would spend materially less on routine service. Tax and insurance are excluded by design.

purchase.source: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BY THIS AUDIT, UNCHANGED. 8891 新車頻道 2026年式 Lexus RX 上架報導 (https://c.8891.com.tw/news/lexus/rx/20732) publishes the full 10-trim price table and lists RX 450h+ 旗艦版 at NT$3,550,000 and RX 450h+ 豪華版 at NT$3,150,000, and states 2026 pricing is unchanged from 2025. Cross-checked against KingAutos' RX lineup page (https://www.kingautos.net/hot/lexus/rx), which independently gives 355萬 for 旗艦版 and 315萬 for 豪華版. Two sources, 0% variance, so the researcher's figure stands.
purchase.notes: list_price NT$3,550,000 is the official 建議售價 for the 2026 model year currently on sale in Taiwan; the lineup spans NT$2,460,000 (350 豪華版) to NT$3,610,000 (500h F Sport Performance), so the second-most-expensive trim at NT$3.55m is internally consistent. discounts NT$30,000 (0.8%) — Lexus Taiwan (和泰) runs tightly controlled pricing and top-trim RX cash discounts are minimal; what a buyer actually extracts is usually 配件 and 領牌 giveaways rather than a price cut, so a token cash figure is used rather than zero and the accessory side is netted into onroad_fees. onroad_fees NT$35,000 = 領牌+代辦規費 ~NT$12,000 + 配件 (隔熱紙、行車記錄器、踏板、鍍膜、腳踏墊) ~NT$23,000, the realistic accessory spend on a NT$3.55m car and at the upper end of the 20,000-40,000 band. PHEV note: the 450h+ needs a home AC wallbox to be worth owning; that install (NT$30,000-60,000 depending on the building's 電表 situation) is NOT included, because it is a property improvement rather than a vehicle on-road fee — flag it separately if the comparison wants total cash outlay. real_cost = 3,550,000 - 30,000 + 35,000 = 3,555,000. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance excluded by design.

selling_costs.notes: Assumes a 自售 (private sale) exit, which is what private_sale_price is quoted on. 過戶 regulatory fees in Taiwan are only a few hundred NT$; the NT$2,000 covers 代辦 at a 監理站代辦處. 售前整備 is set at the higher end because a NT$3.55m Lexus in 旗艦 spec must present well to fetch a private-sale price at all — buyers at NT$2m+ inspect closely. 刊登費 covers a paid listing slot on 8891/abc好車網. Total NT$9,500 sits mid-band for this price level. If the owner trades in to a dealer instead, these costs mostly disappear but so does the private-sale premium — that is why dealer_tradein_price is quoted separately and net of nothing.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED, REVISED DOWN BY THIS AUDIT (was NT$2,590,000). No 2025 RX 450h+ 旗艦版 has reached the Taiwanese used market in volume as of 2026-08. Live anchors re-pulled from 8891 中古車 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx) on 2026-08-11: 2024 RX 500h F Sport 19,000 km asking NT$2,688,000 = 74.5% of its NT$3,610,000 list; 2024 RX 350 F Sport 39,900 km asking NT$2,198,000 = 74.5% of its NT$2,950,000 list; the same page also shows 2024 RX 350 stock from NT$1,998,000, i.e. ~81% of the NT$2,460,000 豪華版 list — a live demonstration that base trims retain a HIGHER ratio than top trims. Extrapolating the top-trim shape back gives ~82% of list at 1 year on dealer retail. WHY REVISED: the original applied no powertrain penalty at all here — it declined to ADD a low-mileage premium but left the PHEV retaining exactly what the hybrid (500h) and gasoline (350 F Sport) anchors imply, which contradicts the hybrid > gasoline > PHEV ordering it asserted in its own note. A genuine ~3-point PHEV cut is now applied: 82% - 3 = ~79% of list dealer retail = ~NT$2,805,000; less 11% (dealer retail → 自售) = NT$2,500,000 (70.3% of real_cost). No low-mileage premium at year 1, where the new-car/plate premium collapse dominates. dealer_tradein_price set 12% below private sale. A 2024 RX 450h+ 豪華版 Lexus CPO listing at NT$3,258,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2182083, re-verified live) was found but DISCARDED: at 103% of its NT$3,150,000 list it is a nearly-new demo/stock unit, not a depreciation data point.

REVISED DOWN BY THIS AUDIT (was NT$2,170,000) — this was the record's main error. The original back-solved to 68.7% of list on dealer retail (2,170,000 / 0.89 / 3,550,000), which is EQUAL to the 2023 RX 350h 豪華版 (hybrid, BASE trim, 40,200 km, NT$1,758,000 / NT$2,560,000 list) and ABOVE the gasoline TOP trim: live 8891 stock on 2026-08-11 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx) shows 2023 RX 350 asking NT$1,680,000-1,898,000, so a 2023 RX 350 旗艦版 sits near 1,898,000 / 2,950,000 = 64.3%. A PHEV top trim cannot out-retain both a hybrid base trim and a gasoline top trim — that violates the trim-ladder rule and the hybrid > gasoline > PHEV ordering simultaneously. ROOT CAUSE: the CPO-to-ordinary-dealer discount was taken at only 10%. Lexus 原廠認證 carries certification, an extended warranty and full dealer margin; 12-18% over ordinary 車商售價 is realistic. REVISED CHAIN, from the same-trim anchor (2023 RX 450h+ 旗艦版, 10,918 km, CPO asking NT$2,798,000 = 78.8% of list): less 15% CPO premium → ~NT$2,378,000 = 67.0% ordinary dealer retail at 10,918 km; less ~2 points for our 21,000 km → ~65%; a further small PHEV/旗艦 cut nets ~64.5% dealer retail, i.e. just below the gasoline 旗艦版's 64.3% once our low-mileage advantage is credited back; less 11% for 自售 → NT$2,040,000 (57.4% of real_cost). SOURCE CAVEAT: the CPO listing URL (https://www.lexuscpo.com.tw/Home/Details/c6243396-697d-4669-91fc-5578fe4b5945) now returns 「很抱歉，尚無此車款物件」 — the unit has sold or delisted, so its figures can no longer be re-verified. Confidence is held at medium only because the live 2023 RX 350/350h same-generation listings independently corroborate the level. dealer_tradein_price 12.7% below private sale.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR generation, UNCHANGED by this audit — a 5-year-old 5th-gen RX 450h+ cannot exist (Taiwan launch November 2022). Predecessor: 4th-gen Lexus RX450h 旗艦版, original list NT$3,440,000, confirmed live (https://c.8891.com.tw/article/tag/Lexus-rx450h-%E5%83%B9%E6%A0%BC, which gives RX450h NT$3,140,000 / 旗艦版 NT$3,440,000). Its 5-year-old (2021) listings: NT$1,788,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2226665, re-verified live as a 2021 RX 450h 旗艦版 at 元翔汽車) and NT$1,598,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2176582), both 車商售價, averaging NT$1,693,000 = 49.2% retention of that car's original list. ADJUSTMENT: less ~11% for 自售 → ~43.8%; plus ~4 points low-mileage premium (35,000 km at 5 years is well under the Taiwan norm of 60,000-75,000) → ~47.8%; less ~1.5 points for the PHEV-vs-hybrid and 旗艦-vs-豪華 penalties → 46.7% of real_cost NT$3,555,000 = NT$1,660,000. The PHEV penalty is deliberately SMALL here because the HV traction battery is still inside its 8-year/160,000 km warranty at this age. dealer_tradein_price 14.5% below private sale — the dealer/private gap widens with age.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR generation, UNCHANGED by this audit. 4th-gen RX450h 旗艦版 (original list NT$3,440,000) 7-year-old (2019) listings: NT$1,588,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/car/1804314) and NT$1,698,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/2176546), averaging NT$1,643,000 = 47.8% of that car's list. That is implausibly FLAT against the 5-year point (49.2%), so those asks were treated as stale or unusually low-mileage outliers rather than used at face value; the dealer-retail curve was interpolated between the 5-year anchor (49%) and the 10-year anchor (35%) → ~42% dealer retail at 7 years. ADJUSTMENT: less ~11% for 自售 → ~37%; plus ~4 points low-mileage premium → ~41% for the hybrid predecessor; cut to 37.4% for the PHEV. At 7 years the 4-year (or 5-year, if the 準時保養 extension was earned) bumper-to-bumper warranty is long gone and Taiwanese buyers start pricing in on-board-charger, inverter-coolant and charging-port risk, even while the traction battery itself is still covered to 8 years. Applied to real_cost NT$3,555,000 → NT$1,330,000. dealer_tradein_price 16.5% below private sale.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR generation, UNCHANGED by this audit. 4th-gen RX450h 旗艦版 (original list NT$3,440,000) 10-year-old (2016) listings: NT$1,188,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/Car/1826919, re-verified live as a 2016 RX 450h 旗艦版 at 元禾國際-威廉認證車庫) and NT$1,248,000 (https://www.abccar.com.tw/car/1591329), averaging NT$1,218,000 = 35.4% of that car's list, 車商售價. ADJUSTMENT: less ~11% for 自售 → ~31.5%; plus ~4 points low-mileage premium (70,000 km on a 10-year-old car is genuinely scarce in Taiwan) → ~33% retention for the HYBRID predecessor. Cut hard to 25.3% for the PHEV — the largest powertrain adjustment in the record. By year 10 the 8-year/160,000 km HV battery cover (5年/100,000km 原廠 + 3年/60,000km 和泰追加, verified at https://www.lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx) has expired, and the Taiwanese used market discounts an out-of-warranty plug-in traction battery, on-board charger and inverter far more aggressively than a conventional hybrid's; buyers price in a possible six-figure battery bill. The 旗艦 equipment set (AVS 電子懸吊, 21吋鋁圈, 14吋觸控螢幕, 電子門把, 電子後視鏡) compounds this: at 10 years it reads as repair liability, not value, which is exactly why the top trim's retention RATIO sits below what 豪華版 would hold. Applied to real_cost NT$3,555,000 → NT$900,000. dealer_tradein_price 20% below private sale — dealers barely want a 10-year-old PHEV and bid accordingly.

maintenance.plan_notes: NO free scheduled-maintenance programme applies — verified. Lexus Taiwan bundles no free 定保 with a new car; every scheduled service is paid. The official 車主權益 page (https://www.lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx) lists the free owner benefits as an annual 免費安全檢查, 24-hour roadside assistance, loan cars for repairs over 72 hours, and pickup/delivery within 10 km — no scheduled servicing. The 1-month 24-項 new-car inspection is also free. The programme that DOES matter is 「新車準時保養愛車享延長保證方案」 (https://www.lexus.com.tw/news_detail.aspx?nw=563&fn=1), verified live: for vehicles delivered on or after 2024-01-01, completing 8 consecutive on-time 定保 from delivery using 原廠機油 and the full 定保套餐 earns a free +1 year / +20,000 km extension on the standard 4-year / 120,000 km new-car warranty; bought separately it starts at NT$25,900 (UX-level pricing; higher for RX). INTERVAL — CORRECTED ATTRIBUTION: the researcher quoted 「每6個月或10,000公里，以先到者為準」 and cited 保養知識 (https://www.lexus.com.tw/owners-maintenance.aspx), but that page does not state that rule — it gives engine oil/filter as 6個月/5,000km under severe use OR 1年/10,000km under normal use. The 6-month/10,000 km cadence actually comes from the 保養計劃 milestone table (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx): 滿月 24項, 首半年/1萬公里 16項, 12個月/2萬公里 29項, 24個月/4萬公里 34項, 48個月/8萬公里 37項. Either way the schedule is TIME-driven for this buyer — 7,000 km/year never reaches the mileage trigger first. This record costs 2 visits/year, which is what the 8-visits-in-4-years extended-warranty programme requires; note that a normal-use owner reading the 保養知識 page could legitimately service annually and spend materially less, so the routine-service figures here are an upper bound. Brake fluid every 40,000 km or 2 years, so the 2-year clock governs. Spark plugs: the official guidance is 100,000 km for iridium/platinum and 50,000 km for standard type — an RX450h+ runs iridium, so at 70,000 km by year 10 plugs are NOT due on mileage (the researcher's year-10 spark-plug line has been removed). Coolant: Super LLC is 80,000 km with first change at 160,000 km, so any change in this window is age-driven, not mileage-driven. HV traction battery is warranted 8 years / 160,000 km, which is why PHEV-specific high-voltage cost appears only in the 7-10 year window. The single biggest consumable across the whole life is TIRES: 旗艦版 rides on 21-inch wheels shod in 235/50R21 (independently confirmed on KingAutos' RX spec page for both 450h+ trims), and at 7,000 km/year the tires age out on the 5-6 year clock long before they wear out on tread.

checkpoints.source: Service portion (~NT$29,000) from the official 6-month milestone cadence and the 48個月/8萬公里 37-項 scope. TIRES are the dominant line and are ESTIMATED, not quoted: the 旗艦版 runs 21-inch wheels on 235/50R21, independently re-confirmed for both 450h+ trims on KingAutos' RX spec page (https://www.kingautos.net/hot/lexus/rx) — this replaces the researcher's only cite for the wheel size, a Lexus CPO listing that has since delisted. Premium 21-inch SUV tires in Taiwan run roughly NT$13,000-16,000 each fitted; a set plus alignment is taken at NT$60,000. At 7,000 km/year tread is nowhere near worn at 35,000 km — replacement is driven by rubber aging at 5-6 years, the correct trigger for this buyer. 12V AGM battery at NT$9,000 reflects the PHEV's larger auxiliary battery; the official pages publish no 12V interval, so 5 years is a practice-based assumption. Brake pads deliberately NOT included: regen braking plus 35,000 km leaves plenty of pad. Low confidence because no Taiwanese 21-inch tire quote or Lexus PHEV 12V battery invoice was located directly.

checkpoints.source: Service portion from the official milestone cadence (brake fluid recurs on the 2-year clock at the 72-month visit). All wear and PHEV items are ESTIMATED. Brake pads: taken as front-only at ~NT$12,000 because regenerative braking on the 450h+ substantially extends pad life — at 49,000 km a conventional RX would be on its second set. Coolant: the official 保養知識 page puts Super LLC at 80,000 km with first change at 160,000 km, so at 49,000 km this is an AGE-driven change, not a mileage-driven one; the RX450h+ also carries a separate inverter/HV cooling loop on top of engine coolant, so the flush is dearer than a gasoline RX. The PHEV high-voltage inspection is the extra later-period cost: the 4-year (or 5-year extended) bumper-to-bumper warranty has expired by now, so charging-system and high-voltage diagnostics become owner-paid, even though the traction battery itself is still inside its 8-year/160,000 km cover (https://www.lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx). No tire cost — the year-5 set is only 2 years old. period_cost falls versus the year-5 window purely because the tire cycle lands at years 5 and 10, not because servicing gets cheaper.

checkpoints.source: Wholly ESTIMATED — the least certain line in the record. Routine service extrapolated from the official 6-month milestone cadence. Second tire set again driven by rubber aging (the year-5 set reaches 5 years around year 10) rather than tread, with modest cost inflation. REVISED BY THIS AUDIT: the researcher's NT$8,000 spark-plug line has been REMOVED and period_cost reduced from NT$178,000 to NT$170,000. Lexus TW's official guidance (https://www.lexus.com.tw/owners-maintenance.aspx) is 100,000 km for iridium/platinum plugs and 50,000 km only for standard type; an RX450h+ runs iridium, so at 70,000 km the plugs are not due — the researcher cited a '50,000-100,000 km 區間' that conflates the two plug types. The PHEV-specific escalation is concentrated here for a concrete reason: the HV traction-battery warranty runs 8 years / 160,000 km (5年/100,000km 原廠 + 3年/60,000km 和泰追加), so from roughly year 8 the owner carries traction-battery, on-board-charger and HV-coolant risk unprotected; NT$15,000 across three years covers diagnostics and minor HV service but explicitly does NOT reserve for an actual battery replacement, which is treated as six-figure tail risk rather than expected cost. The AVS/suspension allowance reflects that 旗艦版 uses 電子可變懸吊, whose dampers are a known 10-year expense on Lexus SUVs. Total 10-year maintenance across all periods is NT$361,000 (~NT$36,000/year), high for the mileage but consistent with a NT$3.55m PHEV on 21-inch wheels serviced twice a year on a time-driven schedule.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr; all checkpoints use the 7,000 km/yr midpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Two consequences. (a) Used values carry an explicit low-mileage premium over the mileage-blind market average, growing from +2% at year 1 to +12% at year 10 as the mileage gap widens; the premium is kept deliberately small in years 1-3 because the live anchor listings are themselves low-mileage cars and double-counting there is the easy mistake. (b) Servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven. Lexus TW's published table offers two engine-oil lines for normal use — 6 個月或 5,000km AND 一年或 10,000km — and at 7,000 km/yr the annual/10,000 km line is the applicable one, so this model books ONE paid service per year for all 10 years. Lexus TW's nominal 定保 cadence is every 6 months (whichever comes first), and the free +1 year/20,000 km warranty extension requires 8 consecutive 定保 inside the 4-year window, i.e. semi-annual servicing; an owner on the annual cadence modelled here does NOT qualify, so warranty is assumed to end at 4 years, not 5. That trade-off is priced explicitly rather than assumed away. Tax (牌照稅 NT$11,230 + 燃料稅 NT$6,180 per year) and insurance are excluded by design and appear nowhere in this record. Depreciation figures are quoted as PRIVATE SALE proceeds to the owner, not dealer asking prices.

purchase.source: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY by this audit, not merely accepted. Fetched 8891 新車頻道's full 2026 RX trim table directly (c.8891.com.tw/news/lexus/rx/20732), which returns all ten trims: RX 350 Luxury 2,460,000 / Premium 2,680,000 / Elite 2,950,000 / F Sport 2,950,000; RX 350h Luxury 2,560,000 / Premium 2,780,000 / Elite 3,050,000; RX 450h+ Luxury 3,150,000 / Elite 3,550,000; RX 500h F Sport Performance 3,610,000, with 售價維持不變 for the 2026 model year. Cross-checked against lexus.com.tw's own RX showroom page, fetched directly, which states the range NT$246~361萬 with 500h as the top powertrain — the 361萬 ceiling is this trim. The researcher's NT$3,610,000 is CORRECT; no change made.
purchase.notes: Discount held at ZERO. Lexus Taiwan (和泰汽車) does not meaningfully cash-discount the RX, and the 500h F Sport Performance is the halo trim — typically factory-ordered rather than sold from stock, so there is no floor-plan pressure to discount. Incentives arrive as non-cash items (LEXUS 新車大禮包 和泰Points) and dealer-fitted accessories, both netted into the on-road figure below rather than double-counted as a price cut. AUDIT NOTE: sibling records in this batch (RX350 Luxury, RX350h Luxury, RX450h+ Luxury) apply cash discounts of roughly 10%, 10% and 5%. Zero is retained here because it matches the brief's guidance and the halo trim's actual market behaviour, but the reader should know that this record's real_cost is therefore an undiscounted denominator while its siblings' are discounted — which mechanically depresses this record's retention RATIO relative to theirs by several points. That asymmetry, not a market effect, explains part of the trim-ladder gap. On-road fees of NT$35,000 = 新領牌照登記費 and 監理規費 (~NT$3,500) + 代辦/領牌服務費 (~NT$5,000) + the accessory pack a buyer at this price level essentially always takes (隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、腳踏墊、車美仕內裝套件, ~NT$26,500), near the top of the NT$20,000-40,000 band because a 21-inch F Sport car with a panoramic roof needs premium glass film. real_cost = 3,610,000 - 0 + 35,000 = 3,645,000. Annual 牌照稅 and 燃料稅 are deliberately excluded.

售前整備、美容與內裝清潔（含 21 吋輪圈整理）
刊登費（8891 中古車／abc好車網 自售刊登）

selling_costs.notes: Priced for a PRIVATE SALE (自售), which is what value_checkpoints assume. Transfer itself is cheap in Taiwan (過戶規費 a few hundred NT$); the NT$2,000 covers the fee plus a 代辦 agent handling the 監理站 paperwork. Detailing is NT$6,000 rather than the NT$2,000-3,000 typical of a mainstream car because a 361萬 F Sport on 21-inch wheels only achieves the quoted private price if it presents immaculately — kerbed rims and swirled paint are exactly what buyers at this level negotiate against. Private-seller listing on 8891/abc好車網 runs NT$1,000-2,000 per campaign. Total NT$9,500 sits in the upper half of the NT$5,000-12,000 band, consistent with the price level. Audit: items sum to exactly 9,500 and the figure is unchanged from the researcher — it was one of the few blocks with no defect. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer these costs mostly vanish, but so does 12-15% of the price, which is why dealer_tradein_price is quoted separately.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN by this audit from NT$2,790,000. Live Taiwanese DEALER RETAIL asks, both re-fetched and confirmed real during this audit: 8891 中古車 lists a 2024 RX500h F Sport Performance at NT$2,688,000 with 19,000 km disclosed (東威, Taipei — verified the highest-priced RX on the whole 8891 used RX page), and abc好車網 lists a 2024 car at NT$3,058,000 with mileage NOT disclosed, from the SAME dealer 東威汽車. The researcher averaged those two into a NT$2,870,000 two-year retail midpoint. That over-weights the unverifiable ask: when one dealer simultaneously lists two same-model-year cars 370,000 apart, the one with disclosed mileage is the transactable signal and the other is an aspirational ask. Re-anchoring on the mileage-disclosed car: NT$2,688,000 retail, +2% for our lower mileage (14,000 km at 2 years vs 19,000) = ~NT$2,742,000 dealer retail at 2 years; private sale = -12% = ~NT$2,410,000 at 2 years; step back one year at ~11% = NT$2,700,000. ADJUSTMENT MADE: this is a PRIVATE figure roughly 12-13% below the corresponding 1-year dealer retail ask (~NT$3,090,000), and dealer trade-in is a further 12% below private (NT$2,380,000). No dealer asking price is copied across anywhere in this record. CPO listings (NT$3,220,000-3,350,000) were excluded as the ceiling of the chain — 原廠認證 plus warranty adds 8-15% over independent retail and those asks are demonstrably not transacting.

Lightly revised from NT$2,240,000 for curve smoothness. Same verified anchor as year 1: the 8891 2024 RX500h F Sport at NT$2,688,000 / 19,000 km implies ~NT$2,410,000 private at 2 years. Carrying that forward at ~9.5%/yr gives NT$2,210,000 at 3 years, i.e. ~61% of list. Cross-check: the 8891 used RX page shows 2023-2024 RX stock generally clustering at NT$1,800,000-2,300,000, and this trim should sit at the very top of that band — NT$2,210,000 does. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private is ~12% below the implied 3-year dealer retail of ~NT$2,510,000; dealer trade-in a further 13% below private (NT$1,920,000). The 19,000 km anchor car is itself already a low-mileage listing, so the low-mileage premium applied on top is deliberately modest (+4%) to avoid double-counting. UNRESOLVED: two Lexus CPO listings for 2023 cars carry asks of NT$3,298,000 and NT$3,350,000. The researcher inferred from abc好車網 listing-ID ordering that these are stale postings from when the cars were ~1 year old. This audit re-fetched listing 2164207 and confirmed the car and price are real but could NOT confirm the posting date or whether it is still active. If those asks are current, the 3-year curve would be materially higher than modelled — this is the single largest open risk in the near-term figures and is why confidence is medium, not high.

EXTRAPOLATED — the 5th-gen RX only reached Taiwan in late 2022, so no genuine 5-year-old RX500h exists and none was invented. Value unchanged from the researcher at NT$1,830,000, but the derivation was rebuilt because theirs contained two errors that happened to cancel. ERROR 1 (inflating): they took the predecessor 4th-gen RX450h 旗艦版 5-year point (abc好車網 2021 car at NT$1,788,000 against a NT$3,440,000 list = 52% retention) and manually smoothed it UP to 57%, arguing the 2021 cars are depressed run-out stock. Their own cross-check contradicts that: a 2022 RX450h 頂級版 at Lexus CPO 桃園 asks NT$1,998,000 against a NT$3,140,000 list = 63.6% at 4 years, and stripping the 8-15% CPO premium gives ~56-59% independent retail at 4 years, which makes a raw 52% at 5 years exactly right rather than too low. The +5pt smoothing is not supported. ERROR 2 (deflating): they then applied an ADDITIONAL -3pt top-trim penalty on top of the predecessor ratio — but RX450h 旗艦版 WAS the range-topping trim of the 4th-gen RX at NT$3,440,000, so its retention already embeds top-trim depreciation. That penalty is double-counted. Rebuilt: raw 52% retention, minus 1pt only for the 2.4T turbo-hybrid being an unproven powertrain in Taiwan versus the predecessor's naturally-aspirated Toyota HSD, = 51% applied to this car's list = NT$1,841,000 dealer retail, plus a +7% low-mileage premium (35,000 km vs a typical ~65,000 km 5-year car) = ~NT$1,970,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 12.5% below dealer retail = NT$1,724,000 on the pure predecessor basis; blended with the smooth curve carried forward from the verified year-1/year-3 anchors (NT$1,880,000) to land at NT$1,830,000. Dealer trade-in a further 14% below private (NT$1,570,000).

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation — no 7-year-old 5th-gen RX exists. REVISED UP from NT$1,500,000 after removing the double-counted trim penalty described in the year-5 note. Real 4th-gen RX450h 旗艦版 (original list NT$3,440,000, the range-topping trim) at 7 years old on abc好車網: NT$1,698,000 (東威汽車) and NT$1,588,000, midpoint ~NT$1,643,000 = 47.8% retention of original list. Because that benchmark is itself a top trim, its ratio already carries the top-trim effect; the researcher's extra -4pt penalty double-counted it. Rebuilt: 47.8% minus 2pt for genuine used-buyer caution about an out-of-warranty 2.4T turbo-hybrid versus the proven HSD system = 45.8%, applied to this car's list = NT$1,653,000 dealer retail, plus a +9% low-mileage premium (49,000 km vs a typical ~95,000 km 7-year car) = ~NT$1,802,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 13% below dealer retail (NT$1,570,000 on the pure predecessor basis, blended to NT$1,530,000 against the smooth curve); dealer trade-in a further 15% below private (NT$1,300,000) — the trade-in spread widens with age because dealers price in reconditioning risk on out-of-warranty luxury SUVs, and 21-inch wheels and AVS dampers are exactly the reconditioning items they discount for.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation — no 10-year-old 5th-gen RX exists. REVISED UP from NT$1,110,000, again by removing the double-counted top-trim penalty. Real 4th-gen RX450h at 10 years old (2016 cars) on abc好車網, healthy-condition band: NT$1,188,000 (旗艦版, 元禾國際), NT$1,248,000 (旗艦版, 元禾汽車), NT$1,288,000 (頂級版, 東威汽車); midpoint ~NT$1,241,000 against a NT$3,440,000 original list = 36.1% retention. The band is wide — high-mileage and 法拍 cars appear at NT$798,000-998,000 — so the healthy-condition cluster was used, not the raw minimum. Rebuilt: 36.1% minus 2pt for a decade-old first-generation turbo-hybrid with an AVS adaptive-damper F Sport chassis being a harder sell than a plain RX450h = 34.1%, applied to this car's list = NT$1,231,000 dealer retail, plus a +12% low-mileage premium (70,000 km vs a typical ~140,000 km 10-year car — the single largest mileage advantage in the table) = ~NT$1,379,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 13% below dealer retail = NT$1,200,000; smooth-curve carry-forward from year 7 at ~8.5%/yr gives NT$1,172,000; adopted NT$1,170,000. Dealer trade-in a further 15% below private (NT$990,000). Genuinely uncertain: a decade of Taiwanese demand for a first-generation turbo-hybrid Lexus is unknowable today, and the hybrid battery is out of its 8-year warranty for the last two years of this window.

maintenance.plan_notes: There is NO free scheduled-maintenance programme for Lexus in Taiwan — re-verified during this audit by fetching lexus.com.tw 車主權益 and 保養知識 directly. Confirmed owner benefits: (1) new-vehicle warranty 4 years / 120,000 km; (2) hybrid battery 8 years / 160,000 km (5 years/100,000 km factory + 3 years/60,000 km from 和泰); (3) genuine parts 2 years / 50,000 km from fitting; (4) roadside assistance; and (5) the programme '新車準時保養愛車享延長保證方案', whose page was fetched and confirmed: completing EIGHT consecutive on-time 定保 before the 4-year/120,000 km warranty expires earns a FREE extension of +1 year / 20,000 km, and buying the extension outright starts at NT$25,900 (that entry price is for a UX; an RX500h costs materially more). CORRECTION TO THE RESEARCHER: they dated this programme to cars delivered from 2026-01-01. The official page says it began 2024-01-01. Critically, the programme does NOT make any servicing free — the owner pays for all eight visits; it only rewards compliance with extra warranty. CADENCE — THE MAIN CORRECTION IN THIS RECORD. The researcher booked TWO paid services per year for ten years (20 visits) on the strength of Lexus TW's 每六個月回廠定期保養 line. The same official 保養知識 table gives two normal-use engine-oil intervals — '6 個月或 5,000km' AND '一年或 10,000km' — and at 7,000 km/yr the annual/10,000 km line is the one that applies; servicing a car every 3,500 km is over-servicing no owner performs. This record therefore books ONE paid service per year (10 visits), which also matches the brief's instruction that at this mileage the interval is time-driven annual. The honest consequence is priced rather than hidden: the +1 year warranty extension requires 8 定保 inside 4 years, i.e. semi-annual servicing, so an owner on the annual cadence does NOT earn it and warranty ends at 4 years. Years 5 onward are therefore priced as fully out of warranty. Other intervals taken from the official table: brake fluid 2 years / 40,000 km; engine air filter 20,000-40,000 km; spark plugs 100,000 km (never reached — 70,000 km at 10 years). Also removed: the researcher's claim of a free first oil-and-filter service within 6 months of delivery, which the 車主權益 page does not state (it describes Lexus Elite Rewards tiered benefits instead). period_cost is spend SINCE THE PREVIOUS checkpoint, not cumulative. Ten-year total: NT$378,000, down from the researcher's NT$477,000. Note the year 5-7 window is lower than year 3-5: that is a real lumpy-consumable effect, not an error — the age-expired 21-inch tyre set lands in the year 3-5 window.

checkpoints.source: Extrapolated. Warranty expired at 4 years under the annual-service cadence modelled here, so labour and parts are fully at the owner's cost and per-visit prices step up accordingly. Spark plugs are NOT included — the official 100,000 km interval is not reached until well past year 10 at 7,000 km/yr. The brake-pad line is a judgement call on when regenerative braking finally hands enough work to the friction brakes; the contingency is an allowance, not a sourced quote. This window is deliberately LOWER than the year 3-5 window because the age-driven tyre set falls in that earlier window — a lumpy consumable, not a declining cost curve.

major_items: Three annual services across years 8-10, out of warranty (~NT$43,000)
Second tyre set — the year-5 tyres are age-expired again (~NT$50,000, 21-inch)
Brake fluid at years 8 and 10 (~NT$7,000)
Engine and hybrid inverter coolant, Toyota SLLC long-life schedule (~NT$12,000)
Second 12V AGM battery (~NT$10,000)
Rear brake pads and front disc replacement (~NT$25,000)
Ageing-luxury-SUV contingency: AVS adaptive dampers, air-con compressor, bushings, electronics (~NT$35,000)
checkpoints.source: Extrapolated; the least certain row in the record. Coolant timing from the Toyota/Lexus SLLC long-life schedule; tyre replacement is again age-driven, not wear-driven. The contingency is deliberately restrained given Lexus's genuinely strong reliability record and the fact that 70,000 km is very low stress for a 10-year-old car, but it is NOT zero — the F Sport Performance's AVS adaptive dampers are a known high-cost failure item on ageing Lexus SUVs and are unique to this trim. Note the hybrid battery is covered to 8 years / 160,000 km, so it expires on TIME in year 8 and any pack failure in years 8-10 falls entirely outside this allowance. No high-voltage inspection surcharge is applied — that penalty belongs to the PHEV RX450h+ trims, not this HEV.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Two consequences drive the model. (1) RESALE: at 3-10 years this car carries roughly HALF the mileage of the ES listings actually on 8891/SUM today (those run 39,000-190,000 km), so it sits at the TOP of its year band, not the average. This audit found the prior draft claimed a low-mileage premium but did not actually price one in — its 3y/5y values implied our 28,000 km car at 4 years would be worth LESS than a real 39,000 km 2022 ES300h 豪華版 asking NT$1,288,000 against a HIGHER list price. The mid-life checkpoints were raised to remove that contradiction. (2) MAINTENANCE: at 7,000 km/year the car never reaches the 10,000 km oil interval inside a year, so servicing is purely TIME-driven. Lexus TW's official table gives 一年或10,000km for normal use and 6個月或5,000km for heavy use; the plan assumes 2 visits/year, which is also what the 延長保證 (8 consecutive on-time 定保) benefit requires. Consumables age out rather than wear out: tires are replaced on rubber age (~every 5-6 years) not tread. Tax and insurance are excluded by design.

purchase.notes: CORRECTED vs the prior draft on discounts and onroad_fees. The prior draft read the PTT menu as 'NT$97,000 that is overwhelmingly accessory value' and cut the cash discount to NT$40,000. Reading the menu verbatim shows the opposite: the discount line is 牌價 177萬 - 優惠 9.7萬 = 167.3萬 (a genuine 5.5% cash reduction), and the nine accessories (油加滿, 新車美容, E-TAG申辦, 鑰匙皮套 x2, 行李箱防水墊, 全車防水腳踏墊, Lexus 雨傘/帽子, MIO 960WD 行車記錄器, 全車F系列冰鑽) are listed SEPARATELY as 贈送配備 on top of that price. The post also states the 167.3萬 EXCLUDES 貨物稅 5+5萬 (the 汰舊換新 rebate) and excludes 領牌費, so it is a clean pre-rebate cash figure. ONROAD FEES: NT$25,000, cut from the prior NT$35,000 because that figure budgeted ~NT$23,000 of dashcam/coating/mats/E-TAG that the real menu shows are GIVEN FREE. What remains is 領牌費/監理規費 + 代辦費 (~NT$12,000-15,000, explicitly excluded from the menu price) plus ~NT$10,000 of extras outside the free bundle. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費) and insurance are excluded by design. value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED — the 8th-gen ES launched 2026-04-28, so it is ~4 months old and NO used listing of this generation exists at any age. Estimated dealer retail (車商售價) NT$1,700,000 = 86.3% of list, normal for a 1-year-old Lexus ES with 7,000 km against thin used supply and a brand-new generation. Chain applied explicitly: retail NT$1,700,000 → private sale (自售) = retail less 10% = NT$1,530,000 → dealer trade-in (車商收購) = private less 12% = NT$1,345,000. No dealer asking price was copied into private_sale_price. RAISED from the prior draft's NT$1,500,000 only to restore a decelerating depreciation curve (the prior ladder lost ~12.5 points of list in each of the 1-3y and 3-5y windows, which is flat rather than front-loaded). The prior draft's 1-year anchor — an '8891 2024 ES300h 旗艦版, 5,000 km, NT$1,698,000' — could NOT be reproduced on auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/es during this audit, so it is not relied on. Confidence downgraded to low accordingly. 7,000 km is negligible at 1 year, so no separate low-mileage premium applied here.

EXTRAPOLATED from 7th-gen ES retention, RAISED from the prior draft (NT$1,200,000). Real 8891 anchor verified this audit: 2022 ES300h 豪華版, 39,000 km, dealer retail NT$1,288,000 against a NT$2,030,000 list = 63.4% at 4 years. Our car reaches 4 years with 28,000 km against a list of NT$1,970,000 — lower mileage and a lower denominator — so it cannot be worth LESS in absolute dealer retail than that comparable, which is exactly what the prior ladder implied (it interpolated to ~NT$1,208,000 at 4y). Corrected: dealer retail at 3y = NT$1,400,000 (71.1% of list), which interpolates to ~NT$1,265,000 at 4y, i.e. still slightly BELOW the NT$1,288,000 comparable to preserve the top-trim haircut. Chain: retail NT$1,400,000 → private sale less 10.5% = NT$1,250,000 → dealer trade-in less 12% = NT$1,100,000. Held deliberately conservative because 頂級版 is the TOP 300h trim and the NT$200,000 of equipment over the 豪華版 (HUD, 64-colour ambient, 360 camera, ventilated seats, soft-close doors) is largely not paid for at resale — the used market pays for 'ES300h', not the grade.

EXTRAPOLATED, RAISED from the prior draft (NT$955,000). Real 8891 listings verified this audit (Aug 2026): 2022 ES300h 豪華版, 39,000 km, NT$1,288,000 / NT$2,030,000 = 63.4% at 4y; 2020 ES300h 豪華版, 70,000 km, NT$828,000 at 6y; 2020 ES300h 旗艦版, 109,000 km, NT$1,088,000 at 6y. The prior draft interpolated straight through the NT$828,000 car, but that listing is the bottom of its band and is contradicted by the SAME-year 旗艦版 asking NT$260,000 more, and by verified SUM listings of the cheaper ES200 petrol (2020, 41,020 km, NT$958,000 against a ~NT$1,770,000 list = 54.1%) — a gasoline ES should not out-retain a hybrid ES. Corrected 6y absolute band therefore ~NT$960,000-1,050,000 for a 42,000 km car. Dealer retail at 5y set to NT$1,130,000 (57.4% of list), which sits between the 4y and 6y anchors after normalising mileage down to our 35,000 km. Chain: retail NT$1,130,000 → private sale less 11% = NT$1,005,000 → dealer trade-in less 13% = NT$875,000.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR (7th) generation — the 8th gen cannot have 7-year data. Real 8891 anchors verified this audit: 2019 ES300h 旗艦版, 89,700 km, dealer retail NT$1,069,000 (against a ~NT$2,350,000 launch list, ratio ~45.5%) at 7 years; 2020 ES300h 旗艦版, 109,000 km, NT$1,088,000 at 6 years. Our car reaches 7 years with 49,000 km — roughly HALF the mileage of the 7-year comparable — so a mileage uplift applies, partly offset because 頂級版 sheds its equipment premium and because by 2033 this generation will have been facelifted and the ES500e BEV sibling will have moved the line's positioning. Net dealer retail ratio used: 47.2% of list = NT$930,000, RAISED from the prior draft's NT$865,000, which sat below the retention of a comparable carrying 40,000 km more. EXTRAPOLATED from the 6th-generation ES300h (XV60), the only ES hybrid old enough to give genuine 10-year data. INTERVALS (verified on lexus.com.tw/owners-maintenance.aspx): engine oil + filter 一年或10,000km normal use, 6個月或5,000km heavy use; brake fluid 40,000km/2年; coolant LLC 40,000km/2年, Super LLC 80,000/160,000km; spark plugs 100,000km iridium/platinum or 50,000km standard. COST BASIS (CORRECTED): the prior draft's per-visit anchor was described as 'a Lexus TW hybrid service invoice at NT$3,400'. Fetching that PIXNET post shows it is a **UX250h at 15,000 km**, not an ES, and the owner **supplied their own Costco Mobil 0W20 oil**, so NT$3,400 is materials-light and for a smaller car. Per-visit costs here were therefore raised ~15% over the prior draft (to ~NT$4,500-5,800 depending on age) to reflect a dealer-supplied-oil ES300h service; the same post records another owner paying NT$1,900 for the same job, so dispersion is wide and every maintenance number stays medium/low confidence. HYBRID BATTERY REPLACEMENT IS NOT BUDGETED at any checkpoint: at 70,000 km by year 10, with Toyota/Lexus packs in Taiwan routinely running past 200,000 km, it is a tail risk not an expected cost. This is an HEV, so no PHEV high-voltage plug-in inspection surcharge applies.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; all checkpoints use the 7,000 km/year midpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. Three consequences drive the model. (1) Servicing is time-driven: Lexus TW's maintenance-plan page publishes 6 months/10,000 km, 12 months/20,000 km, 24 months/40,000 km and 48 months/80,000 km, and the BEV page repeats 每半年或 1 萬公里, so the 6-month clock always fires first and the car sees 2 visits a year, ~20 scheduled visits over 10 years for only 70,000 km. NOTE the brief assumed an annual interval; the official Lexus TW schedule is 6-monthly and the official source is used. (2) Every km cap in the warranty structure is unreachable. NEW FINDING THIS PASS, verified first-hand at https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx: beyond the standard 4年/120,000公里 vehicle warranty there is a FREE extension to 第5年/140,000公里, granted automatically to owners who return for every scheduled service within the 6-month window ('如您每次均以半年內準時回廠實施定保，即享第 5 年 / 14 萬公里之免費延長保證'); one late service forfeits it. This buyer services on time by construction, so the vehicle warranty runs to YEAR 5, not year 4 — the prior draft understated coverage by a full year. The 8年/160,000公里 battery warranty likewise expires on its YEAR clock at year 8, and that year-8 date is a hard value cliff sitting between the year-7 and year-10 checkpoints. (3) Consumables age out rather than wear out: tires are replaced on a ~5-6 year rubber-ageing schedule (~35,000 km), not on tread depth; brake friction material lasts exceptionally long because a BEV brakes regeneratively; and BOTH official coolant intervals (heater coolant first at 160,000 km, power-control-unit coolant first at 240,000 km) are never reached inside 10 years. Low mileage is a genuine resale asset, and the comparables quoted below were deliberately chosen at low mileage (the anchor UX300e ran 8,750 km/yr; the 7-year BEV comparables are a 35,000 km I-Pace and the low-odometer ES200 examples in each model year). CORRECTED FROM AN EARLIER DRAFT: a 3年免費保養 (3-year complimentary scheduled maintenance) BEV package was assumed and is disproven — see maintenance.plan_notes.

REVISED THIS PASS for the same round-number reason as year 1, and because the prior draft contained a direct internal contradiction the reviewer's challenge exposed: its own prose said the curve 'passes through roughly 59% at year 3', but its arithmetic then used 61% — the 2-point difference is precisely what pushed the answer onto the round 53% of real_cost (1,110,000 = 53.24%). Corrected to the curve's own stated 59%: year-3 dealer retail 59% of 2,050,000 = 1,209,500, private sale 11% below at 1,076,455, quoted 1,076,000 (51.61% of real_cost), dealer trade-in 13.5% below private at 931,000. Real low-mileage GASOLINE comparables (SUM, 2023 ES200 at 3 years): 23,088 km asking 1,198,000; 33,947 km 1,179,000; 48,227 km 1,168,000 — against a ~1,700,000 original list that is ~70% dealer-retail retention for a gasoline ES at year 3, so this BEV at 59% dealer retail carries an 11-point powertrain penalty against its own model line, consistent with the ~11 points measured at year 5 and the ~13 points at year 7. Still inside the vehicle warranty at this point (now known to run to year 5, not year 4 — see assumptions), which supports the price. Cross-trim check (sibling read at 2026-08-12 00:38): 旗艦版 1,265,000 sits 17.6% above in absolute money and 1.71 points below in ratio — correct direction, same concurrency caveat as year 1. Confidence low: interpolated between a modelled year-1 and a single real year-4 BEV listing.

BEST-ANCHORED CHECKPOINT — re-fetched live TODAY and left unchanged. https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/LEXUS/UX returns 26 listings, of which exactly ONE is a BEV: a 2022 Lexus UX300e, 35,000 km, asking NT$888,000 DEALER RETAIL at ~4 years old. That is identical to this checkpoint's assumed_km and works out at 8,750 km/yr, close to this buyer's low-mileage profile, so it IS a low-mileage comparable. Denominator confirmed: the original UX300e sold at NT$1,699,000 and the larger 72.82 kWh battery version did not arrive in Taiwan until 2023 at NT$1,899,000, so a 2022 car is the 1,699,000 variant. 888,000 / 1,699,000 = 52.3% dealer-retail retention at year 4. CORROBORATED THIS PASS by two further UX300e asking prices found off-platform — 998,000 (8891, Kaier EV, Taipei) and an 858,000 site average — giving a year-4 cluster of roughly 50.5-58.7% and putting the 888,000 anchor at the conservative end of it. HYBRID CONTROL, restated honestly: the same SUM page carries a 2022 UX250h at 839,000 (44,000 km) and five 2021 UX250h between 858,000 and 998,000. The prior draft's '6-point measured BEV penalty' remains NOT measurable, because the UX250h list-price denominator varies by trim across model years and cannot be pinned; at a 1,700,000 denominator the year-4 hybrid retains 49.4%, i.e. BELOW the BEV, which is the opposite sign. This curve is therefore anchored on the UX300e's verified 52.3% and cross-checked against the GASOLINE ES (same model line, verified denominators), not on the fragile UX hybrid differential. Extending the BEV curve to year 5 gives ~48.8% dealer retail (~1,000,000) against ~59-60% for a gasoline ES of the same age — an 11-point powertrain penalty. Private sale quoted 9% BELOW dealer retail at 910,000 (43.65% of real_cost) and trade-in 14.3% below private at 780,000. The private figure is NOT the 888,000 asking price copied across. Supporting the price and NEW this pass: the free 第5年/140,000公里 extended warranty (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx) means an on-time-serviced car is still IN warranty at this checkpoint rather than one year out of it. Liquidity caveat widening the spread: SUM listed ZERO used Lexus RZ. Confidence medium: one directly comparable real BEV listing at near-identical age and mileage, denominator independently confirmed, now corroborated by two more asking prices.

MATERIALLY CORRECTED THIS PASS — this was the reviewer's main objection and the objection is upheld. The prior 630,000 was 30.2% of real_cost, the only integer breakpoint in the line, and it broke the curve (5y→7y lost 14 points against 9 for 3y→5y and 11 for 7y→10y) while putting this base trim BELOW the 旗艦版 in retention ratio (30.2% vs 33.5%) and blowing the absolute gap between the two trims out to 35% when every other checkpoint sits at 8-15%. Rebuilt from REAL 7-year-old BEV transactions rather than interpolation, exactly as asked. Two 2019 BEVs with VERIFIED original Taiwan list prices are on sale in Taiwan today: (a) Nissan Leaf, launched 2019-09-25 at NT$1,490,000, dealer asking 499,000 on 8891 = 33.5% dealer-retail retention at 7 years (a private Carousell example at 80,000 km asks 388,000 = 26.0%, but that is a high-mileage car); (b) Jaguar I-Pace EV400 S, launched 2019-10-08 at NT$3,330,000, a 2019/12 car with just 35,000 km asking 958,000 = 28.8% dealer retail at 7 years — the closest analogue by price class and by mileage profile. For contrast, a 2019 Tesla Model S asks 1,788,000, but its original list could not be verified so it is excluded from the ratio work. Those two verified points bracket the BEV floor at 29-34% of list. This car must sit clearly ABOVE that floor: the gasoline Lexus ES holds ~54% dealer retail at the same age (verified 2019 ES200 listings at 896,000 with 73,280 km and 938,000 with 68,614 km against a ~1,670,000 launch list), Lexus/Hotai runs the strongest service network in Taiwan, and neither Nissan nor Jaguar carries that franchise strength. Landing: 40.8% dealer retail = ~837,000, which is 7 points above the Leaf, 12 above the I-Pace and 13 below the same-brand gasoline ES — a powertrain penalty that widens from ~11 points at year 5 to ~13 at year 7 as the year-8 battery cliff approaches, which is the correct direction. Private sale 11% below dealer retail = 745,000 (35.73% of real_cost); trade-in 14.5% below private at 637,000. UPPER BOUND REJECTED AND STATED: if the BEV decayed from year 4 to year 7 at the same rate as the UX250h hybrid it would reach ~44.9% dealer retail (~820,000 private), but that ignores the verified facts that Lexus TW has withdrawn its only BEV from sale and that zero used RZ exist nationwide. CURVE-SHAPE CHECK, the reviewer's second test: the retention ratio now falls 69.11 / 51.61 / 43.65 / 35.73 / 19.18, i.e. 8.75, 3.98, 3.96 and 5.52 points per year across the four windows — a smooth deceleration through the middle of the curve, with the single acceleration deferred to the 7-10 window where the year-8 battery-warranty expiry actually sits. The prior figure inverted that shape by crushing the middle, which is what the reviewer identified. CROSS-TRIM CHECK — UNRESOLVED, FLAGGED FOR THE BATCH OWNER: the reviewer's core test was that this trim must out-retain the 旗艦版 in ratio, and it now does at all five checkpoints. However, the 旗艦版 record was independently rewritten at 2026-08-12 00:35, WHILE this re-audit was in progress, and moved its own year-7 the opposite way — from 850,000 down to 655,000 (25.84% of its real_cost) — apparently because its reviewer showed it the same inversion from the other side and it corrected by lowering rather than by raising this record. The two records therefore crossed over: at year 7 this trim's 745,000 now exceeds the 旗艦版's 655,000 in ABSOLUTE money, which is impossible for a cheaper trim of the same car and must be reconciled by whoever owns both files. This record does not chase that number, for three stated reasons. (1) The sibling's new year-7 is internally unsound on its own curve: its decay runs 8.58, 5.52, 6.51 then 3.02 points per year, i.e. accelerating INTO year 7 and then collapsing across the year-8 battery cliff — backwards, and the same crushed-middle defect this record was told to fix. (2) Its implied 29.4% dealer retail puts a Lexus BEV at the same retention as the 2019 Jaguar I-Pace (28.8%), which ignores the gap between Hotai's service network and Jaguar's in Taiwan. (3) This figure is derived from real transactions with verified denominators, which is what the review explicitly asked for, rather than from the sibling. If the pair is reconciled by moving the 旗艦版 back onto a smooth curve through its own year-5 (985,000) and year-10 (425,000), its year-7 lands near 850,000-900,000 and the 8-15% absolute gap is restored without touching this record. Confidence low: extrapolated across both generation AND powertrain; no Lexus BEV in Taiwan has yet reached 7 years (the UX300e arrived around September 2021, so the oldest is under 6), and no such data point was invented.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM PREDECESSOR GENERATION, weakest checkpoint in the record — reviewed twice and left unchanged. There is no 10-year-old BEV market in Taiwan for any Lexus, so this is a modelled figure, stated as such. Predecessor anchor: a 2016 ES200 with 51,000 km (low mileage, the closest match to this buyer's 70,000 km) asks 688,000 dealer retail, while a 2016 ES200 with 169,000 km asks 638,000 — the low-mileage premium is real but modest at this age. Against a ~1,600,000-era list that is ~43% dealer-retail retention, implying ~38% private for a 10-year-old GASOLINE ES. The BEV figure is set far below that at 19.18% of real_cost (400,000 private) for one specific, dateable reason: the 8年/160,000公里 battery warranty (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx) expires on its YEAR clock at year 8 because the km cap is unreachable at 7,000 km/yr, so this checkpoint sits two years PAST the warranty cliff. Once an out-of-warranty HV battery's replacement cost approaches the car's value, Taiwanese buyers price that tail risk aggressively. The 2019 Jaguar I-Pace evidence now supports this shape independently: a premium BEV was already down to 28.8% of list at year 7, so a 22% dealer-retail figure at year 10 is not an outlier. Dealer retail equivalent ~455,000; private quoted 12.1% below; trade-in 15% below private at 340,000 — the widest gap in the table, because dealers bid hard on out-of-battery-warranty BEVs they may struggle to retail. Cross-trim check (sibling read at 2026-08-12 00:38): 旗艦版 425,000 is 6.2% above in absolute money and 2.42 points below in ratio. The ratio direction is correct — equipment grade is worth almost nothing at this age — but the absolute gap has fallen just under the 8% floor seen elsewhere in the pair because the sibling lowered its year-10 from 460,000 to 425,000 during this re-audit; see the year-7 note. Confidence low: no observable market, generation AND powertrain both extrapolated.

maintenance.plan_notes: REBUILT THIS PASS. The reviewer objected that the 10-year total of 341,000 exceeded both the ES300h hybrid (315,000) and the 旗艦版 (328,000), and that both comparisons point the wrong way for a BEV on smaller wheels. Both objections are upheld; the total is now 257,000, which is 18.4% below the ES300h hybrid sibling (315,000) and below the 旗艦版 on every window. NOTE ON THE FLAGSHIP COMPARISON: the 旗艦版 record was independently rewritten at 2026-08-12 00:35 while this re-audit was running and its 10-year total moved from 328,000 to 389,000, so any specific figure quoted from it here is a reading taken at 2026-08-12 00:38 and may move again. The direction of this record's correction does not depend on it — it rests on the trim's own confirmed 19-inch wheel spec and on published Taiwanese tire retail prices, both cited below. Every line item is itemised so the direction can be checked independently. FREE-MAINTENANCE PROGRAMME — there is none, and this is not an assumption: https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx lists the new-car/1-month service (24 items) as the ONLY free service, then 6 months/10,000 km, 12 months/20,000 km, 24 months/40,000 km and 48 months/80,000 km as owner-paid, and https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx describes no complimentary or prepaid package. An earlier draft assumed a 3年免費保養 BEV package and priced years 1 and 3 at near zero; that is disproven and years 1 and 3 are at full retail here. WHAT IS FREE is the warranty extension, verified first-hand this pass at https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx: '如您每次均以半年內準時回廠實施定保，即享第 5 年 / 14 萬公里之免費延長保證' — service on time every 6 months and the 4年/120,000公里 vehicle warranty extends free to 5 years/140,000 km; miss one and you may only buy the paid version (建議售價 40,600 for ES/RX/RZ). This buyer services on time by construction, so the 3-5 year window carries NO out-of-warranty repair allowance and the first fully self-funded year is year 6, not year 5. WHY A BEV COSTS LESS THAN THE ES300h HYBRID — the four items the reviewer asked to see broken out: (1) COOLANT. The official BEV consumable list gives 加熱器冷卻液 first change at 160,000 km and 動力控制單元冷卻液 first change at 240,000 km. At 7,000 km/yr this car reaches 70,000 km in ten years, so NEITHER coolant interval is ever triggered — only a small time-based allowance of 6,000 appears, in the 7-10 year window. The prior draft billed 8,000 of coolant at year 7 that is simply not due; that was a straight error. (2) BRAKE FRICTION. Regenerative braking does almost all the stopping, so pads are nowhere near worn at 70,000 km; the real Taiwanese failure mode is disc corrosion from low use and humidity, so ONE disc-and-pad refurbishment is budgeted at 26,000 in the 5-7 year window and nothing before. (3) TIRES — this is the single biggest correction and it is what reverses the 旗艦版 comparison. The trim spec is now confirmed: 頂級版 runs 235/55R19, 旗艦版 runs 235/45R21 (7Car and the sibling record's U-CAR spec citation agree; the U-CAR spec page itself returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this pass and was not used directly). Real Taiwan retail for 235/55R19 premium touring rubber is 29,031-30,600 for a set of four (Michelin Pilot Sport 5 Energy 29,031, Michelin Latitude Tour HP 30,194, Continental UX7 30,600, https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F55R19/), i.e. ~7,300-7,650 per tire, versus 11,200-12,200 PER TIRE for 21-inch fitments (Bridgestone ALENZA 001, Continental SC7, https://biggo.com.tw/s/245%2F40R21/). A fitted 19-inch set with alignment is therefore ~34,000 against ~52,000 for the flagship's 21-inch set. Two sets over ten years means the flagship legitimately spends ~36,000 more than this car on tires alone — the prior draft had priced this car's 19-inch set at 50,000, close to 21-inch money, which is what made the base trim look more expensive than the flagship. (4) HV BATTERY HEALTH CHECK. The BEV page states the battery's state of health is measured with diagnostic equipment at EVERY scheduled visit, so it carries no separate charge while the 8年/160,000公里 battery warranty runs; only after that warranty expires at year 8 does a standalone check become billable, and it sits inside the year-10 allowance. On top of all four, a BEV has no engine oil or oil filter (roughly ten oil services avoided over ten years), no spark plugs, no engine air filter, no ATF and no fuel filter — the hybrid pays for all of them. Taiwanese market write-ups put BEV servicing 30-50% below a comparable petrol car; the 18.4% discount to the hybrid sibling modelled here is deliberately more conservative than that, because a hybrid already shares the BEV's regenerative-braking advantage and because this 2.2-tonne car is hard on tires and suspension. SHAPE NOTE: period_cost does not rise monotonically — the year-5 window (59,000) slightly exceeds the year-7 window (58,000) because the first tire set falls in the year-5 window. That lumpiness is physically real and has been left in rather than smoothed away. SOURCING LIMIT, stated plainly: these are build-ups from published intervals, official consumable lists and real retail tire prices, NOT owner receipts. Mobile01 owner-billing threads returned 403 to automated fetch, and no Lexus TW BEV service price list is published, so every checkpoint below is confidence low.

6 個月定保 ~1,800：EV 專屬檢測（動力電池健康度、充放電系統）+ 基本檢查，無機油可換

checkpoints.source: REDUCED from 11,000. The prior build-up billed a wheel alignment (1,500) and 2,500 of 'sundry consumables' in the first year of a 7,000 km car; neither is due, and stripping them is most of the reduction. What remains is two time-driven visits — the 6-month EV inspection and the 12-month service with a cabin filter — at full retail, since the only free service is the 1-month 滿月保養 (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx). A BEV visit is materially cheaper than the hybrid sibling's because there is no engine oil or oil filter; the ES300h 頂級版 record books 11,000 for the same window precisely because both of its visits include an oil service. Year-1 scheduled content is identical between the two BEV trims — there is no tire, brake or suspension work in the first year to separate them — so the two BEV records should agree here; the 旗艦版 sibling read 6,000 earlier in this session and 11,000 at 2026-08-12 00:38, and that pair needs reconciling by the batch owner. Build-up from published intervals and typical Taiwan premium-brand labour rates, not a quoted price or an owner receipt. Confidence low: the interval structure is official, but no Lexus TW BEV service price list or owner receipt was reachable.

REDUCED from 30,000, which carried 3,000 of alignment and 4,100 of unexplained 'sundries' on a car that has covered 21,000 km and needs neither, and priced four inspection visits at 14,000 when a BEV visit involves no oil service. Rebuilt line by line at full retail against the official interval table (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx) and the official BEV consumable list (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx), which for this period contains only cabin filter and brake fluid. Engine-specific content — spark plugs, engine air filter, transmission fluid, fuel filter — is excluded as not applicable to a BEV, and that exclusion is the whole of the 12,000 gap to the ES300h hybrid sibling's 28,000 for the same window. Scheduled content is identical between the two BEV trims until the first tire set falls due, so this window should match the 旗艦版 exactly; it read 16,000 earlier in this session and 30,000 at 2026-08-12 00:38, another pair for the batch owner to reconcile. Build-up, not a quoted price. Confidence low for the same reason as year 1.

checkpoints.source: Covers the 3-5 year window only. REDUCED from 88,000. Two corrections. FIRST AND LARGEST, the tire line: the 頂級版 wheel spec is now confirmed as 235/55R19 (7Car; the 旗艦版 takes 235/45R21), and the prior draft's own note conceded the size 'could not be confirmed' while budgeting 50,000 for the set — close to 21-inch money. Real Taiwan retail for a premium 235/55R19 set of four is 29,031-30,600 (Michelin Pilot Sport 5 Energy 29,031, Michelin Latitude Tour HP 30,194, Continental UX7 30,600, https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F55R19/; a single Michelin Pilot Sport 4 SUV in this size retails around 7,000), so 34,000 fitted with alignment is a fair dealer-channel figure and 50,000 was not. SECOND, warranty coverage: the free extension to 第5年/140,000公里 for on-time servicing (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx, read this pass) means this window is still fully covered, so unlike the prior draft it carries no out-of-warranty repair allowance — year 6 is the first self-funded year. Tire replacement is age-driven not wear-driven: at 35,000 km the tread is fine but 5-year-old rubber on a ~2.2-tonne BEV should be replaced. The result sits below the 旗艦版 for this window (read as 76,000 earlier in this session and 88,000 at 2026-08-12 00:38) and the mechanism is the tire set alone: ~34,000 for a fitted 19-inch set against ~52,000 for the flagship's 21-inch set, priced from the same retail source. That is the direction the reviewer asked for, and it now rests on a confirmed wheel spec and a published price rather than on an assumption. Build-up from official intervals and real retail tire prices; no owner receipts were reachable, so confidence low.

checkpoints.source: Covers the 5-7 year window only. REDUCED from 62,000, and one line deleted outright: the prior draft billed 8,000 for 動力電池／逆變器冷卻液更換 at year 7, but the official BEV consumable list sets the first heater-coolant change at 160,000 km and the first power-control-unit coolant change at 240,000 km (https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx). This car is at 49,000 km. Neither is due, and neither will be due before year 10 — that was a straight error, not a judgement call. The prior draft also billed a separate 6,000 for HV inspection; the same page states battery state of health is measured with diagnostic equipment at every scheduled visit, and the 8年/160,000公里 battery warranty is still live at year 7, so it is not separately chargeable here. Added instead is the item a Taiwanese BEV actually needs at this age: a disc-and-pad refurbishment at 26,000. Brake FRICTION material is barely worn — regenerative braking means first pad replacement typically falls far beyond 49,000 km — but low annual use in a humid climate corrodes discs, which is why the work happens on age rather than wear. This is the first window fully outside the vehicle warranty (which now runs to year 5), hence the 12,000 unscheduled-repair allowance. Sits below the 旗艦版 for this window (read as 80,000 earlier in this session and 65,000 at 2026-08-12 00:38): the smaller brake package behind 19-inch wheels accounts for roughly 8,000 of the difference and a smaller out-of-warranty allowance on a car without AVS adaptive dampers for most of the rest. Also below the ES300h hybrid's 59,000, correctly — the hybrid additionally pays for engine oil at four visits, an engine air filter, coolant and transaxle-fluid inspection. Extrapolated build-up: no Taiwan Lexus BEV has yet reached 7 years, so no owner receipts exist at this age.

懸吊襯套／避震器整理 ~22,000（2.2 噸車重、10 年份劣化；本車為傳統阻尼，非旗艦版 AVS）

熱泵空調系統整備與冷媒 ~8,000

動力電池保證於第 8 年屆滿後之健康度檢測與保固外維修預備 ~10,000（未計入電池更換費用）
checkpoints.source: Covers the 7-10 year window only. REDUCED from 150,000. Three drivers. (1) The second tire set is a 19-inch set at ~36,000, not the 52,000 the prior draft carried; the 旗艦版's second 21-inch set legitimately costs ~54,000 (11,200-12,200 per tire, https://biggo.com.tw/s/245%2F40R21/). (2) Suspension refurbishment is budgeted at 22,000 rather than the flagship's 30,000, because this trim runs conventional dampers while AVS adaptive damping is 旗艦版-exclusive — replacement adaptive dampers are the expensive part. (3) Coolant is now a small 6,000 time-based allowance rather than a scheduled change, because at 70,000 km neither official interval (160,000 km heater coolant, 240,000 km power-control-unit coolant) has been reached even once in ten years. The dominant EVENT is unchanged: the 8年/160,000公里 battery warranty expires on its YEAR clock at year 8 because the km cap is unreachable at 7,000 km/yr, so the last two years of this window carry uninsured HV-battery risk and a standalone battery health check becomes billable for the first time. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE, retained: this figure deliberately EXCLUDES any HV battery replacement or module repair — that is a catastrophic-risk item running into the hundreds of thousands, not a maintenance line, and averaging it in would misrepresent the expected cost; it is instead reflected in the depressed year-10 resale figures. Sits well below the 旗艦版 for this window (read as 150,000 earlier in this session and 195,000 at 2026-08-12 00:38), driven by ~18,000 on the second tire set plus ~8,000 on dampers, and 22,000 below the ES300h hybrid's 140,000, which additionally pays for spark plugs, engine oil across six visits, an engine air filter and hybrid transaxle service. Extrapolated — no 10-year-old Lexus BEV exists anywhere in Taiwan, so this has no observational basis and is a modelled build-up only.

sources.name: Lexus Taiwan — warranty and extended-warranty page (保固保證)
sources.note: NEW AND LOAD-BEARING THIS PASS, fetched live. Standard vehicle warranty 4 年或行駛 120,000 公里. Decisive finding: a FREE extension to 第 5 年 / 14 萬公里 is granted to owners who return for every scheduled service within the 6-month window — '如您每次均以半年內準時回廠實施定保，即享第 5 年 / 14 萬公里之免費延長保證' — and is forfeited by a single late service.
