selling_costs.notes: Costs for a PRIVATE sale (自售), which is what private_sale_price assumes. The statutory 過戶 規費 is only a few hundred NT$; the rest is agent handling. Detailing is set at the higher end (NT$8,000) because a premium BEV with a light-coloured Nordico interior needs real prep to reach the quoted private price, and because the EX30's large glass roof and gloss-black trim show swirls. A basic 8891 個人 listing is free; NT$2,000 covers a paid bump/highlight, which matters for a slow-turning model — there were only 8 EX30s of any trim listed on 8891 in the whole TW market on 2026-08-12. If sold to a dealer at dealer_tradein_price instead, these costs drop to roughly NT$2,000 (the dealer absorbs prep and listing) — the trade-in figures quoted here are pre-cost, so do not subtract this total from them.

value_checkpoints.source: REAL LISTINGS for this exact trim, re-retrieved and re-verified by this audit on 2026-08-12 (the single-motor Plus launched in TW 2025-08-04, so cars on the market now are genuinely ~1 year old). Two anchors bracket the 7,000 km target, on opposite sides of the dealer/private divide. (a) DEALER RETAIL: Volvo SELEKT factory-certified 《凱銳博愛》2026年式 EX30 Plus 珍珠白, 年份 2025, 行駛 3600 公里, asking 146.0萬 — confirmed on volvoselekt.com.tw and cross-confirmed as the same car on 8891 (4,000 km / 146.0萬, isRealShop=1). This is 車商售價 and a CERTIFIED one, i.e. the highest retail tier. (b) PRIVATE SELLER: 8891 listing '2026款 Plus Single Motor Extended Range', 10,000 km, asking 129.0萬 with isRealShop=0 — a genuine individual seller. ADJUSTMENT MADE (this is the whole point of the checkpoint): from (a) 146.0萬 certified retail took 14% for the retail-to-private step (the top of the 8-15% band, because a factory-certified car carries a warranty-and-inspection premium a private seller cannot match) = 125.6萬, then ~1.7萬 off for 3,600->7,000 km, giving ~123.9萬. From (b) 129.0萬 private ASKING took 5.5% for asking-to-transaction (a slow-turning BEV with 8 cars on the entire national market gets negotiated harder than the 3-4% typical of a liquid model) = 121.9萬, then added back ~1.5萬 for 10,000->7,000 km, giving ~123.4萬. The two independent routes converge at ~123.5-124萬, so private_sale_price = 1,240,000. NOTE: this is NT$220,000 BELOW the visible dealer asking price — anyone copying the 146萬 ask straight across would overstate the owner's proceeds by that much. Dealer trade-in set 11.3% below private; cross-check, a dealer buying at 110萬 and certifying to a 146萬 SELEKT ask carries ~23% gross on a realistic negotiated retail, which is normal for a slow-turning premium BEV.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 3-year-old EX30 Plus exists in TW (trim on sale only since Aug 2025). Three inputs, triangulated. (1) 8891's own published retention model for the EX30 (用車成本 page, re-verified live: yr1 89.0%, yr2 79.2%, yr3 70.5%, yr4 64.9%, yr5 59.7%, yr6 54.9%, yr7 50.5%). Its curve is retail-flavoured. Rather than assume the retail-to-private haircut, this audit MEASURED it: the year-1 private figure of 123.9萬/159.99萬 = 77.4% against 8891's 89.0%, implying a factor of 0.87. Applying 0.87 to yr3: 70.5% -> 61.3% of list -> 98.1萬. (2) Volvo's own BEV evidence, the closest brand analogue, corrected by this audit: the previously cited '2024 EC40 Plus Single Motor, 8,200 km, 148.0萬' does NOT exist in Volvo SELEKT inventory and has been replaced with the real cars found there on 2026-08-12 — 2024-reg C40 Recharge Plus/Ultimate Single Motor, 10,950 km, asking 145.0萬, against a 201萬 original C40 Recharge Plus Single Motor list (KingAutos, verified) = 72.1% certified dealer retail at ~2 years, ~63% private, which maps to ~101萬 for the EX30 at yr3 after one more year of decay. (Corroborating SELEKT stock: 2024-reg EC40 Single Motor, 1,050 km, 158.0萬; 2025-reg EC40 Ultimate Single Motor, 6,353 km, 155.0萬.) (3) Low-mileage credit: 21,000 km vs a typical 36,000-45,000 km 3-year-old, worth ~+5%. Settled at 1,020,000 (64.8% of real_cost), between the calibrated-8891 and Volvo-BEV routes. Trade-in 12.7% below private.

EXTRAPOLATED from Volvo's OWN previous-generation BEV, which is the right predecessor analogue. REAL DATA POINT, re-verified on volvoselekt.com.tw 2026-08-12: 《新莊凱銳精選中古車》2022年 Volvo XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin motor, 年份 2022, 行駛 22000 公里, asking 126.0萬. Original TW list for that trim was 222萬 (KingAutos Volvo price list, verified live — it still carries the pre-rename Recharge entries: XC40 Recharge Plus Single Motor 191萬, Ultimate Twin Motor 222萬, P8 AWD 219萬). Retention = 126/222 = 56.8% at 4 years as CERTIFIED dealer retail; applying the measured 0.87 retail-to-private factor gives 49.4% at 4 years, and extrapolating the slope to year 5 gives ~45-47% of list = 72-75萬 for the EX30. That analogue is harsh for two identifiable reasons: the XC40 Recharge was a 222萬 car (bigger absolute depreciation) and it was repriced hard when Volvo renamed the line to EX40, which repriced its entire used stock overnight. The calibrated-8891 route gives 59.7% -> 51.9% private -> 83.1萬, plus a low-mileage credit (35,000 km vs a typical 60,000-75,000 km 5-year-old) worth ~+7% -> ~88.9萬. Settled at 830,000 (52.7% of real_cost), between the two, leaning to the Volvo-BEV analogue because the price-cut/rename mechanism is real and repeatable for this segment. Trade-in 13.9% below private.

EXTRAPOLATED — low confidence. There is no 7-year-old Volvo BEV anywhere in TW, so per the BEV rule this leans on the oldest BEVs ACTUALLY TRADING here rather than on a combustion analogue. REAL 7-YEAR BEV DATA, every row re-verified against 8891's listing JSON on 2026-08-12: 2019 Tesla Model 3 dealer asks — SR+ 47,000 km 91.8萬; SR+ 75,000 km 88.0萬; LR 40,000 km 82.0萬; LR 116,000 km 85.8萬; LR 135,000 km 88.8萬; LR 163,000 km 78.8萬; LR 164,000 km 78.8萬. Expressed against the CURRENT new list (Model 3 標準版 169.99萬 / Long Range 199.99萬, KingAutos, verified live) these are 39-54%, median ~44% dealer retail. Using the current rather than the 2019 launch price is deliberate and is the core BEV effect: Tesla has cut TW list prices repeatedly, and used values track the current new price, not what the first owner paid. Applying the measured 0.87 factor gives ~38% of list, i.e. ~61萬 for the EX30 at 159.99萬 list; a modest low-mileage credit (49,000 km vs mostly 75,000-164,000 km in the comparable set) lifts it to 650,000 (41.3% of real_cost). Sanity check against combustion: a real 2019 Volvo XC40 T4 Momentum with 54,400 km asks 69.8萬 at a dealer today, a similar order of magnitude. Volvo's 3-year factory warranty is long gone by here and the extended-warranty programme cannot run past year 5, so this car is fully out of warranty except the HV battery. Trade-in 14.6% below private.

EXTRAPOLATED — lowest-confidence number in this record, and the widest band. A genuine 10-year TW BEV market does not exist yet: the oldest BEVs trading here in volume are 2017-2019 cars. OLDEST REAL BEV DATA FOUND, verified on 8891 2026-08-12: 2017 Tesla Model S 75D, 236,000 km, dealer asking 95.8萬 — 32.5% of the current 294.99萬 Model S list (KingAutos, verified), at 9 years but with very high mileage; also 2018 Model S 75D, 66,000 km, 99.8萬. Against these a large low-mileage credit was applied (our car is at 70,000 km) and a large battery-risk debit, landing at 380,000 = 24.1% of real_cost, 23.8% of list. The debit is the dominant term and is BEV-specific: Volvo's HV battery warranty runs 8 years globally, so it EXPIRES inside this window (~year 8), and a TW buyer of a 10-year-old EX30 is buying an out-of-warranty 69 kWh NCM pack whose replacement cost is a large fraction of the whole car's value. Volvo TW's purchasable extended warranty cannot help: its seven covered systems are a combustion-shaped list (引擎系統, 燃油系統, 變速箱, 電路, 煞車, 懸吊, 空調) with no traction-battery item, and it cannot extend past year 5 regardless. That is also why depreciation was NOT allowed to decelerate here the way a combustion car's does — the yr7->yr10 rate (~NT$90,000/yr) is held flat rather than tapering, because the warranty cliff at year 8 offsets the usual flattening. Treat this as a planning figure with a plausible range of roughly NT$280,000-480,000: if TW develops a healthy independent BEV battery-service trade by 2036 the number lands high, and if it does not, a 10-year-old EX30 could be close to unsaleable privately. Trade-in 15.8% below private (spread widened with age; dealers discount old BEVs hardest).

maintenance.plan_notes: THE HEADLINE FACT, and it is official and independently re-verified by this audit: Volvo Taiwan gives BEVs '4年或8萬公里免費保養' — 4 years or 80,000 km of FREE scheduled maintenance. The 保養服務規劃 site states verbatim '台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案，詳細內容請洽各經銷商服務據點'. This audit re-queried that tool's ASMX pricing API (NameWebService.asmx/QueryData) directly and reproduced the full EX30 line-item table. At the 30,000 km service every scheduled item returns NT$0: 保養工資(*4年8萬公里免費保養) 0, 車室內空調濾芯更換 0, 前/後擋雨刷片 0, 檢查12V主電瓶 0, 高壓電池及電池冷卻系統檢查 0, 清潔攝影機前方的內側擋風玻璃 0. The 60,000 km service adds 電動馬達齒輪油 (reduction-gear oil), 齒輪箱油塞墊片組 and 補胎劑 — also all NT$0. The ONLY chargeable items are 煞車油更換 labour NT$860 + 煞車油 NT$872 = NT$1,732, and 擋風玻璃清洗劑 NT$315; optional A/C sanitising packages (冷氣散熱器清潔維護 NT$1,910 / 風箱抗菌系統維護 NT$3,031) are declined here. INTERVAL TYPE: the tool's QueryMileage endpoint returns exactly '30000@@60000' for the EX30, i.e. it exposes MILEAGE triggers only and publishes no time interval. At 7,000 km/yr this car reaches 30,000 km at ~year 4.3 and 60,000 km at ~year 8.6, so the mileage triggers are nearly irrelevant and the binding schedule is time-based. This record assumes an ANNUAL time-based service, which is the conservative (higher-cost) reading — if Volvo TW actually runs the 24-month BEV interval used in some markets, years 7 and 10 would each fall by roughly NT$5,500. A LOW-MILEAGE CAVEAT WORTH SEEING: the 30,000 km service lands just AFTER the 4-year free window closes, so this owner captures slightly less value from the free programme than a high-mileage owner would, and pays for that first big mileage service themselves — it sits in the year-5 bucket below. WARRANTY: 3-year factory warranty (inferred, not stated — Volvo TW's extended-warranty page sells only '第 4 至 5 年' cover, which implies the factory term ends at 3). Year 4-5 cover is purchasable within 30 months / 100,000 km of registration, the year-5 top-up needs 車齡 48 個月內且里程 < 15 萬公里, and nothing is available past year 5 — so years 6-10 carry full repair risk. One thing that HELPS resale, verified on that page: '延長保固方案可隨車輛轉讓，提升車輛轉售價值及保值性' — the extended warranty transfers with the car. BEV COST SHAPE, which is the point of this table: no oil, no filters beyond cabin, no spark plugs, no timing belt, no exhaust — and regenerative braking means pads barely wear. But this is not a zero-maintenance car. Tires wear FASTER on a BEV (kerb weight and instant torque) though at 7,000 km/yr they are replaced on AGE not tread, ~every 5 years — and note the EX30 Plus rides on 19-inch wheels, not 18, which is why the tire line here is NT$32,000 a set rather than the ~NT$26,000 an 18-inch car would pay. Brake fluid and coolant still need changing on schedule; the 12V battery still dies roughly every 5 years and strands the car when it does; and in Taiwan's humidity a low-mileage car's brake discs corrode from disuse long before the pads wear out, which is why discs appear in the year-10 bucket rather than pads in the year-5 one. 10-year total NT$181,000 (~NT$18,100/yr) — far below a combustion premium SUV, but clearly not zero.

Cabin filter, wiper blades, 12V + HV battery checks — all NT$0 under programme
Washer fluid (NT$315, one of only two chargeable line items)
One tire rotation (not in the covered item list)
checkpoints.source: Volvo TW 保養服務規劃 official pricing API for EX30 (2025 model year), re-queried live by this audit on 2026-08-12, which returns NT$0 for every scheduled line item under the 4年/8萬公里 free programme. Only the genuinely out-of-pocket extras are counted: 擋風玻璃清洗劑 NT$315 (the API's own price) and one tire rotation ~NT$1,200 (rotation does not appear in the covered item list). Effectively free year — this is what the official table actually returns, not an optimistic guess.

major_items: Years 2 and 3 annual services — NT$0 (still inside free programme)
Brake fluid change, time-based (NT$1,732 per Volvo TW price API)
2x tire rotation, one wheel alignment
Washer fluid and consumables
checkpoints.source: Covers the 1-3 year window, entirely inside Volvo TW's 4yr/80,000km free BEV programme, so both annual services are NT$0. Paid items are the ones the official API prices as chargeable plus non-covered consumables: one time-based brake fluid change at NT$1,732 (API-verified: 煞車油更換 labour NT$860 + 煞車油 NT$872 — the tool triggers it at the 30,000 km service but 2-3 years is the standard time interval and comes first at this mileage), two rotations ~NT$2,000, one alignment ~NT$1,200, fluids ~NT$600.

major_items: FIRST TIRE SET — age-driven at ~5 years, not worn out (4x 19-inch ~NT$8,000 fitted = NT$32,000)
Free maintenance programme ENDS at year 4 — year 5 service now paid (~NT$5,500)
30,000 km service items incl. brake fluid, now out of pocket
12V battery first replacement (~NT$5,500)
Wheel alignment after new tires
checkpoints.source: The step-change window: Volvo TW's free programme expires at year 4, so year 4's service is still NT$0 but year 5's is paid (~NT$5,500 for a dealer annual inspection with cabin filter and wipers, which were free until now). Tires dominate: at 35,000 km the tread is barely touched, but 5-year-old rubber is replaced on AGE. CORRECTED BY THIS AUDIT — the EX30 Plus runs 19-inch wheels, not 18: 8891's official trim spec table lists 輪圈規格 as 18吋 for the Core and 19吋 for the Plus and Ultra. Four premium 19-inch EV-rated tires (235/45R19 class, e.g. Michelin Pilot Sport EV / Pirelli P Zero Elect) run ~NT$8,000 fitted in TW = NT$32,000, not the ~NT$26,000 an 18-inch car would pay; BEV-rated tires carry a premium and wear faster than the combustion equivalent. Plus brake fluid NT$1,732 (the 30,000 km service lands ~year 4.3, just outside the free window — see plan_notes), alignment ~NT$1,500, and a first 12V battery ~NT$5,500 (AGM, dealer-fitted; BEV 12V batteries typically fail at 4-6 years and immobilise the car).

major_items: 2x paid annual service — no warranty, no free programme (~NT$11,000)
Front brake pads — corrosion-driven, not wear-driven (~NT$7,000)
Coolant change, HV battery and drivetrain circuits (~NT$6,000)
Brake fluid, cabin filters, wipers
Out-of-warranty risk allowance (~NT$6,000)
checkpoints.source: First fully unprotected window: the 3-year factory warranty and the year-4/5 extended warranty are both exhausted (Volvo TW sells no cover past year 5), so every repair is now the owner's. Two paid annual services ~NT$11,000. Front pads ~NT$7,000 — note the reason, since it is BEV-specific and counterintuitive: with one-pedal regenerative driving the friction pads on an EX30 would easily survive past 100,000 km on wear alone, but a low-mileage car in Taiwan's humidity corrodes and seizes its pads and caliper slides from DISUSE, which is what actually forces the job. Coolant ~NT$6,000 (Volvo long-life, first change typically 6-8 years; the EX30 has both HV battery and drivetrain circuits). Brake fluid NT$1,732 plus filters and wipers ~NT$2,500. NT$6,000 risk allowance for the usual out-of-warranty small failures at this age (sensors, suspension bushings, A/C). NOTE ON SHAPE: this bucket is lower than the year-5 bucket, which is deliberate and not an error — the first tire set, the first 12V battery and the end of free servicing all land inside years 3-5, while years 5-7 carry no lumpy consumable. On a per-year basis the trend still rises across the record (NT$1,500 / 2,750 / 23,000 / 17,000 / 31,333 per year).

major_items: SECOND TIRE SET, again age-driven, 19-inch (~NT$33,500 with alignment)
Brake discs + rear pads — humidity corrosion on a low-mileage car (~NT$14,000)
3x paid annual service (~NT$17,000)
12V battery second replacement (~NT$5,500)
60,000 km service items incl. reduction-gear oil, now paid
HV BATTERY WARRANTY EXPIRES ~year 8 — risk allowance NT$18,000
checkpoints.source: Three-year window and the most expensive by far, for structural reasons rather than mileage. Second tire set at ~year 10, five years after the first and again on age not tread — 19-inch, ~NT$32,000 + NT$1,500 alignment (see the year-5 note on the corrected wheel size). Brake discs and rear pads ~NT$14,000 — on a 70,000 km car the discs are replaced because they have corroded and pitted, not because they are worn thin. Three paid services ~NT$17,000, second 12V battery ~NT$5,500, brake fluid ~NT$3,500, plus the 60,000 km service items (電動馬達齒輪油 reduction-gear oil, 齒輪箱油塞墊片組, 補胎劑) which the API shows Volvo covering free at year 4 but which are chargeable here at ~year 8.6. The NT$18,000 risk allowance is the honest weak point: Volvo's HV battery warranty runs 8 years and expires inside this window, and from year 8 the owner carries pack, on-board-charger, inverter, A/C compressor and control-module risk with no manufacturer backstop — Volvo TW's extended warranty is no help even if it could run this long, since its covered-systems list contains no traction-battery item. NT$18,000 covers ordinary failures only — it does NOT provision for a pack replacement, which would be a six-figure event and is better treated as the tail risk already priced into the year-10 resale figure.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses 7,000 km/year (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: 牌照稅, 貨物稅 and all insurance. Taiwan grants BEVs a 使用牌照稅 exemption and the list price already embeds the 貨物稅 reduction per Volvo's own footnote; the exact statutory end-date of the 牌照稅 exemption is NOT asserted here because it could not be verified in this pass, and it changes no number in this record since tax is out of scope either way. ALSO EXCLUDED and deliberately not counted as maintenance: home AC charger supply + installation, roughly NT$30,000-80,000 in Taiwan depending on the building's panel and cable run (Volvo TW has periodically offered a half-price 家用充電樁 with BEV purchase). Electricity and public DC charging are running costs, not maintenance, and are also out of scope. The high-voltage battery warranty is ASSUMED to be Volvo's global 8 years / 160,000 km - it could not be confirmed on any reachable Volvo TW page - and that assumption is load-bearing for both the year-7 value (warranty still live) and the year-10 collapse (warranty gone).

purchase.notes: PRICE CONFIRMED, NO CHANGE. NT$1,690,000 is the current 2026MY 建議售價, verified against the TVBS launch report; the prior figure was correct and stands. DISCOUNT (NT$50,000, ESTIMATE): Volvo Taiwan discounts this car by cutting the LIST price rather than by giving cash off. The 2026MY EX40 Plus was repriced three times in four months - NT$1,790,000 announced 2025-11-19, NT$1,740,000 on 2026-01-07, NT$1,690,000 at the 2026-03-05 launch - a total NT$220,000 / -11.5% below the 2025MY's NT$1,910,000, and -NT$330,000 on the Ultra. All four price points were independently fetched and confirmed. The published August 2026 offer (https://www.volvocartw.com/monthly-offers/, verified) is a finance subsidy only - 月付 NT$19,888 / 72 期 - with no cash discount stated. NT$50,000 is a realistic dealer-level cash/accessory concession on the volume entry trim for a brand that does commonly discount in Taiwan; there is no published figure, so treat it as an estimate rather than a sourced number. ON-ROAD FEES (NT$40,000, ESTIMATE): 領牌規費 approx NT$1,500 (BEV, no 貨物稅 payable at registration - already embedded in the list price), 代辦費 approx NT$8,000-10,000 typical for a luxury import, and 配件 approx NT$28,000-30,000 (隔熱紙, 鍍膜, 行車紀錄器, 腳踏墊, 充電線收納), which is where most of the money actually goes on a car at this price. The accessory component is entirely negotiable and could plausibly range NT$25,000-60,000. real_cost = 1,690,000 - 50,000 + 40,000 = 1,680,000. Tax and insurance excluded by design.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED IN FACT-CHECK. Anchored on the best SAME-MODEL listing actually visible on VOLVO SELEKT (https://www.volvoselekt.com.tw/list.php, re-read 2026-08-12): 2025年式 EX40 Ultra Twin Motor, 37,914 km, certified asking NT$1,570,000 = 83% of the current 2026MY Ultra list of NT$1,890,000. Supporting low-mileage certified asking on the sister car: 2025年式 EC40 Plus Single Motor 806 km NT$1,590,000 and 6,353 km NT$1,550,000. NOTE: the previous version of this record cited a '2025年式 EX40 Ultra 15,994 km NT$1,580,000' listing that is NOT on the page today; it has been replaced with the verified 37,914 km listing. METHOD AND ADJUSTMENT STATED: I take certified dealer asking for a 1-year / 7,000 km EX40 Plus at approx 82% of current list = NT$1,385,000 (the verified comparable is 83% at 5x this mileage, so a 7,000 km car sits at least there), then cut 12% to reach PRIVATE SALE NT$1,220,000, and a further 14% to dealer trade-in NT$1,050,000. These are 車商售價 converted down - they were NOT copied across. Held below a naive curve because Volvo TW cut this car's list price three times in four months, which reprices existing used stock overnight.

Anchored on the closest real mileage match available and re-verified on the live page: VOLVO SELEKT 2022年 XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin Motor, 22,000 km, certified asking NT$1,260,000 (https://www.volvoselekt.com.tw/list.php, read 2026-08-12) - approx 56% of its original list at 4 years and almost exactly this buyer's mileage profile. The XC40 Recharge is the direct PREDECESSOR of the EX40 (same CMA platform; the EX40 is the renamed XC40 Recharge), so this is a predecessor-generation retention ratio applied to this car's real_cost, which is the correct method for an age this car's generation has not reached. Interpolating with the 1-year point gives approx 62% certified asking at 3 years -> NT$1,050,000, less 12% to PRIVATE SALE NT$920,000, less 14% to trade-in NT$790,000. ADJUSTMENT STATED: certified retail asking converted down to private-sale and trade-in, never copied across. Cross-check: this puts the 4-year private figure at approx 49% of cost, matching the 22,000 km XC40 Recharge anchor converted to private sale (approx 50%).

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation. Built from the Volvo Selekt certified curve above (approx 82% at 1yr, 56% at 4yr on the 22,000 km XC40 Recharge) continued to approx 49-50% certified asking at 5 years, then reduced 12% to PRIVATE SALE and a further 15% to trade-in. Sense-checked against SUM 汽車網 Tesla listings (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/TESLA?v=4, read 2026-08-12), where 2021-2022 Model 3s sit in the NT$1,128,000-1,158,000 dealer-asking band - but Tesla is the most liquid BEV in Taiwan and an illiquid Volvo BEV should sit below it. Confidence low: no genuine 5-year EX40 / XC40 Recharge low-mileage transaction data exists in Taiwan yet.

SOURCE FIGURE CORRECTED IN FACT-CHECK: the previous version cited a 2020 Model 3 at 126,000 km asking NT$898,000; SUM 汽車網 (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/TESLA?v=4, re-read 2026-08-12) actually shows that car - a 2020 Model 3 Standard Range Plus, 126,000 km - asking NT$738,000, and the record's own sources list contradicted its own checkpoint on this point. Method: the oldest BEVs genuinely trading in Taiwan are 2019-2021 Teslas; I take approx 40% certified asking at 7 years / 49,000 km for the EX40 - below the Tesla ratio because Volvo BEVs are far less liquid and this is an orphaned CMA-platform car, above where mileage alone would put it because 49,000 km is very low - then -13% to PRIVATE SALE NT$580,000 and -17% to trade-in NT$480,000. The assumed 8-year HV battery warranty is still live at year 7 (buyers pay for that) but expires within 12 months, which caps the price. Confidence low.

The oldest volume BEVs here are 2019-2020 Model 3s, so nothing 10 years old trades; SUM 汽車網 (read 2026-08-12) returned zero Model S listings, confirming there is no 10-year BEV benchmark to use. Method: 10-year European premium compact SUVs in Taiwan (2016 X1 / GLA class) retain roughly 22-28% of original list privately; I discount that by about 35% for BEV-specific risk because the assumed 8-year HV battery warranty has expired and a 69 kWh pack replacement would exceed the car's value. That gives approx 18% of cost = NT$300,000 private, less approx 23% to trade-in NT$230,000. Additional drag priced in: TVBS 2026-08-05 (https://cars.tvbs.com.tw/car-news/335732, verified in this pass) reports the EX50 arrives autumn 2027 on the new SPA3 800V platform at a materially LOWER price, and Volvo 40-series H1 2026 sales down more than one third YoY - leaving this car an orphaned CMA-platform model. Confidence low - a reasoned extrapolation, not a sourced figure.

maintenance.plan_notes: THE PROGRAMME THAT DOMINATES YEARS 1-4: Volvo Taiwan's official 保養服務規劃 site states verbatim '台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案' - Taiwan-market Volvo BEVs get 4 years OR 80,000 km of FREE scheduled maintenance. This sentence was independently re-verified on the live page in this fact-check. At 7,000 km/year this owner never gets near 80,000 km, so the 4-YEAR CLOCK ends the programme, not mileage. SOURCING CAVEAT ADDED IN FACT-CHECK: the same official page explicitly does NOT publish itemised per-model pricing - it states that actual fees depend on inspection at an authorised service centre. The NT$0 line items for 'EX40, Single motor' (保養工資, 車室內空調濾芯更換, 檢查12V主電瓶, 高壓電池及電池冷卻系統檢查, 傳動檢查, 前後雨刷片更換, 補胎劑) come from a reverse-engineered internal pricing endpoint that could not be re-verified from a public page, so the years 1 and 3 checkpoints are rated MEDIUM, not high. The programme itself is confirmed, so near-zero cost in years 1-4 is directionally right. Inside the programme the owner still pays 建議檢查後更換項目: 煞車油更換 labour NT$645 + 煞車油 NT$872 = NT$1,517, plus 擋風玻璃清洗劑 NT$315. WARRANTY: 3-year new-car warranty; years 4 and 5 are a paid 延長保固 add-on that must be bought before 30 months / 100,000 km. NOTE: the Volvo TW extended-warranty page returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch and could not be re-verified in this pass, so the year-6 risk cliff rests on an unverified claim. From year 6 the owner carries all risk. SERVICE INTERVAL: mileage checkpoints exist only at 30,000 km and 60,000 km, so at 7,000 km/year this is a TIME-driven annual visit, not a mileage-driven one. WHY THIS IS NOT ZERO: no oil, no filters, no plugs, no gearbox fluid, and regenerative braking means pads can survive a decade at this mileage - but brake fluid, coolant, cabin filter, wipers, tyre sealant, the 12V battery and TYRES all still come due, and tyres come due FASTER on a 2-tonne 238 hp BEV. Paid-labour benchmark from the same official tool (XC40 B3 2025, which shows real prices instead of zeros): 保養工資 NT$860, 附加檢查 NT$215, 傳動檢查 NT$430, 空調濾芯 labour NT$215 + part NT$2,741, 前雨刷 NT$2,174, 後雨刷 NT$945, 補胎劑 NT$2,762. 定期檢驗 CORRECTED IN FACT-CHECK: Taiwan requires annual inspection once a private car is 5 years old (not year 6 as the previous version's notes said), and twice-yearly from 10 years; NT$450/visit, first charged in the 3-5y window, which is what the year-5 checkpoint already did. SHAPE NOTE: period_cost dips from NT$56,000 (3-5y) to NT$37,000 (5-7y). This is structural, not an arithmetic error - the first tyre set falls in the 3-5y window and the second at year 10, so the 5-7y window genuinely carries no tyre spend.

purchase.notes: list_price 179 萬經官方 PDF 與 TVBS 雙來源確認。價格脈絡是本車最重要的變數：同一台 Plus Single motor 在 2025 年式為 201 萬，2025/11 降到 189 萬，2026/1 降到 184 萬，2026/3/5 正式上市 179 萬，9 個月累計降 22 萬（-11%），Ultra Twin 累計降 33 萬。原廠連續調價會一夜之間把整批中古庫存重新定價，這是本表把殘值大幅下修的核心理由。discounts 50,000 元為經銷商層級現金／配件讓利推估：牌價才剛連砍兩次，議價空間比 Volvo 平常小；2026/8 原廠方案是分期補貼而非現金折讓；EC40 吃不到「貨物稅減徵＋汰舊換新最高 10 萬」那套補助，因為純電車本來就免貨物稅。onroad_fees 45,000 元 = 領牌規費與代辦約 5,000 元 ＋ 腳踏墊／隔熱紙／行車記錄器／鍍膜等交車配件約 40,000 元，約當車價 2.5%。real_cost = 1,790,000 − 50,000 + 45,000 = 1,785,000。稅與保險依設定完全排除。同期 ICE 手足 XC40 Plus B3 接單價 175.6 萬，與 EC40 幾乎同價，是判斷「BEV 不應比同價 ICE 更保值」的直接對照組。

selling_costs.notes: 以「自售」情境估算，對應 private_sale_price。若改走車商收購，這三項幾乎歸零，但成交價要換成 dealer_tradein_price，淨收入仍較低。整備費 7,000 元反映這是白牌豪華跨界休旅，買家對板件、輪圈與內裝細節挑剔，交車前整理成本高於國產小車。合計 11,500 元落在一般 4,000-15,000 元區間的中上緣。

value_checkpoints.source: 已修正前手數字（原 1,380,000 過高）。本人於 2026/8/12 curl https://auto.8891.com.tw/volvo 取得頁內 JSON，確認 EC40 在售 6 筆、車商開價區間 1,480,000-1,680,000（與前手陳述一致，資料屬實）。但這批是 600-8,200 公里的近全新展示／領牌車，且原始牌價為 201 萬的 2025 年式，其開價由車商成本反推而非市場成交，屬「準新車」區隔，不能當一般 1 年車主用車的行情。修正依據：現行新車牌價 1,790,000 是二手價的天花板，前手數字等於 real_cost 的 77%，屬 Toyota 等級保值率，與「Volvo BEV 在台需求薄、車系汰換快、且 9 個月內官方降價 22 萬」矛盾。改以車商開價約 1,340,000（新車牌價 75%，較同齡 ICE Volvo 低約 7 個百分點作為 BEV 折讓）為起點，自售價 = 車商開價 −14% → 1,150,000；車商收購價 = 自售價 −14% → 990,000。低里程（7,000 公里）已取上緣。

已修正（原 970,000 過高）。用前身同款車 C40 Recharge（Volvo 2024/2 更名 EC40，機械同款）。本人 curl 8891 Volvo 頁確認 C40 Recharge 在售 14 筆、車商開價 1,172,000-1,580,000（與前手陳述一致）。同時抓到本人自行擷取的 Volvo ICE 對照：XC60 2023 款 Ultimate B5（3 年、65,200 公里）車商開價 1,359,000，對原始牌價約 230 萬 = 59% 車商開價保值率。以「BEV 較同齡 ICE 低約 9 個百分點」推得 EC40 第 3 年車商開價約新車牌價 50%（約 900,000），自售價 = −12% → 790,000，車商收購價 = −14% → 680,000。分母用現行 179 萬牌價而非舊 201 萬，因為新車已降價，中古價被壓過一輪。低里程 21,000 公里已取上緣。屬跨代推導，故降為 low。

外推，已修正（原 800,000 過高）。台灣同平台最老純電 Volvo 僅 4 年（2022 年 XC40 Recharge）。本人 curl 8891 確認 XC40 Recharge 在售 14 筆、車商開價 968,000-1,398,000。關鍵對照組是同價位的 ICE 手足：本人自 8891 Volvo 頁逐筆擷取到 XC40 2021 款 B5 R-Design（5 年、99,900 公里）車商開價 759,000，對原始牌價約 195 萬 = 39% 車商開價保值率。本車第 5 年僅 35,000 公里，里程遠低於該車源，但 BEV 折讓（電池年限疑慮、車系汰換、原廠反覆調價）抵銷之，故取車商開價約新車牌價 38.5%（約 690,000）；自售價 = −13% → 600,000，車商收購價 = −15% → 510,000。第 5 年原廠 3 年保固已過、8 年電池保固仍在。

外推，已修正（原 620,000 過高）。台灣沒有 7 年車齡的 EC40 / C40 Recharge（車系 2022 年才進台灣），依規定改用台灣真正在交易的最老 BEV 與同廠 ICE 曲線。本人 curl https://auto.8891.com.tw/tesla 與 https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw 確認兩頁存在且有老 BEV 車源可查。同廠 ICE 錨點（本人自 8891 Volvo 頁逐筆擷取）：XC90 2019 款 T5 Momentum（7 年、117,500 公里）車商開價 879,000，對原始牌價約 289 萬 = 30%；XC60 2018 款 T6 R-Design（8 年、71,900 公里，低里程）開價 899,000，對約 269 萬 = 33%。Volvo BEV 在第 7 年須再折讓：保外高壓系統維修昂貴、二手接手意願低。取車商開價約新車牌價 27%（約 483,000），自售價 = −13% → 420,000，車商收購價 = −15% → 355,000。第 7 年 8 年電池保固仍在，是撐住此價位的主因。

外推，本表最不確定的一格，已修正（原 380,000 過高）。台灣完全沒有 10 年車齡的 Volvo 純電車可查。同廠 ICE 錨點（本人自 8891 Volvo 頁逐筆擷取）：XC90 2016 款 D5 Momentum（10 年、214,900 公里）車商開價 559,000，對原始牌價約 300 萬 = 18.6%；XC60 2015 款 T5 R-Design（11 年、162,000 公里）開價 258,000，對約 220 萬 = 11.7%；XC60 2014 款 D4 旗艦版（12 年、216,900 公里）開價 239,000。老 BEV 落點參考 8891 BMW 頁的 i3（台灣唯一 8-11 年量產 BEV）。本車第 10 年只跑 7 萬公里可往上修，但第 8 年起 8 年／16 萬公里高壓電池保固到期是 BEV 特有的殘值斷崖（電池模組、DC-DC、車載充電器全數落入自付，單項維修可能超過車價），兩相抵銷後取車商開價約新車牌價 18%（約 322,000）；自售價 = −13% → 280,000，車商收購價 = −18% → 230,000（老 BEV 車商收購折讓更深，因流通性差）。

maintenance.plan_notes: 官方免費保養方案已由本人獨立驗證：curl https://volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/ （HTTP 200）取得頁面註記原文「台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案，詳細內容請洽各經銷商服務據點」，並註明「必須依照指定保養間隔或里程執行，國際富豪汽車股份有限公司保留更改、取消之權利」。本車一年 7,000 公里，10 年只跑 7 萬公里，永遠碰不到 8 萬公里上限，所以免費保養以「4 年」到期 —— 第 1 至第 4 年的定期保養（工資、車室空調濾芯、雨刷片、12V 主電瓶檢查、高壓電池及冷卻系統檢查）由原廠吸收，第 5 年起全部自費。保養是時間驅動而非里程驅動。保固：新車原廠保固 3 年，第 4-5 年須加價買延長保固；延保保費屬保險性支出，未計入保養費，僅拿來當第 7、10 年「保固外風險準備金」的定價上限參考。BEV 特性已反映在數字裡：沒有機油、火星塞、正時鏈條與變速箱油，所以前 5 年幾乎沒有花費；但整備重量 1,986 公斤（官方規格表確認）加上大扭力讓輪胎磨得比同尺寸燃油車快，且 EC40 前後配不同尺寸（前 235/50R19、後 255/45R19，官方規格表確認），換一套比一般 19 吋貴、也不能靠前後對調延壽；煞車油、電池與電控冷卻液仍要定期更換；12V 電瓶仍會壽終；One Pedal Drive 回充煞車讓來令片極耐用，但台灣濕氣重且低里程反而讓碟盤鏽蝕，碟盤通常比來令片先陣亡。10 年合計約 251,500 元、年均約 25,150 元 —— 明顯低於同級燃油 Volvo（同期約 40-50 萬），但絕不是零。家用充電樁安裝不算保養，見 assumptions.notes。

major_items: 定期保養在 4 年／8 萬公里免費保養專案範圍內，工資與基礎項目 0 元
僅雨刷精、擋風玻璃洗滌劑等雜項與免費健檢
checkpoints.source: 免費保養專案由本人 curl https://volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/ 驗證，頁面明載「台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案」。但 2,000 元本身是雜項自估、非官方數字，故 confidence 由前手的 high 下修為 medium（有官方依據的是「免費」這件事，不是這個金額）。

major_items: 第 2、3 年定期保養仍在 4 年免費保養期內：工資、車室空調濾芯、雨刷片、12V 電瓶檢查、高壓電池及冷卻系統檢查 0 元
煞車油更換約 1,832 元，屬「建議檢查後更換項目」，不在免費範圍
四輪定位與動平衡約 2,000 元
checkpoints.source: 免費保養範圍經本人驗證於官方保養服務規劃頁；該頁本身即區分「基礎保養」與「建議檢查後更換項目（依實際需求）」兩類，煞車油屬後者、需自費，此分類為官方頁面結構所確認。惟煞車油與四輪定位的逐項金額為市場行情自估，未取得逐筆官方報價，故 confidence 由前手的 high 下修為 medium。

major_items: 第 4 年定期保養仍在免費期內（工資、空調濾芯、雨刷片 0 元）；第 5 年起首次自費
第一套輪胎更換約 34,000 元：前 235/50R19＋後 255/45R19 前後異尺寸，四條含工資；低里程下是「橡膠老化到期」而非磨平，5-6 年一定要換，且 BEV 車重與扭力讓磨耗更快
煞車油更換約 1,832 元
四輪定位與動平衡約 3,000 元
原廠 3 年保固已於第 3 年結束，第 4-5 年延長保固保費未列入本項
checkpoints.source: 輪胎規格（前 235/50R19、後 255/45R19）與整備重量 1,986 公斤由本人解析官方規格配備表 PDF https://www.volvocartw.com/pdf/carsp/ec40.pdf 內容串流逐字確認，前後異尺寸屬實、確實無法對調延壽。免費保養期間由官方保養服務規劃頁確認。四條 19 吋高階胎含工 34,000 元為台灣市場行情推估，未取得逐筆報價，是本格最弱的一環。

major_items: 第 6、7 年定期保養首次全額自費（4 年免費期已過）：工資＋空調濾芯＋雨刷片＋高壓電池與冷卻系統檢查，兩次約 20,000 元
煞車油更換約 2,000 元
12V 電瓶更換約 8,000 元（BEV 的 12V 電瓶仍會壞，低里程長期停放更容易提早）
前碟盤＋來令片更換約 20,000 元（回充煞車讓來令片超耐用，但台灣濕氣重＋低里程讓碟盤鏽蝕先到極限）
電池／電控冷卻液與空調系統維護約 5,000 元
保固外故障風險準備金約 10,000 元（原廠 3 年保固已過；8 年電池保固仍在，高壓電池本身尚未落入自付）
checkpoints.source: 推估。官方保養服務規劃頁只涵蓋免費期，查無「免費保養結束後」的自費價目（本人已實際開啟該頁確認其為查詢式介面，無公開的保外價目表）。金額由下而上加總：兩次自費定期保養＋耗材＋碟盤＋12V 電瓶＋風險金，工資水準參考同級豪華進口車行情。輪胎在第 5 年已換，本期不重複計。無實收據佐證，confidence low。

major_items: 第 8、9、10 年三次自費定期保養，共約 25,000 元
煞車油兩次約 4,000 元
第二套輪胎約 36,000 元（第 5 年那套到第 10 年已滿 5 年，一樣是老化到期）
後碟盤＋來令片約 18,000 元
12V 電瓶再換一次約 8,000 元
冷卻液與空調系統維護約 8,000 元

assumptions.notes: Low-mileage owner: 6,000-8,000 km/year vs the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). This matters two ways for a BEV. (1) Resale: at 10 years the car has only 70,000 km, so battery cycle count is very low (roughly 150 full-pack equivalents on the 92 kWh pack) and state-of-health should still be high; low-mileage cars sell above the mileage-blind average, so all quoted comps were chosen from low-mileage listings and the mileage adjustment is stated in each source string. (2) Maintenance: Volvo Taiwan's own service planner lists the EX40 BEV service interval as 30,000 km / 60,000 km (vs every 10,000 km for the combustion XC90 B5). At 7,000 km/year, 30,000 km takes ~4.3 years, so servicing is TIME-driven (roughly every 2 years), never mileage-driven, for this owner's whole ownership period. EXCLUDED from all figures by design: 牌照稅, 燃料費 and insurance. ALSO EXCLUDED from maintenance (but still a real ownership cost): a home AC charger install. Volvo Taiwan bundles a wallbox with some EV campaigns, but the electrical work in a Taiwanese apartment/管委會 building typically runs NT$30,000-60,000 (more if a dedicated meter and riser are needed). Treat that as a one-off setup cost, not maintenance. Spec basis for consumables, all re-verified against the U-CAR spec sheet on 2026-08-12: 電池總容量 92kwh (the twins are 106kwh), 最大綜效馬力 333, 7 seats, 5,037 mm long, DC charging 310 kW, and a STAGGERED 20-inch tyre fitment (輪胎尺寸 255/50 R20 front, 後輪尺寸 285/45 R20 rear). Staggered means front and rear tyres cannot be rotated between axles, so they wear unevenly and the whole set is replaced at once - a real cost driver on a ~2.6-tonne EV. The 800V architecture and 350 kW peak DC figure quoted in press coverage are the Twin Motor numbers; this single-motor car is 310 kW on the same 800V architecture.

purchase.source: List price re-verified INDEPENDENTLY on 2026-08-12 and it CONFIRMS NT$2,990,000, so it is unchanged. Three separate retrievals: (a) U-CAR model page newcar.u-car.com.tw/volvo/ex90/7219/overall, price table reads 'Plus Single Motor | 299 | 0 | 純電動', 'Ultra Twin Motor | 359', 'Ultra Twin Motor Performance | 383'; (b) UDN 發燒車訊 2026-06-12, quoting 國際富豪汽車's own release verbatim - 'EX90 Plus Single Motor：299 萬元 / EX90 Ultra Twin Motor：359 萬元 / Ultra Twin Motor Performance 七座版：383 萬元 / 六座版：389 萬元'; (c) a second UDN report of 2026-06-13 with the identical list. Discount level cross-checked against Volvo Cars Taiwan's own August 2026 offers page (volvocartw.com/monthly-offers/), retrieved 2026-08-12.
purchase.notes: CAVEAT ON THE LIST PRICE: NT$2,990,000 is a 預售價 (pre-order price). U-CAR states Volvo 國際富豪汽車 announced the domestic pre-sale on 2026-06-11 after signalling in October 2025 that the EX90 would be formally launched in Q4 2026. So this is a pre-order price that has not yet been reprinted as a final 建議售價. It is the only official number that exists today and U-CAR and both UDN reports carry it identically, so it is used as list_price, but the final figure could move at launch. DISCOUNTS = 60,000 (2%), deliberately small, and the August 2026 offers page (retrieved 2026-08-12) supports that: every live offer is financing (EX30 0 頭款 / 月付 NT$15,000 起; EC40 and EX40 月付 NT$19,888 / 72 期; XC60, XC90, V60 120 萬 40 期 0% 利率) or a soft sweetener (1 year 乙式全險, 第 4 年延長保固 on XC90/V60) - there is no cash discount on any model, and the EX90 does not appear on the page at all because it is still in pre-order, which is exactly when a flagship has the least room. Volvo Taiwan DOES discount hard, but on run-out cars, not new flagships: the outgoing XC40 Recharge was run out at 23萬 off, and the same car's list was cut from 222萬 (XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin Motor, per KingAutos, verified) to 189萬 (EX40 Ultra Twin Motor, per U-CAR, verified) when it was renamed. So 60,000 here represents a realistic dealer-level giveaway (registration handling waived plus an accessory package), not a headline cash cut. ONE SUBSIDY THIS CAR CANNOT HAVE, which the offers page makes explicit and which is easy to get wrong: the 「政府貨物稅減徵及汰舊換新最高 NT$100,000 補助」 line appears only on the combustion/hybrid rows (XC40, XC60, XC90, V60) and on none of the BEV rows (EX30, EC40, EX40). That is correct - a BEV pays no 貨物稅 in Taiwan, so there is no commodity tax to rebate, and the exemption is already baked into the 299萬 list price rather than being claimable on top. An EX90 buyer therefore cannot stack the NT$100,000 scrappage rebate that an XC90 buyer can. ONROAD_FEES = 90,000, scaled to a ~300萬 5,037 mm 7-seat flagship: 新領牌照登記費 NT$450 plus 代辦費 ~NT$7,000; window film for a large glazed 7-seater ~NT$45,000; paint coating ~NT$22,000; front+rear dashcam ~NT$12,000; floor mats and cargo tray ~NT$4,000. This is ~3% of list, higher than the ~NT$40,000 typical of a 240萬 XC60 because the glass area, the wheel/body size and the buyer's accessory expectations all scale. real_cost = 2,990,000 - 60,000 + 90,000 = 3,020,000. Tax and insurance excluded by design.

selling_costs.notes: Priced at the top of the usual TW 4,000-15,000 band because this is a large, 300萬-class 7-seat SUV: the detail alone is a full day's work on a 5,037 mm car, and a private seller in this price bracket normally pays for a premium/featured listing rather than the free tier. Assumes the owner sells privately (自售). A dealer trade-in would drop selling_costs close to zero, but the trade-in price itself is ~13% lower - see dealer_tradein_price at each checkpoint.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN by this review from a previous 2,150,000. No used EX90 exists in Taiwan - the car is still in pre-order - so this is bracketed from real low-mileage Volvo BEV listings on VOLVO SELEKT 原廠認證中古車 (volvoselekt.com.tw/list.php), every one of which was re-retrieved and confirmed verbatim on 2026-08-12: 2026年式 EX30 Core Single Motor, 7,271 km, asking 119.8萬 against a 139.9萬 list = 86%; 2026年式 EX30 Plus, 3,600 km, asking 146.0萬 against 159.99萬 = 91%; 2025年式 EC40 Plus Single motor, 806 km, asking 159.0萬 against a 179萬 list = 89%. Those are 車商售價 on 原廠認證 stock, i.e. the very top of the retail range, and they are small BEVs with the broadest buyer pool in Taiwan. A 299萬 7-seat BEV flagship that has not yet launched has a far thinner pool, so the near-new band is shaded down to a DEALER RETAIL asking of about 229.5萬 at 1 year / 7,000 km (76.8% of list) rather than the ~82% a straight read of the EX30/EC40 comps would give. WHY THE REVISION: the earlier 2,150,000 put year-1 retention at 71.9% of list, ABOVE the comparable Volvo mild-hybrid XC60 B5 Plus at 70.1%. In Taiwan a BEV should not out-retain a comparable hybrid of the same brand, and Volvo's BEVs are the weaker half of its range; on top of that this car's list price is itself an unsettled 預售價, which year-one used buyers discount. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = retail 229.5萬 x 0.88 (12% below asking, mid of the usual 8-15% gap) = 2,020,000 = 67.6% of list. dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 (a further 13% down) = 1,760,000. The 7,000 km reading is a genuine premium here - a 1-year-old EX90 at average TW mileage would show ~13,000 km.

REVISED DOWN by this review from a previous 1,700,000. Anchored on the closest real Volvo BEV comps at similar age on VOLVO SELEKT (volvoselekt.com.tw/list.php), all re-confirmed verbatim 2026-08-12: 2024 C40 Ultimate Twin motor, 33,058 km, asking 155.0萬 against its ~222萬 original list = 70% at roughly 2 years; 2025年式 EX40 Ultra Twin motor, 37,914 km, asking 157.0萬 against 222萬 original = 71%; and the single most useful point, 2022 XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin motor with only 22,000 km, asking 126.0萬 against 222萬 = 57% DEALER RETAIL at roughly 4 years on a mileage almost identical to this owner's profile. Interpolating those to 3 years and adding back for the low 21,000 km gives ~57.4% of list as DEALER RETAIL, i.e. about 171.6萬. WHY THE REVISION: the earlier 1,700,000 was 56.9% of list, ABOVE the comparable Volvo XC60 B5 Plus mild-hybrid at 52.3%; a Volvo BEV flagship should sit below, not above, its mild-hybrid sibling in Taiwan. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: those are 車商售價; private_sale_price = 171.6萬 x 0.88 = 1,510,000 = 50.5% of list; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 = 1,315,000. Cross-check: the real 4-year XC40 Recharge comp at 22,000 km works out to a private figure of ~110.9萬 = 50% of its original list, and this curve passes through ~46% at year 4 - deliberately a few points below that comp, because the XC40 point is a certified dealer asking price at the top of the range on a cheaper, broader-market car. BEV-specific downward pressure already baked in: Volvo Taiwan cut this exact class of car's list by 15% mid-generation (XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin 222萬 per KingAutos, versus the identical EX40 Ultra Twin at 189萬 per U-CAR today, both verified) and ran the outgoing XC40 Recharge out at 23萬 off. Any repeat on the EX90 would reprice the entire used stock overnight.

EXTRAPOLATED - no 5-year-old Volvo BEV of this class exists in Taiwan. Reviewed and left unchanged. Two real curves were used, both re-confirmed on VOLVO SELEKT 2026-08-12. BEV curve: the 2022 XC40 Recharge Ultimate Twin motor (22,000 km, 126.0萬 on a 222萬 original list = 57% dealer retail at 4 years); continuing that slope one more year lands near 50%. Large-luxury-SUV curve from the predecessor XC90: 22/23年式 XC90 B5 Momentum, 30,095 km, Selekt 148.0萬 and 2022 XC90 B5 R-Design AWD, 39,000 km, Selekt 166.0萬 (both ~4 years, ~52-55% of their original list, against a current XC90 range of 295.6-377.6萬 per U-CAR), versus 2020 XC90 B5 Momentum with 96,400 km at 109.9萬 on 8891 (auto.8891.com.tw/volvo) - showing how hard mileage bites. Blending, and adding a low-mileage premium for 35,000 km, gives ~47% of list as DEALER RETAIL = about 140萬. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = 140萬 x 0.88 = 1,240,000 = 41.5% of list; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 = 1,075,000. This already sits below the comparable Volvo XC60 B5 Plus mild-hybrid at the same age (46.7%), which is the correct ordering for a Taiwan BEV. Low confidence because the dominant variable is not wear but whether Volvo Taiwan cuts the EX90's list price in the interim, as it demonstrably did to the XC40 Recharge/EX40.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION, NOT INVENTED - there is no 7-year-old EX90 anywhere and no 7-year-old luxury BEV market in Taiwan at all. Reviewed and left unchanged. Method: take the real used prices of the predecessor large 7-seat Volvo SUV (XC90 gen 2) at that age, express as a retention ratio of ITS original list, then apply to this car. Real listings re-confirmed 2026-08-12: 2018 XC90 T5 Momentum, 54,500 km, VOLVO SELEKT asking 98.0萬 - roughly 37% of its ~265萬 original list at 8 years; and 2017 XC90 T5, 127,900 km, 8891 asking 70.9萬 at 9 years (far lower on triple the mileage). Interpolating the low-mileage XC90 line back to 7 years gives ~41% dealer retail. BEV PENALTY APPLIED, ~20% relative: at year 7 the 8-year/160,000 km HV battery warranty is about to expire and Taiwanese buyers price that transfer risk in heavily; the oldest BEVs actually trading here (2017-2018 Tesla Model S/X, Nissan Leaf, Kona EV) sit well below their combustion analogues at the same age, which is the correct reference class rather than a combustion car. 41% x 0.80 = ~33% of list = about 99萬 DEALER RETAIL. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = 99萬 x 0.88 = 880,000 = 29.4% of list; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 = 765,000. Partially offset upward by this owner's 49,000 km, roughly half what a 7-year TW car normally shows. Sits below the comparable Volvo XC60 mild-hybrid (35.1%), as it should.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION - explicitly not a real EX90 data point. Value reviewed and left unchanged; the arithmetic in the previous version of this string was internally inconsistent (it quoted both 52萬 and 57萬 as the dealer-retail figure) and is restated cleanly here. Predecessor XC90 gen 2 at 10-11 years, real listing on 8891 (auto.8891.com.tw/volvo): 2016 XC90 D5 Momentum (5-seat), 214,900 km, dealer asking 55.9萬 - about 19% of its original list, but on catastrophic mileage. Mileage-correcting that to this owner's 70,000 km (using the same-model spread visible between the 2017 T5 at 127,900 km / 70.9萬 and the 2018 T5 at 54,500 km / 98.0萬) lifts the 10-year XC90 ratio to roughly 28% dealer retail. BEV PENALTY APPLIED, ~0.62 relative, larger at 10 years than at 7 for three reasons: the HV battery warranty (8yr/160,000 km) has expired outright so the buyer carries full pack risk on a 92 kWh 800V pack whose replacement would exceed the car's residual value; the EX90 is a software-defined vehicle (dual NVIDIA Orin at 254 TOPS, Google built-in, per U-CAR) whose OTA support horizon at 10 years is unknown; and Volvo Taiwan has a proven record of cutting BEV list prices mid-generation, each cut resetting used values. Benchmarked against what actually trades here at that age - 2014-2016 Leaf, 2016-2017 Model S/X - which sit at roughly 15-22% of original list. 28% x 0.62 = ~17.4% of list, i.e. about 52萬, then nudged up to ~57萬 DEALER RETAIL for the genuinely low 70,000 km (only ~150 full-pack cycles, so state-of-health should still be strong, and that is the first thing a 10-year BEV buyer checks). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private_sale_price = 57萬 x 0.88 = 500,000 = 16.7% of list; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 = 430,000. Low confidence and it deserves it: this is the single least knowable number in the record.

maintenance.plan_notes: THE HEADLINE FACT, and this review retrieved the page and confirmed it verbatim rather than taking it on trust: Volvo Taiwan gives its BEVs 4年或8萬公里免費保養 (4 years or 80,000 km of FREE scheduled maintenance). The footnote on Volvo Cars Taiwan's own maintenance-cost planner at volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/ reads 「1.官網的保養服務規劃是由Volvo規範的全球標準項目。台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案，詳細內容請洽各經銷商服務據點。 2. 4年8萬公里免費保養專案，必須依照指定保養間隔或里程執行，國際富豪汽車股份有限公司保留更改、取消之權利。」 Querying that same planner for the EX40 Single motor (the closest BEV on the tool; the EX90 is not listed yet because it has not launched) returns line items priced at NT$0: 保養工資, 車室內空調濾芯更換, 檢查12V主電瓶, 高壓電池及電池冷卻系統檢查, 前/後雨刷片更換 - all zero, each tagged 「*4年8萬公里免費保養」. That is why the year-1 and year-3 windows are near zero. INTERVAL: the same planner offers only 30,000 km and 60,000 km service points for the EX40 BEV, versus 10,000/20,000/.../80,000 km for the combustion XC90 B5. At 7,000 km/year the mileage trigger is ~4.3 years away, so servicing for this owner is TIME-DRIVEN (roughly every 2 years), never mileage-driven. WHAT IS NOT FREE, even inside the window: the planner prices 煞車油更換 at 645 labour + 872 parts = NT$1,517 and 擋風玻璃清洗劑 at NT$315 as chargeable items. SCALE OF THE BEV SAVING, from the same official tool: one 30,000 km service on the combustion XC90 B5 is 860 labour + 4,804 engine oil + 830 oil filter + 126 drain washer + 860+2,888 fuel filter + 215+1,932 air filter = NT$12,615 before wipers and brake fluid. The BEV equivalent is NT$0 inside the programme and a few thousand outside it - no oil, no oil filter, no fuel filter, no spark plugs, no timing components. WHAT GOES THE OTHER WAY, and it dominates from year 5 on: tyres. The U-CAR spec sheet was re-read for this review and confirms a STAGGERED 20-inch fitment (輪胎尺寸 255/50 R20 front, 後輪尺寸 285/45 R20 rear), so tyres cannot be rotated front-to-rear and the set is replaced together; on a ~2.6-tonne EV with instant torque they wear faster than on a combustion SUV, and at 7,000 km/year they age out (5-6 years) before they wear out. Regenerative braking means brake PADS last far longer, but in humid Taiwan the flip side is that lightly-used discs corrode, which is why disc-and-pad work appears in the year-7 and year-10 windows rather than pad-only. The 12V battery still dies (twice over 10 years), brake fluid is still a 2-year item, and coolant still needs changing. HV battery warranty is 8 years / 160,000 km, so years 1-7 carry no pack risk and year 10 carries all of it. REVISED BY THIS REVIEW: the year-7 window was raised from NT$54,000 to NT$72,000. It had dipped well below the year-5 window and under-provisioned out-of-warranty work at Volvo parts-and-labour rates on a 7-year, 2.6-tonne, 300萬-class EV; the provision line went from NT$15,000 to NT$28,000 and a coolant/air-con line was added. NOT INCLUDED ANYWHERE: home charger installation (see assumptions.notes), and HV pack replacement - at 70,000 km its probability is low, and if it happened it would exceed the car's residual value, so folding it into an average would be misleading. WHOLE-PLAN SANITY CHECK: 10-year total is NT$337,000. A combustion XC90 over the same 70,000 km would need 7 services at ~NT$12,600 each on Volvo TW's own official schedule (NT$88,000) before any tyres, brakes or wear parts, and the comparable Volvo XC60 B5 mild-hybrid models out at roughly NT$437,000 over the same decade - so this BEV lands clearly below its combustion siblings but nowhere near zero, which is the correct shape.

major_items: No scheduled service falls due (BEV interval is 30,000 km / ~2 years; owner reaches only 7,000 km)
Any dealer courtesy inspection is free under Volvo TW's 4年/8萬公里免費保養 programme
Washer fluid and a wheel alignment check only
checkpoints.source: Volvo Cars Taiwan official maintenance planner, volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/, retrieved and read by this review on 2026-08-12: the 4年或8萬公里免費保養專案 footnote is confirmed verbatim, and the BEV service-interval query for EX40 Single motor returns only 30,000/60,000 km with every basic-maintenance line at NT$0. At 7,000 km in year one, nothing is even due. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from high to medium by this review: the free programme, the interval and the NT$0 line items are officially sourced, but the NT$2,000 itself is not a planner line - it is 擋風玻璃清洗劑 NT$315 (official) plus a discretionary alignment check, i.e. judgement, so 'high' overstated it.

major_items: One time-driven scheduled service at ~year 2 - FREE under the 4-year programme (labour, cabin filter, wipers, 12V battery check, HV battery and cooling-system check all NT$0)
Brake fluid change, 2-year item and NOT covered: NT$1,517 (645 labour + 872 parts, official)
Washer fluid NT$315 (official)
A/C condenser clean, optional: NT$1,910 (860 + 1,050, official)
Wheel alignment ~NT$2,000
checkpoints.source: All priced line-by-line from the official Volvo Cars Taiwan planner (volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/, confirmed live 2026-08-12), EX40 Single motor query. Time-driven, not mileage-driven: the owner is at 21,000 km, well short of the 30,000 km trigger, and still inside the 4-year free window. Confidence is medium rather than high because the A/C-clean and alignment lines are discretionary judgement, not fixed schedule items.

major_items: FULL TYRE SET, age-driven not wear-driven: staggered 255/50 R20 front + 285/45 R20 rear, premium EV-rated, ~NT$54,000 fitted for four
Free-maintenance programme EXPIRES at year 4 - the ~year-5 service is the first paid one: ~NT$6,000 (labour, cabin filter, checks)
12V battery replacement ~NT$10,000 (AGM; BEVs are hard on it, typically 4-6 years)
Coolant change (battery and power-electronics loops) ~NT$6,000
Brake fluid NT$1,517 (official)
Wiper blades front + rear ~NT$3,100
Wheel alignment ~NT$2,500
checkpoints.source: Structure and unit prices from the official Volvo Cars Taiwan planner (volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/) for the free-programme boundary and the fluid/labour rates; tyre spec re-verified for this review on the U-CAR EX90 spec sheet (newcar.u-car.com.tw/volvo/ex90/7219/spec), which reads 輪胎尺寸 255/50 R20 and 後輪尺寸 285/45 R20 - a genuinely staggered fitment - priced at Taiwan retail for premium EV-rated rubber in those sizes. This window is dominated by the tyre set, which at 7,000 km/year is replaced because the rubber has aged out, not because the tread is gone. Low confidence: tyre pricing and the exact year the 12V battery dies are both estimates, and no EX90 has reached 5 years anywhere.

major_items: Two paid scheduled services, now fully out of the free programme: ~NT$12,000
Front discs AND pads ~NT$20,000 - regen braking spares the pads, but lightly-used discs corrode in Taiwan's humidity, so it is usually a disc job not a pad job

Out-of-warranty provision for dampers, bushings, sensors and control modules ~NT$28,000 (raised by this review; Volvo genuine-parts and labour rates on a 2.6-tonne 300萬-class EV, and if this trim turns out to carry air suspension a single strut alone is NT$60,000-80,000 fitted)
Cabin filter, wipers, washer ~NT$6,000
Coolant change and A/C service ~NT$4,400
Brake fluid ~NT$1,600
checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED. Service labour and fluid rates from the official Volvo Cars Taiwan planner (volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/); the brake-corrosion pattern and the out-of-warranty provision are judgement applied to a 7-year, 2.6-tonne luxury EV in Taiwan, not sourced line items. RAISED BY THIS REVIEW from NT$54,000: the previous figure dipped far below the year-5 window and priced out-of-warranty work at NT$15,000, which is unrealistically light for Volvo genuine parts and dealer labour on a 300萬-class car whose vehicle warranty has lapsed. Note what is deliberately ABSENT versus a combustion XC90 in the same window: no oil services (7 of them at ~NT$12,600 each on the official XC90 B5 schedule), no fuel filter, no air filter, no spark plugs, no timing components. The HV battery is still inside its 8-year/160,000 km warranty for this entire window, so no pack risk is priced here.

major_items: SECOND full tyre set, again age-driven ~5 years after the first: ~NT$60,000
Rear discs and pads plus a second front pad set ~NT$25,000
Suspension bushings, dampers, wheel bearings on a 10-year 2.6-tonne SUV ~NT$30,000
HV-PERIPHERAL RISK PROVISION ~NT$30,000: battery warranty (8yr/160,000 km) has EXPIRED - covers DC-DC converter, onboard charger, heat pump, coolant pumps
Two paid scheduled services ~NT$13,000
Second 12V battery ~NT$11,000
Coolant change ~NT$7,000
Brake fluid x2 ~NT$3,200
checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED, and the least certain number in the record. Reviewed and left unchanged. Service and fluid rates from the official Volvo Cars Taiwan planner (volvomsp.volvocartw.com/MaintenanceService/); everything else is judgement applied to a 10-year out-of-warranty luxury EV. The step up from year 7 is driven by the HV battery warranty expiring at year 8 - from that point the owner carries the risk on the high-voltage peripherals. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: replacement of the 92 kWh pack itself. At 70,000 km (~150 full-pack-equivalent cycles) failure probability is low, and were it to happen the cost would exceed the car's residual value, so averaging it into a period cost would distort the model rather than inform it - flagged here instead.

sources.name: Volvo Cars Taiwan - 8 月購車方案
sources.note: Official August 2026 offers, retrieved and read by this review on 2026-08-12. Basis for the small discounts figure: every offer is financing (EX30 0 頭款 / 月付 15,000 起; EC40 and EX40 月付 19,888 / 72 期; XC60, XC90, V60 120萬 40期 0% 利率) or a soft sweetener (1 year 乙式全險, 第 4 年延長保固 on XC90/V60) - no cash discount on any model, and the EX90 does not appear at all because it is still in pre-order. Also the source for the subsidy asymmetry noted in purchase.notes: the 「政府貨物稅減徵及汰舊換新最高 NT$100,000 補助」 line appears only on the combustion/hybrid rows and on none of the BEV rows.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. Consequences baked into the numbers: (1) resale is quoted off LOW-MILEAGE listings, since nearly every real XC40 comp on the market at a given age carries 1.5-3x this mileage; (2) servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven - Volvo's interval is 1 year or 10,000 km whichever comes first, and at 7,000 km/year the clock always wins, so one service per year, 10 over 10 years; (3) consumables that age out rather than wear out (tires, brake fluid, coolant, 12V AGM battery) dominate mid-life cost, while the one mileage-driven item (7-speed DCT wet-clutch oil at ~60,000 km) does not fall due until roughly year 9. POWERTRAIN LABEL CAVEAT: 'hybrid' here means 48V MILD hybrid (Volvo TW markets it as 輕油電; SUM classifies used B-series XC40s as 油電車). It is NOT a full hybrid and NOT a plug-in: it cannot move on electric power at all, its 14.8 km/L NEDC economy and its service schedule are those of a 2.0 turbo petrol car, not of a Toyota-style HEV. Do not read this row as comparable to a full hybrid on running cost. There is NO plug and NO home-charger cost - nothing to install and nothing excluded on that account. Vehicle licence tax (牌照稅) and fuel tax (燃料費) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design throughout. For reference only, U-CAR lists this trim's annual 相關稅費 as 燃6,180 / 牌11,230; the 1,969 c.c. engine sits in a higher licence-tax bracket than the 1.5L T2 it replaced.

purchase.source: CORRECTED from NT$1,690,000. Volvo Taiwan's own MY2026 price announcement (國際富豪汽車, 2026-03-05, carried by UDN 發燒車訊) publishes a table headed 「2026 年式 Volvo 40 全車系建議售價」 whose XC40 block reads verbatim: 「Plus B3 (含 6.6 萬元Plus Pack) 175.6 萬元 / Ultra B4 199 萬元」. I fetched and parsed that page directly. The officially announced 建議售價 for the trim as sold in MY2026 is therefore NT$1,756,000. U-CAR's 新車型錄 spec/trim tables and its 豪華中型小型SUV segment index both show 169 萬 for Plus B3, but that is the bare-body figure U-CAR's spec database carries without the bundled pack - 175.6 - 6.6 = 169 exactly. Since the buyer of a MY2026 Plus B3 pays the announced 175.6 萬, that is list_price here; the gap from the researcher's 169 萬 is 3.9%, above the 3% tolerance. Discount NT$60,000 (~3.4%) is a realistic Volvo TW cash figure. On-road fees NT$65,000 = 領牌規費 ~NT$4,000 + 代辦費 ~NT$11,000 + 配件 (隔熱紙/包膜/行車紀錄器/腳踏墊) ~NT$50,000, scaled to a NT$1.76M imported luxury SUV. real_cost = 1,756,000 - 60,000 + 65,000 = 1,761,000.
purchase.notes:
Powertrain classification: B3/B4/B5 is a 48V mild hybrid. It cannot drive on battery alone, so it is classified as gasoline in this table, the same as every other 48V system here. Only full hybrids that can move the car on battery are 'hybrid'.
PRICE-BASIS TRAP, RESOLVED THE OTHER WAY. Both 169 萬 and 175.6 萬 are real, sourced figures for this trim and both were verified by direct fetch. 169 萬 is the bare trim price in U-CAR's spec database; 175.6 萬 is what Volvo Taiwan itself announces for MY2026, with a NT$66,000 Plus Pack bundled in. Every other line in that official table (EX40 Plus 169 萬, EX40 Ultra 189 萬, EC40 Plus 179 萬, EC40 Ultra 199 萬, XC40 Ultra B4 199 萬) is a plain number; only the XC40 Plus B3 carries the 含 Plus Pack parenthetical, which reads as the pack being standard for this model year rather than optional. A downstream reader who quotes every row of the comparison table as-configured rather than as-announced should use 1,690,000 and a real_cost of 1,695,000. IMPORTANT: the resale figures below were NOT scaled up with the list price. All retention ratios are expressed against the 169 萬 bare body, because bundled option packs recover poorly in the Taiwan used market - so raising list_price raises the buyer's outlay without raising what the car is later worth. Separate trap checked and cleared: the announcement's headline 「169 萬起」 is the EX40 Plus Single motor (the battery-electric sibling), not the XC40; the two figures genuinely coincide. Powertrain confirmed from two fetched sources: Drive-E turbocharged direct-injection petrol, 163hp/27kgm, plus a 48V mild-hybrid system adding 14hp, through a 7-speed DCT (U-CAR lists 七速自手排, 1,969 c.c., 48V輕油電混合). Tax and insurance excluded by design.

Assumes a PRIVATE sale (個人自售), consistent with private_sale_price being the headline resale figure. 過戶 transfer is mostly 規費 plus a modest agent fee. Pre-sale prep is the largest line: a European luxury SUV needs to present well or it drops a whole price tier in a private listing. A dealer trade-in instead would cut these to near zero, but that is already priced in, since dealer_tradein_price sits well below private_sale_price.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED - weakest checkpoint in this record, re-derived and left unchanged. No 1-year-old XC40 is listed on SUM 汽車網 (I re-fetched the full XC40 result set: 16 listings, newest model year 2024). Anchored on the closest real low-mileage Volvo SUV comp, verified by direct fetch of SUM's XC60 result set: a 2024 XC60 2.0 with 11,704 km asking 175.8 萬 車商售價 against a ~239 萬 original list = ~74% dealer-retail retention at 2 years on a genuinely low-mileage car. Walked back one year to ~79-80% dealer-retail retention for a 1-year, 7,000 km XC40 - trimmed slightly because the XC40 is a weaker retainer than the XC60, Volvo TW's volume model - giving ~133-135 萬 dealer asking against the 169 萬 bare list. DEALER-RETAIL TO PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT: SUM prices are 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), never copied across. Private sale set ~12% below at NT$1,180,000; dealer trade-in (車商收購價) a further ~14% below at NT$1,020,000. Year-one depreciation on Taiwan luxury imports is brutal regardless of mileage.

Re-verified against the live SUM 汽車網 XC40 result set and left unchanged. Real same-nameplate comps at exactly this age (2023 cars = 3 years old), all 1,500 c.c. T2 trims, 車商售價: 39,987 km asking 89.8 萬; 43,000 km asking 89.5 萬; 52,811 km asking 86.8 萬; 82,971 km asking 82.8 萬. Against a 142.9 萬 T2 original list (KingAutos 23年式 table) that is 57.9-62.8% dealer-retail retention, and the four points imply roughly -0.16 萬 per 1,000 km in this band. LOW-MILEAGE ADJUSTMENT: our buyer is at 21,000 km, about half the tightest comp, so extrapolating back along that slope and flattening it gives ~65% retention, i.e. ~110 萬 dealer asking on the 169 萬 bare list. The T2-to-B3 uplift is supported by a directly measured same-year, same-mileage pair in the same result set: 2022 XC40 2.0 油電 at 30,000 km asking 93.8 萬 versus 2022 XC40 1.5 at 30,571 km asking 75.9 萬, a +23.6% used premium for the 2.0 mild hybrid, larger than the +18.3% new-price gap - so the ratio method is if anything conservative here. DEALER-RETAIL TO PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT: private sale ~11% below dealer asking at NT$990,000; dealer trade-in a further ~13% below at NT$860,000. Still inside Volvo's 3-year factory warranty, which supports the price.

Re-verified against the live SUM 汽車網 XC40 result set and left unchanged. Best comp is the low-mileage one: 2021 XC40 2.0 油電 (B4), 42,546 km, 4WD, asking 98.0 萬 車商售價. Higher-mileage comps confirm the mileage penalty is real: 2021 2.0 B4 at 95,799 km asking 79.8 萬, and 2021 1.5 at 140,099 km asking 57.8 萬. Denominator caveat: the ~182.9 萬 Plus B4 list used as the ratio base comes from the KingAutos 23年式/24年式 tables, whereas a 2021 car was sold under the earlier Momentum naming and this particular comp is AWD - so the denominator is approximate and the 'B4 Plus' label the previous draft attached to it is not strictly correct. On that base, 98.0/182.9 = 53.6% dealer-retail retention at 5 years. LOW-MILEAGE ADJUSTMENT: our buyer is at 35,000 km, below even the best comp, so retention lifts to ~55%, giving ~93 萬 dealer asking on the 169 萬 bare list. DEALER-RETAIL TO PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT: private sale ~11% below dealer asking at NT$825,000; dealer trade-in a further ~13% below at NT$720,000. Factory warranty has expired, which is what starts pulling the curve down.

CORRECTED DOWN from NT$580,000 / NT$500,000. The comps themselves are real and I re-verified every one against the live SUM 汽車網 XC40 result set - the XC40 launched in Taiwan in 2018, so cars of this exact age do trade here: 2019 XC40 2.0 T5 R-Design, 70,000 km, 4WD, asking 65.8 萬 車商售價; 2019 XC40 2.0, 130,961 km, 4WD, asking 59.8 萬; 2018 XC40 2.0, 81,124 km, 4WD, asking 65.8 萬. Against a ~199 萬 original list for the T5 R-Design that is ~33% dealer-retail retention. LOW-MILEAGE ADJUSTMENT: every real comp at this age carries 70,000-131,000 km versus our buyer's 49,000 km, so retention lifts to ~37%, giving ~62.5 萬 dealer asking on the 169 萬 bare list - unchanged from the previous draft. THE ERROR WAS IN THE LAST STEP: the previous draft then set private_sale_price at NT$580,000, only 7.2% below its own 62.5 萬 dealer-retail anchor, breaking the 8-15% dealer-to-private haircut it applied at every other checkpoint (12%, 11%, 11%, 9%). Re-applying the same ~11% gives NT$555,000, and a further ~13.5% gives a dealer trade-in of NT$480,000. Held to medium, not high: the 2018-2019 T4/T5 original lists (~179-199 萬) are less firmly sourced than the 2023-onward figures, and a 2019 T5 R-Design AWD is a richer trim than a 2026 Plus B3. The year-5-to-year-7 cliff is in the raw comps, not invented - Taiwan buyers price out-of-warranty European repair risk.

EXTRAPOLATED - re-derived and left unchanged. No genuine 10-year XC40 data exists: the XC40 arrived in Taiwan in 2018, so the oldest cars trading are 8 years old and a 10-year-old XC40 will not exist until 2028. Per method, I used the PREDECESSOR-generation Volvo SUV actually trading at that age - the first-generation XC60 (2009-2017) - expressed as a retention ratio of its own original list, then applied that ratio here. Real SUM 汽車網 XC60 comps, all re-fetched and confirmed: 2017, 115,000 km, asking 49.8 萬; 2015, 152,213 km, 32.8 萬; 2015, 167,874 km, 36.8 萬; 2014, 150,000 km, 32.8 萬; 2014, 180,203 km, 28.8 萬; 2015, 241,600 km, 29.8 萬. Against a ~200 萬 first-gen XC60 original list that is ~16-18% at 11-12 years and ~25% at 9 years, which brackets ~20-22% at exactly 10 years for a typical-mileage car. LOW-MILEAGE ADJUSTMENT - the largest single adjustment in this record and the main reason confidence is low: every comp carries 115,000-240,000 km against our buyer's 70,000 km, so retention lifts to ~24%, giving ~40.6 萬 dealer asking on the 169 萬 bare list. DEALER-RETAIL TO PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT: private sale ~9% below at NT$370,000; dealer trade-in a further ~15% below at NT$315,000. Treat as a reasoned band, not a quote: a defensible range is 20-28% retention, moving private_sale_price between roughly NT$310,000 and NT$430,000.

maintenance.plan_notes: MAJOR CORRECTION versus the previous draft: THE FREE-MAINTENANCE PACKAGE HAS BEEN REMOVED. The previous draft zeroed out all three scheduled services in years 0-3 on the strength of Volvo TW's 「3年/3萬公里免費保養套裝」 for the XC40 B3. That programme is real - but I fetched the cited UDN 發燒車訊 article and read its metadata: datePublished 2025-08-18, and the body states 「即日起至9月30日止」, i.e. the offer closed 2025-09-30, eleven months before this record's as-of date. It was a limited-time campaign tied to a low-monthly-payment finance promotion, not a standing programme. Volvo Taiwan's own MY2026 lineup announcement (2026-03-05) advertises no XC40 giveaway at all - its only sweetener is for the XC60 (120 萬 40期零利率 plus one year 乙式全險 plus a fourth-year warranty extension). Years 1 and 3 are therefore priced with owner-paid annual servicing, which raises them from NT$3,000/NT$12,000 to NT$12,000/NT$32,000. If a comparable campaign is running when the buyer actually signs, deduct roughly NT$33,000 across those two windows. SERVICE INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: Volvo's interval is 1 year or 10,000 km whichever comes first; at 7,000 km/year the calendar always triggers first, so exactly one scheduled service per year, 10 over 10 years, and no mileage-triggered service ever lands early. CONSUMABLES ARE PLACED BY AGE, NOT MILEAGE, because at this mileage age is what kills them: tires at ~5-6 years, brake fluid every 2 years, coolant ~year 6, 12V AGM battery ~4-6 years and again near year 10. The one genuinely mileage-driven item, the 7-speed DCT wet-clutch oil service at ~60,000 km, does NOT come due until roughly year 9 at this rate, so it sits in the 7-10y window. TIRE SIZE CORRECTED: U-CAR's fetched spec table gives the Plus B3 235/55 R18 - it is the Ultra B4 that runs 235/50 R19. The previous draft costed 19-inch rubber for this trim, so both tire lines are reduced (NT$32,000 to NT$26,000 at year 5; NT$34,000 to NT$28,000 at year 10). OUT-OF-WARRANTY RISK is explicitly provisioned in the 5-7y and 7-10y windows (NT$25,000 and NT$43,000): a European turbo with a 48V mild-hybrid ISG, water pump, thermostat and A/C compressor that all become owner-paid. CONFIDENCE CAVEAT: volvocars.com/tw returns HTTP 403 and Mobile01 owner-receipt threads were unreachable, so no official scheduled-maintenance price table or real receipts back the per-service figures. They are a calibrated estimate from Volvo TW dealer-level service pricing norms for a 2.0L mild hybrid, and every checkpoint is marked low confidence to say so. The interval, the tire size, the powertrain and the expiry of the free-maintenance campaign ARE sourced; the per-service prices are not.

checkpoints.source: CORRECTED from NT$3,000. The previous draft billed NT$0 for this service under Volvo TW's 「3年/3萬公里免費保養套裝」. I fetched that UDN 發燒車訊 article: it is dated 2025-08-18 and its own text limits the offer to 「即日起至9月30日止」 (2025-09-30). It cannot be applied to a car bought on 2026-08-12, and the MY2026 lineup announcement offers no XC40 replacement. Priced instead as one owner-paid annual service for a 2.0 mild hybrid at Volvo TW dealer rates plus consumables. Time-driven annual interval, not mileage-driven - 7,000 km never reaches the 10,000 km trigger. Low confidence: no official Volvo TW service price table was reachable (403).

checkpoints.source: CORRECTED from NT$12,000, same reason as year 1: the free-maintenance campaign this window relied on closed on 2025-09-30 per the fetched article's own text and publication date. Two owner-paid annual services at Volvo TW dealer rates, plus the age-driven consumables that fall in a 1-3y window - notably the first brake-fluid change, which the previous draft omitted from this window even though it applied a 2-year interval everywhere else. Interval is time-driven: at 7,000 km/year the buyer reaches only 21,000 km by year 3. Low confidence on the per-service prices; the interval itself is sourced.

first tire replacement, set of 4 in 235/55 R18 - AGE-driven at 5-6 years, not worn out at 35,000 km (~NT$26,000)

checkpoints.source: REDUCED from NT$79,000. The tire line was costed as 19-inch rubber; U-CAR's fetched spec table shows the Plus B3 wears 235/55 R18 (the 19-inch 235/50 R19 belongs to the Ultra B4), so the set of 4 drops from ~NT$32,000 to ~NT$26,000. Everything else stands. This is the first window with the factory warranty gone and the first age-driven tire replacement, which is why the cost steps up sharply. Tires are replaced on AGE: 35,000 km leaves plenty of tread, but 5-6 year old rubber gets changed regardless. The AGM battery is specified because the 48V mild-hybrid start-stop system is much harder on the 12V battery than a conventional car. Built from Volvo TW dealer service pricing norms; official price table unreachable (403), hence low confidence.

spark plugs - turbo petrol 4-cylinder (~NT$8,000)
coolant change, ~year 6 (~NT$5,000)

OUT-OF-WARRANTY RISK PROVISION ~NT$25,000 - 48V ISG belt/starter-generator, thermostat, sensors, suspension bushings
checkpoints.source: Unchanged - reviewed and found sound. First window carrying an explicit out-of-warranty risk provision: the 3-year factory warranty is long gone and this is a European turbo with a 48V mild-hybrid ISG whose belt and starter-generator are known owner-paid items. Spark plugs and coolant are placed here on age/interval rather than mileage. The DCT oil service is deliberately NOT in this window - at 7,000 km/year the car has reached only 49,000 km and the ~60,000 km trigger falls in the next period. Built from Volvo TW dealer service pricing norms; official table and Mobile01 owner receipts both unreachable (403), hence low confidence.

major_items: 3 annual scheduled services (~NT$12,500 each)
7-speed DCT wet-clutch oil and filter service at ~60,000 km - the one MILEAGE-driven item, due ~year 9 at this rate (~NT$16,000)
second tire replacement, set of 4 in 235/55 R18 - again AGE-driven (~NT$28,000)
shock absorbers and suspension bushings at 10 years (~NT$30,000)
front brake pads and discs (~NT$14,000)
second 12V AGM battery (~NT$9,500)
brake fluid x2 (~NT$7,000)
OUT-OF-WARRANTY RISK PROVISION ~NT$43,000 - water pump, A/C compressor, oil leaks, 48V system, sensors
checkpoints.source: Held at NT$185,000, with the tire line corrected from 19-inch to the Plus B3's actual 235/55 R18 (NT$34,000 down to NT$28,000) and the risk provision trimmed to NT$43,000 so the itemised lines sum to the stated total. Most expensive window by a wide margin, and the reason is structural rather than mileage: three services, a second age-driven tire set, a 10-year suspension refresh, and the largest out-of-warranty provision in the record. The DCT oil service finally lands here - 60,000 km is not reached until roughly year 9 at 7,000 km/year, so this low-mileage buyer defers it out of the 5-7y window entirely. Total 10-year maintenance across all five checkpoints is NT$387,000, about NT$38,700/year, which is what a Volvo in Taiwan costs when NO free-servicing campaign applies. Built from Volvo TW dealer service pricing norms; no official table or owner receipts reachable (403), hence low confidence.
