checkpoints.source: FIRST FULLY UNSUBSIDISED PERIOD under every reading of the warranty term, so this figure carries the true cost. Adds the scheduled big-ticket items that fall around year 6-7 (spark plugs, dual-clutch transmission oil and filter, coolant) plus rear brakes, and an explicit NT$28,000 expected-value allowance for the failure modes this EA211-family engine is known for in Taiwan: thermostat housing, electric water pump and ignition coils. That allowance is an expected value across owners, not a certainty for any one car. Sits essentially level with the Q5's NT$100,000 for the same window. Estimated from Audi TW dealer norms; Mobile01 owner-receipt threads returned HTTP 403 and could not be used.

checkpoints.source: The heaviest period and the one that separates a German SUV from a Japanese one at this age. Three annual services at rising rates, a second set of tyres (the year-5 set ages out again on the calendar, not on tread), front discs and pads, a second 12V battery, and two age-driven blocks: suspension dampers and bushings, and a repeat of the fluid services. The Q3-specific line is the 48V allowance — the 48V lithium battery and belt starter-generator are failure items unique to this powertrain and expensive outside warranty; NT$28,000 is an expected value, not a guaranteed bill, and it is the one figure that would drop out if the Taiwan car turns out to lack the 48V hardware. Deliberately NOT included: air suspension, which the Q3 does not offer. REBASED DOWN from the prior draft's NT$250,000, which put this smaller Audi 47% above the larger Q5's NT$170,000 for the identical window at the identical labour rate. Ten-year total NT$392,000, about 1.6x the Toyota RAV4 and 1.45x the Lexus NX in this table. All figures estimated; no Audi TW price table or owner-receipt thread was retrievable.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far under the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000). Because mileage is so low, servicing is TIME-driven (annual visits, 2-year brake-fluid interval, tires ageing out at 5-6 years) rather than mileage-driven, and consumables are replaced on calendar age, not wear. Used-value quotes are taken from LOW-MILEAGE listings, which sit above the mileage-blind average. Tax and insurance are excluded by design (TW BEVs currently pay NT$0 牌照稅 and NT$0 燃料稅 anyway, per the Yahoo autos trim page). Home-charger installation is NOT counted as maintenance and is NOT in real_cost: a 220V/32A wallbox plus conduit and 社區管委會 approval typically runs NT$40,000-80,000 in Taiwan and is a one-off ownership cost the buyer should budget separately. Electricity/charging cost is also excluded, consistent with fuel being excluded for combustion cars in this table. SECOND FACT-CHECK PASS (2026-08-12): a cross-model review flagged this record for holding value too well at 3y/5y and for a 10-year maintenance total that exceeded its own combustion siblings. Both were re-researched from scratch. The whole retention curve was re-derived downward and the maintenance schedule was rebuilt from an EV-only basis (10-year total cut from NT$576,000 to NT$353,000). List price and purchase terms were re-confirmed unchanged. See value_checkpoints sources and maintenance.plan_notes for the evidence.

purchase.source: List price RE-CONFIRMED on the second pass by direct fetch of the Yahoo autos 2026 model page (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/new-cars/model/audi-q4-e-tron-2026), which renders exactly two trims: '45 Advanced進化版 219萬, 563km, 286hp/55.6kgm' and '55 quattro S-Line運動版 240萬, 541km, 340hp'. NT$2,190,000 CONFIRMED — no change. The 2025 model-year page shows the identical 219萬/240萬 pair (verified on the first pass), so there was no 2026 price move; the 2024 facelift launched at 209萬. The 8891 SPA page (c.8891.com.tw) still returns no price text to a fetcher and was not used. audi.com.tw returned HTTP 503 again on this pass, so no official Audi TW page could be read.
purchase.notes: BEV, 82 kWh usable pack, rear-wheel drive, 286 hp / 55.6 kgm, 563 km claimed range, 2,109 kg, CCS2, 135/175 kW DC charging. Full battery-electric, not a mild hybrid of any kind — correctly classified 'bev'. DISCOUNT UNCHANGED at NT$170,000 (7.8%) — the reviewer did not object to it and the second pass found nothing to move it. The supporting evidence in fact strengthened: the Q4 e-tron still has the thinnest used footprint of any Audi in Taiwan (5 cars nationwide against 4 e-tron and 10 e-tron Sportback), it sits on the ageing MEB platform while Audi's own PPE-based Q6 e-tron is already positioned above it, and the predecessor e-tron's used prices (re-checked this pass, see the 3y/5y sources) show how hard the Taiwanese market marks down an Audi BEV once it is superseded. 7.8% is a deliberately mid-band figure — Audi TW is less cash-aggressive than Mercedes TW — and remains an estimate, not a quoted 菜單. Non-cash gifts (charging credit, insurance subsidy, accessories) are NOT counted as cash discount. ON-ROAD FEES (NT$70,000), unchanged and itemised: 領牌/新領牌照登記費 ~NT$6,000 + 代辦費 ~NT$10,000 + 配件 ~NT$54,000 (heat-rejection film across a large glazed area, partial PPF, floor and boot mats, dash cam, coating), scaled to a 219萬 luxury SUV. Tax and insurance excluded by design. real_cost = 2,190,000 - 170,000 + 70,000 = 2,090,000.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN on the second fact-check pass, from NT$1,490,000 (71.3% of real_cost) to NT$1,420,000 (67.9%). Anchored on the four REAL same-trim listings on 8891 中古車 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q4-e-tron), re-fetched 2026-08-12: Q4 e-tron 45 advanced進化版, all 出廠年 2024 (~2 years old) — 1.1萬km NT$1,580,000 (台北), 1.3萬km NT$1,480,000 (台中), 1.5萬km NT$1,580,000 (台北), 1.8萬km NT$1,438,000 (台北); mean dealer asking ~NT$1,520,000. These are 車商售價 (dealer retail asking), NOT what an owner receives, and none was copied into private_sale_price. HAIRCUT WIDENED to ~23% (dealer retail -> 自售), giving ~NT$1,160,000 private at year 2, for three stacked reasons found on this pass: (a) this fetch of the rendered listing page reports ALL FIVE Q4 e-trons as 原廠認證 CPO — the first pass had read only one as CPO from the RSC payload — and a CPO car carries an inspection-plus-warranty premium of roughly 6-10% in TW that a private seller structurally cannot charge; (b) the usual 8-15% 車商售價 -> 自售 gap applies on top; (c) with 5 cars nationwide the asking prices are aspirational and sticky, demonstrated directly by the predecessor e-tron Sportback where a 5-year-old car and a 3-year-old car both ask exactly NT$1,488,000. Year 1 is set one year back from that year-2 anchor. WHY THE OLD FIGURE WAS WRONG: 71.3% first-year retention put this BEV above the Q5 TFSI and level with the Q3 — the same violation the reviewer identified at 3 years, one year earlier. A German BEV must be the weakest retainer in its own lineup at every age. Low-mileage listings quoted deliberately because this buyer covers only 7,000 km/year. dealer_tradein_price is 13% below private sale.

REVISED DOWN on the second fact-check pass, from NT$1,130,000 (54.1% of real_cost) to NT$950,000 (45.5%), which is inside the 44-48% band the review called for and below the Q5 TFSI at the same age. Two independent lines of evidence, both re-fetched 2026-08-12. (1) FORWARD FROM THE CAR'S OWN LISTINGS: the four verified 45 advanced listings (出廠年 2024, dealer asking NT$1,438,000-1,580,000 at ~2 years, https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q4-e-tron) cut ~23% for CPO-dealer-retail -> 自售 give ~NT$1,160,000 private at year 2, then ~-18% for year 3. (2) PREDECESSOR AT A GENUINE 3 YEARS — this is the finding that forced the revision and the first pass missed it entirely: https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/e-tron-sportback now lists 出廠年 2023 cars, i.e. actually 3 years old. 55 quattro S line asks NT$1,478,000 against a 2023 list of NT$3,570,000 (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/new-cars/model/audi-e-tron-sportback-2023); on an acquired-cost basis (~NT$3,480,000) with a -15% private haircut that is ~36.1% retention AT THREE YEARS. The 2023 50 quattro S line at NT$1,238,000 against a 3,180,000 list works out at ~33.9%. A three-year-old Audi BEV in Taiwan therefore trades in the mid-30s. The Q4 is deliberately placed well ABOVE that (45.5%) because the predecessor was a NT$3.1-3.6M flagship whose ~350 km real-world range is exactly why it collapsed, and because cheaper cars retain a higher percentage — but 54% was indefensible against this evidence. maintenance.plan_notes: REBUILT FROM AN EV-ONLY BASIS on the second fact-check pass. The 10-year total falls from NT$576,000 to NT$353,000. The review was right that the old total was the wrong shape: it exceeded this car's own combustion siblings, which cannot be true of a drivetrain with no engine oil, no spark plugs, no coil packs, no DPF, no timing service and no DSG fluid. WHAT WAS ACTUALLY WRONG — the schedule contained no mis-filed ICE line items (checked item by item: no oil service, no plugs, no DSG/transmission fluid, no exhaust work appeared anywhere), so the error was not contamination but PROVISIONING. Three specific faults, all corrected: (1) the year 5-7 line replaced front AND rear discs and pads at 49,000 km for NT$62,000 — but regenerative braking is the whole point, pads barely wear, and the realistic condition-based job on a garaged car is front discs and pads only, NT$32,000; (2) the out-of-warranty risk provisions (electric coolant pump, HV heater, DC-DC converter, AC compressor/heat pump) totalled NT$97,000 across the last two periods, priced near certainty rather than probability-weighted, and are now NT$29,000 combined; (3) the year 7-10 suspension and ageing-parts lines assumed a full overhaul rather than a refresh. The corrected total sits ~10% below the Q3's combustion figure and ~35% below the Q5's, which is the right ordering for a compact MEB BEV, while still being roughly twice what a Japanese SUV of the same size would cost at this mileage — German dealer labour rates, 20-inch tires on a 2,109 kg car, and genuine high-voltage risk after year 8 all stay in. SCHEDULE SHAPE: at 7,000 km/year the plan is entirely TIME-driven, not mileage-driven — the car never reaches a mileage-based service trigger inside 10 years, so cost is one dealer visit per year plus calendar-aged consumables (brake fluid every 2 years, coolant, cabin filter, wipers, tires ageing out at 5-6 years, 12V AGM battery every ~4-5 years). WARRANTY: 原廠新車保固 5年／10萬公里 plus 電池保固 8年／16萬公里 — verified in the dealer description of a real Q4 e-tron 45 listing on 8891, item id 4747269, subtitle text 'Q4 e-tron 45/原廠新車保固5年10萬公里 電池保固8年16萬公里' (https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q4-e-tron). That is a repair warranty, NOT a prepaid service package — no evidence of a bundled free-servicing plan was found, so years 1-5 still carry full dealer labour for scheduled work and consumables; what the warranty removes is unscheduled repair cost. Periods 7 and 10 carry the full unsubsidised out-of-warranty burden. BEV-SPECIFIC COSTS THAT REMAIN REAL: at 2,109 kg the car eats 20-inch tires, brake discs corrode from disuse under regen and get replaced on condition rather than wear, the 12V AGM battery still dies on schedule, and MEB's electric coolant pump, high-voltage heater and electric AC compressor (which also cools the pack) are known out-of-warranty risk items. NOTE: this trim rides on conventional steel springs — there is NO air suspension on the 45 advanced, so no air-strut replacement is included. Home-charger installation is excluded from maintenance by design (see assumptions.notes). SOURCING HONESTY: amounts are Audi Taiwan authorised-dealer pricing estimates built from published TW dealer labour rates and parts norms, not from a published Audi TW service-price table — audi.com.tw returned HTTP 503 again on this second pass (https://www.audi.com.tw/tw/web/zh/service-and-accessories.html) and Mobile01 blocks automated access, so no owner receipts or official price list could be obtained on either pass. Treat the absolute amounts as modelled, not quoted; every checkpoint stays 'low' for that reason.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use the 7,000 km/year midpoint, so assumed_km = 7000 x years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Consequence 1: servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven — the owner never reaches Audi's 10,000 km step inside a year, so visits are annual and the car takes about ten visits to cover 70,000 km. Consequence 2: mileage-triggered big-ticket items land LATE — the automatic transmission fluid + Sealing Plug service is tied to 60,000 km in Audi Taiwan's official service matrix, which at 7,000 km/year arrives around year 8.6, i.e. inside the 7-10 window rather than the 5-7 one. Consequence 3: tires age out rather than wear out, so they are replaced on rubber age (~5-6 years), not on tread depth. Consequence 4: used values are read off LOW-MILEAGE listings, which sell materially above the mileage-blind median — the MY2023 Q5 listing set shows a 76,000 km car asking 1,005,000 against a 14,000 km car asking 1,558,000, a spread driven by mileage alone. Vehicle licence tax (牌照稅), fuel tax (燃料費) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design and appear nowhere in this record. POWERTRAIN: this car carries Audi's 48V MHEV Plus mild-hybrid system (belt-driven starter-generator plus a small 48V lithium battery). It cannot move the car on electricity alone, so it is classified 'gasoline', not 'hybrid'. TRIM POSITION: the advanced 進化版 is the front-wheel-drive entry car — Audi Taiwan's first FWD Q5 — while quattro starts higher up the range. FWD is a resale negative in the Taiwan used German-SUV market and there is no historical FWD Q5 resale record to measure it against, so a judgement penalty of ~4-5% is applied at each checkpoint and flagged as judgement.

purchase.source: LIST PRICE CORRECTED BACK TO 2,400,000 — see notes. Chain of evidence: (1) the October 2025 LAUNCH table for the all-new Q5, fetched directly from 8891 新車頻道 (https://c.8891.com.tw/news/audi/q5/20805) and independently from 7Car (https://www.7car.tw/articles/read/113533), both printing 'Q5 TFSI 150 kW advanced 進化版 = 2,300,000', 'Q5 Sportback advanced = 2,410,000', 'Q5 TFSI quattro 150 kW S line 運動版 = 2,700,000', 'Q5 Sportback S line = 2,810,000', SQ5 3,829,000 / 3,939,000, SQ5 Edition One 3,415,000 / 3,525,000, launch 2025-10-02; (2) TVBS Auto, 2026-07-16 (https://news.tvbs.com.tw/cars/3259163), fetched directly, reporting Audi Taiwan's 2026 model-year adjustment verbatim: '包含A5、A5 Avant、A6 Sportback e-tron、A6 Avant e-tron、Q5、Q5 Sportback等多數車型均較舊年式調漲10萬元' and 'Q5及Q5 Sportback另新增TFSI quattro 150kW進化版車型，開價分別為257萬元、268萬元'. 2,300,000 + 100,000 = 2,400,000 for the model year on sale today. This is a DERIVED figure, honestly labelled: TVBS prints no per-trim table naming the entry FWD car's new number, and audi.com.tw returns HTTP 503 to every automated fetch. Coherence cross-check supports it — the MY2026 ladder 2,400,000 (FWD advanced) / 2,570,000 (new quattro advanced) / 2,800,000 (quattro S line) gives sensible 170,000 and 230,000 steps, whereas holding the entry car at 2,300,000 would leave an implausible 270,000 gap to the new quattro variant directly above it. Discount and on-road fees are my own estimates (see notes), not published figures.
purchase.notes: THE RESEARCHER'S 'CORRECTION' WAS ITSELF THE ERROR. The prior pass overrode the scout's NT$2,400,000 down to NT$2,300,000, asserting the scout had misread the Q5 SPORTBACK row. That reasoning fails twice. First, the Sportback advanced lists at 2,410,000, not 2,400,000, so it is not a clean match for the scout's figure. Second and decisively, 2,300,000 is the OCTOBER 2025 LAUNCH (MY2025) price, and Audi Taiwan raised Q5 and Q5 Sportback prices by 100,000 for the 2026 model year in July 2026 (TVBS, 2026-07-16). This record carries model_year 2026 and is dated 2026-08-12, so the price of the model year actually on sale is 2,400,000. The prior pass even flagged this exact risk in its own open questions ('I could not confirm whether Audi Taiwan has adjusted the Q5 price since the October 2025 launch') and then resolved it the wrong way. POWERTRAIN: 2.0 TFSI four-cylinder turbo, 150 kW / 204 hp, 34.6-34.7 kgm, with Audi's 48V MHEV Plus system fitted across the whole Q5 range. This is a MILD hybrid — a belt-driven starter-generator plus a small 48V lithium battery that assist, restart and coast, but CANNOT drive the car on electricity alone. It is therefore classified 'gasoline' for this table, not 'hybrid'. DRIVETRAIN: the advanced 進化版 is front-wheel drive, headlined by KingAutos as '同級唯一前驅'; quattro begins with the new TFSI quattro 150 kW 進化版 (2,570,000) and the S line 運動版. DISCOUNT (NT$80,000, 3.3%): reduced from the prior pass's NT$100,000 because that figure was set against the 2,300,000 launch car. The MY2026 price list landed only in July 2026, so the car on the floor today is a fresh model year with no run-out pressure behind it. Audi Taiwan's published campaigns lead with a 5-year factory warranty and a first-two-years NT$9,999/month finance scheme rather than headline cash off, and 8891 notes that cash buyers who forgo the finance subsidy can negotiate an unpublished '隱藏版現金折扣'. NT$80,000 is a conservative achievable cash-buyer figure on a fresh model year. ON-ROAD FEES (NT$60,000): 領牌規費 ~NT$3,500 (new registration and plates) + 代辦費 ~NT$11,000 + dealer accessory package ~NT$45,000 (window film, dashcam, mats and boot tray, paint coating). The accessory line scales with class and is the bulk of the number on a NT$2.4m SUV. These are estimates from typical Taiwan luxury-SUV purchase quotes; no verbatim published 菜單 for this trim could be retrieved. Vehicle licence tax, fuel tax and insurance are excluded by design. real_cost = 2,400,000 - 80,000 + 60,000 = 2,380,000.

Pre-sale preparation sits at the upper end of the normal range because a German luxury SUV is judged on paint and interior condition and a proper polish and detail measurably protects the asking price. Listing fees cover a paid slot on 8891 or SUM for the weeks needed to move a car in this price band. Total NT$12,000 sits mid-range for the class (typical band 6,000-15,000). If the owner trades in to a dealer instead, these costs largely disappear but the proceeds drop to dealer_tradein_price, which is why both figures are carried. Reviewed this pass and left unchanged — the breakdown sums correctly (2,500 + 7,500 + 2,000 = 12,000) and sits inside the expected band.

value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED UPWARD, and now built on genuine current-generation evidence the prior pass said did not exist. 8891 中古車 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q5, fetched directly this pass) carries two real B10 listings: MY2025 'TFSI quattro 150kW S line' @ 2,000 km = 2,280,000 and @ 2,360 km = 2,280,000, both 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking). Against that trim's 2,700,000 launch list that is 84.4% dealer-retail retention at roughly ten months. Those are near-delivery-mileage cars, so a genuine 1-year / 7,000 km example sits a step below — I take ~81% — and the FWD entry trim carries a further ~4% penalty for weaker used demand, giving DEALER RETAIL 1,870,000 (78% of the 2,400,000 list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (the dealer-retail trap): private sale = dealer retail -11% => 1,660,000; dealer trade-in = private -13% => 1,440,000. Cross-check: 1,660,000 is 69.7% of real_cost, i.e. a ~30% first-year loss, which is the German shape and sits at the steep end of the 20-30% Taiwan first-year band rather than the Toyota-like high-70s the prior pass's method would have implied for a fresh generation. Low-mileage basis: 7,000 km is far under the ~16,000 km median of comparable 1-2 year listings, which supports the upper half of the range.

CORRECTED UPWARD — the prior pass claimed a low-mileage read and then did not perform it. Predecessor-generation (B9) proxy, trim-matched. 8891 中古車 (fetched this pass) lists a MY2023 '40 TFSI quattro advanced' @ 6,100 km = 1,380,000, the same car carbook.tw (https://carbook.tw/cars/audi-q5/2023, n=23, fetched this pass) shows at 6,000 km = 1,380,000. The same page shows 76,000 km => 1,005,000, 45,000 km => 1,229,000, 36,000-37,000 km => 1,238,000-1,288,000, 30,000 km => 1,230,000 and 14,000 km => 1,558,000, with a blended median of 1,229,000 at 45,000 km — and 8891 shows the mid-mileage cars are mostly the lower 'Technik' trim, which is why the trim-matched 6,100 km advanced point is the right anchor. Our buyer sits at 21,000 km, about 15,000 km above that anchor; at the ~0.4% per 1,000 km slope implied by the same listing set that is about -6%, giving a B9 advanced at 3 years / 21,000 km of ~1,300,000, i.e. 57.8% of the B9 advanced's ~2,250,000 list. Applying that ratio to this car's 2,400,000 list and taking a further ~4% off for the FWD entry trim gives DEALER RETAIL 1,330,000 (55% of list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale = dealer retail -11% => 1,190,000; dealer trade-in = private -13.5% => 1,030,000. Note on the correction: the prior pass wrote that it read retail 'off the low-mileage end rather than the median' and cited 14,000 km => 1,558,000, then stated a retail of 1,200,000 — which is BELOW the 1,229,000 median it was supposedly reading above. The stated method did not produce the stated number.

Predecessor-generation (B9) proxy, corrected for the same self-contradiction as year 3. carbook.tw (https://carbook.tw/cars/audi-q5, fetched this pass) gives MY2021 Q5 median dealer asking 958,000 at 67,000 km (n=13) and MY2022 1,093,000 at 72,000 km (n=22); 8891 corroborates with MY2021 45 TFSI quattro @ 48,000 km = 958,000, @ 61,600 km = 979,000, @ 62,700 km = 979,000 and @ 110,000 km = 875,000. The MY2021 sample is 45 TFSI quattro, whose list was ~2,590,000, so the median is 37.0% retention. Our buyer carries 35,000 km against that 67,000 km median; at the ~0.4% per 1,000 km slope measured on the MY2023 listing set that is a ~12% low-mileage uplift, lifting retention to ~41.4%. Applied to this car's 2,400,000 list and reduced ~4% for the FWD entry trim, DEALER RETAIL 950,000 (40% of list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale = dealer retail -12% => 840,000; dealer trade-in = private -14% => 720,000. Cross-check: 840,000 is 35.3% of real_cost, i.e. cumulative five-year depreciation near 65%, consistent with Taiwan guidance putting luxury brands near 60% at five years and German marques steeper. The 5-year factory warranty expires right at this point and the used market prices that in. Correction note: the prior pass said it applied '~15% low-mileage uplift then ~5% FWD penalty' to the 958,000 median — arithmetic that yields ~1,046,000 — but then stated a retail of 920,000, below the raw median.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation — the B10 is under a year old and has no genuine 7-year data. Method: take real B9 used prices at that age, express them as a retention ratio of that car's own original list, then apply the ratio to this car. carbook.tw MY2019 Q5 (7 years old in Aug 2026) median dealer asking 728,000 at 50,000 km (n=5); 8891 corroborates with a MY2019 45 TFSI quattro Active Plus @ 50,000 km = 768,000. Median mileage matches this buyer's 49,000 km almost exactly, so NO mileage adjustment is applied. Against that trim's ~2,590,000 original list the two points give 28.1% and 29.7% retention; I take ~28.9%. Applied to this car's 2,400,000 list and reduced ~5% for the FWD entry trim gives DEALER RETAIL 660,000 (27.5% of list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale = dealer retail -12% => 580,000; dealer trade-in = private -16% => 485,000 (a wider trade-in spread than the 10-15% norm, because dealers price reconditioning risk harder on an out-of-warranty German SUV). The car is two years out of warranty here and the market discounts repair risk, so the tail keeps falling rather than flattening. Small sample (n=5) at the anchor year — hence low confidence.

EXTRAPOLATED across two generations — no B10 or even late-B9 data exists at this age. This is the weakest checkpoint in the record. carbook.tw MY2016 Q5 (10 years old in Aug 2026) median dealer asking 438,000 at 92,000 km (n=5), corroborated exactly by 8891's MY2016 40 TFSI quattro @ 92,100 km = 438,000; surrounding years: MY2017 median 525,000 at 120,000 km (n=19), MY2015 383,000 at 130,000 km (n=12). MY2016 is the outgoing B8, whose 2.0 TFSI quattro listed around 2,390,000, giving 18.3% retention at the sample's 92,000 km. This buyer's 70,000 km is 22,000 km under that, worth about a 9% uplift on the same slope, lifting retention to ~20.0% and giving 479,000 on this car's 2,400,000 list. I then take that back down twice: ~8% because the B10 carries materially more electronics than a B8 (48V MHEV Plus, its lithium battery, the belt starter-generator), which a 10-year-old market discounts as future repair liability rather than rewarding as content, and ~4% for the FWD entry trim. Net DEALER RETAIL 425,000 (~18% of list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale = dealer retail -13% => 370,000; dealer trade-in = private -18% => 305,000 (dealers barely want a 10-year-old out-of-warranty Audi except as trade fodder). The curve does not flatten into the tail: 580,000 at year 7 to 370,000 at year 10 is a further 36% over three years, which is the correct out-of-warranty German shape.

maintenance.plan_notes: BASIS — VERIFIED THIS PASS. Audi Taiwan publishes an official transparent scheduled-maintenance price table at https://service-pricing.audi-service.com.tw/ and I pulled its underlying JSON endpoints directly (/api/v1.0/pricing, 175 rows; /api/v1.0/service-matrix). The prior pass's quoted figures were re-checked row by row against the live API and are EXACTLY correct: 2021 Audi Q5 45 TFSI quattro (Petrol) returns 10,000 km [11,000-12,000]; 20,000 km [19,000-20,000]; 30,000 km [13,400-14,400]; 40,000 km [19,000-20,000]; 50,000 km [11,000-12,000]; 60,000 km [39,100-40,100]; 70,000 km [11,000-12,000]; 80,000 km [19,000-20,000]; 90,000 km [13,400-14,400]; 100,000 km [19,000-20,000]; 110,000 km [11,000-12,000]; 120,000 km [56,700-57,700] — a midpoint sum of NT$248,600 of scheduled servicing alone across 120,000 km. The official service matrix was likewise verified verbatim for Petrol: 原廠引擎機油, 機油濾清器, 華司與油封 and 粉塵濾清器 at every 10,000 km step; 煞車油 and 火星塞 every second step (20,000 km); 空氣濾清器 every third (30,000 km); 自動變速箱油 and Sealing Plug at 60,000 and 120,000 km only; V 型皮帶/綜合皮帶 and 皮帶調整器 at 120,000 km only. CAVEAT ADDED THIS PASS: the table's Q5 rows stop at model year 2022 — there is NO row for the B10, so every figure below carries a judgement uplift of roughly 15-25% for the B10's added complexity (MHEV Plus 48V hardware, more electronics) and 2026+ dealer labour rates. That uplift is unsourced, which is why the year-1 and year-3 checkpoints are marked medium rather than high. Worth noting as an upper bound: the same API's 2022 Q5 45 TFSI quattro Premium Plus row runs roughly three times the 2021 row (10,000 km [34,000-35,000], 60,000 km [106,800-107,800]); I did not build on it because its scope is unclear, but it shows the downside risk is on the expensive side, not the cheap side. INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: at 7,000 km/year the owner never reaches the 10,000 km step inside a year, so servicing is annual and the car takes about ten visits (1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 3) to reach 70,000 km. Brake fluid therefore falls due on its 2-year time limit, spark plugs on their ~4-year limit, and the 60,000 km transmission-fluid service arrives around year 8.6 rather than year 6, landing in the 7-10 window. WARRANTY: 8891 (https://c.8891.com.tw/news/21771, fetched this pass) confirms the Q5 is sold with 5年原廠保固 alongside a first-two-years NT$9,999/month finance scheme, and that the 5年10萬公里免費保養 benefit applies ONLY to the e-tron range, not the Q5 — so the owner pays every service from year 1. Note that article is dated 2026-05-08 and its campaign window closed 2026-05-31, so treat the warranty term as the recurring structure of Audi Taiwan's campaigns rather than a live quote. Years 1-5 therefore carry scheduled servicing and wear items only; from year 5 the car is unsubsidised and the 5-7 and 7-10 periods carry the full out-of-warranty repair burden, which is where cost concentrates. CONSUMABLES are placed on age, not tread: tires roughly every 5-6 years (a set of four fitted ~NT$38,000-40,000 on 19-inch 235/55 R19), front brakes around year 6-7 and rears around year 9-10 (large discs, dealer prices), 12V AGM battery about every 5 years. LATER-PERIOD RISK ITEMS in years 7-10: the EA888's well-known water pump and thermostat housing, coil packs, the 48V lithium battery and belt-driven starter-generator, plus suspension bushings. TOTAL ~NT$547,000 over 10 years / 70,000 km (~NT$54,700 per year, ~NT$7.8 per km) — several times a comparable Japanese SUV over the same period, which is the correct shape for a German luxury SUV serviced at a main dealer.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr (~7,000 km/yr midpoint), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Checkpoint mileage = 7,000 x years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Three consequences shape this record. (1) EVERYTHING IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. Audi Taiwan's vehicle warranty is 5 years OR 100,000 km and the high-voltage battery warranty is 8 years OR 160,000 km (>=70% capacity retained) — both confirmed by direct fetch. At 7,000 km/yr this car reaches only 35,000 km at year 5 and 70,000 km at year 10, so it never gets near either km cap: both warranties expire on the CALENDAR, and every service, brake-fluid change, coolant change and tyre replacement is triggered by age rather than wear. (2) RESALE IS QUOTED AGAINST LOW-MILEAGE LISTINGS. The used comparables used below are deliberately the lowest-mileage Q6 e-tron examples on the market (9,000 km and 14,400 km), which sit above the mileage-blind 行情 average. (3) HOME CHARGER IS EXCLUDED. A wallbox plus installation in a Taiwanese apartment building runs roughly NT$40,000-100,000 once the 社區管委會 application, the dedicated meter and the cable run are paid for. It is a real one-off ownership cost but it is NOT maintenance, so it appears in neither purchase nor maintenance here. Electricity, 牌照稅/燃料費 (both NT$0 for a BEV in Taiwan anyway) and insurance are excluded by design.

purchase.source: LIST PRICE INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED AND CONFIRMED CORRECT AT 2,760,000. I fetched the Yahoo Autos MY2026 price-adjustment article dated 2026-07-17 (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/%E8%A3%9C%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%BB%E5%8B%95%E5%BC%8F%E8%BB%8A%E9%81%93%E7%B6%AD%E6%8C%81%E6%A9%9F%E8%83%BD%EF%BC%8Caudi-q6-e-tron%E3%80%81a6-e-tron-%E6%96%B0%E5%B9%B4%E5%BC%8F%E6%B7%BB%E6%96%B0%E9%85%8D%E5%82%99%E4%BD%86%E5%83%B9%E6%A0%BC%E4%B9%9F%E6%9C%89%E8%AA%BF%E6%BC%B2-040212205.html) and it prints the MY2026 table verbatim: 'Q6 e-tron：276 萬元 (調漲 11 萬元) / Q6 e-tron quattro S line 運動版：326 萬 (調漲 11 萬元) / Q6 Sportback e-tron：287 萬元 (調漲 11 萬元)'. The bare 'Q6 e-tron' line is the entry single-motor RWD SUV, so 2,760,000 is the correct MY2026 建議售價 for this trim. The prior researcher's concern that 276萬 might be a Sportback mix-up is correctly resolved: 276萬 WAS the MY2025 Sportback RWD price, and became the SUV RWD price only after the +11萬 MY2026 adjustment (which pays for 主動式車道維持機能 and an AR HUD). The MY2025 SUV RWD baseline of 265萬 is corroborated by the launch coverage (Taiwan launch 2025-03-28), and a pre-sale figure of 269萬 for the same car appears in contemporaneous coverage (Mobile01/TVBS/Yahoo pre-sale reports), consistent with the reported 4萬 cut at launch. CAUTION NOTED: the same Yahoo MY2026 table is internally garbled on the SQ6 line ('SQ6 e-tron：326 萬 (降價 9 萬元)', which cannot be reconciled with a 369萬 MY2025 SQ6). That noise does not touch the Q6 e-tron 後驅版 line, which is consistent across the +11萬 pattern applied to every other Q6 variant. discounts 150,000 remains an INFERENCE, not a fetched figure — see notes.
purchase.notes:
TRIM ID: Q6 e-tron 後驅版 — single rear motor, 252 hp, 83 kWh battery, 533 km WLTP, 20-inch alloys as standard, CCS2, 800V PPE platform shared with the Porsche Macan EV. NO AIR SUSPENSION on this trim — 氣壓懸吊 is exclusive to the SQ6 e-tron, so the entry RWD rides on conventional steel springs and dampers. That is a genuine long-run saving versus air-sprung German SUVs and is why no air-strut replacement appears in the year-7 or year-10 maintenance windows; conventional dampers are replaced on age at year 10 instead.

DISCOUNTS 150,000 (5.4%) — INFERRED, and still the weakest number in this record. No published Audi TW cash-discount figure for the Q6 e-tron could be fetched (audi.com.tw returns HTTP 503 to automated fetches, confirmed again on this pass). The inference rests on four observations: (a) Audi Taiwan structurally leads with FINANCING rather than cash — 48期0利率 and a 3年保證買回 — which is how German brands in TW protect list price; (b) Audi has already shown willingness to move on this exact car, cutting 4萬 off the 269萬 pre-sale price at launch; (c) the car is ~1.4 years into its Taiwan life, not a launch model, and Audi has just raised the price 11萬 while MY2025 stock is still being cleared, both of which create negotiating room; (d) luxury BEV demand in Taiwan is thin and BEVs discount harder than equivalent ICE. RETAINED UNCHANGED after cross-checking the rest of this comparison table, where 150,000 is exactly the peer-consistent figure: the BMW i4 eDrive40 at a near-identical 2,790,000 list carries 150,000 (5.4%), the BMW iX2 carries 120,000 on 2,430,000 (4.9%) and the Mercedes EQB250+ carries 120,000 on 2,220,000 (5.4%). Treat as a realistic negotiated cash-equivalent — 掛牌金, 配件抵用, or a charging-equipment credit — rather than a quoted figure.

ONROAD_FEES RAISED 45,000 -> 55,000. The prior figure was scaled off the ICE Audi Q5's 40,000 in this same table, which is internally coherent but lands below every comparable German BEV SUV in the comparison set: Mercedes EQE300 SUV uses 72,000, BMW iX3 uses 85,000, BMW iX2 uses 65,000, Mercedes EQB250+ uses 60,000. 55,000 = 領牌 + 代辦 (~12,000: 新領牌照登記規費、驗車、車籍代辦; note a BEV pays no 貨物稅, and that is already inside the list price) + 配件 (~43,000: 高階隔熱紙 across a large glazed area, 行車記錄器, 腳踏墊, 車身鍍膜, 20吋輪圈防刮). This is a calibration adjustment against peers rather than a sourced correction, and is deliberately kept at the conservative end of the peer band. EXCLUDES the home wallbox and its installation (see assumptions.notes) and, by design, excludes tax and insurance.

real_cost = 2,760,000 - 150,000 + 55,000 = 2,665,000.

selling_costs.notes: Private-sale disposal costs for a luxury BEV SUV, set at the same level as the Audi Q5 and the BMW SUVs in this table since the class and the selling channel are identical (peer range 13,000-13,500). 過戶費 is small (監理站規費 plus a 代辦 charge, ~2,000-3,500). 售前整備／美容 scales with class — a 276萬 Audi needs proper detailing to defend a private-sale price, and 20-inch wheels on Taiwanese kerbs reliably need refurbishing, so 8,000 rather than the ~3,000 a mainstream car gets. 刊登費 assumes a paid 8891 自售 listing with an exposure boost, which matters more than usual here because the private-buyer pool for a German BEV is thin and the car needs longer exposure to find one. Total 13,000 sits in the upper half of the 6,000-15,000 band, as expected for this segment. Excludes any 履約保證／第三方驗車 a cautious BEV buyer might request (commonly another 3,000-6,000, and increasingly requested on used EVs because of battery-health checks). Unchanged from the prior record — reviewed and found correct.

value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED DOWNWARD — the prior record mis-dated its own best comparable. All three 8891 listings it cited are real and I re-fetched them (https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q6-e-tron): a 2025 後驅版 with 14,400 km asking 198.0萬, a 2025 後驅版 with 34,000 km at 電洽, and a 2024/12-built quattro S line with 8,300 km asking 236.8萬 at Audi's own 內湖認證中古車. The decisive car — a 2025 後驅版 with 9,000 km that sold at 190.8萬 through 弘達國際桃園店 — is also real and still retrievable (https://m.8891.com.tw/auto?id=4657734), and it is genuinely marked 已售出, so it reflects a price the market actually cleared rather than an asking price. THE ERROR: the prior record treated that car as '~1.3 years old', reasoning from the 2025-03-28 launch. The listing itself states '2025年出廠' but '2026/01領牌' — it was first registered in January 2026, so at this record's 2026-08-12 as-of date it is roughly SEVEN MONTHS old, not 1.3 years. Its 190.8/265 = 72.0% is therefore a ~0.6-year dealer-retail retention, not a ~1.3-year one. The prior record then applied that same ~72% to a ONE-year-old car against the HIGHER 276萬 MY2026 list, which double-counts in the optimistic direction: it assumes a 12-month-old car holds what a 7-month-old car holds. Re-anchored accordingly, dealer retail at the true year-1 point is set at ~68.5% of the 276萬 list = ~189萬. The two live asking prices (198.0萬 = 74.7% and 236.8萬 = 75.2% of their respective lists) are consistent with this: both are unsold asks and therefore sit above clearing level, and both are on cars younger than one year. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN APPLIED — these are 車商售價 (dealer retail), NOT what an owner receives: private_sale_price = 189萬 x 0.875 = 165.5萬 (a 12.5% haircut, in the middle of the stated 8-15% dealer-retail-to-private-sale band, toward the wider end because a German BEV private sale is a slow, buyer's-market transaction); dealer_tradein_price = 165.5萬 x 0.87 = 144萬, a further 13% down. Confidence medium: the underlying listings are real and one is a cleared transaction, but the year-1 point is still a short extrapolation and rests on a thin three-car market.

EXTRAPOLATED — no genuine 3-year data exists for this car and none can exist: the Q6 e-tron only went on sale in Taiwan on 2025-03-28, so the oldest example in the country is ~1.4 years old. Built by interpolating between two anchors — the corrected year-1 dealer-retail ratio of ~68.5% of list (see the year-1 checkpoint, re-anchored after the registration-date correction) and the year-5 ratio of ~40% derived from the predecessor Audi e-tron 55 (see the year-5 checkpoint) — along the steep German year 1-3 curve rather than a straight line. Dealer retail is set at 50% of the 276萬 list = 138萬; private_sale_price = 138萬 x 0.88 = 121.5萬; dealer_tradein_price = 121.5萬 x 0.865 = 105萬. Sanity note on Audi Taiwan's 3年保證買回: the programme exists and covers e-tron models, but Audi does not publish the guaranteed residual percentage, and in any case a finance-contract buyback is a floor available only to that contract's holder — it does not set the open-market private-sale price used here, so it was deliberately NOT used as an anchor. Confidence low: this is an interpolation between one observed and one proxy anchor, not an observation.

PREDECESSOR-GENERATION RATIO, applied as the brief prescribes, with the prior record's ratio trimmed for a denominator error I found. The current car cannot be 5 years old, so the proxy is Audi's previous BEV SUV, the e-tron 55 quattro, launched in Taiwan 2020-12-09 (325萬 for the 55 quattro advanced, 357萬 for the 55 quattro S line). I re-fetched 8891's used e-tron index (https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/e-tron) and confirmed four cars, two priced: a 2021 55 quattro advanced with 30,000 km at 125.8萬, and a 2021 55 quattro S line with 41,000 km at 148.8萬. These are ~5.5 years old and their mileage brackets our 35,000 km assumption almost exactly, so no mileage adjustment is needed. THE CORRECTION: the listing detail shows the 148.8萬 car is a SPORTBACK with air suspension, not the SUV whose 357萬 list price the prior record used as its denominator. The e-tron Sportback carried a higher list than the equivalent SUV, so that car's true retention is somewhat BELOW the 41.7% the prior record computed, pulling the observed pair down from its stated ~40% average. The prior record then applied a still-kinder 41.5% on the argument that the PPE-platform Q6 is a better product than the heavy first-generation e-tron. I have removed that bonus: with the Sportback denominator understated and the year-1 anchor having proved weaker than assumed once its true age was established, a 'holds better than the predecessor' premium is not earned by the evidence. Dealer retail set at 40.0% of the 276萬 list = 110.4萬; private_sale_price = 110.4萬 x 0.88 = 97.2萬, rounded to 97萬; dealer_tradein_price = 97萬 x 0.86 = 83.5萬. Note this is the last checkpoint inside the 5-year vehicle warranty, which is why the tail beyond it steepens. Confidence low: explicitly a predecessor-generation extrapolation resting on two listings, one of which needed a body-style caveat.

EXTRAPOLATED — no data exists and no proxy is available either: the predecessor e-tron only reaches 7 years old in 2028, so there is nothing in the Taiwanese market to measure. Projected forward from the corrected year-5 predecessor-derived ratio (40% of list at dealer retail) along the German-BEV tail, which does NOT flatten the way a Lexus does. Two specific forces are priced in. First, the 5-year/100,000 km vehicle warranty has expired on the calendar (35,000 km at year 5 is nowhere near the km cap), so from here the used market is buying uncovered repair risk on an Audi. Second, the 8-year high-voltage battery warranty is within a year of expiry at this checkpoint, and Taiwanese used-BEV buyers discount hard for that — a replacement pack for an 83 kWh PPE car costs a large fraction of the whole car's value. Dealer retail set at 27.5% of the 276萬 list = 75.9萬; private_sale_price = 75.9萬 x 0.87 = 66萬; dealer_tradein_price = 66萬 x 0.85 = 56萬 — the private-to-trade-in gap widens here because dealers take on real risk stocking an out-of-warranty German BEV. Confidence low, and honestly so: this is a modelled point, not a sourced one.

EXTRAPOLATED — the weakest-supported point in the record. No 10-year data exists for this car or for any Audi BEV in Taiwan (the e-tron 55 only arrived in December 2020, so the oldest Audi BEV in the country is ~5.5 years old). Projected from the year-7 point along a tail that keeps falling for three compounding reasons specific to a German BEV in Taiwan: the 8-year battery warranty is two years expired, so a buyer is fully exposed to a pack cost that by then exceeds the car's value; used demand is genuinely thin, since the pool of buyers willing to take a decade-old high-voltage German SUV without dealer backing is small; and by 2036 this generation will be two product cycles obsolete on charging speed and software, in a segment where those are the selling points. Dealer retail set at 15.5% of the 276萬 list = 42.8萬; private_sale_price = 42.8萬 x 0.86 = 37萬; dealer_tradein_price = 37萬 x 0.82 = 30.5萬 — the widest gap of any checkpoint, because at this age most dealers would rather not stock the car at all and will only bid a wholesale/trade number. CALIBRATION CLAIM CORRECTED: the prior record asserted this was 'the weakest 10-year retention of any BEV in this comparison set'. It was not, and is not now — the Mercedes EQE300 SUV in the same table retains ~12.5% of real cost at year 10 versus ~13.9% here. The Q6 e-tron is among the weakest German BEVs in the set, which is the defensible claim, but it is not the single weakest. Confidence low. Being explicitly extrapolated is the point; this is not presented as observed.

maintenance.plan_notes:
WARRANTY AND WHY THE CURVE BREAKS AT YEAR 5 — NOW CONFIRMED BY DIRECT FETCH. Audi Taiwan covers the vehicle for 5 years or 100,000 km and the high-voltage battery for 8 years or 160,000 km with at least 70% capacity retained. The prior record flagged this as its most important unverified claim because it rested on a search-result snippet; I fetched the page directly and it states '全車原廠 5 年或 10 萬公里原廠保固' and '8 年或 16 萬公里保固，在保固期間內維持 70% 以上電池效能' (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/audi-e-tron-e-tron-062540322.html). Audi Taiwan's own warranty page (https://www.audi.com.tw/zh/Audi_Service/regular-warranty/) exists and appears in search results but returns HTTP 503 to automated fetches, so the secondary source stands as the confirmation. At 7,000 km/yr this car reaches 35,000 km at year 5 and only 70,000 km at year 10, so NEITHER km cap is ever approached and both warranties lapse purely on the calendar. Everything else is time-driven too: brake fluid every 2 years, coolant on an age limit, tyres replaced at ~5-6 years because the rubber ages long before 20-inch tread wears out at this mileage. That is why the years-1/3 windows are modest and the years-7/10 windows carry the full unsubsidised cost including out-of-warranty risk.

TOTALS CORRECTED UPWARD: 380,000 -> 509,000. This is the largest change in the record. The prior build was not German-realistic. It landed BELOW the ICE Audi Q5 in this table (404,000) on the argument that a BEV should cost less than combustion — but that is not how the rest of this comparison set is calibrated, and the argument is contradicted by the table's own BMW pair, where the ICE X3 runs 462,000 and the BEV iX3 runs 528,000. For German cars in Taiwan the dominant cost drivers are dealer labour rates, oversized consumables and out-of-warranty high-voltage exposure, none of which get cheaper because the car is electric. Every comparable German BEV in this set sits far above the prior 380,000 figure: Mercedes EQE300 SUV 469,000, BMW i4 eDrive40 519,000, BMW iX3 528,000, BMW iX2 549,000, Mercedes EQB250+ 571,000. The prior record was also internally inconsistent — its own plan_notes argued at length that Audi Taiwan bundles NO free scheduled maintenance 'unlike Volvo and Lexus', yet its total landed in the Volvo band (Volvo EX90 337,000, which is low precisely BECAUSE Volvo bundles servicing). The corrected 509,000 sits between the EQE300 SUV and the i4/iX3, which is the right place for an Audi PPE SUV: heavier and larger-wheeled than the i4 sedan, at slightly lower dealer labour rates than BMW. Three windows were rebuilt (years 5, 7 and 10); years 1 and 3 were reviewed and left unchanged.

NO FREE SERVICE PACKAGE. Unlike Volvo and Lexus in this table, Audi Taiwan bundles no complimentary scheduled maintenance with the car — it leads with finance incentives (48期0利率, 3年保證買回) instead. It does run a published 保養透明 pricing portal (https://service-pricing.audi-service.com.tw/), which is JS-rendered and yielded no e-tron-specific schedule. Every period below is the owner's real out-of-pocket cost with no subsidy assumed in any window.

WHAT BEING ELECTRIC ACTUALLY SAVES — AND WHAT IT DOES NOT. Genuinely gone: engine oil and filter at every visit, spark plugs, coil packs, the S tronic dual-clutch fluid service, the water pump and thermostat housing that make EA888-engined Audis expensive after year 6. Genuinely still there, and not small: 20-inch tyres on a ~2.2-tonne car (heavier than the equivalent ICE Q5, so they wear faster and cost more), brake fluid every two years, battery and power-electronics coolant, the reduction-gearbox oil, the heat-pump air-conditioning circuit, and the 12V battery — which dies on a schedule of its own regardless of the traction pack and needs coding when replaced. One BEV-specific trap is budgeted explicitly: because regenerative braking means the friction brakes are barely used, the pads last unusually long but the DISCS CORRODE, and Taiwan's humidity accelerates it — so the year-7 window pays for discs on a car whose pads still have material left. Air suspension is NOT fitted to this trim (SQ6 only), so no air-strut replacement is budgeted anywhere; conventional dampers are replaced on age in the year-10 window instead. The genuinely expensive BEV failure items — the DC-DC converter, the onboard charger, the heat-pump compressor, the HV harness and the battery cooling module — are carried as explicit reserves in the years-7 and years-10 windows, sized realistically at Audi parts prices rather than token amounts.

checkpoints.source: UNCHANGED — reviewed and found correct. Audi Taiwan gives no free scheduled maintenance, so year 1 is paid by the owner. Costed from Audi TW dealer service levels: the published 菁英保養 interval runs ~NT$6,500 on a small A3 and Audi's own 保養透明 portal (https://service-pricing.audi-service.com.tw/) quotes NT$10,500-11,500 for a scheduled A1 Sportback service. Both are ICE services including oil; stripping oil and filter from an equivalent Audi-rate visit while keeping the same labour and inspection scope lands a first-year BEV inspection at ~6,000 on a larger car. Everything else in this window is warranty work at zero cost. Consistent with the German BEV peers in this table at year 1 (BMW iX3 5,000; BMW i4 6,000; Mercedes EQE300 SUV 6,000).

checkpoints.source: UNCHANGED — reviewed and found correct. Two annual dealer visits at Audi TW rates (~6,500 each including cabin filter, calibrated from the 菁英保養 figure), plus the first brake-fluid change at ~4,500 — triggered by the 2-year time limit, not by the 21,000 km, which is trivial — plus wipers and alignment. No brake pads: at 21,000 km with regenerative braking doing nearly all the deceleration, the friction material is essentially untouched. No tyres yet either. Still inside the 5-year warranty, so no repair risk is carried. Sits correctly among the German BEV peers at this window (BMW iX3 17,000; Mercedes EQE300 SUV 19,000; BMW i4 22,000), and is materially higher than the Volvo BEVs in this table purely because Volvo bundles free servicing here and Audi does not.

checkpoints.source: RAISED 66,000 -> 86,000. The shape was right but two lines were under-priced and two were missing. TYRES were the main error: the prior build used ~9,000 per corner fitted for 20-inch rubber, which is below the Taiwanese market for premium EV-rated tyres in this size on a 2.2-tonne SUV (255/50R20-class EV-specific rubber runs nearer 11,000-12,000 a corner fitted and balanced), so four are budgeted at ~46,000 rather than 36,000 — replaced on AGE at year 5, since at 7,000 km/yr the tread is far from worn but five-year-old rubber on a heavy car is past its useful life. Rebuilt as: two annual services with cabin filters (~14,000), second brake-fluid change (~5,000), four 20-inch tyres (~46,000), 12V AGM battery with coding (~9,000 — EVs are unusually hard on the 12V because it wakes the whole high-voltage system), heat-pump A/C circuit service including refrigerant and desiccant (~5,000, omitted entirely from the prior build), and alignment, wipers and TPMS sensor batteries (~7,000). Brake pads are deliberately NOT included: with regen, 35,000 km leaves plenty of material. Still under warranty for defects, so no repair reserve is carried here. The corrected figure sits correctly among the German BEV peers at this window (Mercedes EQE300 SUV 78,000; BMW iX3 80,000; BMW i4 104,000). Confidence low because the tyre, 12V and A/C prices are class-typical Taiwanese figures rather than a fetched Audi TW quotation for this specific model.

checkpoints.source: RAISED 88,000 -> 132,000. The composition was right; the out-of-warranty reserve was not. This is the first window with no manufacturer cover at all, and the prior build carried only ~12,000 against high-voltage ancillary failure — a token amount when a DC-DC converter, an onboard charger or a heat-pump compressor at Audi parts prices is individually 60,000-150,000 fitted. These are precisely the components that fail on this class of car, and an expected-value reserve across two fully uncovered years has to be materially larger. Rebuilt as: two annual services at independent-specialist rates (~16,000), third brake-fluid change (~5,000), battery and power-electronics coolant on its age limit (~9,000), reduction-gearbox oil at roughly the 6-year mark (~7,000), filters/wipers/alignment (~9,000), pads all round plus front discs (~32,000 — the BEV-specific trap noted in plan_notes: regen means the pads survive 49,000 km easily, but the discs corrode from disuse in Taiwan's humidity and get condemned on surface condition rather than thickness), early control-arm and bushing work on a heavy EV (~12,000), and a ~42,000 reserve for genuine out-of-warranty exposure on high-voltage and thermal ancillaries. No air-suspension line — this trim has steel springs. The corrected figure sits correctly among the German BEV peers at this window (BMW i4 122,000; Mercedes EQE300 SUV 128,000; BMW iX3 136,000; BMW iX2 140,000). Confidence low: modelled from component-level Taiwanese pricing, not from a fetched Audi TW schedule or an owner receipt for this model, which cannot exist yet at this age.

checkpoints.source: RAISED 200,000 -> 265,000. Three years fully outside every warranty — the vehicle cover lapsed at year 5 and the 8-year battery cover lapses inside this window — so this period carries the entire unsubsidised cost, exactly as the brief requires. Two lines in the prior build were too low for the class. DAMPERS: four conventional units replaced on age were budgeted at ~38,000, which is below Audi-specialist pricing for a 2.2-tonne SUV where OEM dampers fitted run nearer 13,000-14,000 a corner, so ~55,000. HIGH-VOLTAGE RESERVE: the prior build carried ~25,000 for three post-battery-warranty years, which is not credible when a heat-pump compressor alone is 80,000-120,000 at Audi parts prices and module-level pack repair becomes a live possibility once cover lapses at year 8; raised to ~55,000 as an expected-value reserve. Rebuilt as: three annual services (~30,000), a second set of four 20-inch tyres on age (~50,000, allowing for price drift to 2036), second 12V battery (~10,000), two brake-fluid changes (~10,000), second coolant change (~9,000), four dampers (~55,000), lower arms and suspension bushings which a heavy EV reliably destroys (~24,000), a second brake service of rear discs and pads all round (~24,000), and a ~55,000 reserve for post-warranty high-voltage and thermal-system risk. Corrected 10-year maintenance across all windows is 509,000, which sits between the Mercedes EQE300 SUV (469,000) and the BMW i4 (519,000) / BMW iX3 (528,000) in this table — the right band for an Audi PPE SUV, and correctly far above any Japanese equivalent. Confidence low — this is a modelled projection for a car and a market where no 10-year German BEV data can yet exist.

assumptions.notes: 買家年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律以 7,000 km/年推算（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km）。此里程下原廠保養間隔由「時間」而非「里程」觸發，Audi 一年一次的定期保養即使里程未到也必須做，否則保養紀錄會斷、影響保固與殘值。輪胎同理：Q7 標配 20/21 吋大胎，7,000 km/年跑不到磨耗極限，實際是橡膠老化（約 5-6 年）決定更換時機，本表把輪胎放在第 5 年與第 8-9 年兩次。低里程對殘值有正面影響，因此各檢查點都盡量比對低里程在架車而非里程盲平均——本次已在 8891 找到同車型同代的低里程實價樣本（2025 年式 45 TDI quattro 享馭版、30,100 km），是全表最重要的錨點。牌照稅、燃料稅、保險（強制險與任意險）依規格排除，不計入任何欄位。此車非電動車，無充電樁安裝成本問題。

purchase.source: 建議售價 NT$3,540,000 經獨立覆核確認。主來源為 8891 新車頻道 2026 年式 Q7 上市新聞（https://c.8891.com.tw/news/audi/q7/20990），該頁完整列出 2026 年式全車系牌價：45 TFSI quattro 享馭版 3,290,000、45 TDI quattro 享馭版 3,540,000、55 TFSI S line quattro 運動版 3,960,000、SQ7 5,660,000。交叉驗證：多家媒體（8891 新車、CarFun、自由時報汽車頻道 auto.ltn.com.tw、U-CAR）一致報導「2026 年式 Q7 車系建議售價自 329 萬元起」，與上述車系表的入門價相符，可反證該表為真實車系表而非單一頁誤植。折扣與領牌配件為市場行情推估，非官方公告。
purchase.notes: 動力為 3.0 V6 TDI 柴油搭配 48V 輕油電（MHEV）皮帶啟動發電機。48V 系統無法純電行駛，僅做怠速熄火延伸與扭力輔助，依本表規則不算 hybrid；本車燃料為柴油，故歸類 diesel（規格中「48V MHEV 應歸 gasoline」那條是針對汽油 MHEV，柴油 MHEV 對應的正確值是 diesel）。折扣 210,000（約 5.9%）的理由：Q7 為 4M 世代，2015 年發表、2019 與 2024 兩度小改，平台已屆末期，新世代改款在即；台灣大型柴油休旅買氣本就薄弱，經銷端讓利空間大於 A 級距車款。實務上這筆讓利常以選配補助或延長保固形式給付而非現金折讓，故以「等值現金」計。領牌代辦與配件 110,000 拆解：新領牌照登記費、牌照與驗車規費約 6,000；交車代辦與領牌服務費約 12,000；配件約 92,000（大型休旅全車隔熱紙 35,000、行車紀錄器前後鏡頭 15,000、原廠腳踏墊與行李箱防水托盤與門檻踏板 17,000、新車鍍膜 25,000）。此金額約為牌價 3.1%，符合此級距交車實務。牌價已內含貨物稅、營業稅與特種貨物稅；牌照稅、燃料稅與保險依規格排除。

selling_costs.notes: 以自售（private sale）情境估算。此級距的售前整備比一般房車貴：Q7 標配 20-21 吋大輪圈，路緣刮傷整理單顆就要 2,000-3,000，加上七人座內裝清潔工時較長，故美容整備抓 9,000 而非一般轎車的 4,000-5,000。若改走車商收購（trade-in），過戶與整備由車商吸收，賣方端成本趨近於零，但售價要改用 dealer_tradein_price。

value_checkpoints.source: 同車型同代直接對照（本次覆核新增的關鍵樣本）：8891 中古車在架 2025 年式 Q7 45 TDI quattro 享馭版、30,100 km、車商售價 2,650,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7）。這是完全同 trim、同引擎、僅差一個年式的實價，比原本用 45 TFSI 代打可靠得多。輔助樣本（車商售價）：2025 年式 45 TFSI quattro 享馭版 1,200 km／2,880,000、2,660 km／2,688,000、2,000 km 與 8,000 km 各 2,598,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7?page=2 與第 1 頁）；Audi Approved Plus 原廠認證 2025 年式 2,662 km／2,598,000、2026 年式 8,215 km／2,598,000（https://approvedplus.audi.com.tw/listing/2513/q7，含認證與延長保固溢價，僅作上緣參考）。調整過程：以上全部是「車商售價」而非車主拿到的錢。本案 7,000 km 低於對照車的 30,100 km，低里程加價約 5-7%，得車商售價約 2,800,000；依 8891 車商售價→自售價的慣常差距下修 11.4% 得自售價 2,480,000；車商收購價再下修 14% 得 2,130,000。第 1 年帳面損失 960,000（占實付成本 27.9%），符合德系而非日系的折舊斜率。

同引擎同代直接對照：8891 中古車在架 2023 年式 Q7 45 TDI quattro Technik 豪華版、40,000 km、車商售價 1,890,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7?page=2）。同頁另有 2023 年式 55 TFSI quattro 享馭版、46,800 km、車商售價 1,868,000（多筆重覆刊登），佐證 3 年 V6 Q7 的車商售價確實落在 1,870,000-1,890,000 這一帶，非單一樣本。調整過程：本案里程 21,000 km 約為對照車的一半，低里程加價約 5-8%，得車商售價約 2,000,000；下修 11% 得自售價 1,780,000；車商收購價再下修 14.6% 得 1,520,000。第 1→3 年再跌 28%，是德系車最陡的一段。註：對照車 Technik 豪華版的原始牌價未經一手來源證實，故本點不以保值率反推，而是直接用「同齡實價 + 里程調整 + 車商售價折讓」推導，避開牌價不確定性。

無同年式（2021 年式）45 TDI 低里程在架車可直接對照，屬內插推估，信心 low。兩端錨點皆為同 4M 世代實價（車商售價）：上端是 2023 年式 45 TDI Technik、40,000 km／1,890,000；下端是 8891 在架 2021 年式 Q7 50 TDI quattro、137,000 km／1,280,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7）。下端那台雖同為 5 年車，但里程是本案的 3.9 倍，其 1,280,000 應視為同齡高里程車的地板價而非中位。調整過程：5 年、35,000 km 的合理車商售價取 1,480,000；下修 12.2% 得自售價 1,300,000；車商收購價再下修 15.4% 得 1,100,000。原廠 3 年保固此時已失效兩年，二手市場開始把修繕風險折進價格，故跌幅未收斂。

同世代（4M）實價對照，車商售價：8891 在架 2018 年式 Q7 45 TDI quattro 七人座、90,000 km／895,000（https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7）。同頁另有 2019 年式 55 TFSI quattro、14,000 km／1,800,000，是超低里程 7 年車，用來界定上緣（本案里程較高且為 45 TDI，不應貼到該價位）。本世代 2016 年即在台上市，7 年車有真實同世代同引擎資料，非跨代外推。調整過程：對照車為 8 年、90,000 km，本案為 7 年、49,000 km，年份少 1 年（約 +8-10%）且里程少 41,000 km（約 +15-20%），合計加價約 28%，得車商售價約 1,180,000；下修 13.6% 得自售價 1,020,000；車商收購價再下修 14.7% 得 870,000（老德系車商收購折扣比新車大，因整備與保固風險高）。

同世代（4M）10 年對照，樣本離散度大，信心 low。最貼近本案里程的樣本是 SUM 汽車網 2017 年式 Q7 3.0L、71,244 km、車商售價 888,000（https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch.php?v=3&brand=AUDI&model=Q7）——本次覆核確認該車為 3.0 汽油（45 TFSI）七人座、非柴油。8891 同步有 2017 年式 45 TFSI quattro 七人座、71,200 km／888,000（極可能為同一台跨平台刊登）。同年份（2016）樣本：45 TDI quattro 七人座、177,400 km／599,000；45 TFSI quattro 七人座、100,000 km／699,000。上緣是 Audi Approved Plus 原廠認證 2016 年式 45 TDI quattro、82,127 km／1,380,000（https://approvedplus.audi.com.tw/listing/2513/q7），含認證與延長保固溢價，不能當一般成交行情。調整過程：以 71,244 km／888,000 那台為主錨（里程幾乎等同本案），本案年份再老 1 年（約 -10%），且柴油大型休旅在台接手面較窄、DPF 與氣壓避震修繕風險被定價，再折約 2%，得車商售價約 795,000；下修 12% 得自售價 700,000；車商收購價再下修 17% 得 580,000。10 年車保固全失效，尾段續跌而非像 Lexus 那樣打平。

maintenance.plan_notes: 全期以「時間觸發」而非「里程觸發」計算。年跑 7,000 km，10 年僅 70,000 km，永遠碰不到原廠的里程門檻，但 Audi 定期保養一年一次是硬性要求（不做會斷保養紀錄、影響保固與殘值），所以保養次數等於年數，不是里程除以間隔。前段有原廠補貼但需注意其性質：Audi Taiwan 新車「3 年不限里程原廠保固」是官網明載的標準條件；「3 年／5 萬公里免費定期保養」則出自 U-CAR 上的 Audi 促銷專案（涵蓋 A3/A4/A5/Q7 等），屬期間限定的購車優惠而非永久標配，且近期另有以「5 年原廠保固」為主打的專案，實際條件依成交當期方案而定。本表假設買家取得該免費保養方案，因此第 1、3 年只計入不在涵蓋範圍的自費項目（雨刷片、四輪定位、胎壓感知器與鑰匙電池、冷氣濾網等），但已較原估上調以反映方案未必到手的風險。第 4 年起補貼全數失效，後三段一律以「無補貼原廠廠價」計算，這才是後段金額陡升的原因，不是估算膨脹。原廠廠工資高：Audi 官方保養價格查詢頁（本次覆核確認該頁僅查得到 A1 Sportback 2020 年式一次定期保養 10,500-11,500 元，查不到 Q7 柴油專屬表）；Q7 是 3.0 V6 柴油、油量與濾芯規格大一階、另有柴油濾芯這個 A1 沒有的項目，單次年度保養抓 26,000-30,000 元屬合理而非高估。柴油與 48V 專屬風險項目已列入後段：DPF 柴油微粒濾清器清洗或更換、EGR 積碳、噴油嘴保養，以及 48V 輕油電的鋰電池與皮帶啟動發電機（BAS）。氣壓避震器（adaptive air suspension）是 Q7 8-10 年最常見的高額故障，單支氣囊 60,000-80,000、壓縮機 35,000，本表在 7-10 年段以風險攤提 95,000 計入；若該車實際未配氣壓避震而是鋼圈彈簧，此段可扣除約 90,000。輪胎依老化更換（第 5 年與第 8-9 年各一套），非依磨耗。10 年保養總計約 874,000，遠高於同尺寸日系休旅（約 250,000-350,000），這個差距是真實的德系原廠工資與零件價差，不是誤植。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). At this mileage the Audi service interval (12 months or 15,000 km, whichever comes first) is entirely TIME-driven: the car never reaches a mileage trigger inside a service year, so the number of services equals the number of years and low mileage does NOT skip services. Two consequences: tyres and the 12V battery age out rather than wear out, and the car stays well inside any mileage cap on the factory warranty (only 35,000 km at year 5). Verified spec (Yahoo 汽機車 2025/2026 spec pages, re-read 2026-08-12): 1,984 cc turbo inline-4, 265 hp, 8-speed auto, quattro, 285/45R20 tyres, 2,073 kg kerb weight, 五連桿 front and rear suspension, 前後碟煞, 7 seats. WARRANTY CAVEAT (corrected in this review): Audi Taiwan's STANDARD new-car warranty is 3 years unlimited mileage; the '5-year factory warranty' widely quoted for the 2026 Q7 is a period-limited purchase campaign (8891 新車頻道's 2026 Q7 launch article ties it to a promotional window), not a permanent standard term. The maintenance model therefore does NOT treat years 3-5 as risk-free. EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: 牌照稅 (NT$11,230/yr for 1,984 cc) and 燃料稅 (NT$6,180/yr), all insurance, and fuel — none appear in purchase, maintenance or selling_costs. Home-charger installation is not applicable (combustion car). Value figures are quoted against the NT$3,290,000 list price, the convention Taiwanese used-price guides use.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED in this adversarial pass against two sources I fetched myself on 2026-08-12: (1) Yahoo 汽機車 2026 Audi Q7 lineup table (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/new-cars/model/audi-q7-2026) showing 45 TFSI quattro享馭版 329萬 / 45 TDI quattro享馭版 354萬 / 55 TFSI quattro S-Line運動版 396萬 / SQ7 566萬; (2) 8891 新車頻道's 2026 model-year Q7 launch article (https://c.8891.com.tw/news/audi/q7/20990) giving the identical four-trim table with 45 TFSI quattro 享馭版 = NT$3,290,000. The two agree exactly, so NT$3,290,000 stands unchanged (0% deviation). The researcher's third citation (CarFun 玩車誌, quoted at publisher-root level with no article permalink) has been REPLACED by the 8891 news permalink, which I actually opened. Discount and on-road fees are market estimates, not published figures.
purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: 2.0-litre turbo inline-4 (1,984 cc, 265 hp, 8-speed auto, quattro), EA888 family. Taiwanese spec sheets list this trim's 動力型式 as 汽油, while the sibling 45 TDI quattro 享馭版 and 55 TFSI quattro S-Line are tagged 油電混合 — Taiwan's label for the 48V mild-hybrid V6s. A 48V MHEV cannot move the car on battery alone, so even if this 2.0T carries a 12V/48V mild-hybrid belt-starter it is classified 'gasoline', never 'hybrid'. Classification is correct as filed and is unchanged. DISCOUNT (NT$220,000, 6.7%): the 4M-generation Q7 is a mature platform in its run-out phase and a slow-selling large SUV in Taiwan, so dealer-level cash negotiation of this order is realistic. Audi Taiwan's advertised 2026 package is finance-led (低頭款／首年低月付方案, 0% instalments) plus a campaign 五年原廠保固, so the cash element here is what is negotiated at the desk rather than a published cut. Kept at the researcher's figure — it is consistent with the NT$210,000 (5.9%) used on the pricier 45 TDI sibling. ON-ROAD FEES (NT$90,000) = 領牌規費 + 代辦費 (~NT$15,000) plus the accessory pack a buyer at this price point actually takes (~NT$75,000: 隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 腳踏墊, 鍍膜／美容, 避光墊). That is 2.7% of list, at the light end but defensible. Tax and insurance are excluded by design and are NOT in this figure. real_cost = 3,290,000 - 220,000 + 90,000 = 3,160,000.

value_checkpoints.source: VERIFIED IN THIS PASS on 8891 中古車 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/?key=Q7, read live 2026-08-12): a 2025款 Audi Q7 45 TFSI quattro 享馭版 2.0L — the EXACT trim — at 2,000 km asking NT$2,598,000. That is 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), and it is an essentially-new low-mileage car, which is the right comp for this 7,000 km/yr buyer. Chain applied: dealer retail NT$2,598,000 -> minus 13.4% -> 自售價 NT$2,250,000 -> minus 13.3% -> 車商收購價 NT$1,950,000. LOWERED from the researcher's NT$2,300,000 / NT$2,000,000: their figure was anchored on an unverified NT$2,620,000 average across six claimed listings (only one of which I could reproduce), several of which they themselves noted were Audi Approved 原廠認證中古車 carrying a certification premium that a private seller cannot charge. Private = 68.4% of the NT$3,290,000 list — a German first-year number, not a Toyota one. Confidence downgraded from 'high' to 'medium': one exact-trim listing verified, not six.

CORRECTS A FACTUAL MISREAD. The researcher's anchor was '2023款 55 TFSI quattro 享馭版, 2022 registration (~4 yr), 46,800 km, asking NT$1,868,000'. The actual 8891 row (read live 2026-08-12) is 2023款 55 TFSI quattro 享馭版 3.0L, **4,680 km**, NT$1,868,000 — the mileage was inflated 10x and the age by a year. Recomputed: a 3-year-old, 4,680 km 享馭版 asking NT$1,868,000 against its NT$4,040,000 list = 46.2% retention on DEALER ASKING for an ultra-low-mileage car, i.e. an excellent comp for this buyer with no upward mileage nudge available. Secondary comp claimed by the researcher (2023款 45 TDI Technik豪華版, 40,000 km, asking NT$1,890,000 / NT$3,510,000 = 53.8%) did not appear on the pages I fetched and is treated as unconfirmed. EXTRAPOLATED — no 5-year-old example of this exact 2.0T trim is on sale. Bracketed by two listings I verified on 8891 (2026-08-12): 2023款 55 TFSI quattro 享馭版, 4,680 km (3 yr), asking NT$1,868,000 / NT$4,040,000 list = 46.2%; and 2020款 50 TDI quattro, 137,000 km (6 yr), asking NT$1,280,000 / NT$3,690,000 list = 34.7%. Private = 34.7% of list. Trimmed from NT$1,190,000 / NT$1,030,000 to stay coherent with the corrected year-3 anchor. Ratio transferred from V6 trims, hence low confidence.

EXTRAPOLATED by retention ratio from same-generation (4M) 8891 listings I verified on 2026-08-12: 2018款 45 TDI quattro 7Seats (8 yr), 90,000 km, asking NT$895,000 / NT$3,720,000 list = 24.1%; 2017款 40 TFSI quattro Luxury 7Seats (9 yr), 130,000 km, asking NT$648,000 / ~NT$3,100,000 list = 20.9%; 2017款 40 TFSI Luxury 7Seats (9 yr), 90,000 km, asking NT$598,000 = 19.3%. The car is out of the standard 3-year warranty (and out of even the campaign 5-year warranty) well before this window, and the used market prices in that repair risk, so the curve keeps falling.

EXTRAPOLATED by retention ratio from the direct PREDECESSOR 2.0-litre trim — the pre-facelift 4M Q7 40 TFSI quattro. 8891 rows verified live on 2026-08-12: 2016款 40 TFSI quattro Luxury 七人座 2.0L, 100,000 km (10 yr), asking NT$578,000 / NT$2,970,000 list = 19.5%; 2016款 45 TDI quattro 七人座 3.0L, 177,400 km (10 yr), asking NT$599,000 / ~NT$3,750,000 list = 16.0%; 2014款 35 TFSI quattro 3.0L, 131,200 km (12 yr), asking NT$279,000. maintenance.plan_notes: BACKBONE: Audi Taiwan's own scheduled-service price tool (https://service-pricing.audi-service.com.tw/). The researcher reported querying it for Q7 / 45 TFSI quattro and obtaining, per 使用年份 1-10: 12,200-13,200 / 14,300-15,300 / 16,900-17,900 / 14,300-15,300 / 12,200-13,200 / 45,900-46,900 / 12,200-13,200 / 14,300-15,300 / 16,900-17,900 / 14,300-15,300 (midpoints 12,700 / 14,800 / 17,400 / 14,800 / 12,700 / 46,400 / 12,700 / 14,800 / 17,400 / 14,800). VERIFICATION CAVEAT ADDED IN THIS REVIEW: the tool renders client-side and, when fetched, returns only its default vehicle (A1 Sportback 2020, NT$10,500-11,500 for one scheduled service). I could not independently reproduce the Q7 table, and a parallel researcher on the sibling 45 TDI record reported the same failure. The magnitudes are plausible for a 2.0 TFSI at Audi Taiwan labour rates and the NT$1,000 band matches the tool's output format, so the table is retained as the backbone — but every checkpoint's confidence has been downgraded accordingly and no checkpoint is marked 'high'. Year 6 is the spike (ATF, spark plugs, V-belt and tensioner falling due together). INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN: 12 months or 15,000 km, whichever comes first; at 7,000 km/yr the 12-month trigger always fires first, so all ten annual services are incurred. WARRANTY — CORRECTED: Audi Taiwan's standard new-car warranty is 3 years unlimited mileage. The '5 年原廠保固' quoted for the 2026 Q7 is a period-limited purchase campaign (8891's 2026 Q7 launch article frames it as a promotional incentive), and the '五年或十萬公里內最多兩次免費基本保養' the researcher netted out of years 1-2 is likewise a campaign item, not a standard term. The record previously treated 5-year/100,000 km as the official warranty and therefore gave periods 1, 3 and 5 ZERO repair risk and cut period 1 to NT$5,000. That is now reversed: period 1 pays the full scheduled service, and period 5 (years 3-5) carries a risk-weighted out-of-warranty allowance because the buyer may only hold the standard 3-year cover. If the buyer does land the campaign package, period 1 falls by roughly NT$11,000 and period 5 by roughly NT$15,000. CONSUMABLES: 285/45R20 tyres on a 2,073 kg SUV run NT$52,000-55,000 a set fitted in Taiwan; at 7,000 km/yr they age out rather than wear out, so one set is budgeted around year 5 and another around year 10. A 12V AGM battery (NT$15,000-16,000 at the dealer) is budgeted around year 5 and year 9. LATER-PERIOD RISK ITEMS NAMED: thermostat housing and water pump, ignition coil packs, PCV/valve-cover and oil-filter-housing oil leaks, direct-injection carbon cleaning, five-link suspension bushings and control arms, starter/alternator. AIR SUSPENSION — OPEN: the researcher asserted this trim runs steel springs because the Taiwanese spec sheet says 五連桿 front and rear. That label describes the linkage geometry, not the spring medium, and the Q7's adaptive air suspension also sits on a five-link axle, so it does not prove the point. Rather than budget a full air-strut replacement (NT$60,000-80,000 per strut, NT$35,000 compressor) or assume it away, a risk-weighted component is folded into the year 7-10 allowance and the uncertainty is flagged. NO DPF (petrol, not TDI) and no large 48V pack to replace. TEN-YEAR TOTAL: about NT$618,000, up from the researcher's NT$543,000 — roughly 2.5-3x a comparable Japanese seven-seat SUV, and sensibly below the 45 TDI sibling's NT$874,000, which additionally carries DPF, 48V hardware and confirmed air suspension.

assumptions.notes: 低里程車主：每年 6,000-8,000 km，取中位 7,000 km/年，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km/年。各檢查點 assumed_km = 7000 x years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。Audi Taiwan 的定期保養為「1 年或 10,000-15,000 km 先到者」，在 7,000 km/年 下一律由「時間」觸發而非里程，等於一年進廠一次、里程幾乎不影響保養次數，但耗材（輪胎、電瓶、冷卻液、煞車油）同樣由年限而非磨耗決定。Q8 55 TFSI 為 3.0L V6 渦輪汽油（EA839, 340hp）搭配 48V MHEV 輕油電：皮帶式啟動發電機（BAS）+ 48V 鋰電池，只能做怠速熄火／滑行熄火與扭力輔助，無法純電行駛，故依規格歸類為 gasoline 而非 hybrid。變速箱為 8 速 tiptronic（ZF 8HP 液力變矩器自排），不是 S tronic 雙離合器。台灣 Q8 55 TFSI quattro S line 標配 adaptive air suspension（氣壓式懸吊）與 21 吋胎圈，這兩項是 7 年後養車成本遠高於日系同級的主因。2026 年式再新增標配抬頭顯示器與動態全輪轉向（後輪轉向），後者是額外的過保風險件。稅金（牌照稅、燃料稅）與保險依設計排除在外。低里程在殘值面是加分項，各檢查點均已相對於同齡但里程較高的實際掛牌車做向上校正，校正幅度寫在各 source 字串。

purchase.source: list_price 4,130,000 經獨立複查確認，與 scout 一致，不需修正。本次以 DuckDuckGo HTML/lite 端點當搜尋通道（WebSearch 額度已用罄），取得六筆彼此獨立的媒體報導一致寫「2026 年式 Audi Q8 車系建議售價自 413 萬元起」，含 U-CAR news/article/86195「標配抬頭顯示器、動態全輪轉向下放，Audi 新年式 Q7 與 Q8 配備與價格調整」、自由時報汽車頻道 auto.ltn.com.tw/news/30043、TVBS Cars、LINE TODAY 轉載（「2026 年式 Audi Q7 車系售價自 329 萬元起，Audi Q8 車系則為 413 萬元起」）。價格歷程亦交叉吻合：2021/03/08 台灣首度導入 55 TFSI quattro S line 單一車型 392 萬（U-CAR、7car、Auto-Online、Mobile01 四來源一致），2024 年式 406 萬（S line 運動版）／416 萬（Black Edition），2026 年式 413 萬。折讓與領牌費為經銷通路慣例推估，非官方公告。
purchase.notes:
車型識別：Q8 55 TFSI quattro S line 運動版（4M 世代小改款，3.0L V6 渦輪汽油 340hp + 48V MHEV 輕油電，8 速 tiptronic，quattro 全時四驅，台灣單一汽油規格；RS Q8 與 Q8 e-tron 屬不同車系，不在本筆）。48V 系統只有怠速／滑行熄火與扭力輔助，無法純電行駛，故 powertrain 記為 gasoline。
discounts 取 200,000（約 4.8%）：Q8 是 4M 世代（全球 2018 年問世、台灣 2021 年導入）末期產品，在台灣以 400 萬級距對上 GLE／X5／Cayenne 屬極低量的小眾車，8891 全站同時在售的中古 Q8 僅 7 台即可佐證量體之小，經銷商現金折讓空間明顯大於銷量主力。對照本表 Audi Q5 給 80,000（3.3%）、BMW X5 給 160,000（4.0%）、Mercedes GLE 450 給 150,000（3.6%），旗艦滯銷車給到 4.8% 是合理但不浮誇的估計。
onroad_fees 取 70,000（已由前一版的 55,000 上修）= 領牌規費約 6,000 + 代辦費約 6,000 + 交車配件約 58,000（大面積玻璃隔熱紙、全車鍍膜、行車紀錄器、迎賓踏板、行李廂墊）。上修理由：前一版拿 Mercedes GLC（約 290 萬級距、40,000）當下緣比較基準，級距不對；本表 400 萬級距的實際對照是 Porsche Cayenne 60,000、BMW X5 95,000、Mercedes GLE 450 110,000，55,000 低於這三者全部，不符「onroad_fees 隨車價等比放大」的規則。取 70,000 貼近該區間下緣（Audi 的交車配件包普遍不如雙 B 豪華）。
real_cost = 4,130,000 - 200,000 + 70,000 = 4,000,000。牌照稅與燃料稅依設計不計入。

items.name: 過戶費（監理規費 + 代辦）
售前整備／美容（拋光鍍膜、內裝深度清潔、輪胎與鋁圈整理）
刊登費（8891 精選刊登 / 平台曝光）

selling_costs.notes: 以自售（私人賣給下一手）為前提。400 萬級距的德系旗艦 SUV 在自售前通常會做一次完整美容與鍍膜，否則 21 吋鋁圈的路緣傷與淺色內裝的髒污會被買方大幅殺價，故整備費抓得比一般房車高。與本表 Porsche Cayenne、Mercedes GLC 同樣取 15,000，為本級距合理上緣。若改走車商收購（dealer trade-in）則這筆多半省下，但售價本身已低 14-19%，整體仍較不划算。

value_checkpoints.source:
外推自同世代實際掛牌車，並已做車商售價→自售價折算。台灣 Q8 於 2021/03 上市，市場上沒有「1 年車」可直接觀察，故由後段實價往前推。硬資料為 8891 兩筆有明碼的同世代車商開價：2022 年掛牌（4.0 年）40,000 km 開 198.8 萬（原價 392 萬 → 車商售價 50.7%）、2021 年掛牌（5.4 年）82,000 km 開 169.8 萬（→ 43.3%）。兩點斜率約每年 -5.3 個百分點，並依德系前段跌幅較陡（曲線上凸）修正，得第 1 年車商售價約為新車價 70-72%。本車 7,000 km 低於同齡平均約 13,000 km，第 1 年里程對價格影響很小，僅加約 1-2%，取 72% × 4,130,000 ≈ 297 萬車商售價；自售依規則低約 9-11% → 270 萬。dealer_tradein 再低約 14%。
【與前一版的差異】前一版取 285 萬，主因是重壓 8891 個別車輛頁 usedauto-infos-4524802.html 那台 2024 年出廠、開價 299 萬的車（宣稱原廠認證、車齡 2.2 年 → 73.6%）。本次實抓該頁只能確認「2024 年、299.0 萬、車商（無名車庫）」，里程與原廠認證身分都讀不到；且該價位與上述兩筆有明碼的一般車商開價連不成一條線（照 50.7%@4 年推回，2.2 年應在 58-62% 而非 73.6%），研判為認證溢價疊加滯銷旗艦的喊價，不宜當第 1 年的主錨點，已降權。Q8 是本表 400 萬級距德系 SUV 中銷量最小、世代最老（2018 年全球問世）的一台，第 1 年保值率理應是同群最差而非中段，故由 71.5% 下修至 67.5%（對 real_cost），低於 Mercedes GLE 450 的 70.6%。

以同世代實際掛牌車為錨點，並已做車商售價→自售價折算。主錨點：8891 auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q8 實抓「Audi Q8 2023 款 55 TFSI quattro S line 運動版 3.0L｜2022 年掛牌｜4 萬公里｜198.8 萬」——4.0 年車、車商開價 198.8 萬、原價 392 萬 → 車商售價 50.7%。校正到本車第 3 年、21,000 km：年齡少 1 年（依 8891 兩點實測斜率約 +5.3 個百分點，相對約 +10%）、里程少 19,000 km（此級距約每 5,000 km 值 1%，約 +4%），得車商售價約 227 萬；另以「同款原價比」路徑（本車新車價 413 萬 × 校正後比例約 58.8%）得約 243 萬，兩路徑取中約 235 萬車商售價。自售依規則低約 11% → 208 萬。dealer_tradein 再低約 14.5%。
【與前一版的差異——本次最主要的修正】前一版填 225 萬，但其推導鏈有兩個問題：(1) 內插用的上緣是那台 299 萬的疑似認證車（見第 1 年說明），把整段曲線墊高；(2) 算術灌水——source 自述「車商售價約原價 62%」，62% × 392 萬 = 243 萬，卻寫成「約 256 萬」，再乘自售折扣才得 225 萬。用它自己宣告的 62% 正確計算應得 243 × 0.88 ≈ 214 萬。更關鍵的是，225 萬落在本次估到的車商售價區間（227-243 萬）之內而非其下 8-15%，等於把車商開價當成自售價填入，正是本任務要抓的 dealer-retail trap。改以 208 萬（對 real_cost 52.0%），低於本表 Cayenne 56.0%、X5 59.1%、GLE 59.6%；這個位置有實際 4 年車開價 50.7% 撐著，是本表同級唯一有硬資料的第 3 年錨點。

有同世代真實 5 年車開價可用，且已做車商售價→自售價折算。錨點：8891 auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q8 實抓「Audi Q8 2021 款 55 TFSI quattro S line 3.0L｜2021 年掛牌｜8.2 萬公里｜169.8 萬」——5.4 年、原價 392 萬 → 車商售價 43.3%。同列表另有 2020 年掛牌 95,000 km 一台為電洽，無法採用。校正到本車第 5 年、35,000 km：年齡少 0.4 年約 +2%、里程少 47,000 km 約 +9%（每 5,000 km 約 1%），得車商售價約 189 萬；另以同款原價比路徑（413 萬 × 約 49%）得約 203 萬，兩路徑取中約 196 萬車商售價。自售依規則低約 11% → 174 萬。dealer_tradein 再低約 15%。
【與前一版的差異】前一版同樣填 175 萬、數字幾乎一致，但推導鏈有算術灌水：source 自述「低里程車商售價約為原價 48%」，48% × 392 萬 = 188 萬，卻寫成「約 198 萬」。本次改以雙路徑取中重算，結論相近（174 萬 vs 175 萬），故金額僅微調，但推導已可稽核。對 real_cost 為 43.5%，與本表 Cayenne 43.5%、GLE 43.8%、Q5 42.8% 同一族群。

外推，非同世代實價：台灣 Q8 2021/03 才上市，市場上最老只有 5.4 年，7 年車不存在，不編造。依規則改用前代／同級大型 Audi SUV（Q7 4M，同底盤同級）的殘值比再套回本車。路徑 A：8891 auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7 實抓「Audi Q7 2019 款 55 TFSI quattro 3.0L｜2019 年掛牌｜1.4 萬公里｜180.0 萬」，7.4 年、原價 371 萬（7car.tw/articles/read/57736 記載 Q7 車系 296／318／371 萬，55 TFSI quattro 為頂規）→ 車商售價 48.5%；但該車 14,000 km（約 1,900 km/年）比本車 49,000 km 還極端，且為孤例喊價，向下校正約 -7% → 45%，套回 413 萬得車商售價約 186 萬。路徑 B：本車自身曲線外推，第 5 年車商售價約 47.5%，第 7 年出保後市場開始把氣壓避震與 V6 過保風險計入，續跌至約 39-40%，得約 163 萬。兩路徑取中約 165 萬車商售價，自售低約 12% → 145 萬。dealer_tradein 再低約 15%。
對 real_cost 為 36.3%，落在本表 Cayenne 36.7%、GLE 36.5%、X5 36.4% 之間、Q5 33.5% 之上。第 7 年已出保（原廠保固 3 年），尾段持續下墜而不像 Lexus 走平。路徑 A 與 B 分歧達 14%，且 A 的唯一依據是一台極端低里程的孤例開價（非成交價），故 confidence 維持 low。

外推，非同世代實價：Q8 不存在 10 年車。依規則改用前代大型 Audi SUV（Q7 4M）的殘值比。8891 auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q7 實抓三筆 10-11 年車，各自對照 FindCar 2016 年 Q7 分車型新車價（findcar.com.tw/datalist.aspx?u=0&b=5&m=47&y=2016 實抓，該頁列出 40 TFSI quattro 五／七人座 275／283 萬、40 TFSI quattro Luxury 五／七人座 289／297 萬、45 TDI quattro 五／七人座 351／359 萬、45 TFSI quattro 五／七人座 367／375 萬）：(a) 45 TFSI quattro 七人座、100,000 km、69.9 萬 ÷ 375 萬 = 18.6%；(b) 40 TFSI quattro Luxury 七人座、100,000 km、56.8-57.8 萬 ÷ 297 萬 = 19.1-19.5%；(c) 45 TDI quattro 七人座、177,400 km、59.9 萬 ÷ 359 萬 = 16.7%（里程更高故更低，方向一致）。取 (a)(b) 得 10 年、100,000 km 車商售價殘值比約 18.9%。本車 10 年僅 70,000 km，低里程約 +6% → 約 20.0%，套回新車價 4,130,000 得車商售價約 83 萬，自售低約 12% → 73 萬。dealer_tradein 再低約 18%（10 年車車商收購折讓最大）。
【與前一版的差異】前一版填 82 萬，分母用錯：它拿 FindCar 該頁的「2016 年 Q7 全車系新車均價 324.5 萬」去除 45 TFSI quattro 七人座 的 69.9 萬，得 21.5%。但 69.9 萬那台的實際新車價是 375 萬（均價 324.5 萬含 275 萬起的 40 TFSI 入門車型），用車系均價當分母把殘值比高估了約 15%。改用同車型正確分母後為 18.6%，並用第二筆（40 TFSI Luxury 七人座）交叉驗證得 19.1-19.5%，兩者一致。對 real_cost 為 18.3%，與本表 X5 18.3%、Cayenne 18.8% 同位置。旗艦車第 10 年跌更兇：修理風險與車價同步放大（氣壓避震四支、48V 鋰電池、V6 漏油）。註：Audi 原廠認證通路 approvedplus.audi.com.tw/listing/2590/q7 有一台 2016/12 領牌、82,127 km 掛 138 萬，與 8891 一般行情差距過大（疑為未下架的舊頁面），未採用。

maintenance.plan_notes:
保養節奏由「時間」而非「里程」決定。Audi Taiwan 的定期保養為 1 年或 10,000-15,000 km 先到者；本車 7,000 km/年，十年只跑 70,000 km，因此十年間就是每年進廠一次共 10 次，里程幾乎不觸發任何額外保養，但輪胎、電瓶、煞車油、冷卻液這些耗材一樣會因「年限老化」而必須更換——這是低里程車主最容易低估的一塊。
單次費用基準：Audi Taiwan 官方「保養透明 安心啟航」線上查價（service-pricing.audi-service.com.tw）本次實抓確認為官方定期保養費用查詢工具，但只查得到 A1 Sportback 級距的數字（10,500-11,500），Q8 專屬報價查不到。另由 car.faqs.tw 整理的同一套官方表，A1 Sportback 30 TFSI（1.0L 三缸）每 10,000 km 小保 8,300-9,300 元、60,000 km 大保（含機油、機油濾芯、粉塵濾芯、煞車油、火星塞、空氣濾芯、自動變速箱油、變速箱螺塞）19,100-20,100 元。Q8 是 3.0 V6，機油量、濾芯規格與工時都遠高於 A1，實務上約為 A1 的 1.8-2.3 倍，故本表年度小保取約 15,000、四年一次的大保取約 45,000。此換算為推估，非官方 Q8 專屬報價，因此第 5 年之後各期一律標 low。
原廠保固為 3 年不限里程（audi.com.tw/zh/Audi_Service/regular-warranty/），因此第 1、3 年只付保養工料、故障維修為零。Audi Taiwan 歷來常搭配「3 年 5 萬公里免費保養」之類的上市專案（promotion.u-car.com.tw/promotion/article/10239），若本車購入時適用，第 1 期與第 3 期可再降到接近 0；本表保守假設「未適用免費保養專案」，僅在此註明。第 5 年之後一律以完全自費、無任何補貼計算。
本車三個貴在後段的結構性項目：(1) 標配 adaptive air suspension 氣壓式懸吊——四支氣壓避震器與打氣機在台灣是 7 年後的經典故障點，單支原廠更換 6-9 萬、外廠修復件 2.5-4 萬；(2) 21 吋 285/45R21 胎——一套四條含工約 7 萬，且在此里程下是「橡膠老化到期」而非磨到胎紋才換，約每 5 年一套；(3) 48V 輕油電的鋰電池與皮帶式啟動發電機（BAS），以及對 12V AGM 電瓶的高負擔。第 7 年起改以「原廠 + 專業修護廠混用」計價（外廠約原廠 6-7 成），這也是台灣德系車主過保後的實際行為。十年合計 1,015,000，與本表 Porsche Cayenne 1,044,000、BMW X5 1,002,000 同一量級，約為日系同級的 2.5 倍以上。

major_items: 第 1 次年度定期保養（時間觸發，7,000 km 遠未達里程門檻）
