value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,980,000. I re-read the 8891 inventory page (auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/4-series/420i-coupe) directly on 2026-08-12 and pulled the full 2025 (1-year-old) 420i M Sport Coupé set at this buyer's mileage: 1,530 km @ 2,080,000; 4,000 km @ 2,288,000 (three listings); 6,000 km @ 2,188,000; 11,000 km @ 2,100,000; 15,000 km @ 2,150,000; 15,800 km @ 2,150,000 (plus one 12,000 km at 電洽). Median ask ~2,169,000; interpolating to 7,000 km gives ~2,180,000. ALL of these are 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), never copied into private_sale_price. DENOMINATOR CORRECTED TOO: the researcher guessed the 2025 420i M Sport Coupé list at ~2,540,000; the real figure is 2,610,000 (8891 新車 2025 4-Series Coupe, '售價261萬起'; 2024 was 255萬). So the dealer ask is 83.5% of list, not the 86% claimed. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% from dealer retail to private sale = ~1,918,000, taken to 1,900,000 because at year 1 a private seller competes directly against discounted new stock and near-new registered demos. That is 73.2% of real_cost and 70.6% of list - a ~27% first-year loss off list, the classic German year-one hit and nowhere near a Japanese equivalent. Dealer trade-in 1,650,000, a further 13% below private, consistent with dealers buying near 1.65M to re-ask 2.08-2.29M.

CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,740,000, which sat above what the market anchor supports. Direct read of 8891 on 2026-08-12: the 3-year-old point is a 2023 420i M Sport Coupé at 16,000 km asking 1,920,000 - but the page shows a 1,920,000 / 16,000 km cluster appearing four times across BOTH 2023 and 2024 model years, so this is duplicated inventory, not four independent cars. Evidence is genuinely thin and I have not pretended otherwise. Neighbouring real points bound it: 2024 @ 15,300 km = 2,080,000 (twice) and 2024 @ 15,800 km = 2,150,000 above, 2021 @ 14,000 km = 1,658,000 below. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -2% off the 1,920,000 dealer ask for this buyer's higher 21,000 km = ~1,880,000 dealer retail, then -12% to reach private sale = ~1,654,000, taken to 1,660,000 (64.0% of real_cost). Trade-in a further 13% below. The year 1-3 slope is gentler than year 1 because the steepest German loss is the initial new-to-used gap; it steepens again once the factory cover lapses.

CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,400,000. Comparable verified by direct read of 8891 on 2026-08-12: 2021 420i M Sport Coupé (G22, same generation as this car) at 14,000 km, dealer retail ask 1,658,000. That car is a freak at 2,800 km/yr, below even this low-mileage buyer, so a -7% mileage adjustment to reach 35,000 km gives ~1,542,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% from dealer retail to private sale = ~1,357,000, set at 1,360,000 (52.4% of real_cost). Trade-in a further 15% below private - a wider dealer cut than at years 1-3, because year 5 is the first checkpoint fully outside the 3-year factory warranty (4 years if the extension was taken) and the dealer now carries German repair risk on his own floor. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from the researcher's 'medium' to 'low': this rests on ONE usable comparable plus a mileage extrapolation, which is the definition of a single weak data point under this table's rules. The researcher's supporting cross-check (a 2023 430i Gran Coupé at 54,882 km) is a different body style and generation and I could not re-verify it, so I have not leaned on it.

EXTRAPOLATED - no genuine 7-year data exists for this generation and none has been invented. The G22 4 Series launched in Taiwan in 2021, so the oldest real examples are 5 years old. Method as prescribed: take real PREDECESSOR F32 420i Coupé listings, express them as a retention ratio of the F32's own list price, then apply that ratio to this car's real_cost. F32 evidence re-read directly from 8891 on 2026-08-12, WITH TWO OF THE RESEARCHER'S DATES CORRECTED - the two listings they cited as '2018 M Sport' are actually 2017 cars: 2018 420i Coupe (base/標準 trim, not M Sport) at 50,000 km asking 728,000, an almost exact mileage match for this buyer; 2017 420i M Sport at 95,000 km asking 768,000; 2017 420i Sport Line at 90,000 km asking 667,000; 2017 420i M Sport at 120,000 km asking 688,000. The 2017 M Sport vs 2017 Sport Line pair at similar mileage shows an ~15% M Sport premium. Building a 7-year (2019) M Sport at 49,000 km from these gives ~885,000 dealer retail against an F32 420i M Sport list of ~2,300,000 = 38.5%. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% to private sale = 33.9% of list, applied to real_cost 2,595,000 -> 880,000. THE RESEARCHER'S UNSOURCED +5% NUDGE REMOVED: they computed ~900,000 by the same method and then raised it to 950,000 'because the G22 is a more desirable car', which is an opinion, not evidence. Trade-in a further 17% below private: a 7-year out-of-warranty German coupé is real inventory risk. The cliff from year 5 (52.4% to 33.9%) is partly warranty expiry and partly the G22-to-F32 splice; the F32 tail in Taiwan really is this brutal, as the 768,000 ask on a 2017 M Sport shows.

EXTRAPOLATED - same method and same reason as year 7; the current generation is only 5 years old so no real 10-year data can exist. Real F32 predecessor listings re-read directly from 8891 on 2026-08-12, again with the researcher's dates corrected against the live page: 2017 420i Sport Line at 90,000 km asking 667,000 (9 years old); 2015 420i Sport Line at 80,000 km asking 598,000 (11 years); 2015 420i M Sport at 170,000 km asking 550,000; 2014 420i Sport Line at 150,000 km asking 398,000 (the researcher logged this as 2015); 2014 420i M Sport at 157,000 km asking 528,000; 2014 420i Coupe at 120,000 km asking 488,000. Interpolating to a 10-year (2016) M Sport at this buyer's 70,000 km gives ~690,000 dealer retail. Against an F32 420i Coupé Sport Line list of 2,180,000 (M Sport ~2,300,000) that is 30.0% of list as a dealer ask. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -13% to private sale = 26.1% of list, applied to real_cost 2,595,000 -> 675,000 (26.0%). Trade-in a further 18% below private - at ten years most dealers take a German car in at scrap-adjacent money because the repair exposure is uncapped. The tail keeps sliding (33.9% to 26.0%) rather than flattening, which is the defining difference from a Lexus at this age.

maintenance.plan_notes: period_cost is the spend SINCE THE PREVIOUS checkpoint, never cumulative (1 = 0-1y, 3 = 1-3y, 5 = 3-5y, 7 = 5-7y, 10 = 7-10y). Ten-year total ~547,000, materially above a Japanese equivalent and above the 462,000 carried by the BMW X3 record in this batch, which is right for a coupé on staggered 19-inch runflats. THE BIGGEST STRUCTURAL FACT, RE-VERIFIED THIS ROUND: BMW Taiwan (汎德) bundles a 3年／4萬公里原廠保養套裝 (prepaid factory service package) with every new combustion car, alongside a 3-year warranty, with some campaigns adding 原廠第4年延長保固 and 一年乙式全險. At 7,000 km/yr this buyer reaches only 21,000 km in three years, so the 40,000 km cap NEVER binds and the package absorbs essentially all scheduled servicing for years 0-3. That is why years 1 and 3 look almost free. It is a subsidy, not low cost, so the later periods carry the FULL unsubsidised bill with nothing amortised away. INTERVALS ARE TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: at 7,000 km/yr the Condition Based Service system triggers on the calendar - annual oil service, brake fluid every 2 years, filters, coolant, and age-out of tyres and the 12V battery all arrive long before any distance threshold. Low mileage does not save this car; rubber and chemistry age regardless. THE STEP CHANGE AT YEAR 3-5 IS REAL, NOT AN ARTEFACT: 12,000 for the whole 1-3y window versus 118,000 for 3-5y is the package ending and the consumables cycle landing at once (first tyre set, 12V battery, spark plugs, brake fluid, first unsubsidised services). THE B48 RISK CLUSTER drives years 5-10: the electric water pump, thermostat, oil filter housing gasket and valve cover gasket are the documented failure group on this engine family, and Taiwan specialists recommend doing them together because the pump job alone requires pulling the intake manifold, alternator and A/C compressor. A probability-weighted provision sits at 5-7y and the near-certain full job at 7-10y. ON 48V: the previous version of this record asserted the Taiwan 420i has no 48V system and used that to explicitly zero out the mild-hybrid starter-generator as a risk item. That claim could not be independently confirmed, so this plan no longer makes it - the year 7-10 electrical provision is written to absorb a starter-generator if one is fitted. Costs assume BMW dealer rates for years 0-5 and a dealer / reputable independent BMW specialist mix from year 5 on, which is what most Taiwanese owners actually do post-warranty. Labour and parts anchors come from Mobile01 owner receipts for the closely related G20 320i (same B48 engine, same dealer network): a routine service invoice around 15,000, and a larger work order around 36,000 itemising brake pads at 8,750 and an air filter at 1,300.

checkpoints.source: First fully unsubsidised window - the factory package has ended and the warranty has lapsed (3yr, or 4yr if the extension was taken). Service labour and parts benchmarked to Mobile01 owner receipts for the same B48 engine in the G20 320i (routine invoice ~15,000; itemised brake pads 8,750, air filter 1,300). Tyre cost from current Taiwan pricing for staggered 19-inch runflats on M Sport rolling stock, which is where a large slice of this figure sits and where a Japanese equivalent on 17-inch non-runflats would spend roughly a third as much. Tyres and the 12V battery land here because at 7,000 km/yr both age out on the calendar around year 5 with tread and cranking capacity nominally left. Confidence medium: the item list and intervals are solid, individual quotes vary by workshop.

checkpoints.source: Fully out of warranty. The B48 water pump and thermostat are documented Taiwan-market common failures ('水泵浦漏水是常見的通病之一'), with local specialists recommending water pump, thermostat and oil filter housing be done together because the job requires removing the intake manifold, alternator and A/C compressor - hence a partial probability-weighted provision here and the full job at 7-10y rather than pretending it never happens. The M Racing Edition's uprated M brake kit costs more to refresh than standard discs. Transmission oil is BMW-'lifetime' but universally recommended by independents by this age. The previous version of this record carried a note here asserting that no 48V starter-generator need be budgeted; that claim was not independently verifiable and has been removed. Confidence low because the failure-timing weighting is judgement, not a quoted invoice.

checkpoints.source: Three-year window on a 7-to-10-year-old BMW with no factory cover of any kind. Item list assembled from documented B48 failure patterns in Taiwan (water pump, thermostat, oil filter housing and valve cover gasket leaks are the recognised cluster at this age) plus age-driven consumables that ignore the low 21,000 km covered in this window - the second tyre set, the second 12V battery, coolant and rubber suspension components all age out on the calendar. ~97,000/yr average. The electrical provision is deliberately worded to absorb a mild-hybrid starter-generator if the Taiwan 420i turns out to carry 48V, since the prior claim that it does not could not be confirmed. This is the half of the story that separates a German coupé from a Japanese one: a RAV4 over the same window would be a fraction of this. Confidence low - a risk-weighted composite, not quoted invoices, and actual spend swings widely on whether the gasket and pump cluster lands early or late.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses 7,000 km/year (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km), roughly half the Taiwan average. Servicing is therefore TIME-driven, not mileage-driven: BMW's CBS calls an annual oil service long before the ~10,000-15,000 km trigger, and brake fluid (2-year clock), coolant, tyres and the 12V AGM battery age out rather than wear out. Free insurance and 0% financing offers, where they exist, are real economic value but are excluded because insurance and financing are out of scope. On-road fees NT$75,000 (~2.5% of list, scaled to a 300萬-class import): 領牌規費 + 代辦 ~8,000, window film ~25,000, paint coating ~25,000, dash cam + mats + sundries ~17,000. Tax and insurance excluded by design. real_cost = 2,990,000 - 120,000 + 75,000 = 2,945,000. value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN ~4% from the original submission. Re-scraped 8891中古車 (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series/520i, 260 live listings, 122 rows read across 3 pages today). Real current-generation G60 520i M Sport listings, all 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking): 2025-reg at 9,000 km asking 238.0萬 (two listings, both BMW 原廠認證中古車 / BPS 原廠保固); 2025-reg at 20,000-21,000 km asking 229.8萬 (元禾國際車業, three listings); 2024-reg at 9,000-15,000 km asking 220.0-227.8萬; 2024-reg at 3,100 km asking 228.0萬. CORRECTION APPLIED: the original record anchored on the 238萬 BPS-certified cars and then took only a 10% haircut. BPS certification is a dealer product (extended factory warranty, certified inspection) that a private seller cannot offer, so it is stripped out first: ordinary dealer retail for a 1-year / 7,000 km car is ~232萬, and low mileage is already priced in versus the 20,000 km cars. Private sale then set 12.5% below ordinary dealer retail = NT$2,030,000, reflecting that a private seller offers no warranty, no financing and no 過戶 service, and competes against unregistered 韓規 parallel imports listed at 219.8萬. Dealer trade-in a further 13% below private = NT$1,760,000. Implies a ~31% loss in year one - the front-loaded German first-year hit, far worse than a Japanese equivalent.

Note the observed F10-to-G30 cliff between 2016-reg (43-56萬) and 2017-reg (66.8-85.8萬) cars is a GENERATION break, not a pure age effect, and our car will be on the wrong side of exactly such a break at year 10.

maintenance.plan_notes: BMW Taiwan (importer 汎德) gives 3 years' unlimited-mileage warranty as standard. CRITICALLY, that covers REPAIRS ONLY: Taiwan does not bundle free scheduled servicing, which 汎德 sells separately as an optional 保養套餐. So years 0-3 are cheap because failures are someone else's problem, but the owner still pays every 定保 invoice; from year 3 onward the periods carry the FULL unsubsidised cost including repair risk. At 7,000 km/year the interval is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven: BMW's CBS system calls an annual oil service well before the ~10,000-15,000 km trigger, and brake fluid (2 years), coolant, tyres and the 12V AGM battery all age out rather than wear out. Dealer rates come from two Taiwanese cost breakdowns: basic oil+filter service NT$5,000-12,000 (owner work orders quoted at 8,000-9,600 / 8,500-8,700 / 8,500-10,000 for the first three services); brake fluid 2,500-4,500; cabin/air filters 2,000-5,000 each; spark plugs 4,000-10,000; gearbox oil 12,000-25,000; pads per axle 4,000-8,000; discs per axle 8,000-20,000; AGM battery 8,000-15,000 (needs computer registration); tyres 3,500-12,000+ each - this car wears staggered 19-inch rubber, so a set runs ~46,000. A 60,000 km major service is quoted at 20,000-35,000 at a dealer. Later periods deliberately carry German-specific risk items: electric water pump and thermostat, valve-cover gasket oil seepage, coil packs, dampers, and the 48V lithium pack / BSG starter-generator, which has no cheap aftermarket answer. NOT included: air suspension - the 520i M Sport runs conventional M Sport suspension, so an air-strut failure line would be wrong. SOURCING WARNING added during fact-checking: the itemised price table used for the later periods (比迪行銷) carries an explicit disclosure at the foot of the page that the article was written by AI ('本文由AI創作'), and the other source's work orders are from 3 Series / 4 Series / X1 owners, not a 5 Series. Both are plausible and mutually consistent, but neither is a 汎德 price list or a 5 Series invoice, so the years 5 and 7 checkpoints were downgraded to low confidence. That same source benchmarks BMW in-warranty servicing at 6,000-9,500 per visit against 3,000-4,500 for a Japanese domestic car, and a 60,000 km major service at 20,000-35,000 against 8,000-12,000 - i.e. roughly 2-2.5x, which is the ratio this plan reproduces. Total 10-year spend NT$463,000 (~NT$6.6/km), about 2.5x what a RAV4-class Japanese car would cost over the same period.

assumptions.notes:
低里程車主：每年 6,000-8,000 km，取中位 7,000 km/年，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km/年。各檢查點 assumed_km = 7000 × years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。

保養節奏：本次查核獨立重抓台北依德 BMW（yiderbmw.wordpress.com/bmw-service-extend/）並逐字確認兩點——「於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養」與「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務」。在 7,000 km/年 下永遠碰不到 1 萬公里觸發點，因此保養完全由時間驅動，10 年正好進廠 10 次、累積約 70,000 km。

動力歸類：735i 為 3.0L 直列六缸渦輪（B58，2,998 c.c.、272 hp/5000 rpm）搭配 48V 輕油電（額外 18 hp）。48V 系統無法純電行駛，依本表規則歸為 gasoline 而非 hybrid（U-CAR 規格表本次獨立實抓，「汽油／直列6汽缸」逐字確認）。

稅金與保險依設計排除在外（供參考：U-CAR 規格表列本車燃料稅 7,200 元/年、牌照稅 15,210 元/年，兩者皆未計入）。

【查核新增的世代風險修正】G70 於 2022 年 12 月在台上市（U-CAR 內文確認），本車為 2026 年式 pre-LCI；G70 LCI 預期 2026-2027 年登場。原始記錄只在第 5 年才把「世代更替折價」計入，但那不成立——LCI 若在 2026-27 年登場，本車在自己的第 1-2 年就已經是 pre-LCI，折價會提前發生，不會等到第 5 年。前代 G11 的實價直接證明這個斷崖有多大：2019 年掛牌（LCI）730i 層峰旗艦版 50,000 km 開價 148.0 萬，2018 年掛牌（pre-LCI）730i Luxury 105,000 km 開價 85.8 萬，僅差一個年式、價差逾 40%（里程不同會放大，但方向與量級明確）。因此本次查核把第 1、3 年的殘值由「今天市場上還是現行世代的 G70 掛牌價」向下修正，理由與幅度寫在各 checkpoint 的 source。

purchase.source:
價格已由本次查核獨立重抓驗證，維持 4,930,000 不變（與原始記錄一致，誤差 0%）。實抓 U-CAR 新車規格表（newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/7%20series/6498/overall，HTTP 200）逐格確認表列內容：「735i Luxury｜493｜2,998｜汽油｜直列6汽缸｜八前速手自排｜後輪驅動｜272 hp/5000 rpm｜12.3 km/l｜燃7,200 / 牌15,210」，即建議售價 NT$4,930,000。同頁內文亦確認價格歷程：G70 於 2022 年 12 月導入台灣，燃油三車型 488 萬 735i Luxury / 595 萬 740i Luxury / 638 萬 740i Excellence，後調升為 493 萬 / 600 萬 / 640 萬（735i 與 740i Luxury 各漲 5 萬、740i Excellence 漲 2 萬，追加手機遙控停車）。735i Luxury 為台灣 7 Series 燃油版入門車型。

BMW Taiwan 官網（bmw.com.tw）本次查核亦獨立嘗試抓取，回傳 HTTP 000（連線失敗），與原始記錄的描述一致，確認並非誤述；因官網未提供任何內容，該 URL 已從 sources[] 移除，不列為來源。折讓與領牌費為台灣汎德經銷通路慣例推估，非官方公告。
purchase.notes:
動力與配備辨識：735i Luxury（G70，3.0L B58 直列六缸渦輪 2,998 c.c. + 48V 輕油電，272 hp / 40.8 kgm，後輪驅動，八速手自排，長軸單一車身）。48V 輕油電額外提供 18 hp 並改善油耗，但無法純電行駛，故 powertrain 記為 gasoline，此處註明 48V 系統（本表規則：48V mild hybrid 一律 gasoline）。

list_price 4,930,000 為現行官方建議售價（U-CAR 規格表本次獨立實抓）。

discounts 取 300,000（約 6.1%）：7 Series 是台灣年掛牌量極低的旗艦房車，庫存成本高、汎德與經銷商有實質議價空間，實務上以現金折讓 20-40 萬搭配配件與低利分期為常見組合。未比照量產車給更大折扣，是因為旗艦車單台毛利結構與走量車不同；本資料庫既有的 BMW X3 記錄為牌價 249 萬成交 218 萬（-12.4%），那是競爭最激烈的中型 SUV 級距，不宜套用。此幅度仍缺一份真正的 7 Series 成交菜單佐證，列為 open question。

onroad_fees 取 65,000 = 領牌規費約 5,000 + 代辦費約 5,000 + 交車配件約 55,000（高階隔熱紙、鍍膜、行車紀錄器、迎賓踏板、行李廂墊）。與本資料庫級距對齊：GLC 200（274 萬）取 40,000、Porsche Cayenne（419 萬）取 60,000，本車 493 萬取 65,000。

real_cost = 4,930,000 - 300,000 + 65,000 = 4,695,000。牌照稅與燃料稅依設計不計入。

items.name: 過戶費（監理規費 + 代辦）
售前整備／美容（內裝深度清潔、鍍膜、輪圈整理）
刊登費（8891 個人自售刊登）

selling_costs.notes: 取本級距上緣，查核後維持不變。過戶規費加代辦約 2,500；成本主要在售前整備：493 萬的旗艦房車自售時，買方對內裝皮革、水晶內裝套件、大尺寸輪圈與車漆的檢視標準遠高於一般車，不做深度美容會直接反映在成交價，9,000 為實務合理支出。刊登費以 8891 個人自售方案估 3,000。合計 14,500，落在本級距 6,000-15,000 區間上緣，符合旗艦車定位。

value_checkpoints.source:
【本次查核已下修】資料來源為 8891 中古車 G70 735i 實際掛牌（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/735i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓，HTTP 200，解析出 n=14 筆，價格區間 10.8 萬~433.0 萬，與原始記錄描述一致）。近新車實際掛牌：2025 年掛牌 2025 款 735i Luxury / 3,000 km 開價 418.0 萬；2025 年掛牌 2026 款 735i Pure Excellence / 2,000 km 418.0 萬；2025 年掛牌 2026 款 735i M Edition / 3,000 km 433.0 萬；2024 年掛牌 2024 款 Luxury / 4,858 km 382.0 萬；2024 年掛牌 2025 款 Luxury / 4,000 km 382.0 萬。

【修正 1：車商開價基準】原始記錄取 415 萬，等於幾乎照抄那筆唯一的 1 年 Luxury 開價 418.0 萬。該筆有兩個問題：(a) 它是該車齡唯一一筆 Luxury 樣本；(b) 它的開價與更高階的 Pure Excellence 完全相同（同為 418.0 萬），顯示屬偏高的個別喊價，而非級距行情。相對地，兩筆 2024 年掛牌 Luxury 在 382.0 萬完全一致（n=2 互相印證），是更可靠的錨點。取 1 年車商開價 408 萬（高於 2 年群聚的 382 萬、低於單筆偏高的 418 萬）。

【修正 2：世代時點】今天的 1 年車仍是「現行世代」，本車滿 1 年時（2027）G70 LCI 預期已登場、本車已成 pre-LCI，故不能直接套用今天的行情，額外下修約 4%。

【車商售價 → 自售價】408 萬為車商零售開價（dealer retail asking），非車主拿得到的錢。旗艦房車庫存周轉慢、車商單台押的利息與毛利高，取價差區間高端 -15%：408 萬 × 0.85 ≈ 347 萬，再套世代時點 -4% ≈ 333 萬，記為 3,330,000（real_cost 的 70.9%）。dealer_tradein_price 取自售價 85% = 2,830,000。confidence 由原始記錄的 high 下修為 medium：掛牌樣本雖真實且多筆，但 private_sale_price 本身從未被觀測到，是換算值，且已再疊加世代時點判斷。

【本次查核已下修】8891 中古車 G70 735i Luxury 同世代同車型實際掛牌（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/735i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓）。3 年車真實樣本：2023 年掛牌 735i Luxury / 44,000 km 318.8 萬、/ 53,000 km 318.8 萬、/ 76,000 km 279.8 萬（3 筆同價）；另 2022 年掛牌（約 3.7 年）735i Luxury / 24,000 km 299.8 萬。

【車商開價基準】本車主第 3 年僅 21,000 km，遠低於 44,000-76,000 km 的市場樣本，享有低里程溢價。兩條路徑收斂：(a) 由 44,000 km 的 318.8 萬往下修里程，約 +3~5% → 約 330 萬；(b) 由 3.7 年 / 24,000 km 的 299.8 萬往回推 0.7 年（本世代觀察到的年跌幅約 45 萬/年）→ 約 331 萬。取車商開價 330 萬。註：原始記錄取 325 萬，方向正確但略保守，此處依實價上修。

【修正：世代時點】此為對本記錄最實質的修正。原始記錄只在第 5 年才把世代更替折價計入，但本車 2026 年式為 pre-LCI、LCI 預期 2026-2027 登場，本車在第 3 年（2029）早已是上一世代，且次世代已在望。今天觀測到的 3 年行情屬「仍是現行世代」的 G70，直接套用會高估。前代 G11 的實價證明這個斷崖量級很大：2019 年掛牌（LCI）730i 層峰旗艦版 / 50,000 km 148.0 萬 vs 2018 年掛牌（pre-LCI）730i Luxury / 105,000 km 85.8 萬，僅差一個年式。故對第 3 年施加約 -8% 的 pre-LCI 折價。

【換算】330 萬 × 0.86（車商售價 → 自售價，-14%）≈ 284 萬，再乘 pre-LCI 折價 0.92 ≈ 261 萬，記為 2,610,000（real_cost 的 55.6%）。dealer_tradein_price 取自售價 85% = 2,210,000。confidence 由 high 下修為 medium：掛牌樣本真實且有 4 筆同世代同車型，但最終數字已疊加兩層判斷（自售換算、pre-LCI 折價），不再是可直接讀出的觀測值。

【外推，非同世代實價；查核後維持金額、調整 tradein】G70 於 2022 年 12 月才在台上市，市場上最老的同世代車僅約 3.7 年，第 5 年沒有同世代真實行情，依規則改用前代 G11（2016-2022）同齡低里程車的殘值比再套回本車 real_cost。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓，HTTP 200，解析出 36 筆）：2022 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 13,000 km 199.0 萬（車齡 4 年、極低里程）；2021 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 99,000 km 143.0 萬（5 年、高里程）；2020 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 46,500 km 153.8 萬（6 年）。以本車主 35,000 km 的低里程條件內插，前代車齡 5 年的車商開價約 175 萬。

前代 LCI（2019 年小改）730i 層峰旗艦版原始新車價採約 430 萬——此為估計值，本次查核未能找到可驗證的官方或媒體價格頁（U-CAR 僅保留現行 G70 規格頁，前代頁面查無），故此分母仍是本檢查點最大的不確定來源，敏感度見 open questions。前代第 5 年低里程殘值比 ≈ (175 萬 × 0.87 自售換算) / 430 萬 ≈ 35.4%。

對照 G70 自身 1-3.7 年走勢外推約 46%，兩者差距主因是世代更替：今天的 G11 之所以殘值低，正因它已被 G70 取代，而本車在第 5 年（2031）同樣是上一世代（甚至已接近上兩世代）。加權後偏向前代比率，取 40.0% × 4,695,000 ≈ 1,880,000。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 83% 調整為 84% = 1,580,000，使其落在本表規定的「較自售價再低 10-15%」區間內。

【外推，非同世代實價；查核後維持金額、上修 tradein】第 7 年同世代資料不存在，改用前代 G11 同齡低里程車殘值比。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓並逐筆核對）：2019 年掛牌（車齡 7 年）730i 層峰旗艦版 / 50,000 km 開價 148.0 萬、/ 53,000 km 開價 146.8 萬——這兩筆的里程幾乎正好等於本車主第 7 年的 49,000 km，是全表匹配度最高的樣本，原始記錄引用無誤；同年份較高里程者：93,000-94,000 km 開價 128.0-128.8 萬、120,000 km 開價 118.0 萬。

取車商開價 147 萬，以前代 LCI 車型原價約 430 萬（估計值，見第 5 年說明）計，自售換算 (147 萬 × 0.87) / 430 萬 ≈ 29.7%。套回本車 real_cost：29.8% × 4,695,000 ≈ 1,400,000。此時原廠 2+1 年不限里程保固早已結束（依德實抓確認），中古市場已把氣壓懸吊、後軸轉向等高價修繕風險折進價格，這是德系旗艦第 7 年之後續跌而非打平的結構性原因。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 81% 上修為 83% = 1,160,000：81% 已落在本表「較自售價再低 10-15%」的規定區間之外，屬過度折價。

【外推，但錨定在真實的 10 年車實價上；查核後維持金額、上修 tradein】第 10 年同世代資料不存在，改用前代 G11 同齡低里程車殘值比。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓並逐筆核對）：2016 年掛牌（車齡正好 10 年）730i 樣本 7 筆——55,000 km 79.8 萬、55,700 km 79.8 萬、122,000 km 72.8 萬、130,000 km 68.8 萬、139,000 km 68.8 萬、148,300 km 69.8 萬、170,000 km 75.8 萬。原始記錄引用完全正確。本車主第 10 年為 70,000 km，介於 55,000 與 122,000 km 之間，內插得車商開價約 76 萬。

前代原始新車價在此有直接證據（本次查核已在原始 HTML 中逐字複驗）：同一批掛牌中一則 2016 款 730i 的車商標題自述「【新車價近 380 萬｜現在不用 80 萬入主】」，即 2016 款 730i 原價約 380 萬。故前代 10 年低里程殘值比 = (76 萬 × 0.87 自售換算) / 380 萬 ≈ 17.4%。套回本車：17.5% × 4,695,000 ≈ 820,000。

此比率是本資料庫德系車中最低的（對照 Porsche Cayenne 18.8%、BMW X3 23.8%、Mercedes GLC 26.6%），符合大型旗艦房車的市場現實：買家極少、修繕風險最高、屆時已落後兩個世代。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 78% 上修為 81% = 660,000：78% 明顯超出本表「較自售價再低 10-15%」的規定區間。10 年車齡的 7 Series 多數車商確實不願收，但那反映在「收不收」而非把收購價再壓到 -22%。

maintenance.plan_notes:
時間驅動，不是里程驅動。本次查核獨立重抓台北依德 BMW（yiderbmw.wordpress.com/bmw-service-extend/，HTTP 200）並逐字複驗兩件事：(a) 延長保固購買資格寫明「於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養」，即保養週期為兩者先到；(b)「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務」即 3 年不限里程。在 7,000 km/年 下永遠觸發不到 1 萬公里，因此本車主 10 年只進廠 10 次年度保養，總里程約 70,000 km。

保養套餐與延長保固：BMW Service Inclusive（BSI）在台灣是付費選購而非新車附贈；依德的延長保固方案同樣要加價購，且資格要求在 36 個月保固到期前完成「新車保固到期檢查」並具備完整原廠保養紀錄。因此本表處理方式為：第 1-3 年只付保養工料、故障維修由原廠保固吸收（前期被保固補貼）；第 5、7、10 年一律以無補貼、全額自費計算，未假設車主購買延長保固。

為什麼 7 Series 的保養必然遠高於日系同級，也高於自家 X3：(1) 全車系標配「電子懸吊系統、前後軸自動水平氣壓式懸吊系統與整合式後軸轉向系統」——本次查核已在 U-CAR 規格頁原始 HTML 中逐字複驗這句話，確認為全車系標配而非選配。氣壓避震器與空氣壓縮機是 7 Series 在 8-10 年區間最典型的高價故障項，後軸轉向致動器同樣是高單價零件，這是 X3 xLine（鋼製彈簧）完全沒有的成本。(2) 3.0L B58 直列六缸的火星塞 6 支、點火線圈 6 顆，數量與工時都比四缸多；B58 的電子水泵、節溫器殼體、氣門室蓋墊片與機油濾芯座墊片漏油是已知的高齡項目。(3) 48V 輕油電的起動發電機與 48V 電池是額外的過保風險件。(4) BMW 標配失壓續跑胎（runflat），7 Series 用 19-21 吋大尺寸，單條原廠胎比同尺寸一般胎貴 25-40%，側邊受損不能補、只能整條換。(5) 車重逾 2 噸，煞車碟盤與來令片尺寸與單價都在 BMW 房車頂端。(6) 汎德對 7 Series 的工時費率是 BMW 車系中最高的一級。

【本次查核調整】10 年合計由原始記錄的 1,088,000 上修為 1,158,000（平均約 115,800/年），全部發生在第 10 年檢查點。原因：原始記錄的第 7-10 年區間只編列「氣壓避震器 2 支 + 空氣壓縮機 120,000」，且把後軸轉向與 48V 系統合併塞進籠統的風險備抵。G70 是前後軸皆為氣壓懸吊的四角系統，8-10 年區間漏氣後常需連同閥體一併處理，且整合式後軸轉向致動器與 48V 起動發電機都是應該被具名列出的高價過保風險件，不應只以綜合備抵帶過。

與本資料庫既有記錄對照：Porsche Cayenne 1,044,000、Mercedes GLE 300d 941,000、Mercedes GLC 200 480,000、BMW X3 462,000。本車高於 Cayenne 是合理的——Cayenne 該筆是標準配備版（氣壓懸吊為選配），而本車氣壓懸吊與後軸轉向皆為標配。

誠實聲明：第 1、3 年的年度保養單價可依 BMW 台灣公開的保養週期與級距推得，可信度較高；第 5、7、10 年的每一筆單價都是風險加權的判斷值，不是實際收據。本次查核同樣嘗試取得車主收據來源，Mobile01 回傳 HTTP 403 Forbidden，完全無法讀取，因此沒有任何一筆 7 Series 的真實維修收據支撐後期數字。原始記錄在 sources[] 列了一個無法驗證的 Mobile01 特定討論串 ID，本次查核已將其移除，改在此處誠實聲明「無法取得任何收據來源」。

sources.name: 台北依德 BMW - 保修服務／依德延長保固方案
sources.note: maintenance 的關鍵制度來源。本次查核獨立重抓（HTTP 200）並逐字複驗：(a)「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務；此外，所有 BMW 原廠非消耗性付費零件以及BMW原廠配件均不限里程」，即 3 年不限里程原廠保固；(b) 延長保固購買資格寫明「新車保固期(36個月內)結束前至BMW台北依德完成『新車保固到期檢查』」與「完整保養紀錄。(於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養)」，直接確認保養週期為「每年或每 1 萬公里先到者」——這是本表「7,000 km/年 下保養完全由時間驅動、10 年 10 次」的依據。因延長保固為加價購而非標配，本表第 5、7、10 年一律以全額自費計算。

assumptions.notes: 買家年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律用 7,000 x 年數（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km）。因為里程極低，殘值採「同年份低里程車」而非里程盲的平均行情，保養則以「時間到期」而非「里程到期」為主軸（原廠 CBS 條件式保養在此里程下等同一年一次）。家用充電樁安裝（含電力申請與佈線，台灣行情約 NT$30,000-80,000）屬於擁車支出但不算保養，已刻意排除在 maintenance 之外；電費、稅金、保險亦全部排除。純電車在台使用牌照稅免徵至 2030/12/31，但依本表設計不計入。i4 eDrive40 為單馬達後驅、83.9 kWh 電池、340 hp、WLTP 600 km，屬純電（bev），非油電、非 48V。查核者註：殘值曲線已重建為德系前重式（year 1 一次跌 28%，其後年衰減約 12-14%，第 8 年高壓電池保固到期後尾段再加速到約 17%/年），取代原研究者「年衰減率隨車齡加速」的後重式曲線。

purchase.source: U-CAR 新車頻道 BMW i4 車款介紹（https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i4/7059/overall）— 查核者以 curl 獨立抓取原始頁面驗證，內文明載「eDrive40 與 M60 xDrive 兩款車型…建議售價部分為 279 萬元與 333 萬元」。與研究者提供的 NT$2,790,000 完全一致（差異 0%），不需修正。
purchase.notes: list_price 2,790,000 為 2025 年 11 月上市之新年式建議售價，是 2026-08 台灣在售車型（價格軌跡：2022 首發 255 萬 → 2024/09 小改款 275 萬 → 2025/11 新年式 279 萬，導入碳化矽 SiC 逆變器、WLTP 續航增至 600 km）。discounts 150,000（約 5.4%）為判斷值而非官方公告：台灣純電豪華轎車買氣偏弱（8891 全台在售 i4 eDrive40 中古車僅 13 台，且其中同一台 6.4 萬 km 車重複刊登 4 次，週轉明顯偏慢），總代理汎德以「優惠選配 Racing Package」（M Sport 空力套件、藍色 M 煞車套件、18 吋 M 型輪圈、M 跑車化電子懸吊）作為主要讓利手段，現金加配件的實質讓利落在 12-18 萬區間，取中值 15 萬。查核者覆核：此值在合理帶內，維持不動。onroad_fees 70,000 = 新領牌照規費與臨時牌約 3,000 + 代辦服務費約 12,000 + 交車配件約 55,000（隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、腳踏墊、迎賓踏板、隨車攜帶式充電器）；純電車貨物稅全免已內含在建議售價，不另計。稅金與保險依設計排除。real_cost = 2,790,000 - 150,000 + 70,000 = 2,710,000。

items.name: 過戶代辦與監理規費
售前整備與美容（拋光鍍膜、內裝清潔、輪胎打氣、小鈑金修補）
8891 個人自售刊登費

selling_costs.notes: 以個人自售（非車商收購）為前提估算。280 萬級距的德系純電轎跑，買方對外觀細節挑剔，售前美容不能省，故整備費取 8,000 而非陽春的 3,000-4,000。合計 12,000，落在此級距 6,000-15,000 的合理帶內。若改走車商收購則過戶與刊登費由車商吸收，但售價要再往下修（見 dealer_tradein_price）。

value_checkpoints.source: 查核者獨立抓取並解析 8891 在售車列表（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i4-edrive40，2026-08-12，Next.js RSC payload，共 13 筆）。低里程實車車商開價：2025 年式 4,241 km 245.0 萬、2024 年式 3,500 km 243.0 萬、3,000 km 232.0 萬、5,900-5,978 km 228.0 萬 x3、9,000 km 218.0 萬。這些全部是「車商售價」且原始牌價為 275 萬（2024/09 小改款）。取真正低里程群的中位開價約 230 萬，套用 -15%（此級距週轉慢、庫存重複刊登，取 8-15% 帶的下緣）得自售約 195.5 萬，再對「本案是 2025/11 SiC 新年式、屆時將面對 Neue Klasse 新世代接手」做小幅前瞻下修，定 195 萬。車商收購 = 195 萬 x 0.867 ≈ 169 萬。修正說明：原研究者給 207 萬（對 real_cost 76.4%），屬豐田等級的保值率，非德系純電應有水準；同批德系純電對照組 year-1 落在 66-69%（EQE 66.5%、EQB 66.7%、EQA 69.1%），本案修正後為 72.0%，仍高於對照組以尊重 i4 確有實車支撐，但已脫離「高 70%」紅區。低里程已計入（一般 1 年車跑 12,000-15,000 km，本案僅 7,000 km）。

錨點是查核者親自抓取驗證的唯一成交訊號：8891 個別車輛頁 https://m.8891.com.tw/auto?id=4331289，payload 確認 makeYear 2022、modelEnName eDrive40、里程 2.59 萬 km、開價 183.0 萬、狀態「已售出」、原始牌價 255.0 萬 → 4 年車車商開價保值率 71.8%。姊妹車交叉驗證（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i4-m50，查核者自行解析）：真正的 2022 年式（4 年車）M50 為 3-3.6 萬 km 開價 189.0-191.0 萬，對 310 萬牌價僅 61.0-61.6%。兩者平均約 66-67% 的 4 年車商開價保值率。扣除「2022-2026 期間 i4 新車牌價由 255 萬漲到 279 萬（+9.4%）把中古行情一起墊高」這個不會重演的順風（x0.906），再以 -13% 由車商開價轉自售，得 4 年自售約 147 萬。本檢查點為 3 年，故定自售 150 萬；車商收購 = 150 萬 x 0.867 ≈ 130 萬。修正說明：原研究者宣稱 M50 的 4 年保值率為 71.6-73.5%，實際上他拿的是 2023 年式（3 年車，222-228 萬）去對 4 年的 eDrive40，年份錯置；真正的 4 年 M50 是 61%，姊妹車證據其實是「反駁」而非支持原曲線。原值 165 萬因此下修至 150 萬。

外推，無真實資料點：i4 台灣 2022 年才上市，市場上最老的只有 4 年車，5 年車尚不存在。以修正後的德系前重式曲線推進（year 1 -28.0%，其後穩定約 13%/年），自 3 年 150 萬推得 5 年自售 113 萬（對 real_cost 41.7%），車商收購 = 113 萬 x 0.854 ≈ 96.5 萬。理由：原廠 3 年不限里程保固（汎德，U-CAR news/article/10646）在第 3 年到期後，中古市場開始對德系純電的維修風險打折。同批對照組 year-5 為 34.8-43.5%（EQE 34.8%、EQB 42.6%、EQA 40.5%、EX40 43.5%），本案 41.7% 落在帶內。低里程（35,000 km，約一般車的一半）已給予正向調整。原研究者給 122 萬，因其 1-3 年曲線過於平緩而偏高，已隨整體曲線重建下修。

外推自「前代德系純電」而非憑空捏造：現行 i4 沒有 7 年車，改用 BMW i3 這台台灣唯一有長期資料的德系純電做保值率代理。查核者親自抓取並解析 8891 在售 i3（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i3，共 4 筆）：2017 年式 REX 14 萬 km 開價 52.0 萬、2016 年式 REX 8.3 萬 km 59.8 萬、2016 年式 REX 9 萬 km 45.8 萬；i3 純電版原牌價 239 萬、REX 版 299 萬（U-CAR news/article/23587）。i3 在 9-10 年殘存約牌價的 15-20%。把 5 年與 10 年兩端沿修正後曲線內插得 7 年自售 84 萬（對 real_cost 31.0%），車商收購 = 84 萬 x 0.851 ≈ 71.5 萬。此時車齡 7 年、原廠保固早過、高壓電池 8 年保固僅剩 1 年，中古市場已在對修復風險定價。同批對照組 year-7 為 26.3-34.5%，本案落在帶內。

外推自前代德系純電 BMW i3 的實際 10 年行情（查核者自行解析 8891，見上）：2016 年式 i3 REX（今年正好 10 年）開價 45.8-59.8 萬、里程 8.3-9.0 萬 km，對 REX 原牌價 299 萬為 15.3-20.0%。這些是車商開價，轉自售約 40-52 萬。i4 條件較佳（83.9 kWh、WLTP 600 km，2036 年仍屬堪用，不像 i3 的 22/33 kWh 那樣被續航淘汰；且本案 70,000 km 遠低於樣本 i3 的 8.3-14 萬 km），故取 48 萬（對 real_cost 17.7%），車商收購 = 48 萬 x 0.844 ≈ 40.5 萬。尾段刻意再加速（7→10 年約 -17.0%/年，高於 5-7 年的 -13.8%/年），反映第 8 年高壓電池保固到期後保固外修復風險被市場定價 — 尾段續跌而非打平，這正是德系純電與 Lexus 的差別。同批對照組 year-10 為 15.8-19.4%，本案落在帶內。

maintenance.plan_notes: 純電車無機油、無火星塞、無變速箱油，再生煞車也讓來令片壽命拉長，所以保養確實比同級燃油 BMW 便宜一大截 — 但絕不接近零。在年行 7,000 km 的條件下，保養節奏完全由「時間」而非「里程」決定：原廠 CBS 條件式保養實際上一年一次，煞車油每 2 年、冷卻液每 5 年、輪胎每 5-6 年（橡膠老化先到，里程根本跑不到磨耗極限），12V 輔助電瓶約 4-6 年一顆 — 這些都跟你開多少無關。保固結構：汎德 BMW 提供 3 年不限里程原廠保固（U-CAR news/article/10646），高壓電池 8 年/16 萬公里。注意這是「保固」不是「免費保養」：台灣的 BSI（BMW Service Inclusive）定期保養套餐是另外加購的，交車時常見的只有首次定保由經銷商吸收，故未把它當標配灌進前期。因此第 0-1 年幾乎不花錢、1-3 年在保固內只付耗材，但第 3 年保固到期後費用一次跳上來，5-10 年必須扛全額無補貼成本，包含德系車在台的高工資率（原廠約 NT$2,500-3,500/小時）與大尺寸煞車、輪胎。第 8 年電池保固也到期後，高壓系統（電子水泵、車載充電模組 OBC、電動壓縮機）成為真正的風險項，7-10 年期已編列預備金；若真的整組電池報廢，修復費會超過車輛殘值，那屬於報廢決策而非保養，不列在此表。全期 10 年合計約 NT$519,000 — 明顯低於同級燃油 BMW 4 系（免了機油、火星塞、水泵、點火線圈、節溫器外殼），但約為同級日系油電（10 年約 NT$200,000 量級）的 2.5-2.6 倍，符合德系應有的水準。交叉驗證：faqs.tw 2026 電動車保養整理給 BMW i4 五年 NT$73,000-140,000（以年 15,000 km 計），本表五年累計 NT$132,000 落在其區間上緣，合理 — 因為本表額外含一組輪胎與 12V 電瓶。查核者覆核：分期金額與項目經對照同批德系純電（EQE 573,000、EQB 571,000）後判定量級正確，未更動。

major_items: 原廠首次定期保養（純電：無機油，做車輛檢查、軟體更新、煞車與輪胎檢查）
冷氣濾網更換
雨刷片
checkpoints.source: BMW 汎德 3 年不限里程原廠保固（U-CAR news/article/10646）內；純電車第一年僅需年度檢查層級的定保，無機油/濾心/火星塞支出。金額參考 faqs.tw 2026 電動車保養整理（https://faqs.tw/ev-maintenance-tw）之 BMW 純電項目與台灣原廠工資水準推估。7,000 km 完全用不到任何里程觸發的項目，屬時間驅動。

major_items: 第 2、3 年年度定保 x2（約 12,000）
煞車油更換（每 2 年，約 5,000）
冷氣濾網與雨刷（約 2,500）
四輪定位（約 3,000）
checkpoints.source: 仍在汎德 3 年不限里程保固期內，故障件由原廠吸收，此處只含自費耗材與工資。煞車油 2 年一換、BMW 原廠報價 NT$3,000-5,000（faqs.tw 電動車保養 2026 之 BMW 欄位）。21,000 km 尚未觸及任何里程門檻，全部是時間到期的項目。

major_items: 第 4、5 年年度定保 x2（約 13,000）
四輪胎更換一組（18 吋，約 48,000）— 5 年橡膠老化到期，非里程磨耗
冷卻液（電池/馬達迴路，5 年期，約 10,000）
12V 輔助電瓶（AGM，約 12,000）
前煞車碟盤與來令片整理（台灣濕氣導致再生煞車少用而生鏽，約 8,000）
保固到期後的初期自費風險準備（約 8,000）
checkpoints.source: 此期第 3 年保固到期，費用結構整個改變。輪胎：i4 eDrive40 的 Racing Package 配 18 吋 M 型輪圈（U-CAR 車款介紹已驗證），車重逾 2 噸、實際車主多換 Pirelli P-Zero PZ4 等級，台灣一組行情 NT$40,000-60,000（faqs.tw 給 BMW 純電輪胎 NT$40,000-80,000），取 48,000。純電煞車片壽命 faqs.tw 記為 5 年一次，但本案 35,000 km 磨耗極輕，故只編列碟盤除鏽整理而非整組更換 — 這是低里程純電車在台灣的實際樣態。

major_items: 第 6、7 年年度定保 x2（約 14,000）
前後煞車碟盤與來令片整組更換（BMW 大尺寸碟，約 45,000）
冷氣濾網、雨刷、燈具耗材（約 6,000）
保固外風險項準備：電子水泵、冷氣壓縮機、避震器/M 跑車化電子懸吊阻尼器（約 45,000）
四輪定位與雜項（約 6,000）
checkpoints.source: 無真實 7 年 i4 資料，依德系純電保固外的已知風險項編列。電子水泵是 BMW 跨動力系統的常見故障件（純電車仍有電池與馬達冷卻迴路），單顆連工資約 NT$25,000；若選配 Racing Package 的 M 跑車化電子懸吊，阻尼器單支更換成本遠高於一般避震器。煞車碟盤在此車齡因再生煞車長期少用而鏽蝕，通常整組換掉而非磨到底。工資率以台灣 BMW 原廠約 NT$2,500-3,500/小時計。

major_items: 第二組輪胎（約 55,000）
12V 輔助電瓶第二顆（約 14,000）
懸吊系統：避震器、上座、控制臂襯套（2 噸重車，約 60,000）
高壓系統保固外風險：車載充電模組 OBC、電動壓縮機、電池冷卻迴路（約 70,000）
冷氣、門窗膠條、燈具等老化雜項（約 20,000）
checkpoints.source: 外推，且刻意編列得比一般日系高。關鍵時點：8 年/16 萬公里高壓電池保固在第 8 年到期，之後電池與其周邊（OBC、冷卻）全部自費，這是德系純電十年期成本的主要來源，也是中古市場對 7-10 年德系電動車重殺價的原因（見 BMW i3 十年僅剩牌價 15-20% 的實證）。此 265,000 不含整組電池更換 — 那筆錢會超過車輛殘值，屬報廢決策。參考代理車 BMW i3 在台的實際高齡維修樣態與 faqs.tw 對 BMW 純電「德系維修費較高、進口零件貴」的定性描述。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, so every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000) — roughly half the Taiwan average. At this mileage BMW's condition-based service is effectively TIME-driven, not distance-driven: the annual inspection, brake fluid (2-yr), coolant and cabin filters all come due on the calendar long before any km threshold, and tires age out (5-6 years) rather than wear out. Low mileage also means resale sits at the TOP of the observed listing band, which is how the value_checkpoints were positioned. EXCLUDED by design: 牌照稅, 燃料費, insurance, and electricity/charging. (Taiwan has granted BEVs a 使用牌照稅 exemption that has been extended in multi-year increments; the current end date was NOT verifiable from any page reachable in this environment, so no expiry date is asserted here — the tax is excluded by design either way.) ALSO EXCLUDED and deliberately not in maintenance: home wallbox installation — a BMW Wallbox plus 台電 電力申請 and conduit/wiring runs about NT$40,000-80,000 in TW and is a one-off ownership setup cost, not maintenance. High-voltage battery REPLACEMENT is likewise not budgeted in maintenance; at BMW TW that is a NT$800,000+ event, and rather than model it as a cost it is reflected as the repair-risk discount that keeps the year 7-10 resale falling.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED by this audit against U-CAR's BMW i5 model page (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/overall), fetched successfully 2026-08-12. The page header reads 2 車型 / 329 - 485 萬 and the model table lists exactly two TW trims: eDrive40 M Sport 329萬 (純電動, 後輪驅動) and M60 xDrive 485萬 (純電動, 四輪驅動). The page body further states that when BMW TW published the new model year in July 2025 (SiC 碳化矽 inverters, i5 eDrive40 WLTP range 582 -> 627 km), 雙車系更新後售價配備不變, 轎車 eDrive40 為 329 萬、M60 為 485 萬 — the price was deliberately held. NT$3,290,000 CONFIRMED, 0% deviation, no change made. Discount and on-road fees are estimates, reasoned in notes, not quoted figures.
purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: pure BEV, correctly classified. The U-CAR spec table (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/spec) shows 動力系統 電動 / 能源 電能, a single 後置永磁同步馬達, 340 hp 綜效馬力, 43.9 kgm, 後輪驅動, 205 kW DC / CCS1, AC J1772, and a COMPLETELY EMPTY 引擎系統 section (no 缸徑, 衝程, 引擎型號, 引擎最大馬力). No combustion engine and no 48V question — 'bev' is right, not 'hybrid' or 'phev'. Importer 經銷/代理 汎德汽車股份有限公司 (Pan German Motors); 產地 德國. Kerb weight 2,120 kg on staggered 20-inch tires (輪胎尺寸 245/40 R20 front, 後輪尺寸 275/35 R20 rear) — both verified on the spec table, and both drive the tire and suspension line items later. BATTERY FIGURE CAVEAT: the U-CAR spec table states 電池總容量 83.9kwh / 可用電池容量 81.2kwh, but U-CAR's own article text on the overall page says the i5 uses a 可用容量 81.6kWh pack and that BMW never published a total capacity, noting 83.9/80.7 as the i4's figures. U-CAR contradicts itself; nothing in this record depends on which is right. TRIM: 'eDrive40 M Sport' is the only eDrive40 sedan spec sold in TW; the sole sedan alternative is M60 xDrive at 485萬, so there is no cheaper i5 sedan to confuse this with. DISCOUNT of NT$240,000 (7.3%): estimate, not a quoted deal. Justification — the price has been held at 329萬 across two model years while the product improved, which in TW is the classic signature of a list price being defended while real movement happens as dealer discount and accessory bundling. Demand is visibly thin: 27 used i5 eDrive40 are listed on 8891 for a car whose earliest TW registrations are 2024款, an unusually high churn rate. BMW's Neue Klasse 800V i-models are also approaching, and the i5 is explicitly still a 400V car (U-CAR: i5 全車系皆仍架構於 400V 電壓、尚未是 Neue Klasse 平臺 800V 電壓架構), which softens it further. NT$200,000-280,000 in cash plus accessory value is the realistic band at this class; 240,000 is the midpoint. ON-ROAD FEES of NT$105,000 = 新領牌照登記費/號牌/行照 規費 roughly NT$2,500 + 代辦領牌服務費 roughly NT$12,000 + 配件 roughly NT$90,000 (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 全車鍍膜, 腳踏墊/精品 — a normal delivery package at the 300萬+ level). Commodity tax and 牌照稅 treatment for BEVs was not verifiable from any reachable page and is not asserted; in any case list_price is the 建議售價 as published, and tax and insurance are excluded from this model by design. real_cost = 3,290,000 - 240,000 + 105,000 = 3,155,000 (arithmetic verified).

items.name: 過戶代辦費 + 監理規費 (title transfer)
售前整備/美容 — 拋光、鍍膜、內裝清潔、輪胎保養
刊登費 — 8891 車主自售刊登方案

selling_costs.notes: Private-sale scenario (matching private_sale_price in the value checkpoints). At the 300萬 class a buyer expects the car presented properly, so the 售前整備/美容 line is the bulk of it. Total 2,500 + 8,000 + 2,000 = 12,500, inside the 6,000-15,000 band expected at this class. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer these costs largely vanish, but so does 13-15% of the price — that trade-off is why both private_sale_price and dealer_tradein_price are quoted.

value_checkpoints.source: Directly observed and INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED by this audit. The 8891 BMW listing payload (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i5, fetched 2026-08-12) carries a model facet reading exactly {"count":27,"maxPrice":"253.0萬","minPrice":"209.8萬","name":"i5 eDrive40"} — 27 live listings of this exact trim at NT$2,098,000-2,530,000. This audit also extracted a per-listing record the original research could not retrieve: 'BMW i5 2024款 eDrive40 M Sport 純電', 2024年, 1.4萬公里, 247.0萬, 新北市, 實體車行 — a genuine low-mileage comparable near the top of the band, which supports anchoring a low-mileage car high rather than mid-band. Because this buyer does 7,000 km/year, the anchor is the TOP of the band, NT$2,530,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (the dealer-retail trap): every 8891 figure is 車商售價, dealer RETAIL asking, not what an owner receives. NT$2,530,000 was cut 11.5% to a private-sale NT$2,240,000, then a further 13.0% to NT$1,950,000 for dealer trade-in. Implies a 29% loss in year one against real_cost — steep and correct for a German BEV, not a Toyota-like number.

Near-observed, extrapolated about half a year past the oldest real i5. The bottom of the verified 8891 i5 eDrive40 band, NT$2,098,000, is a 2024款 car at roughly 2-2.5 years. A 3-year car sits below that, helped back up by a 21,000 km odometer: dealer retail equivalent about NT$1,920,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off dealer retail gives the private-sale NT$1,700,000; a further 12.9% gives dealer trade-in NT$1,480,000. Corroborated by sibling German BEVs verified in the same payload by this audit: iX xDrive40 {"count":4,"minPrice":"195.5萬","maxPrice":"213.0萬"} at about 3.5 years against a ~338萬 list = 58-63% dealer-retail retention, which brackets the ~61% implied here; i4 eDrive40 {"count":13,"minPrice":"188.0萬","maxPrice":"245.0萬"}. Years 1-3 remain the steepest stretch, as expected.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 5-year-old i5 exists anywhere; TW registrations start at 2024款. LOWERED BY THIS AUDIT from the researcher's NT$1,250,000. Method, re-derived from real listings this audit extracted from https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series (fetched 2026-08-12): the predecessor G30 5 Series at 5 years. Real rows include 2022 530i M Sport 9.51萬公里 154.9萬 (4 yr, ~46% of its ~338萬 list) and 2020 520i白金旗艦版 7萬公里 109.0萬 (6 yr, ~41% of its ~268萬 list), placing a 5-year 530i-class G30 at roughly 43% of list at dealer retail with ~80,000 km on it. Applying that ratio to real_cost, then a BEV haircut (out of the 3-year factory warranty, battery-anxiety discounting an ICE car does not carry), then a low-mileage uplift for 35,000 km against ~80,000 km comparables, gives dealer retail about NT$1,355,000 (43% of real_cost). The researcher had claimed a 34-41% ratio and then produced NT$1,410,000, which is ABOVE their own stated band rather than below it after a stated haircut — an internal contradiction this audit corrected. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off dealer retail gives private-sale NT$1,200,000; a further 13.3% gives trade-in NT$1,040,000.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 7-year-old i5 exists. LOWERED BY THIS AUDIT from the researcher's NT$940,000. Method changed: the researcher interpolated off the BMW i3, a 22-33 kWh carbon-fibre city car that is a poor structural match for a 5-metre executive sedan. This audit uses the same-class predecessor instead, the G30 5 Series, from rows extracted at https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series: 2019 520i 8.11萬公里 83.9萬 and 2019 520i 11.9萬公里 88.9萬 (7 yr, ~31-33% of the 520i's ~268萬 list), and 2018 530i xDrive 12.4萬公里 110.8萬 (8 yr, ~33% of its ~338萬 list). That places a 7-year German executive sedan at ~33-35% of list at dealer retail on ~100,000 km. Applying that ratio to real_cost with a BEV haircut and a low-mileage uplift for 49,000 km gives dealer retail about NT$1,020,000 (32.3% of real_cost). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off gives private-sale NT$905,000; a further 14.4% gives trade-in NT$775,000. The car is out of the 3-year vehicle warranty and the 8yr/160,000 km HV battery warranty is nearly up, which is why the tail keeps falling instead of flattening the way a Lexus would.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 10-year-old i5 exists. LOWERED BY THIS AUDIT from the researcher's NT$650,000, which was the clearest substantive error in the record: it had the BEV RETAINING MORE at 10 years than its own ICE predecessor, after an explicit undisclosed-magnitude upward nudge, which contradicts the German-BEV thesis the same record argues. Two predecessors were used and cross-checked. (a) ICE, same class: from https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series this audit extracted 2016 520i 9.98萬公里 46.9萬 and 2016 520i 8.3萬公里 43.0萬 — a 10-year F10 5 Series at ~17-18% of its ~258萬 list at dealer retail. (b) BEV, wrong class but right powertrain: the 8891 BMW payload facet {"count":4,"minPrice":"45.8萬","maxPrice":"59.8萬","name":"i3"} on 2014-2017 cars = ~19-25% of the i3's ~239萬 original list at 9-12 years. The two bracket 10-year retention at 17-25% of list. This record takes 20% of real_cost = about NT$630,000 dealer retail: above the ICE sedan floor because 70,000 km is genuinely low and an 81 kWh pack is not range-obsolete the way a 22 kWh i3 is, but below the i3's ratio because a NT$800,000+ HV battery replacement risk on a 329萬 car is a far larger absolute threat than on a 239萬 one. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off gives private-sale NT$560,000; a further 15.2% gives trade-in NT$475,000. That is 17.7% of real_cost with no flattening — by now the HV battery warranty has expired and the market prices replacement risk into every offer. CAVEAT CARRIED FORWARD: the i3's original TW list price (~239萬) could NOT be verified from any page reachable in this environment, so limb (b) rests on unverified knowledge; limb (a) is fully sourced, which is why the two are used together rather than either alone.

maintenance.plan_notes: At 7,000 km/year the schedule is entirely TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven — the car reaches 70,000 km only at year 10, so the annual inspection, the 2-year brake fluid, the coolant service and the cabin filters all fall due on the calendar. BEV economics are genuinely much cheaper than the combustion 5 Series: no engine oil, no oil filters, no spark plugs, no DPF, and regenerative braking means pads last far longer. But nowhere near zero, and materially above a Japanese equivalent. Three things keep it expensive: (1) a 2,120 kg kerb weight on staggered 20-inch tires (245/40 R20 front, 275/35 R20 rear, both verified on the U-CAR spec table) that cannot be rotated front-to-rear, so a set is roughly NT$68,000-72,000 fitted and ages out every 5-6 years at this mileage; (2) BMW TW dealer labour rates; (3) a heavy self-levelling rear suspension provision, treated as a live NT$45,000-90,000 risk item from year 6 onward. SUSPENSION SOURCING CORRECTION: the original record asserted that standard self-levelling REAR AIR SUSPENSION was 'confirmed on the U-CAR spec table'. It is NOT. That table's only suspension entries are 前輪懸吊 雙A臂 and 後輪懸吊 多連桿 — multi-link geometry, with no air-spring field at all. BMW fits self-levelling rear air suspension as standard to the i5 in most markets and the claim is very likely true of the TW car, but it is unverified here and the false attribution has been removed. The provision is retained either way: at 2,120 kg, a rear air unit that fails or a set of conventional heavy-duty dampers and springs are both real money at a BMW dealer. WARRANTY AND PACKAGE — IMPORTANT CAVEAT: BMW Taiwan's standard cover is 3年不限里程 vehicle warranty plus 8年/160,000公里 on the high-voltage battery, and 汎德 has historically bundled a multi-year BMW Service Inclusive scheduled-maintenance package with i-series cars. This audit INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED that www.bmw.com.tw is unreachable from this environment (curl returns exit status 000 on both the homepage and the BMW Service Inclusive path), so the current package terms could not be checked and the researcher's honesty note on this is upheld. Because the package is unverified, this audit RAISED the year-1 and year-3 figures above the researcher's near-zero numbers to avoid under-modelling a German car on an unconfirmed subsidy. Every period from year 3 onward carries the full unsubsidised dealer cost with no package offset. HV BATTERY REPLACEMENT IS NOT BUDGETED HERE — see assumptions.notes; it is modelled as resale-value risk instead. Charger installation is likewise excluded. Ten-year maintenance total is NT$825,000 (the original record stated NT$818,000 against line items summing to NT$813,000 — an arithmetic slip, now corrected and consistent).

major_items: Annual BEV inspection — scheduled labour assumed largely covered by a bundled BMW Service Inclusive package (UNVERIFIED)
Cabin/microfilter replacement
Wiper blades
Wheel alignment and four-wheel balance check
Tire pressure/TPMS service and 20-inch wheel refinish allowance
checkpoints.source: Estimate. RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$8,000. Under the assumed bundled 3-year service package the scheduled labour is covered, so this period is mostly genuine consumables — but the package is unverified (bmw.com.tw independently confirmed unreachable), and NT$8,000 for a first year on a 329萬 German car is optimistic even with a package, since alignment, filters, wipers and 20-inch wheel/tire attention are usually chargeable. No BEV has an oil service, which is why year 1 still sits far below a combustion 5 Series. If no package is bundled at all, add roughly NT$10,000. Not verifiable against an official BMW TW service-price table (site unreachable) or Mobile01 owner receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: Two annual inspections — scheduled labour assumed largely covered by the bundled package (UNVERIFIED)
Brake fluid change at year 2 (time-driven, every 2 years)
Cabin/microfilters x2
Wiper blades, alignment, four-wheel balance
12V AGM battery — BEVs are hard on the 12V and a low-mileage car is harder still
Tires still original — 20-inch set not yet aged out at 21,000 km and 3 years
checkpoints.source: Estimate. RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$30,000, for the same reason as year 1 plus one substantive addition: the researcher deferred the 12V AGM battery to year 5, but a BEV that sits and does short low-mileage trips typically needs its first 12V inside 3-4 years, and BMW's registered AGM plus coding is not a cheap item in TW. Still inside the 3-year factory warranty and the assumed service package, so this covers consumables, the 2-year brake fluid and the 12V only. Tires deliberately NOT included: at 21,000 km and 3 years the original 245/40 R20 and 275/35 R20 set has neither worn nor aged out. Not verifiable against an official BMW TW table (site unreachable) or Mobile01 owner receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: FULL SET OF 20-INCH TIRES ~NT$68,000 — staggered 245/40 R20 + 275/35 R20 EV-rated performance rubber, AGE-driven at 5 years, cannot be rotated front-to-rear
Two annual inspections at full unsubsidised BMW TW dealer rate
Brake fluid change (year 4)
Battery and drive-unit coolant service
Front brake pads and discs — regen saves pads but discs corrode and pit from low-mileage, low-friction use
Cabin filters x2, wipers, alignment, four-wheel balance
Air-con service and 12V check
checkpoints.source: Estimate, and the first period at full unsubsidised cost — the 3-year warranty and the assumed service package have both expired. Unchanged from the researcher's figure; this audit checked it and found it sound. Tire pricing rests on the staggered 20-inch fitment verified on the U-CAR spec table (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/spec: 輪胎尺寸 245/40 R20, 後輪尺寸 275/35 R20) at TW retail for EV-rated performance rubber, on a 2,120 kg car. The 12V AGM was moved OUT of this period into year 3, offset by adding air-con service and balance work, leaving the total unchanged. The step up from NT$38,000 to NT$145,000 is the warranty cliff plus the first tire set, not a modelling artefact. Not verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or Mobile01 receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: SELF-LEVELLING REAR SUSPENSION provision ~NT$45,000 — BMW fits self-levelling rear air suspension as standard to the i5 in most markets to carry the battery; NOT confirmed on the TW spec sheet (U-CAR lists 後輪懸吊 多連桿 only), so this is a provision, not a verified fitment. An air spring or compressor failure from year 6 is the risk being priced
Suspension bushings and control arms ~NT$35,000 — 2,120 kg kerb weight is hard on them and 雙A臂 front geometry means more wear parts
Remaining brake pads and discs, front and rear
Two annual inspections at full dealer rate
Brake fluid, battery/drive-unit coolant service
Cabin filters x2, wipers, diagnostics
checkpoints.source: Estimate. Unchanged in total from the researcher's figure; this audit checked it and found it sound, but CORRECTED THE SOURCING of its largest line. Fully out of the vehicle warranty; only the 8yr/160,000 km HV battery cover is still (barely) running. The 2,120 kg kerb weight and the 雙A臂/多連桿 suspension layout are verified on the U-CAR spec table; the rear AIR suspension is not, and the record no longer claims it is. The provision stands regardless of spring medium — on a 2,120 kg car, either an air unit or a set of heavy-duty conventional dampers and springs at a BMW dealer lands in the same range. This is the period where the market starts pricing repair risk, which is also why the year-7 resale keeps falling. Not verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or Mobile01 receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: SECOND FULL SET OF 20-INCH TIRES ~NT$72,000 — age-driven again at ~year 10
REAR SUSPENSION OVERHAUL ~NT$90,000 — air spring pair plus compressor if air-sprung (see year 7 caveat), or a full conventional rear refresh; realistic at 8-10 years on 2,120 kg
ELECTRIC COOLANT PUMP / thermal-management valve block ~NT$40,000 — a known BMW electrified-drivetrain wear item
Charging-port actuator / OBC / DC-DC electrical provision ~NT$35,000
Suspension and steering wear — control arms, tie rods, bushings ~NT$45,000
Brake discs and pads, full set ~NT$50,000 — low-mileage BEV discs fail by corrosion, not wear
eDrive unit gearbox fluid change (~100,000 km / 10 yr interval)
Three annual inspections, brake fluid x2, coolant, cabin filters x3, second 12V AGM, diagnostics
checkpoints.source: Estimate covering three years fully out of warranty; the HV battery cover also lapses at year 8 inside this window. Unchanged from the researcher's figure; this audit checked it and found it sound for a German BEV. Item list built from the BEV-specific wear pattern (no oil, plugs or DPF, but electric coolant pump, thermal valve block, onboard charger and charge-port actuator all become live) plus the 20-inch staggered tires verified at https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/spec. The rear-suspension line carries the same fitment caveat as year 7 — it is a provision, not a verified air-spring replacement. HV battery replacement is deliberately EXCLUDED here and modelled as resale risk instead. Ten-year maintenance total is NT$825,000 (12,000 + 38,000 + 145,000 + 195,000 + 435,000, verified) — far above any Japanese equivalent, and correctly below what a combustion 5 Series would cost over the same period. Not verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or Mobile01 receipts (HTTP 403).

sources.note: HONESTY NOTE, not a source. This audit independently re-tested the original researcher's claim and UPHELD it: curl returns exit status 000 (connection failure, no HTTP response) on both https://www.bmw.com.tw/zh/index.html and the BMW Service Inclusive path. Mobile01 owner-receipt threads return HTTP 403. Consequently NO maintenance figure in this record comes from an official BMW TW service-price table or a real owner receipt — all five maintenance checkpoints are marked 'low' confidence for exactly that reason, and the assumed bundled service package behind years 0-3 is flagged as unverified in plan_notes and partially compensated for by raising those two periods.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. At this mileage BMW's condition-based service is effectively TIME-driven (annual), not distance-driven, and 255/50 R21 tyres age out on rubber hardening (~5-6 years) long before they wear out. Low-mileage cars sell above the mileage-blind average, so every value figure is quoted against the low-mileage end of the observed listing bands and carries a modest premium. EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: vehicle licence tax and fuel tax (BEVs are currently exempt in TW anyway), insurance, and electricity/charging. ALSO EXCLUDED: home AC charger purchase and installation (typically NT$40,000-120,000 in TW depending on whether the building's electrical riser needs upgrading and whether a separate meter is required) - that is a one-off ownership/setup cost, not maintenance, so it appears in neither purchase nor maintenance. Public DC fast-charging fees are likewise excluded. High-voltage battery REPLACEMENT is also not budgeted as maintenance; at BMW TW that would exceed the car's residual value from year 7 onward, so it is modelled as the repair-risk discount that keeps the year 7-10 resale falling rather than as a line item. Kerb weight 2,450 kg and 255/50 R21 tyres on all four corners are the two verified facts that drive consumable cost hardest.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED by this audit against U-CAR's iX model page (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/ix/6960/overall), fetched by curl 2026-08-12, HTTP 200. The page header reads '3 車型 / 338 - 488 萬' and the model table lists exactly three TW trims: xDrive45 Excellence 338萬, xDrive45 M Sport 368萬, xDrive60 M Sport 488萬. Body text confirms 總代理汎德 formally launched the facelift (LCI) iX on 2025-07-02, with the entry xDrive45 Excellence at 338萬 and the two M Sport trims coming in NT$10,000 below their pre-sale prices (369萬/489萬 -> 368萬/488萬). NT$3,380,000 CONFIRMED at 0% deviation - the researcher's figure was correct and is unchanged. Discount and on-road fees are reasoned build-ups, not quoted transactions, and both were ADJUSTED by this audit (see notes).
purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: pure battery-electric, correctly classified 'bev'. The U-CAR spec table (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/ix/6960/spec) shows 動力系統 電動 / 能源 電能, front and rear 電子勵磁同步馬達, and a COMPLETELY EMPTY 引擎系統 block (no 缸徑, 衝程, 引擎型號, 引擎最大馬力). No combustion engine, no 48V mild-hybrid question, no plug-in question - 'bev' is right. VERIFIED SPEC (all re-checked on the spec table for the Excellence column specifically): 車重 2,450 kg; 輪胎尺寸 255/50 R21 front AND 後輪尺寸 255/50 R21 rear - the entry trim genuinely runs 21-inch rubber on both axles, it is not a small-wheel base car; 電池總容量 100.6 kWh / 可用電池容量 96 kWh; 408 ps; 71.4 kgm; 0-100 km/h 5.1 s; DC 175 kW / CCS1; 純電行程 658 km (WLTC); 前輪懸吊 鋁合金雙A臂 / 後輪懸吊 多連桿; 經銷/代理 汎德汽車股份有限公司; 產地 德國. Every spec claim the researcher made checked out. DISCOUNT RAISED by this audit from NT$200,000 (5.9%) to NT$240,000 (7.1%). Neither figure is a quoted deal, but 5.9% is light for this car and is inconsistent with the sibling record for the BMW i5 eDrive40 (NT$240,000 on a 329萬 list = 7.3%) - same brand, same importer 汎德, same model year, same BEV segment. The iX Excellence is the price-leader entry trim of a slow-selling NT$3.38M BEV in a segment where Taiwanese buyers have drifted to Tesla and cheaper Korean/Chinese EVs, which is exactly the variant dealers deal hardest on, and in practice much of it arrives as accessories, a wallbox or charging credit rather than clean invoice reduction. ON-ROAD FEES RAISED from NT$65,000 to NT$95,000: the researcher's 配件 allowance of NT$49,000 is under-scaled for a 338萬 SUV with a full-length electrochromic glass roof. Build-up = 領牌/規費 approx. 3,000 + 代辦費 approx. 12,000 + 配件 approx. 80,000 (window film for a very large glazed SUV, dashcam, full-body ceramic coating, mats/sill plates). This is in line with the sibling i5 record's NT$90,000 accessory package at the same price class. BEVs in TW pay no 貨物稅, already reflected in the list price. Tax and insurance are excluded by design and are NOT hidden in onroad_fees. real_cost = 3,380,000 - 240,000 + 95,000 = 3,235,000 (arithmetic verified).

selling_costs.notes: Costs the OWNER pays to complete a private sale; reviewed by this audit and left unchanged. The statutory 過戶 fee itself is small (a few hundred NT$); most of the 3,000 is the agent/scrivener handling it. Detailing sits at the upper end of normal because a 2,450 kg luxury SUV with a full-length glass roof takes real work to present, and a tired-looking German EV loses far more than 8,000 off the asking price. Total 13,500 is inside the expected 6,000-15,000 band for this class.

value_checkpoints.source: LOWERED by this audit from the researcher's NT$2,500,000, and confidence downgraded from 'high' to 'medium'. NEW PRIMARY EVIDENCE the researcher missed: 8891 IS reachable by curl (the researcher reported it unscrapeable and fell back on BMW's certified channel alone). The BMW inventory page https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/ix, fetched 2026-08-12 HTTP 200, embeds a model-facet payload reading exactly {"count":11,"maxPrice":"322.0萬","minPrice":"290.0萬","name":"iX xDrive45"} - ELEVEN live listings of this exact facelift model, which can only be 0-1.1 years old because the LCI launched 2025-07-02. That band brackets the researcher's certified-channel figures (295-322萬) closely, so their BPS numbers look real even though bps.bmw.com.tw returns only a 7 KB SPA shell to curl and could NOT be independently verified here - hence the downgrade to 'medium'. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN, stated explicitly: 8891 prices are 車商售價, dealer RETAIL asking, the top of the ladder. TRIM ADJUSTMENT: the researcher established that essentially all used xDrive45s are M Sport (368萬 list), so the 290萬 floor is most likely an M Sport, not an Excellence; scaling by list ratio (338/368) puts an Excellence's dealer-retail equivalent at about 266萬. Cutting 12% to 自售價 gives about 234萬. Blending that against the alternative reading (290萬 already being an Excellence, which would give about 255萬 private) lands at 2,350,000, with a low-mileage premium included since 7,000 km undercuts even these near-new cars. Trade-in a further 14% below. This is 72.6% of real_cost - a genuine German-BEV first year, not the 77% the researcher's figure implied.

RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$1,750,000. The researcher built this off i4/i7 ratios; this audit instead brackets it between two directly observed points on the iX nameplate itself, both from the 8891 facet payload at https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/ix (2026-08-12): the 1.1-year facelift xDrive45 band (11 cars, 290-322萬 dealer retail) above, and the pre-facelift iX band below. The pre-facelift anchor is now precise because this audit RECOVERED THE PREDECESSOR'S ACTUAL LIST PRICE, which the researcher never established: U-CAR's iX event log (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/ix/6960/event) records the 2021-12-30 TW launch headline '320萬與390萬、正式售價向上調整4萬' - iX xDrive40 旗艦版 NT$3,200,000 and xDrive50 旗艦版 NT$3,900,000. Against those real list prices the oldest pre-facelift cars now ask 195.5萬 (xDrive40, 61.1% of 320萬), 229.6萬 (xDrive50, 58.9% of 390萬) and 388.8萬 (M60, 62.7% of its 620萬 launch price, also from the event log) - three independent variants all bottoming at 59-63% of list at dealer retail around 4-4.5 years. Interpolating a 3-year point between the 1.1-year band and that 4.25-year floor gives roughly 66% of list at dealer retail, about 223萬; cutting 12.5% to private gives 1,950,000. Trade-in a further 13.8% below. Years 1-3 still shed NT$1,285,000, i.e. 39.7% of real_cost - front-loaded, as a German BEV must be.

RAISED SUBSTANTIALLY by this audit from the researcher's NT$1,150,000 - the single largest correction in the record. The researcher anchored this on a 2022 Audi e-tron 55 Sportback (149.8萬 / 58,000 km, https://www.sum.com.tw/carinfo-777056.php - this audit re-fetched it and confirmed the listing is genuine) at ~38.5% of its list. That comparator is real but badly chosen: the e-tron 55 is a 2019-era, poor-efficiency German BEV that suffered heavy TW price cuts, and it is a weaker residual performer than the iX. The correct comparator is the iX's OWN predecessor, which the researcher wrongly reported as absent from the used market. It is not absent: the 8891 facet payload (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/ix, 2026-08-12) shows iX xDrive40 count 4 at 195.5-213.0萬 and iX xDrive50 count 10 at 229.6-298.8萬. Against the verified launch prices of 320萬 and 390萬 (U-CAR event log, 2021-12-30), the oldest of these - roughly 4-4.5 years old, since TW deliveries began end-2021 - hold 59-63% of list at DEALER RETAIL, i.e. about 52-55% at private sale after a 12-15% cut. Applying that to this car's 338萬 list puts a 4.25-year private sale near 179萬. Extending 0.75 years further, and applying a deliberate forward-looking penalty because BMW's Neue Klasse 800V replacement for the iX will have arrived well before 2031 and will date this 400V car the same way the 425 km xDrive40 is dated today, gives 45.6% of list = 1,540,000 private. Trade-in 15% below. Retained caveat: these are asking prices on thin inventory and may sit above transaction, which is why this is 'medium' not 'high'.

EXTRAPOLATED, not observed - stated plainly. The current iX generation reached Taiwan only at the end of 2021 (confirmed on U-CAR's model history, https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/ix/6960/history: '臺灣市場則是在 2021 年底先行導入 xDrive40 與 xDrive50 雙車型'), so no genuine 7-year data for this nameplate can exist. RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$750,000, because their whole mid-curve was anchored too low (see the year-5 note); a 7-year figure has to descend from a corrected year-5, not from an Audi e-tron ratio. Method: take real 7-8 year Taiwanese listings of analogues, express each as a retention ratio of ITS OWN original list, then apply to this car. Ratios used, all re-fetched and confirmed genuine by this audit on 2026-08-12: 2018 Tesla Model X, 128.0萬 at 109,470 km (https://www.sum.com.tw/carinfo-773362.php) against a ~NT$4,290,000 list = ~30% dealer asking at eight years, the nearest large-luxury-BEV read available; BMW X5 G05 2019 examples on SUM at 96.8-132.8萬 on 102,000-175,000 km against a ~NT$4,190,000 list = 23-32% dealer asking at seven years. Those comparables carry two to three times this buyer's mileage, so a low-mileage premium applies: 49,000 km on a 7-year car is exceptional. Taking ~35% of list as dealer asking (~118萬) and cutting 11% to private gives 1,050,000, which is 32.5% of real_cost - consistent with the German-BEV peer band and continuing to fall rather than flatten. Trade-in 15% below. The 8-year/160,000 km high-voltage battery warranty is still live at year seven, which supports the price; the 3-year bumper-to-bumper warranty expired long ago, which does not.

EXTRAPOLATED, not observed - stated plainly. RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$400,000 to keep the tail consistent with the corrected mid-curve, though it remains a hard fall with no flattening. Same ratio method against real Taiwanese listings re-fetched and confirmed genuine by this audit on 2026-08-12: BMW 7 Series 2016 (10 years) at 86.8萬 / 94,851 km (https://www.sum.com.tw/carinfo-754869.php) against a ~NT$6,000,000 list = ~14% dealer asking; BMW X5 F15 2015 (11 years) at a genuinely low-mileage 59.6萬 / 56,741 km (https://www.sum.com.tw/carinfo-779242.php) against a ~NT$3,600,000 list = ~17% dealer asking. This is the German tail that keeps falling instead of flattening the way a Lexus does, and for a BEV it is worse, not better: by year ten the 8-year/160,000 km high-voltage battery warranty has EXPIRED, and the Taiwan market discounts a 100.6 kWh pack of unknown health severely because replacement costs a large multiple of the car's value. Taking ~19% of list as dealer asking (~64萬), cutting 12% to private and allowing a premium for a genuinely low 70,000 km gives 560,000, i.e. 17.3% of real_cost. Cross-check: the sibling BMW i5 record independently lands on 560,000 (17.7% of its real_cost) at year ten from the same brand and channel, which is a reassuring calibration for a BMW BEV. Trade-in is set at only 79% of private because dealers in Taiwan barely want a decade-old German BEV on the lot at any price - many simply decline it. CAVEAT: the comparators' original list prices were not re-verified against a live source, and a 10% error in one moves this figure by roughly the same 10%.

maintenance.plan_notes: At 7,000 km/year the service interval is TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven: the car only reaches 70,000 km at year ten, so BMW's condition-based servicing calls for an annual visit, and brake fluid (2-year), coolant and cabin filters all fall due on the calendar long before any distance trigger. Tyres age out on rubber hardening rather than wearing out. BEV maintenance is genuinely much lower than a combustion German SUV in routine work - no engine oil, no oil filters, no spark plugs, no DPF, no gearbox service - and regenerative braking means pads barely wear. It is nowhere near zero, and this car has three specific cost drivers: 2,450 kg kerb weight, 255/50 R21 tyres on BOTH axles (both verified on U-CAR's spec table in the Excellence column specifically), and BMW Taiwan dealer labour rates. TOTAL RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$750,000 to NT$880,000. Reason: the sibling BMW i5 eDrive40 record carries NT$825,000 over ten years on a 2,120 kg car with 20-inch tyres. This iX is 330 kg heavier and runs larger 21-inch rubber on all four corners, so its ten-year maintenance must sit ABOVE the i5's, not NT$75,000 below it. The early periods were also raised (see below). SOURCING DEFECT CORRECTED: the researcher costed years 1, 3 and 5 against a '好車網 HOT 保養週期及服務工資' table at https://www.hotcar.com.tw/UsedCarSell/CarFilter, citing specific rates (imported-car inspection NT$500-1,500, brake fluid NT$400 labour, battery NT$250, tyre rotation NT$400, brake clean NT$688). This audit fetched that URL: it returns HTTP 200 but it is a USED-CAR SEARCH FILTER page titled '中古車、二手車行情價格、車價查詢｜HOT大聯盟'. It is not a service-labour price table and does not contain those figures. The URL is real but the attribution is not, so the citation has been removed and the affected checkpoints downgraded to 'low'. WARRANTY ASSUMPTION - flagged because it could NOT be verified: this audit independently re-tested www.bmw.com.tw and confirms it is unreachable from this environment (curl exits 92, HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR, no response body), upholding the researcher's honesty note. Assumed: the long-standing 汎德 structure of a 3-year unlimited-mileage new-car warranty plus an 8-year/160,000 km high-voltage battery warranty, and NO free scheduled-maintenance package. Because that package is unverified, years 1 and 3 are costed as owner-paid rather than near-zero, so as not to under-model a German car on an unconfirmed subsidy; if a prepaid BSI-style package does turn out to be standard those two periods fall towards zero, while years 5, 7 and 10 already carry the FULL unsubsidised out-of-warranty cost and would not change. Later periods deliberately carry realistic German risk items: suspension overhaul, electric coolant pumps, and high-voltage-adjacent electronics. The iX has no engine, so no water pump, coil packs, thermostat housing, DPF or 48V starter-generator apply - the estimate is not padded with combustion items this car does not have, and instead weights the BEV-specific failure modes. SUSPENSION CAVEAT: U-CAR's spec table lists 鋁合金雙A臂 front and 多連桿 rear but is silent on whether air springs are fitted to this Excellence trim; the year-10 allowance is written to cover an air-strut-and-compressor job if fitted, or dampers, arms and bushings if not. Home charger installation is an ownership cost, not maintenance, and is excluded - see assumptions.notes.

major_items: Annual condition-based inspection at BMW dealer (no oil service - BEV)
Wiper blades, washer fluid, tyre rotation, four-wheel balance and pressure/TPMS check
Wheel alignment check on 21-inch rims
All defects covered by the assumed 3-year new-car warranty
checkpoints.source: Estimate, RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$6,000 and downgraded to 'low' confidence. The researcher's figure was costed against a claimed 好車網 HOT service-labour table that does not exist at the cited URL (see plan_notes), so it has no sourcing behind it. NT$6,000 for a first year on a 338萬 German SUV is optimistic even under warranty, since alignment, balancing, wipers and 21-inch wheel/tyre attention are normally chargeable at a main dealer. Aligned with the sibling BMW i5 record's NT$12,000 first year, adjusted for this car's larger wheels. A BEV at 7,000 km genuinely needs almost nothing beyond an inspection and consumables, which is why this still sits far below a combustion X5. NOT verifiable against an official BMW TW service-price table (www.bmw.com.tw unreachable, independently confirmed) or Mobile01 owner receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: Two annual inspections at BMW dealer
Brake fluid change at year 2 - time-based, applies regardless of mileage
Cabin micro-dust / activated-carbon filters x2 and wipers
First 12V AGM battery with registration to the car - BEVs are hard on the 12V and a low-mileage car harder still
Still inside the assumed 3-year warranty - no repair cost carried
Tyres NOT included: at 21,000 km and 3 years the original 255/50 R21 set has neither worn nor aged out
checkpoints.source: Estimate, RAISED by this audit from the researcher's NT$24,000 and downgraded to 'low'. Same sourcing defect as year 1 - the cited labour table does not exist at that URL. Two substantive changes: the figure is aligned with the sibling BMW i5 record's NT$38,000, and the first 12V AGM battery is pulled INTO this window rather than deferred to year 5, because a BEV doing short low-mileage trips typically needs its first 12V inside 3-4 years and BMW's registered AGM plus coding is not cheap in TW. Brake fluid is hygroscopic, so its 2-year interval is calendar-based and is NOT deferred by low mileage - this is the one item this buyer cannot skip. NOT verifiable against an official BMW TW table (site unreachable) or owner receipts (Mobile01 HTTP 403).

major_items: First full set of 255/50 R21 EV-rated tyres, fitted (~82,000) - aged out, not worn out
Two annual inspections at full unsubsidised dealer rate (~16,000) and brake fluid at year 4 (~5,000)
Battery/motor circuit coolant service and cabin filters (~15,000)
Air-conditioning service, alignment and four-wheel balance (~15,000)
First post-warranty period: allowance for out-of-warranty faults (~32,000)
checkpoints.source: Estimate, raised modestly by this audit from NT$145,000 and downgraded to 'low' for the sourcing reason in plan_notes. Tyre size 255/50 R21 on BOTH axles is confirmed for this exact trim on U-CAR's spec table (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/ix/6960/spec); premium EV-rated 21-inch rubber in Taiwan runs roughly NT$18,000-24,000 per corner fitted on a 2,450 kg car, so ~82,000 for four is realistic and is the dominant line in this window. At 35,000 km the tread is nowhere near worn - the tyres are replaced because five-year-old rubber on a heavy SUV has hardened, which is exactly the low-mileage trap. The assumed 3-year warranty has expired, so this is the first period carrying owner-paid repair risk, and the researcher's NT$14,000 allowance for that was thin for a German BEV. NOT verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or owner receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: Front and rear discs plus pads (~60,000) - replaced for corrosion, not wear
Two annual inspections (~16,000), brake fluid (~5,000), cabin filters (~5,000)
Coolant service (~11,000), four-wheel alignment and balance (~5,000), air-con service (~12,000)
Out-of-warranty allowance (~76,000): auxiliary electric coolant pump, charge-port actuator / on-board charger, control arms and bushings on a 2,450 kg car
checkpoints.source: Extrapolated from German out-of-warranty norms rather than any quote, and labelled as such. Raised by this audit from NT$155,000 to stay consistent with the sibling BMW i5's NT$195,000 at this age, scaled for this car's greater weight but with no tyre purchase in the window. The brake line is the counter-intuitive one and is deliberate: regenerative braking means the pads on a 49,000 km iX are barely touched, but Taiwan's humidity corrodes lightly-used discs so they are replaced on condition, not on thickness - a well-known low-mileage EV outcome, and BMW's discs on a 2,450 kg SUV are large and priced accordingly. The risk allowance covers BEV-specific items that actually fail on this platform - auxiliary electric coolant pumps, charging hardware, suspension bushings - rather than combustion items this car does not have. No tyres here; the year-5 set is still serviceable and the next set falls in the 7-10 window. NOT verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or owner receipts (HTTP 403).

major_items: Suspension overhaul (~125,000) - air struts and compressor if fitted, otherwise dampers, arms and bushings on a 2,450 kg car
Major high-voltage-adjacent risk allowance (~100,000): HV battery coolant pump, DC-DC converter, on-board charger, curved-display / iDrive unit
Second set of 255/50 R21 tyres (~90,000) and discs plus pads (~50,000)
Three annual inspections (~26,000), two brake-fluid changes (~11,000), cabin filters (~8,000)
Second 12V AGM battery (~18,000), coolant (~12,000), A/C service (~13,000), diagnostics and misc electrical (~27,000)
checkpoints.source: Extrapolated from German luxury out-of-warranty cost norms - explicitly not observed, since this model cannot be ten years old. Raised by this audit from NT$420,000 to NT$480,000 so that the ten-year total (12,000 + 38,000 + 165,000 + 185,000 + 480,000 = NT$880,000, arithmetic verified) sits ABOVE the sibling BMW i5's NT$825,000, as a 330 kg heavier car on larger 21-inch tyres must. This is the period the Taiwanese used market is pricing when it marks these cars into the teens as a percentage of list: buyers are discounting exactly this repair bill. The ten-year total is roughly three and a half times what a Toyota RAV4 absorbs over the same decade at the same mileage - the correct relationship for a German luxury BEV SUV, driven by dealer labour rates, 21-inch tyres, big brakes and suspension/electronics risk rather than by routine servicing. The 8-year/160,000 km high-voltage battery warranty has expired by this window, so pack-adjacent thermal-management failures land on the owner; a full pack replacement is deliberately NOT included because it would exceed the car's entire residual value and an owner facing that quote would scrap or sell instead - that risk is priced into the year-10 resale figure instead. NOT verifiable against an official BMW TW table (unreachable) or owner receipts (HTTP 403).
