selling_costs.notes: Sized for a private sale (自售), which is the disposal route private_sale_price assumes. The statutory transfer fee itself is only a few hundred NT$; NT$2,500 reflects the usual 代辦 handling charge. Detailing sits at the upper end of normal because a luxury-badge SUV that photographs badly loses far more than NT$7,500 in asking price. Third-party inspection is zero because in Taiwan the buyer customarily pays for it. Total NT$12,000 sits mid-band for the 6,000-15,000 typical of this class and is consistent with the other German records in this table. If the owner trades in to a dealer instead, these costs mostly vanish — but so does roughly 14-17% of the price, which is why dealer_tradein_price is tracked separately.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED — the new MMA-platform GLB has zero used examples anywhere (deliveries start Q4 2026), so every figure here transfers from the predecessor X247, whose 2020 Taiwan launch price of NT$2,160,000 for GLB 200 is within 0.5% of this car's NT$2,150,000, making the retention-ratio transfer unusually clean. Nearest real anchors, read directly off 8891 (2026-08) and all 車商售價 (dealer retail asking): a 2024 GLB 200 AMG facelift with 3,000 km asks NT$1,838,000 and a 2024 with 25,000 km asks NT$1,798,000, both against a facelift list near NT$2,380,000 — i.e. 75-77% dealer retail at TWO years. CORRECTION TO PRIOR PASS: the earlier researcher read 8891's "2.5万" as 2,500 km; it is 25,000 km. The genuine low-mileage 2-year car is the 3,000 km example at NT$1,838,000. Extrapolating one year up gives roughly 84-85% dealer retail at 1 year for a low-km car, then -12% to private sale gives ~74%. I hold at 73.5% (NT$1,580,000) rather than nudging higher because this is a first-model-year car facing an electric GLB sibling listed NT$170,000 BELOW it, which anchors the badge downward. A ~26.5% first-year loss is deliberately far steeper than the ~85% a RAV4 holds and sits inside the German band in this table (65-74%). Trade-in cut a further 14% from private.

Anchored on real 8891 X247 GLB 200 listings read directly (2026-08), all 車商售價: a 4-year-old 2022 GLB 200 AMG 7-seat with 69,000 km asks NT$1,388,000 against a facelift list near NT$2,380,000 (58.3% dealer retail). Interpolating back to 3 years gives roughly 64-66% dealer retail at a mileage-typical ~45,000 km. Our car carries 21,000 km, under half that, so I added ~6% for low mileage to reach ~69% dealer retail, then cut 12% to private sale (60.7%) and a further 14% to trade-in. Result NT$1,290,000 = 60.0% of list at 3 years — materially below the ~75% a Toyota RAV4 holds at the same age. Still inside the 3-year unlimited-mileage factory warranty at this point, which supports the private price.

REVISED UP from a prior pass's NT$1,090,000 — that figure was an openly-admitted 'judgement haircut' below the data rather than a reading of it, and a haircut is not evidence. Re-derived from real 8891 X247 listings read directly (2026-08), all 車商售價: 2021 GLB 200 7-seat, 72,600 km, NT$1,328,000; 2021 GLB 200 AMG, 70,000 km, NT$1,280,000; 2021 GLB 200 AMG, 60,000 km, NT$1,188,000; plus a 2020, 69,000 km, at NT$1,258,000 as a 6-year cross-check. Critically, these are AMG Line / 7-seat cars whose list was ~NT$2,290,000, NOT the NT$2,160,000 base — using the correct denominator gives 51.9-58.0% dealer retail, averaging ~55.3%, which is LOWER than the prior pass computed. Our car at 35,000 km carries roughly half these cars' mileage, so +7% for low mileage gives ~59% dealer retail; -12% to private sale gives 52.1% = NT$1,120,000; -14.7% again to trade-in. FindCar's reported NT$1,390,000 average for 2021 GLB 200 is noted but not used — it is above every individual listing I could actually see. At 52.1% of list this is consistent with the GLC 200 (51.1%) in this table and above the X3/Q5 (42-43%), which the GLB's real listings do support.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation — the GLB nameplate only launched in Taiwan in 2020, so no 7-year-old GLB of any generation exists and none was invented. Proxy is the Mercedes GLA X156, the brand's previous Taiwan compact SUV, launched June 2014 at NT$1,850,000 for GLA 200. On 8891 today a 2019 GLA 200 with 70,000 km asks NT$650,000 = 35.1%. CORRECTION TO PRIOR PASS: that listing is a 個人/自售 private listing ('18年出廠一手女用車'), NOT 車商售價, so the usual -12% dealer-to-private conversion must NOT be applied to it — it is already a private-sale figure. The prior pass described applying '-12% to private' but its stated arithmetic did not actually produce its stated number, so the narrative was wrong even where the figure was roughly serviceable. Correct treatment: 35.1% is a private-sale retention at 7 years and ~10,000 km/year; our car at 49,000 km is lower-mileage still, so +6% gives ~37.2%, and on NT$2,150,000 that is ~NT$800,000. I set NT$820,000, allowing a small upward nudge because the X156's list price had drifted below NT$1,850,000 by 2019, which makes 35.1% a mild understatement of true retention. Trade-in -15%. The step down from year 5 is intentionally the steepest in the curve: the 3-year factory warranty plus a maximum 3-year extension both expire by year 6, after which the Taiwan market prices out-of-warranty German repair risk rather than the car.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation, same method as year 7. Real 8891 listings for the 10-year-old 2016 GLA 200 (X156, list NT$1,850,000), read directly 2026-08, all 車商售價: NT$538,000 at 54,100 km, NT$550,000 at 66,000 km, NT$588,000 at 93,000 km — averaging ~NT$558,000 = 30.2% dealer retail. Converting to private at -12% gives ~26.5% private retention. CORRECTION TO PRIOR PASS: it added '+12% for our car's very low 70,000 km' — but those GLA comparables average roughly 71,000 km, essentially IDENTICAL to our car's 70,000 km, so there is no low-mileage advantage to claim at this checkpoint and the uplift was unjustified. Removing it: 26.5% of NT$2,150,000 = NT$570,000, which I shade to NT$560,000 (26.0%) for first-model-year MMA electronics risk and the 48V lithium pack a GLA X156 never carried. Trade-in cut a wider 17% because dealers barely want a decade-old German; many will simply decline the car, so NT$465,000 is close to a floor rather than a market. At 26.0% the tail is still falling, not flattening — the observed German pattern and the opposite of a Lexus. Cross-check: a 2014 GLA 200 at 130,000 km still asks NT$478,000 at 12 years, confirming the decline continues past year 10.

maintenance.plan_notes: COST BASIS: Mercedes-Benz Taiwan dealer rates, grounded in Taiwan sources — A-Service (小保養) roughly NT$8,000-15,000 and B-Service (大保養) roughly NT$15,000-30,000, with one owner-reported Taiwan receipt near NT$55,000 for a comprehensive visit including brake pads and discs. INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: the schedule is 10,000 km or 12 months whichever comes first (verified directly on the CW Group Taiwan Mercedes service guide), and at 7,000 km/year the car never reaches 10,000 km inside a year — so the owner pays for one dealer visit every single year regardless, 10 visits over 10 years, with Assyst Plus alternating A and B services. Low mileage protects resale value; it saves almost nothing on maintenance. WARRANTY: 3 years / unlimited mileage is standard from Mercedes-Benz Taiwan, which is why years 0-3 are cheap — only scheduled servicing and wear items are owner-paid. A paid extended warranty for years 4-6 is offered (typically NT$50,000-70,000); it is deliberately NOT included in any period_cost, because doing so would double-count against the repair allowances budgeted in years 5-7. If the buyer purchases it, treat it as substituting for part of that risk allowance, not adding to it. I found no evidence a free scheduled-maintenance package ships as standard with the new GLB — Mercedes-Benz Taiwan sells 預付式保養套餐 separately — so every period is costed at full retail. NO AIR SUSPENSION on this model, so none is budgeted. WHY THE LATER PERIODS ARE LARGE: years 7-10 carry the electric water pump and thermostat housing (both documented Mercedes four-cylinder failure items), ignition coils, an allowance for the 48V lithium battery and its DC/DC converter, and an age-driven suspension refresh. REVISION NOTE: a prior pass totalled NT$574,000 over ten years by summing every risk item at full value; risk allowances must be probability-weighted, not stacked. Corrected ten-year total is NT$507,000 — still roughly 2.1x the NT$244,000 a RAV4 costs over the same period, which is the intended gap and not an error, but no longer the highest figure in this table's German set despite the GLB being the smallest and cheapest Mercedes SUV in it.

NT$25,000 sits at the top of the verified band, which is appropriate for a main-dealer visit but not above it. A-Service at the observed NT$8,000-15,000 range.

major_items: Year 4 A-Service ~NT$11,000 and Year 5 B-Service incl. brake fluid, filters, spark plugs ~NT$24,000

checkpoints.source: Spark plugs at 40,000-50,000 km or on the time schedule (verified directly on the CW Group Taiwan service guide); at 35,000 km this is time-driven. Tires are the clearest low-mileage effect in reverse: 35,000 km would not wear a set out, but 5-year-old rubber must be replaced anyway, so this cost cannot be avoided by driving less. Brake pad cost scaled down from the ~NT$26,000 OEM front+rear figure since only fronts are due; a Taiwan owner receipt reporting ~NT$55,000 for a visit including pads and discs supports this order of magnitude. Warranty expiry per Mercedes-Benz Taiwan's 3-year term.

major_items: Year 6 A-Service ~NT$12,000 and Year 7 B-Service ~NT$28,000
8-speed DCT transmission oil service ~NT$20,000 (due 40,000-60,000 km)
Coolant replacement ~NT$7,000
12V AGM battery, first replacement ~NT$13,000
Front brake discs + rear pads ~NT$30,000
Out-of-warranty risk allowance ~NT$25,000 (ignition coils, sensors, minor oil/coolant leaks)
checkpoints.source: Transmission fluid interval 40,000-60,000 km, verified directly on the CW Group Taiwan Mercedes service guide — at 49,000 km this window is genuinely reached, and it is the one big item our low-mileage buyer hits on mileage rather than time. Dual-clutch fluid service is materially dearer than a torque-converter drain-and-fill, hence NT$20,000. AGM batteries in Taiwan's heat typically last 4-6 years. The NT$25,000 risk allowance is an explicit estimate, not a quote: from year 4 there is no warranty backstop and dealer labour rates apply to every fault. This is the first period where a German meaningfully separates from a Japanese equivalent — the RAV4's comparable window is NT$53,000.

major_items: Three annual services (Y8 A ~NT$13,000, Y9 B ~NT$30,000, Y10 A ~NT$14,000)
Second tire set ~NT$32,000 (age-driven again) and second spark plug set ~NT$10,000
Rear brake discs ~NT$20,000; second 12V battery ~NT$14,000
48V lithium battery / DC-DC converter allowance ~NT$28,000 — risk-weighted, the mild-hybrid-specific item
Electric water pump + thermostat housing allowance ~NT$26,000 — known Mercedes four-cylinder failure items
Ignition coils / injectors ~NT$15,000; suspension refresh (shocks, bushings, arms) ~NT$25,000
General electrical, MBUX, A/C and sensor allowance ~NT$13,000
checkpoints.source: Risk-weighted extrapolated budget, not a quoted table — stated plainly. REVISED DOWN from a prior pass's NT$300,000, which summed every named failure item at its full replacement cost as if all of them fire in the same three-year window; an allowance across a probability of failure is the correct treatment, so the 48V pack, water pump/thermostat, suspension and electronics lines are all probability-weighted here. The certain items (three services, tires, plugs, discs, 12V battery) are unchanged and carry NT$133,000 of the total on their own. Item selection follows documented Mercedes four-cylinder weak points and the fact that a 48V mild hybrid carries a lithium pack and DC/DC converter a plain petrol car does not. Age, not mileage, drives almost everything: at 70,000 km the powertrain is barely run in, but rubber, coolant, batteries and electronics have all aged 10 years in a hot, humid climate. NT$240,000 over three years is NT$80,000/year for a decade-old out-of-warranty German SUV, consistent with the observed dealer per-visit baseline plus repairs, and still 2.2x the RAV4's NT$107,000 for the same window.

assumptions.notes: 低里程車主：年均 6,000-8,000 km，取中位 7,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律 assumed_km = 7,000 × 年數（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km）。此里程下保養完全由時間決定而非里程：10 年只跑 70,000 km，永遠碰不到原廠的里程門檻，因此以一年一次年度檢查為主軸。低里程在中古市場有加分，本表殘值一律取同齡車源的低里程上緣並在 source 註明。【時間點已修正】2026-07-16 開放預售，依 ETtoday 現場報導全車系「第 4 季正式上市交車」，即 2026 年 Q4 起交車；TVBS 提到的「2027 年 3 月才開始生產」是針對入門的 GLB 200 electric，不是本車 250+。前手把入門車型的投產時間套用到整個車系，據此宣稱「第 1 年市場尚不存在」，已更正。即使如此，2026-08-12 當下仍未有實車交付，所有殘值與保養數字本質上都是推估。稅與保險依設計排除（台灣 BEV 牌照稅與燃料費均為 0 元，已由 Yahoo 汽車 EQB 車款頁實測確認，本表仍不計）。家用充電樁安裝（含電力申請與佈線，一般 NT$40,000-80,000）屬持有成本但不算保養，刻意排除、不列入 maintenance；公共充電電費同樣不列。

purchase.source: 本次獨立複核，未直接採信前手。NT$2,410,000 確認正確（差異 0%，遠低於 3% 門檻），但取得方式與前手不同：(1) ETtoday 車雲 https://speed.ettoday.net/news/3202321 本人 curl HTTP 200，內文車型表逐字為「GLB 250+ electric AMG Line七人座：241萬起」，同時載明「第4季正式上市交車」。(2) TVBS 地球黃金線 https://cars.tvbs.com.tw/car-news/333047 本人 curl HTTP 200，獨立列出全車系四款預售價 198／241／215／236 萬。(3) Yahoo 汽車頁面側欄的新聞摘要亦重複同一組數字，為第三個獨立出處。原廠官網 overview 頁我實測 curl 回 HTTP 000（連線失敗），與前手的 timeout 一致，兩人皆未能直讀，故不作為價格依據。discounts 與 onroad_fees 為市場慣例推估，非報價單。
purchase.notes: 完整車名為 Mercedes-Benz GLB 250+ electric AMG Line 7座（欄位長度限制故 trim 縮寫）。規格：MMA 平台、800V 高壓電氣架構、單馬達後驅 272 hp、可用電量 85 kWh、WLTP 633 km、DC 最高 320 kW、前行李廂 127 L。【7 座價格疑慮已排除】前手把「241 萬是否含第三排」列為風險並保留上修 5 萬的可能。實際上 ETtoday 的車型表把 241 萬直接標為「七人座」，GLB 200 electric 才標「五人座」，故 241 萬即為 7 座 AMG Line 的預售價，不需另加第三排選配費，list_price 不上修。【價格性質】241 萬是 2026-07-16 公布的預售價，正式上市牌價仍可能微調。【動力分類】本車為純電，powertrain = bev 正確。附帶界定：同車系的 GLB 200 / GLB 200 AMG Line 是 1.5 升四缸渦輪汽油引擎加 48V 輕油電（引擎 163 hp，電能另補 30 hp，8 速 DCT），無法純電行駛，那兩款若建檔應歸類為 gasoline 而非 hybrid，本記錄不受影響。【折讓 50,000】全新世代＋預售訂單＋剛開始交車，此階段台灣賓士幾乎不給現金折讓，促銷多以充電金、配件包、充電樁補助形式出現，以等值現金 5 萬計入屬保守。【領牌 60,000】新領牌照登記費與代辦約 15,000，配件約 45,000（隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、腳踏墊、鍍膜／內裝防護），約當車價 2.5%，符合 240 萬級距歐系豪華車實務。real_cost = 2,410,000 − 50,000 + 60,000 = 2,420,000。稅與保險依規定排除。

items.name: 過戶規費與代辦
售前整備與美容（拋光、內裝清潔、電池健康報告）
網路刊登費（8891／社團）

selling_costs.notes: 自售情境下的賣方成本，對應 private_sale_price。整備費抓在區間中上緣，因為豪華純電車自售時買方普遍要求原廠電池健康度（SoH）檢測報告，這筆比燃油車多花一點但能守住成交價。若改走車商收購（dealer_tradein_price）則這三項幾乎可省下，實務上已直接反映在較低的收購價裡。合計 12,000 落在此級距 6,000-15,000 的中段。

value_checkpoints.source: 已下修前手數字（原 1,700,000 = real_cost 的 70.2%，對德系純電偏高，接近日系水準）。本車 2026 Q4 才開始交車，第 1 年市場尚不存在，只能由同廠純電的實測曲線回推。本人於 2026-08-12 curl https://auto.8891.com.tw/mercedes-benz/eqb 與 /eqa（皆 HTTP 200）取得台灣賓士純電全部在售車源，最年輕的 EQB 為 2024 年式（2 年車）且標「電洽」不報價，故第 1 年無直接可比車。改以「車商開價鏈」推導：德系純電第 1 年車商開價約當新車牌價 75%（2,410,000 × 75% ≈ 1,807,500），自售價 = 車商開價 −12% ≈ 1,590,000（占 real_cost 65.7%），車商收購價 = 自售價 −13% ≈ 1,385,000。旁證：8891 上 2024 年式 EQE SUV 300（1.1 萬公里、約 2 年車）車商開價 2,050,000，對其新車牌價約 300 萬僅剩約 68%，顯示德系純電在台前兩年即掉三成以上，第 1 年 70% 的自售價不可能成立。低里程（7,000 km）已取上緣。

以前代 EQB（X243）在 8891 的真實在售車源換算，並修正前手的推導錯誤。前手用「Mercedes-Benz Select 原廠精選中古車 EQB 300 4MATIC、2023/04、16,506 km、1,580,000」當錨點，並主張 CPO 是價格鏈最上緣、需先 −6% 才等於一般車商售價。本人 curl https://auto.8891.com.tw/mercedes-benz/eqb（HTTP 200）發現同一台車就掛在 8891 上（2023 年、1.6 萬公里、158.0 萬、新北市實體車行，標題「2023年總代理EQB300跑少保固中」），它本來就是一般車商開價，前手多加的那一階 CPO 折讓是憑空捏造的。改用 8891 全部 4 筆有報價的 3 年低里程車源：1.6 萬 km／158.0 萬、3.0 萬 km／148.0 萬、3.0 萬 km／148.0 萬、3.15 萬 km／155.0 萬。EQB 300 4MATIC 新車牌價 2,670,000 已由本人以兩個獨立來源確認（Yahoo 汽車車款頁 267 萬、TechNews 267 萬）。本案第 3 年只跑 21,000 km，在上述四筆中內插得車商開價約 1,555,000，即 EQB 牌價的 58.2%。轉成自售價：58.2% × 0.88（車商開價 −12%）= 51.2% 的自售保值率，套用到本車 real_cost 2,420,000 得約 1,239,000，保守取 1,230,000（占 real_cost 50.8%）；車商收購價再 −13% 得 1,070,000。全表唯一有多筆同齡低里程實車佐證的檢查點，故給 medium。

外推，已小幅下修（原 900,000）。台灣沒有 5 年車齡的 EQB（2022 年 9 月才導入，U-CAR 專題確認）。落點由兩個真實錨點夾出：上緣是 8891 的 EQB 3 年低里程車商開價 58.2%（見第 3 年），下緣是 8891 的 EQC 400 4MATIC 運動版 2020 年式、3 萬公里、車商開價 1,080,000，車齡約 6 年、里程與本案第 6 年相當，對其新車牌價約 329 萬僅剩約 32.8%。在 3 年 58.2% 與 6 年 32.8% 之間取第 5 年車商開價約 40%（2,410,000 × 40% ≈ 964,000），自售價 = −12% ≈ 850,000（占 real_cost 35.1%），車商收購價 = −14% ≈ 730,000。第 3 年原廠保固到期後，二手市場開始對保固外維修風險折價；此時高壓電池仍在 8 年／16 萬公里保固內，是唯一支撐。EQC 的原始牌價未能以第一手來源核實，故此格維持 low。

外推，已下修（原 630,000），且已推翻前手「台灣市場根本沒有 7 年車齡的德系純電休旅可直接取樣」的說法。本人 curl https://auto.8891.com.tw/mercedes-benz/eqc（HTTP 200）取得台灣賓士最老的量產純電休旅 EQC 400 4MATIC 運動版，2020 年式、車齡約 6 年，共 3 筆在售：3 萬公里／1,080,000、3.6 萬公里／1,080,000、12.9 萬公里／990,000。兩筆低里程車正好貼合本案買家輪廓，是距離第 7 年只差一年的真實德系純電休旅錨點，前手完全未取樣。以其車商開價約當新車牌價 32.8%（第 6 年）為起點，沿此區間約每年 −18% 推到第 7 年約 26.9%，得車商開價 2,410,000 × 26.9% ≈ 648,000；自售價 = −12% ≈ 570,000。考量 GLB 250+ 是專屬純電平台、800V、633 km，體質優於當年由燃油平台改造且續航僅 400 餘公里的 EQC，向上微調至 590,000（占 real_cost 24.4%）；車商收購價 = −16% ≈ 495,000。此時 8 年高壓電池保固尚存最後一年。EQC 原始牌價僅為概略值，且屬跨車型外推，維持 low。

外推，信心最低，無任何 10 年車齡的德系純電可取樣（台灣最老的量產德系純電休旅就是上述 2020 年式 EQC，2026 年也才 6 年）。未虛構比價車。由第 7 年的車商開價 26.9% 再沿約每年 −15% 推三年得約 16.5%，車商開價 2,410,000 × 16.5% ≈ 398,000，自售價 = −12% ≈ 350,000（占 real_cost 14.5%），車商收購價 = −20% ≈ 280,000（車齡越大車商利潤要求越高，且老純電車車商收購意願低）。尾段持續下墜而非像 Lexus 那樣打平，主軸是高壓電池 8 年／16 萬公里保固已於第 8 年到期——這是純電殘值真正的斷崖：10 年車齡、保固外的 85 kWh 電池組一旦模組故障，在台維修報價可輕易超過整車殘值，二手市場會把這個風險整包折進價格。

maintenance.plan_notes: 【間隔是時間驅動】年均僅 7,000 km，10 年也才 70,000 km，遠達不到任何里程門檻，因此保養完全由時間決定：一年一次原廠年度檢查，煞車油每 2 年，冷卻液／電池冷卻液約每 4-5 年。【保固】賓士台灣新車保固 3 年不限里程、高壓電池 8 年或 16 萬公里，但保固只涵蓋瑕疵維修，不含例行保養；我未能查證此車預售是否綁定原廠預付保養套餐（官網 curl 回 HTTP 000），因此第 1、3 年一律以全額自費計價，若實際附贈套餐則早期成本會更低、第 5 年之後的數字不受影響。【BEV 免掉哪些】無機油與機油濾芯、無火星塞、無點火線圈、無水幫浦與正時、無變速箱油、無 DPF，也沒有 48V 啟動發電機（那是同車系燃油版 GLB 200 才有的項目），這是純電相對燃油德系 SUV 真正省下的部分。【BEV 反而貴的地方】整備質量約 2.2 噸（TVBS 確認 GLB 200 electric 為 2,185 kg，250+ 因 85 kWh 電池更重）加上瞬間扭力，胎耗損明顯快於同級燃油車；且 TVBS 規配表確認純電車型因應後驅採「前後配」不同尺寸輪胎、AMG Line 為 19 吋 AMG 輪圈（前手誤寫 19-20 吋），前後不同規格代表無法對調延壽、只能整組更換，約每 5-6 年就得換一組。動能回收讓來令片壽命極長，但低里程反而讓碟盤鏽蝕成為更換主因；12V 輔助電瓶照樣會壞。【尾段風險】第 7-10 年是保固全開的窗口，熱泵／空調壓縮機、車載充電器、充電座與高壓電池模組級維修都要自費。10 年保養合計約 522,000，顯著高於同級日系（RAV4 級距約 20-25 萬）、也高於同為純電但品牌工資較低的 Volvo EC40（約 25 萬），但低於德系燃油 SUV，這個相對關係是正確的。

major_items: 原廠年度檢查（純電：無機油、無火星塞）
冷氣濾網（活性碳）
雨刷片
checkpoints.source: 推估。賓士台灣未公開 GLB electric 保養價目表（官網 curl 回 HTTP 000，無法讀取），且此車 2026 Q4 才開始交車，無實際收據可引用。以在台純電車第一次年度檢查的普遍區間（檢查工資＋冷氣濾網約 5,000-8,000）取中位。無官方或收據佐證。

major_items: 年度檢查 ×2
煞車油更換（第 2 年）
冷氣濾網 ×2
checkpoints.source: 推估。涵蓋第 2、3 年兩次年度檢查（約 7,000 + 7,000）加第 2 年煞車油更換（原廠約 4,000-5,000）。此期間仍在 3 年原廠保固內，故障維修不計入自費。無官方價目表可核，維持 low。

major_items: 年度檢查 ×2
煞車油（第 4 年）
高壓電池冷卻液／防凍液
第一組輪胎四條（19 吋 AMG、前後不同尺寸，無法對調只能整組換）
12V 輔助電瓶（AGM）
四輪定位
checkpoints.source: 推估。第一組輪胎在此窗口到期是最大單筆：約 2.2 噸的純電車配 19 吋 AMG 胎，且 TVBS 規配表確認純電版採前後配不同尺寸、不能靠對調延壽，四條含工約 48,000。加年度檢查 ×2 約 16,000、煞車油 4,500、冷卻液 8,000、12V AGM 電瓶 9,000、定位與雜項 5,000。第 3 年保固到期後所有維修轉自費，此期別起才是真實持有成本。輪胎與工資金額為市場行情推估，未取得原廠報價。

major_items: 年度檢查 ×2
煞車油
前後煞車來令片與碟盤（低里程鏽蝕主導）
避震器與懸吊襯套
空調系統保養
保固外電子件維修預備
checkpoints.source: 推估。完全在保固外。低里程加動能回收讓來令片幾乎不磨，但台灣濕氣重、低里程讓碟盤鏽蝕先到極限，會迫使前後一起換（賓士大尺寸碟盤約 55,000）。加年度檢查 ×2 約 18,000、煞車油 5,000、懸吊 25,000、空調 8,000、電子件維修預備 15,000。此為「德系保固外」的典型量級，明顯高於日系同齡車。無實收據佐證。

major_items: 年度檢查 ×3
第二組輪胎四條（19 吋前後配）
煞車油 ×2
冷卻液
12V 電瓶
熱泵／空調壓縮機風險
懸吊零件（襯套、避震器）更換
車載充電器與充電座風險
高壓電池保固到期後模組級維修預備
checkpoints.source: 推估，且是全表最不確定的一格。第 8 年高壓電池保固到期，這 3 年窗口是首次完全無保障。組成：年度檢查 ×3 約 30,000、第二組輪胎 55,000、煞車油 ×2 10,000、冷卻液 9,000、12V 電瓶 10,000、熱泵／壓縮機風險 45,000、懸吊零件 35,000、車載充電器／充電座風險 40,000、高壓電池模組級維修預備 30,000、雜項 16,000。已較前手的 300,000 下修 20,000：全車 10 年僅 70,000 km，懸吊屬年限老化而非磨耗，原本編列的「懸吊全套更換 50,000」在此里程下不合理，改列 35,000。刻意不編列整組電池更換（在台報價可達 80-150 萬、遠超屆時殘值 350,000，實務上多半直接報廢或換車），僅編列模組級維修準備金。

sources.note: 價格與時間點的第一來源。車型表逐字列出「GLB 200 electric五人座：198萬起／GLB 250+ electric AMG Line七人座：241萬起／GLB 200五人座：215萬起／GLB 200 AMG Line七人座：236萬起」，因此 241 萬即為 7 座 AMG Line 的價格，不需另加第三排選配費。同文明載「將在第4季正式上市交車」，據此推翻前手「2027 年 3 月才量產」的全車系說法。並確認 800V 架構、85 kWh、WLTP 633 km、320 kW DC、127 L 前行李廂。

sources.name: TVBS 地球黃金線 — 新世代 GLB 完整規配（本人 curl 驗證，HTTP 200）

assumptions.notes: 車主年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律以 7,000 km × 年數計算（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km）。所有金額為 TWD。依表格設計，牌照稅、燃料稅與各項保險（強制險、車體險）全部排除，不計入 purchase 也不計入 maintenance。低里程車在中古市場售價高於「不看里程的平均行情」，各年份殘值已針對此做向上修正，並於各 source 字串說明。柴油車在台灣的另一項隱性成本是 AdBlue 補充與短程行駛造成的 DPF 積碳，已計入 maintenance 而非此處。查核修正：台灣規格 GLE 300 d 4MATIC 標配 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊（非鋼簧），此為原研究誤判的項目，已改寫入第 7、10 年保養並調整第 10 年殘值。

purchase.source: 官方建議售價 343 萬元。查核者獨立重驗，四個來源一致：Auto-Online 2026 年式價格表（實際抓取成功，明列「GLE 300 d 4MATIC 星耀版：343萬元」、Coupé 星耀版 367 萬、GLE 450 星耀版 415 萬，文章日期 2026-07-16）、TVBS Cars（實際抓取成功，「GLE 300d 4Matic星耀版從343萬元起跳」，並列 GLE 53 星夜版 457 萬、Coupé 星耀版 367 萬）、工商時報 ctee（「車價343萬元起，較上一代車價增4萬元」）、ETtoday 車雲（「售價同步調漲4萬元，分別來到343萬元」）。原研究的 3,430,000 正確，維持不變（差異 0%，遠低於 3% 門檻）。歷史定價脈絡：2023 年小改款上市 337 萬 → 2025 年式 339 萬 → 2026 年式 343 萬。折扣與領牌配件為市場行情推估，非公開牌價。
purchase.notes: 動力：OM654 M 2.0L 四缸柴油渦輪，272ps / 550Nm，搭配第二代 48V ISG 整合式啟動發電機（可額外輸出約 20ps / 200Nm）。注意：這是 48V 輕度混合動力，無法純電行駛，因此不分類為 hybrid；其基礎燃料為柴油，故 powertrain = diesel。48V 系統本身在 8-10 年後是高單價故障風險項目，已反映在後期保養成本。查核新增：台灣規格 GLE 全車系（含 300 d）標配 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊，非鋼簧＋選擇性阻尼——這是本次查核推翻原研究假設的主要事實，直接墊高第 7、10 年的保養風險並壓低第 10 年殘值。折扣 150,000 元（約 4.4%）：台灣賓士整體讓價幅度小於 Volvo／Audi，但柴油車型在台灣需求持續萎縮、去化較慢，300 d 的實際成交讓利明顯高於同車系的 GLE 450 汽油版，故取較高的一端；此數字包含現金折讓與業代贈品折算，無公開成交價來源可佐證。領牌相關費用 120,000 元明細推估：新領牌照規費＋代辦約 12,000 元、高規格隔熱紙（大型 SUV 全車含全景天窗）約 50,000 元、車身鍍膜約 28,000 元、行車記錄器＋腳踏墊＋晴雨窗等配件約 30,000 元。real_cost = 3,430,000 - 150,000 + 120,000 = 3,400,000（已驗算）。

items.name: 過戶規費＋代辦費
售前整備／內外美容（豪華 SUV 賣相處理、輪圈整理、小補漆）
8891 等平台自售刊登費

selling_costs.notes: 以自售（私下交易）情境估算。過戶規費本身僅數百元，代辦約 1,500-3,000 元。此級距 SUV 車身面積大、賣相直接影響成交價，售前整備通常會做到位。若選擇直接賣給車商則可省下刊登與部分整備費，但售價要改用 dealer_tradein_price。查核：總額 13,000 元＝3,000＋8,000＋2,000，落在此級距合理區間（6,000-15,000），維持不變。

value_checkpoints.source: 查核者實際重抓 8891 中古車 GLE 300d 在架清單（33 筆），確認全部為車商售價（車商開價），已逐筆核對年份／里程／價格。1 年車：2026 年式星耀版市場上尚無在架個體，屬外推。最接近的實測錨點為 2024 年式（2 年車）/ 4.2 萬 km 車商開價 243.8 萬（約當時牌價 339 萬的 71.9%）——注意該車 4.2 萬 km 屬同齡偏高里程。由此往上推 1 年、並把里程由 4.2 萬 km 拉低到 7,000 km，得 1 年低里程車車商開價約 79.5%（343 萬 × 0.795 ≈ 272.7 萬）。再依「車商售價 > 自售價 > 車商收購價」折算：自售 = 車商開價 × 0.88 ≈ 240 萬（-12%，落在 8-15% 帶內）；車商收購 = 自售 × 0.875 ≈ 210 萬（再 -12.5%）。交叉驗算：2 年車 243.8 萬車商開價折自售約 214.5 萬，本車年輕 1 年且少跑 3.5 萬 km，240 萬合理。相對 real_cost 340 萬，第一年帳面損失約 29.4%（保值率 70.6%），符合德系豪華 SUV 在台灣第 1 年的陡跌特性，非日系的高 70%／80% 區間。查核維持原值。

查核者重抓 8891 並逐筆核對年份，修正原研究的抽樣錯誤：實際 2023 年份（3 年車）在架為 1.3 萬 km / 229.8 萬、2.74 萬 km / 223.8 萬、3.59 萬 km / 230.0 萬、3.9 萬 km / 209.8 萬、6.7 萬 km / 208.8 萬、6.72 萬 km / 208.0 萬、2.55 萬 km / 電洽。原研究誤把「5.7 萬 km / 188.8 萬」列為 2023 年份，該筆實際為 2022 年份，已從樣本剔除。本車 21,000 km 落在 1.3 萬與 2.74 萬 km 兩筆實測之間，屬區間內插、非外推：該里程帶車商開價約 227 萬，對 2023 年牌價 337 萬約 67.4%；套用到本車 343 萬 → 車商開價約 231 萬。自售 = × 0.88 ≈ 203 萬，取保守值 202 萬（對觀察到的 227 萬車商開價為 -11%，落在 8-15% 帶內）；車商收購 = × 0.87 ≈ 176 萬。剔除誤植樣本後結論不變，此仍為本車唯一有直接同里程實價支撐的檢查點。

查核者重抓確認 8891 上 2021 年份（5 年車）實際在架為 5.0 萬 km / 165.8 萬（2 筆）、6.85 萬 km / 163.8 萬、8.0 萬 km / 159.8 萬（2 筆）、8.5 萬 km / 159.8 萬、10.8 萬 km / 145.6-145.8 萬、10.9 萬 km / 158.0 萬——里程全部落在 5.0-10.9 萬 km，明顯高於本車假設的 3.5 萬 km。以 2021 年牌價約 331 萬計，5 萬 km 車約 50.1%、10.9 萬 km 車約 44.0%。本車 3.5 萬 km 屬同齡極低里程，向上修正約 6% 至 53%（含跨年式牌價換算 343/331）：343 萬 × 0.53 ≈ 181.8 萬車商開價。自售 = × 0.88 ≈ 160 萬；車商收購 = × 0.865 ≈ 138 萬。里程外推幅度不小（實測最低 5 萬 km → 假設 3.5 萬 km），故不給 high。第 3 年原廠保固到期後中古市場開始把維修風險灌進報價，這是 3→5 年跌幅仍陡的主因；同世代比較車同樣配備 AIRMATIC，氣壓懸吊風險已內含於這些實測開價中，故本檢查點不另做扣減。查核維持原值。

現行 W167 世代 2019 年在台上市，故 7 年車確實存在，但在架量極少且里程都很高。查核者重抓並修正原研究的年份誤植：8891 上 10.1 萬 km / 129.8 萬該筆實際為 2019 年份（＝7 年車），原研究誤記為 2020 年份；另有多筆 2019 年份 / 13 萬 km / 122.8 萬。以 2019 年牌價約 328 萬計，10.1 萬 km 約 39.6%、13 萬 km 約 37.4%。本車 4.9 萬 km 遠低於這些實測樣本，里程修正幅度大（13 萬 → 4.9 萬 km），是此檢查點信心低的主因。取車商開價約 42%（相對 39.6% 僅上修 6%，屬保守）：343 萬 × 0.42 ≈ 144 萬；自售 = × 0.87 ≈ 125 萬；車商收購 = × 0.85 ≈ 106 萬。車齡愈大車商收購折讓愈深，故此處價差比第 1、3 年更大。7 年車已完全脫離原廠保固與延長保固（延保最多到第 6 年），市場對 2.0 柴油＋48V＋AIRMATIC 的後續維修風險定價明顯轉為保守，殘值曲線並未像 Lexus 那樣走平。比較車為同世代同懸吊規格，氣壓懸吊風險已內含於實測開價，故金額維持原值。

查核下修（原 83 萬／69 萬）。現行 W167 世代 2019 年才在台上市，2026 年沒有任何 10 年車，因此不編造，改用前代 W166 GLE（2015-2019）的實際成交價換算保值率再套用到本車。前代原始牌價經查核者獨立驗證：GLE 250 d 4MATIC 285 萬（AutoStar／jwincar 中古車頁明載「新車售價285萬」）。前代 10 年實測：2016 GLE 250d 車商開價 68.8 萬（HOT 大聯盟，查核者實際抓取確認頁面存在、2016 GLE 250D、688,000 元、2.1L、新北）→ 24.1%；市場其他 2016 GLE 250d 開價約 73.8 萬起。FindCar 顯示 GLE250d 在架 13 台平均 105.9 萬，但混雜 2016-2019 多個年份，不是乾淨的 10 年點，僅作上緣參考。原研究取 24-25% 後因低里程上修至 28%，查核認為上修過度：W166 GLE 250d 為鋼簧懸吊、2.1L 柴油、無 48V，而本車標配 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊、多一套 48V ISG 與更複雜電子架構，10 年車的維修風險顯著更高，中古市場會反向折價，足以抵銷大部分低里程溢價。故改取 25.5%：343 萬 × 0.255 ≈ 87.5 萬車商開價；自售 = × 0.87 ≈ 76 萬；車商收購 = × 0.83 ≈ 63 萬。此為明示外推、非實測，且跨世代規格不對等，故 confidence 為 low。

maintenance.plan_notes: 保養節奏由「時間」而非「里程」決定。賓士 ASSYST PLUS 對柴油車的建議間隔約 20,000 km 或 12 個月孰先到，本車年跑 7,000 km，永遠是 12 個月先到，因此一律以每年進廠一次計算，10 年共 10 次，A/B 保養交替。台灣賓士原廠保養行情（2ggx.com 保養費整理，查核者實際抓取確認）：E-Class／GLE 級距 Service A 約 10,000-15,000 元、Service B 約 18,000-30,000 元；GLE 300 d 因機油量大（約 8.5L）、含柴油濾芯與 AdBlue，實務上落在區間上緣，故本表取 A 約 15,000-19,000、B 約 28,000-35,000（逐年微幅通膨）。保固：新車享 3 年不限里程原廠保固（查核者獨立確認台灣賓士「3年期且不限里程之保固責任」），因此第 1-3 年只有保養費、沒有自費維修。台灣賓士第 4-6 年延長保固為「自由選購」方案而非標配（查核者確認經銷商說明「可以自由選購第 4-6 年的專屬延長保固方案」），故本表未把它當作既定成本扣抵，第 4 年起各期一律承擔完整未補貼的自費維修風險；若車主實際加購延保（GLE 級距約 6-9 萬元），第 5、7 年檢查點的維修風險部分會下降，但要另計延保保費。未發現台灣賓士隨 GLE 附贈標配預付保養套餐的證據。**查核重大修正：台灣規格 GLE 全車系（含 300 d 4MATIC 星耀版）標配 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊**，原研究誤按鋼簧計算並把此列為未解問題。AIRMATIC 是 7-10 年期最大的單一高單價風險：原廠氣壓避震筒單角連工資約 7-9 萬元，壓縮機／閥體總成約 4-6 萬元，且失效由橡膠老化與台灣高溫高濕主導、與低里程無關，故第 7 年加計約 35,000 元、第 10 年加計約 120,000 元的機率加權金額。低里程另外放大兩個柴油風險：短程行駛使 DPF（柴油微粒濾清器）難以被動再生、積碳累積，以及 48V 鋰電池長期淺充淺放的衰退，兩者同樣以機率加權方式列在第 7、10 年，而非假設必然發生。10 年保養總計約 941,000 元（原研究 786,000，AIRMATIC 修正後 +155,000），明顯高於同級日系 SUV（RAV4 同條件約 25-30 萬，約為其 3.1-3.8 倍），原因是原廠工時費率、20 吋大尺寸輪胎與煞車系統、氣壓懸吊，以及保固外的柴油專屬項目。

雨刷片、AdBlue 補充

checkpoints.source: 台灣賓士原廠 Service A 行情：2ggx.com 保養費整理（查核者實際抓取成功）明列 E-Class／GLE 級距 A Service 10,000-15,000 元。GLE 300 d 為柴油、機油量大，取區間上緣 15,000 元，另加耗材與 AdBlue 約 3,000 元。保固年限依台灣賓士官方說明：3 年不限里程（查核者獨立確認）。查核維持原值。

AdBlue 補充與例行檢查
仍在 3 年原廠保固內，故障均由原廠吸收

20 吋輪胎四條更換（依橡膠老化年限而非里程，約 5-6 年一次）
前後煞車來令片首次更換

checkpoints.source: 第 3 年底原廠保固到期，本期起開始自費。輪胎：Autobacs 台灣 275/50R20 Pirelli（GLE 20 吋原廠認證規格）單條 12,298 元，四條約 49,000 元，加定位取 52,000 元——本車 5 年只跑 3.5 萬 km，胎紋未必磨到底，但橡膠已老化，屬年限到期更換。Service B 30,000＋Service A 17,000（2ggx.com 行情上緣）。前後來令片 25,000（碟盤此期先不換）、12V AGM 電瓶 14,000、AdBlue 與雜項 4,000、保固外零星維修 15,000。AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊此期已服役 5 年但仍屬正常壽命內，故不計入故障金額，風險集中於第 7、10 年。單項價格為市場行情推估，未取得實際收據；Autobacs 僅取得網域層級來源，未取得該商品深層固定連結。查核維持原值。

checkpoints.source: 涵蓋第 8、9、10 三年，是全表最貴的一段。查核上修（原 385,000）：新增 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊風險攤提 120,000 元——標配項目，原廠氣壓避震筒單角連工資約 7-9 萬、壓縮機／閥體總成約 4-6 萬，且失效由橡膠老化與台灣高溫高濕主導、與低里程無關，8-10 年正是集中發生期，以兩角約六成機率＋壓縮機約五成機率加權。其餘沿用：Service B 34,000＋Service A 19,000＋Service B 35,000；第二套輪胎 56,000（Autobacs 275/50R20 四條 49,000 加通膨與定位）；12V AGM 電瓶 15,000；來令片 22,000；底盤件 45,000；煞車油／變速箱油／水箱精等 25,000；48V 鋰電池／ISG 45,000（全新 ISG 總成逾 12 萬，以發生機率加權）、DPF 更換 40,000（總成逾 12 萬，低里程短程使用提高機率）、渦輪／EGR／噴油嘴／預熱塞等柴油項目 50,000。台灣修車廠公開資訊確認 48V 電池為賓士已知痛點、柴油 DPF 警示燈維修為常見項目，氣壓避震亦有專門維修店家存在（CG 氣壓避震器維修專賣店、LS 聯盛汽車），但三者均未公布金額，故全部單價為推估、confidence 給 low。此段成本約為同級日系 SUV 同期的 3 倍以上，是德系豪華柴油 SUV 長期持有的主要成本。

sources.note: 查核者確認頁面確實存在（標題涵蓋油費、保險、稅金、保值率），但內文數字同樣未載入，未取得任何數字。列此純為紀錄確實嘗試過此來源，未用於任何估算。

assumptions.notes: 買家年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律以 7,000 km × 年數計（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。此里程下保養屬時間驅動而非里程驅動：Mercedes ASSYST PLUS 的「1 年或 10,000 km」門檻會先撞到「1 年」，所以每年進廠一次、A/B Service 交替，油品與煞車油照年限換，輪胎約每 5-6 年因老化（非磨耗）更換。稅（牌照稅 15,210 元/年、燃料稅 7,200 元/年，已於 U-CAR 車型表核對）與保險依設計完全排除在本表之外。殘值一律取 8891／SUM 上里程最接近的低里程物件，並在 source 中寫明由車商開價往下修為自售價的幅度。低里程加成有直接證據：8891 上 2022 年式 GLE450 4Matic 在 44,000 km 開價 2,380,000，在 80,200 km 只開 1,890,000，同年式因里程差 36,000 km 就差 26%，因此本買家的車在每個檢查點都應高於「不分里程的平均行情」。

purchase.source: U-CAR 新車頻道 GLE 車型/售價表（本次自行以 curl 抓取原頁核對，2026-08-12）：GLE 450 4Matic 星耀版 4,150,000 元、GLE 300 d 4Matic 星耀版 3,430,000 元，同頁明載 2026 年式由「進化版」改為「星耀版」、兩車型售價各調漲 40,000 元（進化版為 3,390,000 / 4,110,000）。原研究者的 4,150,000 經獨立查證正確，list_price 不修改。onroad_fees 由 95,000 上修為 110,000：原值僅佔車價 2.3%，低於同家族 GLE 300 d（車價 3,430,000、onroad_fees 120,000）的比例，不符「隨車價等比放大」的規則。折讓 150,000 維持，為市場行情推估。
purchase.notes: 動力為 M256 3.0 升直列六缸渦輪汽油引擎（2,999 c.c.、381 hp，已於 U-CAR 規格表核對），搭載 ISG 48V 輕油電系統，原廠稱可額外提供約 20 匹輔助動力。48V ISG 屬 mild hybrid，無法純電行駛，因此本表分類為 gasoline 而非 hybrid（分類正確，未修改）。折讓 150,000 偏保守：星耀版 2026 年 7 月才在台開賣，是全新年式且為賓士下半年主力，現金折讓空間比清庫存車型小，實務上多以領牌代辦與精品折抵形式給出。onroad_fees 110,000 = 領牌規費與號牌約 6,000 + 代辦費約 10,000 + 配件約 94,000（隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、腳踏墊、鍍膜／車美仕，4,150,000 級距、20 吋輪圈車的常見配置）。real_cost = 4,150,000 − 150,000 + 110,000 = 4,110,000。稅與保險不含。另註：U-CAR 配備表原始 HTML 已核對，「主動式電子懸載系統」（AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊）在 300 d 與 450 星耀版的 img alt 皆為「選用配備」而非「標準配備」，本表的保養成本以未選配 AIRMATIC 為基準。

items.name: 過戶費（規費＋代辦）
售前整備／美容（大型豪華 SUV 全車美容、內裝清潔、輕微補漆）
刊登費（8891 個人自售刊登／照片）

selling_costs.notes: 以個人自售（非車商收購）為前提，總額 14,000 落在本級距合理帶內，未修改。過戶規費本身很便宜（1,000 元上下），主要成本在賣相整備——4,150,000 級距的德系大型 SUV 買家挑剔，20 吋輪圈整理、內裝皮革與 Nappa 方向盤保養、輪拱與保桿刮痕處理都會做，所以整備抓 10,000。若走車商收購（trade-in）則這 14,000 多半可省下，但售價要改用 dealer_tradein_price。

value_checkpoints.source: 【已下修，原研究者的 3,050,000 過高】原值的錨點是 8891 上一台 2025 年式 GLE Coupé 300 d 4Matic（17,000 km、開價 3,088,000）——不同車型、不同動力、不同車身，不能拿來推 GLE 450。本次改用同車型的真實成交級距：8891 上 2024 年式 GLE 450 4Matic（31,000 km）車商開價 2,868,000，當年式牌價 4,090,000，車商開價留存率 70.1%（本次自行 curl 抓取 8891 共 8 頁、261 筆 GLE 在售車輛核對）。該樣本里程 31,000 km 高於本買家 2 年時的 14,000 km，做里程修正後 2 年車商開價約為牌價 73%；德系豪華 SUV 第 1→2 年車商開價通常再差 7-8 個百分點，故 1 年車商開價取牌價 80% ≈ 3,320,000。再依「車商售價 > 自售價 > 車商收購價」修正：自售 = 車商開價 −12.7% ≈ 2,900,000；車商收購 = 自售 −13.1% ≈ 2,520,000。對 real_cost 的留存率由原本的 74.5% 降為 70.6%，符合德系第一年重跌的形狀。無 1 年內的 GLE 450 實際刊登，故 confidence 維持 medium。

本表證據最紮實的一點，數字大致維持原研究者的結論並已逐筆驗證。8891 實際刊登（2026-08-12 自行抓取）：2023 年式 GLE450 4Matic 三筆——50,000 km 開價 2,658,000（兩筆不同車商）、55,000 km 開價 2,658,000；當年式（小改款後）牌價 4,090,000，車商開價留存率 65.0%。另有 2024 年式 31,000 km 開價 2,868,000（70.1%）可夾出曲線。本車 3 年僅 21,000 km，比樣本少約 30,000 km，依同年式里程敏感度給約 +3 個百分點 → 車商開價 68% × 4,150,000 ≈ 2,820,000。自售 = 車商開價 −13.1% ≈ 2,450,000；車商收購 = 自售 −13.1% ≈ 2,130,000。同車型、同世代、多筆實際刊登，confidence 維持 high。

【已上修，原研究者的 1,690,000 偏低，錯在基準價不一致】原值把 8891 上 2021 年式 GLE450（70,000 km）的 1,688,000 這個「絕對金額」加 10% 直接套到本車，但該樣本的原始牌價是 3,810,000（小改款前），本車是 4,150,000，必須轉成留存率再套：1,688,000 / 3,810,000 = 44.3%，× 1.10 低里程加成 = 48.7%，× 4,150,000 ≈ 2,020,000 才是對應的車商開價。本次另抓到原研究者漏掉的低里程樣本，方向一致：2022 年式 GLE450 4Matic 44,000 km 開價 2,380,000（兩筆）、2021 年式 60,000 km 開價 1,728,000、2020 年式 40,599 km（AMG 七人座）開價 2,480,000。本車 5 年僅 35,000 km，低於所有 5 年樣本，車商開價取牌價 51% ≈ 2,120,000。自售 = −12.6% ≈ 1,800,000；車商收購 = −13.9% ≈ 1,550,000。原研究者宣稱的「3→4 年斷崖 −29%」是里程不對等造成的假象：2,658,000（2023 年式 50,000 km）對 1,890,000（2022 年式 80,200 km），但同一批 2022 年式在 44,000 km 是 2,380,000，里程對齊後單年跌幅約 −10% 而非 −29%。仍為外推＋里程修正，confidence medium。

【已上修，原研究者的 1,470,000 偏低，同樣是基準價不一致】本代 W167 於 2019 年在台上市，7 年車有真實資料。8891 實際刊登（2026-08-12 自行抓取）：2019 年式 GLE450 4MATIC 50,000 km→1,738,000、57,699 km→1,688,000、60,000/61,000/62,000 km→1,688,000、72,000 km→1,598,000、80,000-85,000 km→1,730,000-1,738,000；當年式牌價 3,810,000，車商開價留存率 44.3-45.6%。原值把 1,700,000 這個絕對金額直接當本車的車商開價，等於忽略本車牌價高出 340,000。改用留存率：45.0% × 4,150,000 ≈ 1,870,000，再為「2033 年時已過保固、且極可能落後一個世代（下一代 GLE 屆時應已在台上市），二手市場會把修繕風險折進去」保守下修約 7% → 車商開價取 1,730,000。自售 = −13.3% ≈ 1,500,000；車商收購 = −14.0% ≈ 1,290,000。有同車型 7 年實際刊登但需跨牌價換算與風險折價，confidence medium。

明確外推，非本代實測。本代 W167 台灣 2019 才上市，沒有 10 年實績，故改用前代 W166 的同性質車型 GLE 400 4MATIC（3.0 V6 汽油、333 hp）：台灣原廠牌價 3,410,000（LUX 3,630,000），已於 Wayback Machine 的 U-CAR 2017-06-13 快照逐行核對。這些車現在的車商開價——8891：2016 年式 90,000 km→668,000、100,000 km→655,000、102,000 km（LUX）→688,000、74,000 km（LUX）→828,000；SUM 汽車網：2016 年式 102,448 km→798,000。以 3,410,000（LUX 用 3,630,000）為分母，90,000-102,000 km 的 10 年留存率為 19.2-23.4%，中位數約 20.5%；里程最低的 74,000 km LUX 為 22.8%。本車 10 年僅 70,000 km，取 22.5% 留存率套回本車 4,150,000 牌價 → 車商開價約 934,000。自售 = −14.3% ≈ 800,000；車商收購 = −15.0% ≈ 680,000。旁證：8891／SUM 的 2017-2018 年式 GLE400（8-9 年、43,000-72,000 km）開價 868,000-958,000，與此曲線連續——德系尾段沒有 Lexus 那種打平，而是持續下探。風險提醒：W166 是 V6 自然世代、無 48V，本車的 M256＋48V ISG 在 10 年後的修繕風險更高，實際尾段可能比此外推值更低。confidence low。

maintenance.plan_notes:
重要誠實聲明：本次（含覆核）仍未能取得任何台灣賓士官方保養價目表，也未能取得車主實際收據（www.mercedes-benz.com.tw 連線逾時、Mobile01 回 403、中華賓士網站無價目頁）。以下金額全部是依本車實際規格推估的工程估算，不是抄來的報價，因此五個檢查點的 confidence 一律標 low。推估基礎為已由 U-CAR 規格表原頁證實的規格：M256 3.0 直列六缸＋ISG 48V、9G-TRONIC、4MATIC、車重 2,310 kg、輪胎 275/50 R20、油箱 85 L；AIRMATIC 依 U-CAR 配備表原始 HTML（img alt=「選用配備」）為選配，本表以未選配估算。

保養節奏：年行駛僅 7,000 km，ASSYST PLUS 的「1 年或 10,000 km」一定是年限先到，所以是每年一次、A Service 與 B Service 交替，不是里程驅動。B Service 含煞車油與較多濾芯，價格約為 A Service 的兩倍。

覆核調整：第 1 年由 15,000 上修為 18,000、1-3 年由 50,000 上修為 55,000。理由是原值讓這台六缸汽油 GLE 的前期保養比同家族的四缸柴油 GLE 300 d（18,000 / 48,000）還便宜，方向相反——M256 直六單次換油約 8.5 L 全合成，工料都高於 300 d 的四缸。3 年之後的三段維持原值。

保固與套餐：台灣賓士新車一般享原廠保固（本次未能取得官網頁面佐證年限，一般認知為 3 年不限里程），另有可加購的延長保固與預付式保養套餐（Mercedes-Benz Select 網站證實有「延長保固」與「守護星服務」，但價格需洽經銷商）。本表把前 3 年壓在低水準（18,000 / 55,000）就是反映保固期內零件維修為零；相對地 3 年之後完全不做任何補貼假設，全額由車主負擔，後段的 175,000／195,000／470,000 即為未補貼的真實成本。

為什麼遠高於日系同級：原廠工資高、20 吋大輪胎與大尺寸煞車耗材貴、六缸引擎油量大，加上出保後的風險項目——M256 的電子水泵與節溫器殼漏水、點火線圈、48V ISG／DC-DC 轉換器、以及若有選配 AIRMATIC 的氣壓筒。10 年合計約 913,000 元，約為同期 RAV4 的三倍，這個量級差距是刻意的，不是估算誤差。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the TW average of 12,000-15,000 km. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). This drives two things. (1) SERVICING IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: Volvo's interval is 10,000 km OR 12 months, whichever comes first, so at 7,000 km/year the clock always wins and the car gets exactly one annual service and never a mileage-triggered one. Wear items therefore age out rather than wear out: 235/55 R19 tyres (confirmed as the factory size in Volvo TW's own MY26 XC60 sheet, same fitment as the B5) are replaced on rubber age at ~5-6 years, and the 12V AGM battery dies on calendar life. Volvo Taiwan's free scheduled-maintenance programme does NOT apply here: volvomsp.volvocartw.com states in its own footnote that the 4-year/80,000 km free maintenance offer is for 電動車 (BEVs: EX30/EX40/EC40/EX90) only, so this PHEV owner pays for every annual service from year 1. (2) RESALE: every XC60 T8 listing found live on 8891/FindCar carries 19,000-109,000 km, all above this buyer's pace, so comps were normalised UPWARD toward 7,000 km/year before the dealer-retail to private-sale haircut. The uplift used for this car is deliberately small (~0.1% per 1,000 km, roughly a quarter of the 0.375% per 1,000 km measured on the petrol/MHEV XC60) because on a PHEV low mileage does not protect the thing buyers actually worry about: the 18.8 kWh pack degrades on calendar age regardless of km, and in Taiwan a very-low-mileage PHEV is often read as a car whose owner never bothered to charge it. The 0.375%/1,000 km petrol figure was measured independently here from 8891's own 2021 XC60 B5 R-Design cohort (NT$1,300,000 @45,200 km vs NT$989,000 @109,000 km). Tax (牌照稅/燃料費/貨物稅) and insurance are excluded by design throughout.

purchase.source: VERIFIED FROM THE PRIMARY SOURCE, NOT FROM A SUMMARY. I downloaded Volvo Taiwan's own MY26 XC60 price/specification sheet (https://www.volvocartw.com/pdf/carsp/XC60.pdf, HTTP 200, 264 KB, 7 pages) and decompressed its PDF text streams directly. The raw stream reads 'XC60, B5 AWD' / 'XC60, T8 AWD plug in Hybrid' with 'Plus : NT$2,390,000', 'Ultra : NT$2,690,000' and 'Ultra : NT$2,990,000', and the sheet carries an 'MY26' version stamp. The same stream confirms 235/55 R19 tyres and the 18.8 kWh battery. CarStuff independently prints the identical three-car range: 'XC60 B5 MHEV Plus AWD：$239 萬元 / XC60 B5 MHEV Ultra AWD：$269 萬元 / XC60 T8 PHEV Ultra AWD：$299 萬元'. list_price is therefore confirmed at NT$2,990,000, 0% deviation from the briefed figure, no correction needed. DISCOUNT: anchored on documented Volvo TW behaviour rather than a guess. CarStuff reports the launch '隨心入主方案' putting the B5 Plus AWD at NT$2,240,000 against a NT$2,390,000 list, i.e. NT$150,000 (6.3%) off, plus a bundled HUD worth NT$60,000. 8891's August 2026 Volvo package gives XC60 buyers 120萬 40期 0利率 plus a free HUD upgrade, and explicitly advises giving up the interest subsidy in exchange for a deeper 純空車現金折扣. NT$180,000 (6.0% of list) is a realistic negotiated cash 空車折讓 on the T8 Ultra: larger in absolute terms than the documented B5 Plus offer, because this is the slowest-moving halo trim in the range, but slightly lower as a percentage, as flagship trims usually are. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from discounts: the government 舊換新 + 貨物稅減徵 subsidy of up to NT$100,000 (conditional on scrapping a 10-year-old car, and it is a tax rebate, which this table excludes by design) and the bundled HUD (an accessory, not cash).
purchase.notes: Full official designation is 'XC60 T8 AWD Plug-in Hybrid Ultra', the MY2026 (second-facelift) car, and it is the only T8 in the current three-car Taiwan XC60 range (B5 Plus AWD / B5 Ultra AWD / T8 Ultra AWD). Powertrain per Volvo TW's own sheet and CarStuff: second-generation PHEV architecture, engine on the front axle plus a rear electric motor forming e-AWD, combined 455 hp / 72.3 kgm, 18.8 kWh lithium pack, up to 86 km of pure-electric range and a 140 km/h EV top speed; the T8 gets the Bowers & Wilkins 15-speaker 1,410 W system where the B5 gets Harman Kardon. onroad_fees of NT$50,000 covers 領牌規費, 代辦服務費 and basic delivery accessories (mats, window film, dashcam) at this price level; it is scaled consistently with the other Volvo records in this table (NT$40,000 at the NT$2,390,000 XC60 B5, NT$45,000 at the NT$2,790,000 V60 T8, NT$65,000 at the NT$3,776,000 XC90 T8). real_cost = 2,990,000 - 180,000 + 50,000 = 2,860,000. Tax and insurance excluded by design.

8891／FindCar 自售刊登費

selling_costs.notes: Cost of actually completing a private sale, at the level normal for a 2-3 million TWD European SUV. Pre-sale detailing is the big line: a car at this price will not attract private-buyer money without paint correction and a proper interior clean. One PHEV-specific point that is NOT charged here but is worth knowing: Volvo TW's prepaid 保養服務合約 (VOLVO Plus) is transferable to the next owner, so an unused balance is a genuine selling aid rather than a sunk cost.

value_checkpoints.source: BACKCAST ONE YEAR FROM REAL LISTINGS; NO 1-YEAR-OLD T8 IS CURRENTLY ON THE MARKET, so this is not a directly observed point. The nearest real data is the age-2.1 cohort on 8891: 2024款 Recharge Ultimate T8 AWD at NT$1,950,000 / 19,000 km and NT$1,930,000 / 26,500 km, both against a verified MY2024 list of NT$2,941,000 (FindCar new-car reference table), i.e. 0.663 and 0.656 of list as DEALER RETAIL ASKING. Normalising both to this buyer's mileage gives ~0.665 of list at 2.1 years. Backcasting the fitted curve (0.665 @2.1y, 0.609 @3.1y, 0.520 @4.1y) to 1 year gives ~0.74 of list as dealer retail, consistent with a ~25-point first-year loss, which is normal for a Taiwan luxury PHEV; the shape is cross-checked against the one near-1-year XC60 B5 on FindCar (2024-built / 2025-registered, 11,704 km, asking NT$1,758,000). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 0.74 x NT$2,990,000 = NT$2,212,600 dealer retail, then -15% to reach the PRIVATE SALE figure of NT$1,880,000. The 15% haircut is the deep end of the normal 8-15% band, used deliberately because the private buyer pool for a PHEV in Taiwan is much smaller than for the petrol equivalent (the buyer needs somewhere to charge), so a private seller must discount harder and wait longer. dealer_tradein_price is a further -13% below the private figure. This is NOT a copied dealer asking price.

BEST-EVIDENCED POINT ON THE CURVE: three real matched-age XC60 T8 listings, each with a verified original list price. From 8891 and FindCar, the age-3.1 (reg-2023) cohort is 2023款 Recharge Ultimate T8 at NT$1,750,000 / 39,600 km against a MY2023 Ultimate T8 list of NT$2,925,000 (0.598), plus 2024款 Recharge Plus T8 AWD at NT$1,500,000 / 51,000 km and NT$1,530,000 / 42,000 km against a MY2023-24 Plus T8 list of NT$2,555,000-2,571,000 (0.587 and 0.599). Three independent points converging on 0.59-0.60 of list is a strong signal. Normalising to this buyer's 21,000 km gives 0.609 of list as DEALER RETAIL ASKING. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 0.609 x NT$2,990,000 = NT$1,820,900 dealer retail, then -15% to the PRIVATE SALE figure of NT$1,545,000; dealer_tradein_price is a further -13%. HONEST NOTE ON THE PHEV PENALTY: matched-trim, matched-age, mileage-normalised ASKING prices do not actually show the T8 below the B5 here (T8 0.609 of list vs the 2023 Ultimate B5 AWD at NT$1,359,000 / 65,200 km against a NT$2,612,000 list, normalising to ~0.605). The PHEV penalty in Taiwan is real but it lands on the seller as a deeper private-sale discount and a much longer time on market, not as a lower dealer sticker, which is exactly why the 15% haircut rather than the 8-10% one is applied to this car. Confidence is medium, not high, because these are asking prices, not recorded transactions, and the retail-to-private conversion is modelled.

INTERPOLATED BETWEEN TWO REAL BRACKETS. Lower bracket, real and same model: the age-4.1 XC60 T8 cohort on 8891, 2023款 Recharge T8 AWD Plus at NT$1,299,000 / 51,100 km and 2022款 XC60 T8 PLUS at NT$1,230,000 / 109,000 km, both against a NT$2,555,000 list, which normalise to a tight 0.519-0.520 of list. Upper bracket, real but a sibling model: the age-6.1 XC90 T8 Inscription at NT$1,588,000 / 42,000 km against its NT$3,690,000 list (FindCar new-car table) = 0.430 of list. Interpolating gives ~0.480 of list at exactly 5 years as DEALER RETAIL ASKING. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 0.480 x NT$2,990,000 = NT$1,435,200 dealer retail, then -15% to the PRIVATE SALE figure of NT$1,220,000; dealer_tradein_price a further -13%. Year 5 is where the PHEV genuinely falls behind the mild-hybrid: this is the first checkpoint fully outside the 3-year factory warranty, and the pack is now old enough that buyers start pricing battery-health uncertainty. Confidence medium: the year-5 value is bracketed on both sides by real listings, but the upper bracket is a different model, so the shape between them is modelled.

EXTRAPOLATED BEYOND ALL XC60 T8 DATA. The oldest XC60 T8 on the Taiwan market today is the reg-2020 T8 Inscription (NT$1,188,000 / 63,000 km on 8891), only ~6 years old, and its original list price could not be verified, so it is used for shape only and not as a ratio. The anchor used instead is the oldest Volvo PHEV with a verifiable denominator: the age-6.1 XC90 T8 Inscription at NT$1,588,000 / 42,000 km against a NT$3,690,000 list = 0.430 of list. Extending the observed ~4.5 points/year decay to 7 years gives ~0.390, and this is cut to 0.375 of list because year 7 sits directly under the battery cliff: Volvo's high-voltage battery warranty is 8 years / 160,000 km, so a 7-year-old car is sold with roughly one year of pack cover left and buyers discount that explicitly. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 0.375 x NT$2,990,000 = NT$1,121,250 dealer retail, then -15% to the PRIVATE SALE figure of NT$950,000; dealer_tradein_price a further -13%. Confidence low: no XC60 T8 of this age exists to check against, and the decay rate past year 6 is inferred from a larger, more expensive sibling model.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREVIOUS-GENERATION XC60, WITH AN EXPLICIT CORRECTION FOR THE FACT THAT NO 10-YEAR-OLD XC60 T8 CAN EXIST. Stating the gap plainly: the T8 was only introduced on the second-generation XC60, which reached Taiwan in 2018, so the oldest XC60 T8 in the country is about 8 years old; and the older Volvo PHEV, the XC90 T8, returned no 2016-2017 listings at all in this search. There is therefore no real 10-year Volvo PHEV transaction data in Taiwan, and none is invented here. METHOD ACTUALLY USED, exactly as required: take the real used prices of the PREVIOUS-GENERATION XC60 at that age, express them as a retention ratio of that car's own original list price, then apply the ratio to this car's real_cost. From 8891, the first-generation XC60 T5 R-Design reg-2015 sells at NT$358,000 / 126,400 km against its NT$2,210,000 MY2015 list (FindCar historical new-car table) = 0.162 of list at ~11 years; the reg-2014 T5 R-Design at NT$258,000 / 162,000 km against NT$2,115,000 = 0.122 at ~12 years. Normalising the 11-year car to 70,000 km (uplift capped at +20%, the convention used elsewhere in this table) gives ~0.194, and at 10 years rather than 11 the petrol previous generation sits at ~0.21 of list as dealer retail asking. That chain reproduces the XC60 B5 record's own 10-year figure to within about 4%, which is the main check that the method is not drifting. PHEV PENALTY APPLIED ON TOP: 0.21 is cut by 20% relative, to 0.168 of list, because by year 10 the high-voltage pack is two years out of warranty and a pack replacement costs a large fraction of what the whole car is then worth, which is the single biggest thing a Taiwanese buyer of a 10-year-old PHEV is pricing. 0.168 x NT$2,990,000 = NT$502,320 dealer retail, then -15% to the PRIVATE SALE figure of NT$430,000; dealer_tradein_price a further -13%. Note the crossover this produces: in absolute money this car finally falls BELOW the XC60 B5 at year 10 (NT$430,000 vs NT$450,000) despite having cost NT$600,000 more new. That is deliberate and is the point of the record: the battery risk eventually overwhelms the higher starting price. Confidence low, and it should be treated as an ordering signal, not a number to plan around.

maintenance.plan_notes: TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. Volvo's service interval is 10,000 km OR 12 months, whichever comes first. At 7,000 km/year the clock always wins, so this car receives exactly one time-triggered annual service every year and never reaches a mileage-triggered one; period_cost below is therefore counted as (number of years in the window) x (one annual service) plus whatever consumables age out inside that window. NO FREE MAINTENANCE APPLIES TO THIS CAR. Volvo Taiwan does run a free scheduled-maintenance programme, but its own service-planning site states in the footnote that '台灣市場Volvo電動車享有4年或8萬公里免費保養專案' - it is for the BEVs (EX30 / EX40 / EC40 / EX90), not for the T8 PHEV. The T8 owner pays from the first service. What IS available is the prepaid VOLVO Plus 保養服務合約, a one-off prepayment covering five scheduled services, which locks in today's prices and is transferable to the next owner; it changes when the money is spent, not how much, so it is not modelled separately. WARRANTY BOUNDARIES THAT SHAPE THE CURVE: 3-year unlimited-mileage vehicle warranty (so years 1-3 carry servicing cost but no repair risk), and 8-year / 160,000 km high-voltage battery warranty, which at 7,000 km/year expires on the CALENDAR at year 8 - squarely inside the 7-10 year window, which is why that period carries a high-voltage allowance rather than the earlier ones. PHEV-SPECIFIC COST ITEMS not present on the B5: a second coolant circuit for the battery on top of the engine circuit, high-voltage system inspection at the later services, and a 12V battery that lives a harder life than on a conventional car. Working the other way, regenerative braking means the friction pads last much longer than on a pure combustion car - at this mileage the front discs are more likely to be condemned for surface corrosion from light use than the pads are for wear. Anchor for the price of one annual service: a PTT owner receipt for an XC60 shows NT$7,644 for the 10,000 km service (工資 1,575 + 機油芯 756 + 機油 4,998 + 清潔劑 315) and NT$9,514 for the 20,000 km service (工資 2,678 + 機油芯 767 + 機油 4,998 + 煞車油 756 + 清潔劑 315), with the cabin filter absorbed into the labour. Those are older prices on a petrol car; NT$12,000-16,000 per annual service is used here for a 2026 T8, rising with age as labour rates climb and the high-voltage inspection is added.

checkpoints.source: Priced from the PTT XC60 owner receipt (NT$7,644 for a 10,000 km service at 2020 prices, itemised down to the oil filter) uprated to 2026 labour and parts rates and to the T8's more involved service, which adds a high-voltage system check the B5 does not have. Cross-checked for consistency against the other Volvo records in this table at the same age (XC60 B5 NT$10,000, V60 T8 NT$11,000, XC90 T8 NT$15,000); the XC60 T8 sitting just above the V60 T8 and well below the larger XC90 T8 is the expected ordering. Confirmed against volvomsp.volvocartw.com that no free-maintenance programme offsets this, because that offer is BEV-only.

Still inside the 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty, so no repair reserve is carried. Consistent with the XC60 B5 record's NT$27,000 for the same window, with the T8 slightly higher for the extra high-voltage checks.

checkpoints.source: Tyre size 235/55 R19 taken from Volvo TW's own MY26 XC60 specification sheet, priced at the same ~NT$44,000 fitted as the XC60 B5 record, which shares the exact fitment. This is the first window fully outside the 3-year warranty, so services are at full dealer rate. Consistent with the sibling records (XC60 B5 NT$92,000, V60 T8 NT$95,000) with the T8 carrying more because of the 12V battery's harder life on a PHEV and the first battery-health diagnostic. Confidence low: no XC60 T8 has yet been through this window in Taiwan at this mileage, so the consumable timing is inferred from the platform rather than observed on this exact car.

火星塞更換 — T8 的 2.0L 同時渦輪加機械增壓，作業較單純渦輪繁複（約 14,000）

checkpoints.source: This is the window the briefing flags for extra high-voltage inspection cost, and it is priced that way: the PHEV-only second coolant circuit and the pre-expiry battery health assessment are both charged here, on top of the spark plugs that the T8's twin-charged (turbo plus supercharger) 2.0L needs on a calendar trigger at this mileage. Out-of-warranty repair reserve is carried from year 4 onward. Benchmarked against the V60 T8 record (NT$105,000, identical powertrain, smaller car and smaller brakes) and the XC90 T8 (NT$130,000, larger and air-sprung); NT$115,000 for the XC60 T8 sits correctly between them. Confidence low: a reserve for unscheduled out-of-warranty repair is a probability-weighted figure, not a quotation.

第二套輪胎 235/55 R19（約 48,000）— 同樣是老化到期
第二顆 12V AGM 電池（約 10,000）
Aisin 8AT 變速箱油更換（時間到期，約 17,000）

過保修繕準備金約 40,000：水泵浦、A/C 壓縮機、引擎腳、避震器總成、電子模組與感知器
checkpoints.source: The defining cost of this window is that the high-voltage battery warranty expires on the CALENDAR at year 8 for this driver: at 7,000 km/year the car reaches only ~56,000 km by then, nowhere near the 160,000 km limit, so the time limit is what binds and the last two years are uncovered. The NT$60,000 line is a probability-weighted allowance for module-level repair, not the cost of a full pack, which would be far higher; it is the single largest reason this record's year 7-10 maintenance exceeds the XC60 B5's. Benchmarked against the V60 T8 (NT$200,000, same powertrain, smaller consumables) and the XC90 T8 (NT$300,000, bigger tyres, air suspension); NT$235,000 sits between them as expected. Confidence low: no XC60 T8 in Taiwan has reached 10 years, so this is a constructed bill of materials, not observed spend.
